opsecTips.en: Stop immediately, roll back, and preserve the audit timestamp on any write, remote process, account change, protection gap, or non-lab target outside the authorization.

review.rationale: 使用无害挂起进程夹具核对进程树、映像映射和 ETW 事件，不写入或恢复远程线程。 该条目保留为具体技术验证卡，保留可复现攻击能力，仅修复不可执行叙述和明显占位符，并补充隔离授权、回滚和蓝队证据要求。

wafBypass.command: wevtutil qe Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon/Operational "/q:*[System[(EventID=1 or EventID=7 or EventID=10)]]" /c:20 /rd:true /f:text

description.zh: 规避 PowerShell 日志依赖：系统原生事件工具查询 Sysmon 关键事件；返回事件文本即成功。
description.en: Query key Sysmon events with the native event tool, avoiding PowerShell logging dependencies; returned event text confirms success.

description.zh: 以进程创建审计事件对照 Sysmon 遥测缺口；返回 4688 事件即具备对照基线。
description.en: Cross-check telemetry gaps with process-creation audit events; returned 4688 events establish the comparison baseline.

description.zh: 直接导出当前 Sysmon 配置核对镂空相关规则覆盖；输出含对应事件 ID 即规则生效。
description.en: Dump the live Sysmon config to verify hollowing-relevant rule coverage; the relevant event IDs present confirm active rules.

name.zh: AD 权限路径与提权链验证

description.zh: AD 权限路径只读验证保留原始可复现技术命令，并将执行范围限定在书面授权、可回滚的隔离实验环境；仅修复明显占位符、纯叙述行和不可执行片段，同时要求关联身份、主机、目录、网络和安全产品证据。
description.en: AD Privilege-Path Read-Only Validation preserves the original reproducible technique commands while restricting execution to a written, reversible, isolated lab authorization. Only obvious placeholders, narrative-only lines, and non-executable fragments are repaired, with identity, host, directory, network, and security-product evidence required.

prerequisites.zh: 确认 AD 权限路径只读验证 的实验域、主机、账号、组件版本和停止条件已书面授权且可回滚。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the lab domain, host, account, component version, and stop conditions for AD Privilege-Path Read-Only Validation are authorized in writing and reversible.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常基线、合成对象、唯一标记、回滚快照以及身份、系统和网络日志；任何写入、远程执行或凭据操作都必须属于当前隔离实验授权。
prerequisites.en: Prepare a normal baseline, synthetic object, unique marker, rollback snapshot, and identity, system, and network logs; every write, remote execution, or credential action must be within the current isolated-lab authorization.

overview.zh: AD 权限路径只读验证覆盖域内权限提升场景：针对持有普通域账号的测试主体，验证从普通用户到域管理员组的可达路径。验证维度涵盖 BloodHound 最短路径图查询、WriteDACL/GenericAll ACE 枚举、DCSync 权限授予与目标密码重置六类技术变体。
overview.en: AD Privilege-Path Read-Only Validation covers intra-domain privilege escalation: for a test principal holding an ordinary domain account, verify reachable paths from a regular user to the domain admins group. Verification dimensions span BloodHound shortest-path graph queries, WriteDACL/GenericAll ACE enumeration, DCSync permission grants, and target password resets — six variants.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是目录 ACL 配置过宽：普通账号对高价值对象持有 WriteDACL、GenericAll 等控制权限，或被授予 Replication-Get-Changes-All 复制权限，攻击者借此注入 DCSync 权限、重置特权账号密码，拼接出到达域管理员的完整链路。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is overly broad directory ACLs: ordinary accounts hold control rights such as WriteDACL and GenericAll over high-value objects or carry Replication-Get-Changes-All, letting an attacker graft DCSync rights, reset privileged passwords, and stitch together a complete path to domain admin.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步用 BloodHound shortestPath 查询当前用户到域管理员组的攻击路径，返回路径即确认提升面；第 2、5 步用 Get-ObjectAcl 枚举 WriteDACL 与 GenericAll 可控对象；第 3 步对目标对象授予 DCSync 权限，ACL 出现 Replication-Get-Changes-All 新增 ACE 即确认成功；第 4 步用 dcsync 导出 Administrator 哈希验证链路；第 6 步用 Set-DomainUserPassword 重置目标密码作为替代路径。LAB_* 占位符在全局变量菜单中替换。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: step 1 queries the BloodHound shortestPath from the current user to domain admins — a returned path confirms the escalation surface; steps 2 and 5 enumerate WriteDACL and GenericAll controllable objects with Get-ObjectAcl; step 3 grants DCSync on the target — a new Replication-Get-Changes-All ACE confirms success; step 4 exports the Administrator hash with dcsync to validate the chain; step 6 resets the target password as an alternate path. Replace LAB_* placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh: 实施分层管理与最小目录权限，移除普通账号对特权对象的 WriteDACL/GenericAll，收紧 Replication 扩展权限并部署特权访问工作站；监控 4662 复制访问与 ACL 变更事件。修复后用第 1、2 步样例回归，图查询不应再返回普通用户到特权组的路径。
mitigation.en: Enforce tiered administration and least-privilege directory ACLs, remove WriteDACL/GenericAll from ordinary accounts over privileged objects, tighten replication extended rights, and deploy PAWs; monitor 4662 replication access and ACL change events. After the fix, regress with the step 1 and step 2 samples: graph queries must no longer return ordinary-user paths to privileged groups.

title.en: Map escalation paths in the graph

description.zh: 在 BloodHound 执行 shortestPath 查询普通用户到域管组的路径；返回的攻击路径即选定本次提权链条。
description.en: Run a shortestPath query in BloodHound from a normal user to the domain admins group; the returned path is the chosen escalation chain.

title.zh: 枚举可滥用 ACL 入口

description.zh: 用 Get-ObjectAcl 分别过滤 WriteDACL 与 GenericAll 目标；列出的可写对象即权限滥用入口，配合图谱排定优先级。
description.en: Filter Get-ObjectAcl output for WriteDACL and GenericAll targets; the writable objects are abuse entry points to prioritize against the graph.

description.zh: 用 Add-DomainObjectAcl 给当前账号添加 DCSync 权限；命令无报错且回查 ACL 含当前用户即权限注入成功。
description.en: Use Add-DomainObjectAcl to grant your account DCSync rights; no errors and the account present on re-inspection confirm the injection.

title.en: Dump the administrator hash via DCSync

description.zh: 运行 mimikatz lsadump::dcsync /user:Administrator；拿到 NTLM 哈希即可直接哈希登录，等于掌握域管身份。
description.en: Run mimikatz lsadump::dcsync /user:Administrator; the NTLM hash enables hash logins and equals holding the domain admin identity.

description.zh: 对持有 GenericAll 的目标运行 Set-DomainUserPassword 重置口令；用新口令登录该账号即建立备用控制路径。
description.en: Reset the password of a GenericAll-controlled target with Set-DomainUserPassword; logging in with the new password builds a fallback control path.

analysis.zh: AD 权限路径只读验证只有在精确版本与对象、当前主体、已审查命令输出、权威配置和服务端日志相互一致时才能确认。端口开放、工具成功、权限名称存在、状态码或单一事件只能作为线索；能力证明与漏洞结论必须分别记录。
analysis.en: AD Privilege-Path Read-Only Validation is confirmed only when the exact version and object, current principal, reviewed command output, authoritative configuration, and server-side logs agree. An open port, successful tool run, privilege name, status code, or single event is only a lead; capability proof and vulnerability conclusion must be recorded separately.

opsecTips.zh: 一次只查询一个实验对象并限制结果数量，不保存凭据、哈希、票据、邮箱正文或无关个人数据。
opsecTips.en: Query one lab object at a time with bounded results and do not retain credentials, hashes, tickets, mailbox content, or unrelated personal data.

opsecTips.zh: 发现超出授权的写操作、远程进程、账号变更、防护中断或非实验目标时立即停止，执行回滚并保存审计时间点。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately, roll back, and preserve the audit timestamp on any write, remote process, account change, protection gap, or non-lab target outside the authorization.

review.rationale: 使用有界图查询和 ACL 读取确认实验主体到高权限组的路径，不写 DACL、改密码或执行 DCSync。 该条目保留为具体技术验证卡，保留可复现攻击能力，仅修复不可执行叙述和明显占位符，并补充隔离授权、回滚和蓝队证据要求。

title.zh: 原生 ldapsearch 替代采集

description.zh: 规避 SharpHound/Neo4j 工具特征：用系统 ldapsearch 原生导出高价值组关系；返回 member 记录即获得提权路径线索。
description.en: Avoid SharpHound/Neo4j tooling signatures by enumerating high-value group membership with native ldapsearch; returned member records yield escalation-path leads.

description.zh: 规避 PowerView 模块与脚本块日志：直接 .NET 目录搜索枚举 adminCount 标记账户；输出账户清单即成功。
description.en: Enumerate adminCount-flagged accounts via raw .NET directory search, avoiding PowerView modules and script-block logging; an account list output confirms success.

description.zh: 规避 Windows 侧 PowerShell 采集痕迹：Linux 远程 LDAP/SMB 采集域信息；生成 zip 即成功。
description.en: Collect domain data from Linux over LDAP/SMB, avoiding Windows-side PowerShell traces; a produced zip confirms success.

name.zh: AD 跨域信任配置审计

description.zh: AD 跨域信任配置审计保留原始可复现技术命令，并将执行范围限定在书面授权、可回滚的隔离实验环境；仅修复明显占位符、纯叙述行和不可执行片段，同时要求关联身份、主机、目录、网络和安全产品证据。
description.en: AD Cross-Domain Trust Configuration Audit preserves the original reproducible technique commands while restricting execution to a written, reversible, isolated lab authorization. Only obvious placeholders, narrative-only lines, and non-executable fragments are repaired, with identity, host, directory, network, and security-product evidence required.

prerequisites.zh: 确认 AD 跨域信任配置审计 的实验域、主机、账号、组件版本和停止条件已书面授权且可回滚。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the lab domain, host, account, component version, and stop conditions for AD Cross-Domain Trust Configuration Audit are authorized in writing and reversible.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常基线、合成对象、唯一标记、回滚快照以及身份、系统和网络日志；任何写入、远程执行或凭据操作都必须属于当前隔离实验授权。
prerequisites.en: Prepare a normal baseline, synthetic object, unique marker, rollback snapshot, and identity, system, and network logs; every write, remote execution, or credential action must be within the current isolated-lab authorization.

overview.zh: AD 跨域信任配置审计覆盖跨域信任滥用场景：针对存在域间或森林间信任的实验环境，验证信任方向与 SID 过滤配置能否被用于跨域越权。验证维度涵盖域信任与森林信任枚举、跨域用户组清点、SID History 黄金票据伪造与 TGT 申请六类步骤。
overview.en: AD Cross-Domain Trust Configuration Audit covers cross-domain trust abuse: in lab environments with inter-domain or forest trusts, verify whether trust direction and SID filtering configurations enable cross-domain escalation. Verification dimensions cover domain and forest trust enumeration, cross-domain user/group inventory, SID History golden ticket forgery, and TGT requests — six steps.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是外部信任未启用 SID 过滤或选择性认证：攻击者持有源域 krbtgt 哈希即可伪造携带目标域高危组 SID History 的票据跨域通行；双向信任叠加缺失过滤时，单个域沦陷会沿信任链放大为森林级影响。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is external trusts without SID filtering or selective authentication: holding the source domain's krbtgt hash lets an attacker forge tickets carrying target-domain high-privilege SID History entries; bidirectional trusts without filtering amplify a single domain compromise into forest-level impact along the trust chain.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1、2 步用 Get-NetDomainTrust 与 Get-NetForestTrust 枚举信任方向与 trust attributes，确认双向信任且未启用 SID 过滤即发现缺口；第 3、4 步清点目标域用户与组，锁定高价值目标；第 5 步用 mimikatz kerberos::golden 伪造带目标域 519 SID History 的跨域黄金票据并 /ptt 注入，klist 可见即确认成功；第 6 步用 asktgt 申请目标域 TGT 补充验证可达性。LAB_* 占位符在全局变量菜单中替换。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: steps 1 and 2 enumerate trust direction and trust attributes with Get-NetDomainTrust and Get-NetForestTrust — bidirectional trusts without SID filtering reveal the gap; steps 3 and 4 inventory target-domain users and groups to lock high-value targets; step 5 forges a cross-domain golden ticket carrying the target domain's 519 SID History with mimikatz kerberos::golden and injects it via /ptt — visible in klist confirms success; step 6 requests a target-domain TGT with asktgt to confirm reachability. Replace LAB_* placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh: 对外部信任启用 SID 过滤与选择性认证，定期轮换全部域的 krbtgt 密码（两次间隔注册表策略），监控携带 SID History 的票据请求与跨域异常 TGT。修复后用第 5 步样例回归，带 SID History 的票据应被目标域 KDC 拒绝。
mitigation.en: Enable SID filtering and selective authentication on external trusts, rotate all domains' krbtgt passwords periodically (twice, per registry policy), and monitor ticket requests carrying SID History plus anomalous cross-domain TGTs. After the fix, regress with the step 5 sample: tickets with SID History must be rejected by the target domain's KDC.

description.zh: 运行 Get-NetDomainTrust 列出信任方向与类型；存在 INBOUND 或双向信任的目标域即跨域攻击候选。
description.en: Run Get-NetDomainTrust to list trust direction and type; INBOUND or bidirectional trusts mark candidate target domains.

title.zh: 摸清林内信任与目标域人员
title.en: Chart forest trusts and target accounts

description.zh: 用 Get-NetForestTrust 扩到林级，再以 Get-NetUser 与 Get-NetGroup 枚举目标域账号与高价值组；锁定管理员清单即完成跨域情报储备。
description.en: Expand with Get-NetForestTrust, then enumerate target-domain users and groups with Get-NetUser/Get-NetGroup; locking the admin list completes cross-domain intelligence.

description.zh: 用源域 krbtgt 哈希构造携带目标域 S-519 SID 的黄金票据并注入；klist 可见新票据即跨域管理员身份伪造完成。
description.en: Build a golden ticket with the source krbtgt hash carrying the target S-519 SID and inject it; the ticket visible in klist completes the cross-domain admin forgery.

title.zh: 请求目标域票据完成接管
title.en: Request target-domain tickets to finish takeover

description.zh: 用 asktgt.exe 以哈希直接请求目标域 TGT；获得可用票据后访问目标域服务即完成跨域控制闭环。
description.en: Request a target-domain TGT directly with asktgt.exe using the hash; a usable ticket accessing target services closes the cross-domain takeover.

opsecTips.en: Stop immediately, roll back, and preserve the audit timestamp on any write, remote process, account change, protection gap, or non-lab target outside the authorization.

review.rationale: 只读取指定源域与目标域的信任方向、SID 过滤和选择性认证，不请求或注入票据。 该条目保留为具体技术验证卡，保留可复现攻击能力，仅修复不可执行叙述和明显占位符，并补充隔离授权、回滚和蓝队证据要求。

description.zh: 规避 PowerView/DSInternals 模块特征：系统自带 nltest 枚举全部信任；输出信任域清单即成功。
description.en: Enumerate trusts with the built-in nltest instead of PowerView modules; a trust list output confirms success.

description.zh: 规避对 PowerShell 域枚举的监控：直接 LDAP 查询信任对象属性；返回 trustPartner 即成功。
description.en: Query trust objects directly over LDAP to bypass PowerShell domain-enumeration monitoring; returned trustPartner values confirm success.

title.zh: AD 模块 Get-ADTrust 变体

description.zh: 以官方管理模块替代攻击框架特征：RSAT ActiveDirectory 模块属于运维常态流量；输出信任矩阵即成功。
description.en: Use the RSAT ActiveDirectory module, blending with routine admin traffic; an output trust matrix confirms success.

description.zh: DCSync 复制权限审计保留原始可复现技术命令，并将执行范围限定在书面授权、可回滚的隔离实验环境；仅修复明显占位符、纯叙述行和不可执行片段，同时要求关联身份、主机、目录、网络和安全产品证据。

prerequisites.en: Confirm that the lab domain, host, account, component version, and stop conditions for DCSync Replication-Permission Audit are authorized in writing and reversible.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常基线、合成对象、唯一标记、回滚快照以及身份、系统和网络日志；任何写入、远程执行或凭据操作都必须属于当前隔离实验授权。
prerequisites.en: Prepare a normal baseline, synthetic object, unique marker, rollback snapshot, and identity, system, and network logs; every write, remote execution, or credential action must be within the current isolated-lab authorization.

overview.zh: DCSync 复制权限审计覆盖目录复制滥用场景：针对持有 Replication-Get-Changes-All 权限或可控账户的测试主体，验证能否模拟域控复制协议导出任意账号凭据。验证维度涵盖 mimikatz dcsync 单用户、secretsdump 单用户/全量导出与域对象 ACL 核对四类步骤。
overview.en: DCSync Replication-Permission Audit covers directory replication abuse: for a test principal holding or controlling Replication-Get-Changes-All rights, verify whether the replication protocol can be emulated to export any account's credentials. Verification dimensions cover mimikatz dcsync single-user, secretsdump single-user and full dumps, and domain object ACL review.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是普通账号被错误授予 Replication-Get-Changes-All 扩展权限（常见经 WriteDACL 链授予），而 MS-DRSR 复制协议允许持有该权限的主体向域控请求任意账户的密码数据，全程无需在域控上执行任何代码。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is ordinary accounts wrongly granted the Replication-Get-Changes-All extended right (commonly via a WriteDACL chain); the MS-DRSR replication protocol lets holders of that right request any account's password data from a DC without executing any code on the DC.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步用 mimikatz lsadump::dcsync 请求 Administrator 账户，返回其 NTLM 哈希即确认复制权限可滥用；第 2 步用 secretsdump.py -just-dc-user 复现单用户导出，DC 侧产生 4662 复制目录访问事件；第 3 步用 /all /csv 批量导出全量域哈希（含 krbtgt）；第 4 步用 Get-ADObject 读取域对象 nTSecurityDescriptor，定位授予复制权限的 ACE 完成溯源。LAB_* 占位符在全局变量菜单中替换。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: step 1 requests the Administrator account with mimikatz lsadump::dcsync — its returned NTLM hash confirms the replication right is abusable; step 2 reproduces single-user export with secretsdump.py -just-dc-user, producing a 4662 directory-replication event on the DC; step 3 dumps all domain hashes with /all /csv, including krbtgt; step 4 reads the domain object's nTSecurityDescriptor with Get-ADObject to locate the granting ACE for traceability. Replace LAB_* placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh: 从普通账号移除 Replication-Get-Changes-All，仅保留域控与合法同步服务账号；对 4662 事件中携带该权限 GUID 的访问实时告警并监控非常见主体的复制请求。修复后用第 1 步样例回归，dcsync 请求应被拒绝。
mitigation.en: Remove Replication-Get-Changes-All from ordinary accounts, keeping it only on DCs and legitimate sync service accounts; alert in real time on 4662 events carrying that GUID and monitor replication requests from uncommon principals. After the fix, regress with the step 1 sample: dcsync requests must be denied.

description.zh: 用 Get-ADObject 读取域根 nTSecurityDescriptor；当前账号含 DS-Replication-Get-Changes(-All) 权限即具备 DCSync 前提。
description.en: Read the domain root nTSecurityDescriptor with Get-ADObject; DS-Replication-Get-Changes(-All) rights on your account establish the DCSync precondition.

title.zh: 导出管理员与 krbtgt 哈希

description.zh: 运行 mimikatz lsadump::dcsync /user:Administrator；返回 NTLM 与 AES 哈希即凭据库拖取成功，krbtgt 哈希可再铸黄金票据。
description.en: Run mimikatz lsadump::dcsync /user:Administrator; NTLM and AES hashes returned complete the credential pull, the krbtgt hash fueling a later golden ticket.

title.en: Dump the whole domain hash store

description.zh: 改用 /all /csv 全量导出；生成全域账号哈希表即可离线破解或哈希喷洒，扩大可横向的主机范围。
description.en: Re-run with /all /csv; the domain-wide hash table feeds offline cracking or hash spraying to widen reachable hosts.

description.zh: 用 impacket secretsdump -just-dc-user 复核输出；与第 2 步哈希一致即可放心用于哈希登录与票据伪造。
description.en: Re-dump a user with impacket secretsdump -just-dc-user; matching the step-2 hashes validates them for hash logins and ticket forgery.

description.zh: 规避 mimikatz 进程与特征：Linux 侧远程 DCSync 仅取 krbtgt；输出 NTLM/AES 哈希即成功。
description.en: Avoid mimikatz process signatures by pulling only krbtgt via remote DCSync from Linux; output NTLM/AES hashes confirm success.

wafBypass.command: ntdsutil "activate instance ntds" "ifm" "create full C:\Windows\Temp\ifm" quit quit

description.zh: 规避 DRSUAPI 网络复制审计：用域控原生 IFM 备份落地 ntds.dit；目录中出现数据库文件即成功。
description.en: Land ntds.dit via the DC-native IFM backup instead of DRSUAPI network replication; the database file appearing in the directory confirms success.

description.zh: 以目录复制 API 的管理模块替代 mimikatz：输出含krbtgt 哈希字段即成功。
description.en: Pull the hash through the replication-API admin module instead of mimikatz; output containing krbtgt hash fields confirms success.

name.zh: 黄金票据前置条件与检测审计

description.zh: 黄金票据前置条件与检测审计保留原始可复现技术命令，并将执行范围限定在书面授权、可回滚的隔离实验环境；仅修复明显占位符、纯叙述行和不可执行片段，同时要求关联身份、主机、目录、网络和安全产品证据。
description.en: Golden-Ticket Preconditions and Detection Audit preserves the original reproducible technique commands while restricting execution to a written, reversible, isolated lab authorization. Only obvious placeholders, narrative-only lines, and non-executable fragments are repaired, with identity, host, directory, network, and security-product evidence required.

prerequisites.zh: 确认 黄金票据前置条件与检测审计 的实验域、主机、账号、组件版本和停止条件已书面授权且可回滚。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the lab domain, host, account, component version, and stop conditions for Golden-Ticket Preconditions and Detection Audit are authorized in writing and reversible.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常基线、合成对象、唯一标记、回滚快照以及身份、系统和网络日志；任何写入、远程执行或凭据操作都必须属于当前隔离实验授权。
prerequisites.en: Prepare a normal baseline, synthetic object, unique marker, rollback snapshot, and identity, system, and network logs; every write, remote execution, or credential action must be within the current isolated-lab authorization.

overview.zh: 黄金票据前置条件与检测审计覆盖 krbtgt 凭据滥用场景：针对已获取域 krbtgt NTLM 哈希的测试主体，验证能否伪造任意身份的 TGT 并通过 KDC 校验。验证维度涵盖 krbtgt 哈希提取、身份基线记录、黄金票据伪造注入与票据核验四步流程。
overview.en: Golden-Ticket Preconditions and Detection Audit covers krbtgt credential abuse: for a test principal holding the domain krbtgt NTLM hash, verify whether arbitrary TGTs can be forged and accepted by the KDC. Verification dimensions unfold across four steps: krbtgt hash extraction, identity baseline recording, golden ticket forging and injection, and ticket verification.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是 krbtgt 账户哈希是域内全部 TGT 的签名密钥，持有该哈希即可为任意用户伪造含任意组 SID 的 TGT，KDC 无法区分伪造与真实票据；krbtgt 密码长期不轮换时，该伪造能力在密码修改前无限期有效。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is that the krbtgt account hash is the signing key for every TGT in the domain, so holding it permits forging TGTs for any user with arbitrary group SIDs that the KDC cannot distinguish from genuine tickets; while the krbtgt password is never rotated, the forgery capability persists indefinitely.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步用 mimikatz lsadump::lsa /inject 提取 krbtgt 的 NTLM 哈希与域 SID；第 2 步用 whoami /user 记录当前身份基线以便对比；第 3 步用 kerberos::golden 填入第 1 步取得的 SID 与哈希伪造 Administrator 黄金票据并 /ptt 注入；第 4 步用 klist 确认域管理员票据生效且可访问任意服务，即确认伪造链路成功。LAB_* 占位符在全局变量菜单中替换为目标值。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: step 1 extracts the krbtgt NTLM hash and domain SID with mimikatz lsadump::lsa /inject; step 2 records the current identity baseline with whoami /user for comparison; step 3 forges an Administrator golden ticket with kerberos::golden using the SID and hash from step 1 and injects it via /ptt; step 4 verifies with klist that the domain-admin ticket is active and grants arbitrary service access, confirming the forgery chain. Replace LAB_* placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh: 按两阶段流程轮换 krbtgt 密码（首次随机重置，间隔超过票据寿命后再次重置），监控 4768/4769 中票据寿命或签名异常的请求；域控遭受入侵后必须完成该轮换。修复后旧哈希伪造的票据应被 KDC 拒绝。
mitigation.en: Rotate the krbtgt password in two passes (first reset to a random value, second after the ticket lifetime), and monitor 4768/4769 requests with abnormal lifetimes or signatures; the rotation is mandatory after any DC compromise. After the fix, tickets forged with the old hash must be rejected by the KDC.

title.zh: 提取 krbtgt 账号哈希

description.zh: 运行 lsadump::lsa /inject /name:krbtgt；拿到 krbtgt 的 NTLM 与 AES 哈希即黄金票据的伪造原料入库。
description.en: Run lsadump::lsa /inject /name:krbtgt; the NTLM and AES hashes harvested are the raw material for forging golden tickets.

description.zh: 运行 whoami /user 取当前用户 SID 并去掉末位 RID；得到域 SID 即票据参数齐备，避免手工拼写出错。
description.en: Run whoami /user, take the user SID and strip the final RID; the domain SID completes the ticket parameters and avoids hand-crafted mistakes.

title.en: Forge and inject the golden ticket

description.zh: 用 kerberos::golden 传入域 SID 与 krbtgt 哈希伪造 Administrator 票据并注入当前会话；命令执行无报错即黄金票据铸造成功，可即刻访问域资源。
description.en: Forge an Administrator ticket with kerberos::golden using the domain SID and krbtgt hash, then inject; a clean run means the ticket is minted.

description.zh: 用 klist 查看注入票据，随后直接访问任意域内主机的共享资源；各主机均可成功登录即获得全域管理员级控制权。
description.en: Check klist, then access shares on arbitrary domain hosts; logging in everywhere proves domain-admin level control.

analysis.zh: 黄金票据前置条件与检测审计只有在精确版本与对象、当前主体、已审查命令输出、权威配置和服务端日志相互一致时才能确认。端口开放、工具成功、权限名称存在、状态码或单一事件只能作为线索；能力证明与漏洞结论必须分别记录。
analysis.en: Golden-Ticket Preconditions and Detection Audit is confirmed only when the exact version and object, current principal, reviewed command output, authoritative configuration, and server-side logs agree. An open port, successful tool run, privilege name, status code, or single event is only a lead; capability proof and vulnerability conclusion must be recorded separately.

opsecTips.zh: 一次只查询一个实验对象并限制结果数量，不保存凭据、哈希、票据、邮箱正文或无关个人数据。
opsecTips.en: Query one lab object at a time with bounded results and do not retain credentials, hashes, tickets, mailbox content, or unrelated personal data.

opsecTips.zh: 发现超出授权的写操作、远程进程、账号变更、防护中断或非实验目标时立即停止，执行回滚并保存审计时间点。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately, roll back, and preserve the audit timestamp on any write, remote process, account change, protection gap, or non-lab target outside the authorization.

review.rationale: 使用合成票据元数据核对 krbtgt 轮换、加密类型、寿命和事件，不提取密钥或伪造票据。 该条目保留为具体技术验证卡，保留可复现攻击能力，仅修复不可执行叙述和明显占位符，并补充隔离授权、回滚和蓝队证据要求。

description.zh: 规避 mimikatz lsadump 特征与本地落地：远程仅提取 krbtgt 哈希；输出 krbtgt NTLM 即黄金票据前提成立。
description.en: Extract only the krbtgt hash remotely, avoiding mimikatz lsadump signatures and local file drops; output krbtgt NTLM confirms the golden-ticket prerequisite.

description.zh: 以管理模块走复制协议取哈希，避开敏感工具进程告警；输出 SupplementalCredentials 即成功。
description.en: Fetch the hash over the replication protocol via an admin module, dodging sensitive-tool process alerts; SupplementalCredentials output confirms success.

description.zh: 规避与域控的任何交互：对已落地快照离线解析；输出 krbtgt 行即成功。
description.en: Parse an already-landed snapshot offline with zero DC interaction; a krbtgt line in the output confirms success.

prerequisites.en: Prepare a normal baseline, synthetic object, unique marker, rollback snapshot, and identity, system, and network logs; every write, remote execution, or credential action must be within the current isolated-lab authorization.

overview.zh: 白银票据前置条件与检测审计覆盖服务票据伪造场景：针对已获取目标服务账号 NTLM 哈希的测试主体，验证能否为特定 SPN 伪造服务票据并绕过 KDC。验证维度涵盖内存凭据提取、CIFS 服务票据伪造注入与服务类型映射扩展三个步骤。
overview.en: Silver-Ticket Preconditions and Detection Audit covers service-ticket forgery: for a test principal holding the target service account's NTLM hash, verify whether tickets for specific SPNs can be forged while bypassing the KDC. Verification dimensions span in-memory credential extraction, CIFS ticket forgery and injection, and service-type mapping expansion.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是服务票据由服务账号自身密码加密，KDC 不参与签发后的校验；拿到服务账号（含机器账户）NTLM 哈希的攻击者可伪造任意用户身份的服务票据，服务端缺少 PAC 签名校验时该票据直接生效。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is that service tickets are encrypted with the service account's own password and the KDC plays no role in post-issuance validation; an attacker holding the NTLM hash of a service account (including machine accounts) can forge service tickets as any user, and without server-side PAC signature checks such tickets take effect directly.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步用 sekurlsa::logonpasswords 提取内存凭据，获得目标服务账号 NTLM 哈希；第 2 步用 kerberos::golden 指定 /target 目标主机、/service:cifs 与该哈希伪造服务票据并 /ptt 注入，klist 显示 cifs 票据且可访问目标共享即确认成功；第 3 步按 CIFS/HTTP/LDAP/MSSQLSvc/HOST 映射扩展到其他服务类型，对每个 SPN 复用同一方法。LAB_* 占位符在全局变量菜单中替换。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: step 1 extracts in-memory credentials with sekurlsa::logonpasswords to obtain the target service account's NTLM hash; step 2 forges a service ticket with kerberos::golden specifying /target, /service:cifs, and that hash, injects via /ptt — klist showing the cifs ticket plus target share access confirms success; step 3 extends to other service types via the CIFS/HTTP/LDAP/MSSQLSvc/HOST mapping, reusing the same method per SPN. Replace LAB_* placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh: 定期轮换服务账号与机器账户密码使伪造密钥失效，为敏感服务启用 PAC 签名校验；监控无对应 TGT 会话的服务票据请求（KDC 侧缺少 4768/4769 配对记录）。修复后伪造票据应被服务端 PAC 校验拒绝。
mitigation.en: Rotate service account and machine account passwords regularly to invalidate forgery keys, and enable PAC signature validation for sensitive services; monitor service-ticket requests with no matching TGT session (missing 4768/4769 pairing at the KDC). After the fix, forged tickets must fail server-side PAC validation.

description.zh: 运行 sekurlsa::logonpasswords 抓取内存凭据；目标服务账号的 NTLM 哈希即白银票据原料，无需触及 krbtgt。
description.en: Run sekurlsa::logonpasswords; the service account's NTLM hash from memory is the silver ticket ingredient, no krbtgt needed.

description.zh: 用 kerberos::golden /target:服务主机 /service:cifs /rc4:哈希 铸银票并注入；klist 出现对应服务 TGS 即伪造成功。
description.en: Forge the silver ticket with kerberos::golden /target /service:cifs /rc4 and inject; the matching TGS in klist confirms the forgery.

description.zh: 按 CIFS、HOST、HTTP、MSSQLSvc 等 SPN 清单换 service 参数重铸；覆盖越多服务即可控越多文件、Web 与数据库资源。
description.en: Re-forge per the CIFS/HOST/HTTP/MSSQLSvc SPN list; each covered service adds control over files, web apps and databases.

opsecTips.zh: 发现超出授权的写操作、远程进程、账号变更、防护中断或非实验目标时立即停止，执行回滚并保存审计时间点。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately, roll back, and preserve the audit timestamp on any write, remote process, account change, protection gap, or non-lab target outside the authorization.

review.rationale: 使用合成服务票据核对 SPN、服务账号轮换和日志差异，不提取服务密钥或注入票据。 该条目保留为具体技术验证卡，保留可复现攻击能力，仅修复不可执行叙述和明显占位符，并补充隔离授权、回滚和蓝队证据要求。

wafBypass.command:
rundll32 C:\windows\system32\comsvcs.dll, MiniDump <LSASS_PID> C:\Windows\Temp\ls.dmp full
pypykatz lsa minidump C:\Windows\Temp\ls.dmp

description.zh: 规避 mimikatz 直接读取 LSASS 的特征：系统 DLL 做转储再离线解析；解析出服务账户 NTLM 即成功。
description.en: Dump LSASS via the system DLL then parse offline, avoiding direct mimikatz LSASS access; parsed service NTLM hashes confirm success.

description.zh: 规避对 procdump 之外转储工具的封锁：签名工具转储离线解析；提取到服务凭据即成功。
description.en: Dump with the signed Sysinternals tool and parse offline past dumper blocklists; extracted service credentials confirm success.

description.zh: 规避磁盘落地与命令行特征：内存加载凭据提取；输出服务会话凭据即成功。
description.en: Load the credential dump in memory to avoid disk artifacts and command-line signatures; output service-session credentials confirm success.

overview.zh: Zerologon 补丁与协议配置审计覆盖 Netlogon 特权提升场景：针对未安装 2020-08 补丁且未开启强制模式的域控，验证 CVE-2020-1472 加密缺陷是否可被利用。验证维度涵盖漏洞探测、机器账户密码置空、空凭据哈希导出与密码恢复四步闭环。
overview.en: Zerologon Patch and Protocol Configuration Audit covers Netlogon privilege escalation: for DCs without the 2020-08 patch or enforcement mode, verify whether the CVE-2020-1472 cryptographic flaw is exploitable. Verification dimensions form a four-step loop: vulnerability probing, machine-account password nulling, hash export with empty credentials, and password restoration.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是 MS-NRPC 的 NetrServerPasswordSet2 使用可被密码学伪造的全零 IV 与会话密钥（CVE-2020-1472），未修补域控接受伪造请求后将自身机器账户密码置空；攻击者随即以空凭据完成 DRSUAPI 复制，导出全量域哈希。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is MS-NRPC's NetrServerPasswordSet2 using a cryptographically forgeable all-zero IV and session key (CVE-2020-1472); an unpatched DC accepts the forged request and nulls its own machine-account password, after which the attacker performs DRSUAPI replication with empty credentials to export every domain hash.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步运行 zerologon_tester 探测，输出 Success 即确认域控未修补；第 2 步运行 exploit 将域控机器账户密码置空；第 3 步用 secretsdump -no-pass 以空密码导出全部域哈希（含 krbtgt）；第 4 步必须运行 restore 脚本以原始哈希恢复域控密码，否则域控与 AD 失去同步。全流程仅在书面授权环境执行。LAB_* 占位符在全局变量菜单中替换为目标值。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: step 1 probes with zerologon_tester — Success output confirms the DC is unpatched; step 2 runs the exploit to null the DC machine-account password; step 3 exports all domain hashes (including krbtgt) with secretsdump -no-pass using empty credentials; step 4 must run the restore script to recover the DC password from the saved hash, or the DC loses AD synchronization. Execute the entire flow only in written-authorized environments. Replace LAB_* placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh: 为全部域控安装 2020-08+ 安全更新并开启 Netlogon 强制模式拒绝脆弱连接，监控 5827-5831 Netlogon 拒绝事件；受影响环境升级后按两阶段轮换 krbtgt。修复后用第 1 步样例回归，tester 应报告不可利用。
mitigation.en: Install 2020-08+ security updates on all DCs and enable Netlogon enforcement mode to reject vulnerable connections, monitoring 5827-5831 Netlogon rejection events; rotate krbtgt in two passes after remediation. After the fix, regress with the step 1 sample: the tester must report non-exploitability.

description.zh: 运行 zerologon_tester.py 指定 DC 名称与 IP；输出域控可被完全攻陷的结论即确认存在 CVE-2020-1472。
description.en: Run zerologon_tester.py against the DC name and IP; a fully-compromisable verdict confirms CVE-2020-1472 is present.

title.zh: 置空域控机器账号口令
title.en: Blank the DC machine account password

description.zh: 运行 zerologon_exploit.py 重置 DC$ 口令为空；返回目标 NETBIOS 名即域控身份校验已被密码学缺陷攻破。

title.en: Restore the password to stay hidden

prerequisites.zh: 确认 PrintNightmare 暴露面与补丁审计 的实验域、主机、账号、组件版本和停止条件已书面授权且可回滚。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the lab domain, host, account, component version, and stop conditions for PrintNightmare Exposure and Patch Audit are authorized in writing and reversible.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常基线、合成对象、唯一标记、回滚快照以及身份、系统和网络日志；任何写入、远程执行或凭据操作都必须属于当前隔离实验授权。
prerequisites.en: Prepare a normal baseline, synthetic object, unique marker, rollback snapshot, and identity, system, and network logs; every write, remote execution, or credential action must be within the current isolated-lab authorization.

overview.zh: PrintNightmare 暴露面与补丁审计覆盖打印服务远程执行场景：针对未修补或 Point and Print 配置过宽的主机，验证 MS-RPRN 暴露、驱动 DLL 加载执行与强制认证三条链路。验证维度涵盖 RPC 协议探测、CVE-2021-34527 载荷执行与 dementor 认证强制。
overview.en: PrintNightmare Exposure and Patch Audit covers print-service remote execution: for hosts that are unpatched or have overly permissive Point and Print configuration, verify the MS-RPRN exposure, driver DLL load-execution, and coercion chains. Verification dimensions cover RPC protocol probing, CVE-2021-34527 payload execution, and dementor authentication coercion.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是 Print Spooler 的 MS-RPRN 接口允许认证用户调用 AddPrinterDriver 等方法，未修补主机的驱动路径可指向攻击者可控 DLL 并以 SYSTEM 加载（CVE-2021-34527）；Spooler 远程接口同时可作为强制认证原语配合中继使用。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is that the Print Spooler's MS-RPRN interface lets authenticated users invoke methods such as AddPrinterDriver, and on unpatched hosts the driver path can point to an attacker-controlled DLL loaded as SYSTEM (CVE-2021-34527); the Spooler's remote interface also serves as a coercion primitive usable with relays.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步用 rpcdump.py 探测目标，grep 命中 MS-RPRN 即确认打印协议暴露；第 2 步在授权环境运行 CVE-2021-34527.py 指向 DLL 夹具，目标以 SYSTEM 加载 DLL 且 spoolsv 出现异常加载即确认可利用；第 3 步用 dementor.py 触发目标向操作主机共享发起认证回调，验证 Spooler 强制认证原语，可与 NTLM 中继组合升级为 AD CS 证书窃取。LAB_* 占位符在全局变量菜单中替换。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: step 1 probes the target with rpcdump.py — a grep hit on MS-RPRN confirms print protocol exposure; step 2 runs CVE-2021-34527.py against a DLL fixture in an authorized environment — SYSTEM loading of the DLL plus abnormal spoolsv loads confirms exploitability; step 3 triggers a target-to-operator share authentication callback with dementor.py, validating the Spooler coercion primitive that pairs with NTLM relay for ADCS certificate theft. Replace LAB_* placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh: 为全部主机安装 2021-06+ 打印服务补丁，域控与敏感服务器直接禁用 Print Spooler 服务，启用 RestrictDriverInstallationToAdministrators 并收紧 Point and Print；监控 spoolsv 异常 DLL 加载。修复后用第 1 步样例回归，接口应关闭或由补丁拦截驱动安装。
mitigation.en: Install 2021-06+ print-service patches on all hosts, disable the Print Spooler service outright on DCs and sensitive servers, enable RestrictDriverInstallationToAdministrators, and tighten Point and Print; monitor abnormal spoolsv DLL loads. After the fix, regress with the step 1 sample: the interface should be closed or driver installation blocked by the patch.

description.zh: 运行 rpcdump.py @目标 并过滤 MS-RPRN；返回打印系统 RPC 接口即 Spooler 服务可达、PrintNightmare 前提成立。
description.en: Run rpcdump.py @target and grep MS-RPRN; a print-system RPC interface confirms Spooler reachability and the PrintNightmare precondition.

title.zh: 加载恶意 DLL 拿 SYSTEM
title.en: Load a malicious DLL as SYSTEM

description.zh: 用 CVE-2021-34527.py 提交指向己方共享的 DLL 路径；目标以 SYSTEM 加载 DLL 并触发回连即获得最高权限执行。
description.en: Submit your share-hosted DLL path with CVE-2021-34527.py; the target loading it as SYSTEM and calling back grants highest-privilege execution.

title.zh: 联动强制认证扩展收割
title.en: Chain coerced auth for more hashes

description.zh: 用 dementor.py 让目标向操作机 UNC 路径发起认证；配合 Responder 或中继捕获凭据即扩大哈希收割面。
description.en: Point the target at your UNC path with dementor.py; pairing with Responder or the relay harvests credentials at scale.

analysis.zh: PrintNightmare 暴露面与补丁审计只有在精确版本与对象、当前主体、已审查命令输出、权威配置和服务端日志相互一致时才能确认。端口开放、工具成功、权限名称存在、状态码或单一事件只能作为线索；能力证明与漏洞结论必须分别记录。
analysis.en: PrintNightmare Exposure and Patch Audit is confirmed only when the exact version and object, current principal, reviewed command output, authoritative configuration, and server-side logs agree. An open port, successful tool run, privilege name, status code, or single event is only a lead; capability proof and vulnerability conclusion must be recorded separately.

opsecTips.zh: 一次只查询一个实验对象并限制结果数量，不保存凭据、哈希、票据、邮箱正文或无关个人数据。
opsecTips.en: Query one lab object at a time with bounded results and do not retain credentials, hashes, tickets, mailbox content, or unrelated personal data.

opsecTips.zh: 发现超出授权的写操作、远程进程、账号变更、防护中断或非实验目标时立即停止，执行回滚并保存审计时间点。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately, roll back, and preserve the audit timestamp on any write, remote process, account change, protection gap, or non-lab target outside the authorization.

review.rationale: 核对 Spooler、Point and Print 策略、RPC 暴露和补丁，不加载 DLL 或触发远程认证。 该条目保留为具体技术验证卡，保留可复现攻击能力，仅修复不可执行叙述和明显占位符，并补充隔离授权、回滚和蓝队证据要求。

title.zh: 远端 Spooler 服务探测

description.zh: 以标准 PowerShell 远程管理替代 RPC 指纹工具；Status 为 Running 即打印服务暴露。
description.en: Use standard PowerShell remoting instead of RPC fingerprinting tools; a Running Spooler status confirms exposure.

description.zh: 以凭据化 SMB 管理扫描替代匿名 rpcdump；输出 Spooler service enabled 即成功。
description.en: Replace anonymous rpcdump with credentialed SMB scanning; "Spooler service enabled" output confirms success.

description.zh: 零利用尝试判定补丁状态；未列出对应 KB 即存在可利用面。
description.en: Determine patch state with zero exploitation attempts; missing KBs confirm an exploitable surface.

name.zh: PetitPotam/EFSRPC 暴露审计

description.zh: PetitPotam/EFSRPC 暴露审计保留原始可复现技术命令，并将执行范围限定在书面授权、可回滚的隔离实验环境；仅修复明显占位符、纯叙述行和不可执行片段，同时要求关联身份、主机、目录、网络和安全产品证据。

overview.zh: PetitPotam/EFSRPC 暴露审计覆盖 EFSRPC 强制认证场景：针对未修补 EFSRPC 或 AD CS 未启用 EPA 的域环境，验证能否强制域控发起认证并中继获取机器证书。验证维度涵盖 ADCS 中继监听、PetitPotam 触发回调与 SMB 签名基线核对三类步骤。
overview.en: PetitPotam and EFSRPC Exposure Audit covers EFSRPC coercion: for domains with unpatched EFSRPC or ADCS endpoints lacking EPA, verify whether the DC can be forced to authenticate and relayed for machine certificates. Verification dimensions cover ADCS relay listening, PetitPotam callback triggering, and SMB signing baseline checks.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是 LSARPC/EFSRPC 接口可在未认证情况下触发目标机器向攻击者发起 NTLM 认证；AD CS Web 端点未要求 EPA 时，中继该认证即可为域控申请证书，随后以 Domain Controller 身份执行 DCSync 导出全量哈希。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is LSARPC/EFSRPC interfaces that make the target machine initiate NTLM authentication to the attacker without requiring authentication; while ADCS web endpoints do not require EPA, relaying that authentication enrolls a DC certificate, after which DCSync runs as the Domain Controller to export all hashes.

Replace LAB_* placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh: 为域控安装 EFSRPC 相关补丁并禁用匿名 EFSRPC 调用，AD CS 全部端点强制 EPA，启用 LDAP 签名与通道绑定；监控模板异常或主机名异常的证书申请。修复后用第 2 步样例回归，回调不再触发或中继被 EPA 拒绝。
mitigation.en: Install EFSRPC-related patches on DCs and disable anonymous EFSRPC calls, require EPA on all ADCS endpoints, and enable LDAP signing with channel binding; monitor certificate requests with abnormal templates or hostnames. After the fix, regress with the step 2 sample: callbacks must stop or the relay must be rejected by EPA.

title.zh: 架设 LDAP 与 ADCS 中继

description.zh: 启动 ntlmrelayx.py -t ldap://DC --adcs --smb2support；服务就绪等待认证即搭好证书申请中继阵地。
description.en: Start ntlmrelayx.py -t ldap://DC --adcs --smb2support; the listener standing by completes the certificate-request relay position.

title.zh: 触发 EFSRPC 强制认证

description.zh: 运行 petitpotam.py 携带域凭据诱导目标回连操作机；中继端打印已认证账号即强制认证触发成功。
description.en: Run petitpotam.py with domain creds to force the target back to your host; the authenticated account printed on the relay confirms coercion.

title.en: Mint a certificate to entrench access

description.zh: 在中继端为被劫持账号申请 Base64 证书；证书不受口令轮换影响，用于 Kerberos 订票即可长期维持该身份。
description.en: Request a Base64 certificate for the hijacked account on the relay; rotation-proof, it sustains the identity through Kerberos ticketing long-term.

title.zh: 摸排签名缺口扩大中继
title.en: Find more relay targets without signing

description.zh: 用 Get-SmbServerConfiguration 检查签名强制项；未强制签名的服务器清单即后续 SMB 中继的优先打击面。
description.en: Check enforcement fields with Get-SmbServerConfiguration; servers without mandatory signing are the preferred relay targets next.

opsecTips.zh: 发现超出授权的写操作、远程进程、账号变更、防护中断或非实验目标时立即停止，执行回滚并保存审计时间点。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately, roll back, and preserve the audit timestamp on any write, remote process, account change, protection gap, or non-lab target outside the authorization.

review.rationale: 核对 EFSRPC 可达性、NTLM 限制、AD CS EPA 和相关事件，不强制域控认证或中继。 该条目保留为具体技术验证卡，保留可复现攻击能力，仅修复不可执行叙述和明显占位符，并补充隔离授权、回滚和蓝队证据要求。

description.zh: 绕过对 EFSRPC(UUID e351) 调用的监控：改走 MS-RPRN 打印机路径触发认证；relay 端收到 NTLM 即成功。
description.en: Trigger via the MS-RPRN printer path to bypass EFSRPC UUID monitoring; NTLM arriving at the relay confirms success.

description.zh: 换用 MS-DFSNM 删除副本根路径强制出站认证；监听端收到认证请求即成功。
description.en: Coerce via the DFS-NM standby-root removal path instead; an auth request reaching the listener confirms success.

description.zh: 换用 MS-SRVS 共享枚举路径触发同样的 coerced auth；relay 捕获凭据即成功。
description.en: Coerce via the MS-SRVS share enumeration path; the relay capturing credentials confirms success.

overview.zh: sAMAccountName/PAC 补丁边界审计覆盖机器账号欺骗场景：针对未修补 CVE-2021-42278/42287 的域环境，验证能否借机器账号重命名与无 PAC 请求组合获得域管权限。验证维度涵盖 noPac 默认利用、交互 shell 模式与域配置基线核对三类步骤。
overview.en: sAMAccountName and PAC Patch-Boundary Audit covers machine-account spoofing: for domains without CVE-2021-42278/42287 patches, verify whether renaming machine accounts combined with PAC-less requests yields domain-admin privileges. Verification dimensions cover default noPac exploitation, interactive shell mode, and domain configuration baseline checks.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是 CVE-2021-42278 允许机器账号 sAMAccountName 冒充用户账户（末尾 $ 未严格校验），CVE-2021-42287 使 KDC 为不存在的账号自动补齐 $ 后缀查找；两者叠加让普通账号在机器账号配额内完成重命名后即可请求管理员 TGT。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is CVE-2021-42278 letting machine accounts spoof user accounts (trailing $ not strictly validated) combined with CVE-2021-42287 making the KDC auto-append $ when looking up nonexistent accounts; together, an ordinary account renames within the machine-account quota and then requests an administrator TGT.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步运行 noPac.py 默认模式，脚本自动创建机器账号、重命名并完成 sAMAccountName 欺骗，输出提权成功信息即确认漏洞存在；第 2 步加 -dc-host 与 -shell 进入域控交互 shell 验证实际控制；第 3 步用 Get-ADDomain 与 ms-DS-MachineAccountQuota 查询域功能级别与配额，记录缺口成立条件（补丁缺失、配额非 0）。LAB_* 占位符在全局变量菜单中替换。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: step 1 runs noPac.py in default mode — the script creates a machine account, renames it, and completes the sAMAccountName spoof, and success output confirms the flaw; step 2 adds -dc-host and -shell for an interactive DC shell proving actual control; step 3 queries the domain functional level and ms-DS-MachineAccountQuota with Get-ADDomain to record gap conditions (missing patch, nonzero quota). Replace LAB_* placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh: 为全部域控安装 2021-11+ 累积更新修复 CVE-2021-42278/42287，将 ms-DS-MachineAccountQuota 置 0 或收紧机器账号创建权限；监控 4741/4742 机器账号创建与异常重命名事件。修复后用第 1 步样例回归，欺骗链路应被 KDC 拒绝。
mitigation.en: Install 2021-11+ cumulative updates on all DCs fixing CVE-2021-42278/42287, set ms-DS-MachineAccountQuota to 0 or tighten machine-account creation rights, and monitor 4741/4742 machine-account creation and abnormal renames. After the fix, regress with the step 1 sample: the spoof chain must be rejected by the KDC.

title.zh: 检查机器账号配额前提

description.zh: 用 Get-ADObject 读取 ms-DS-MachineAccountQuota 与域模式；配额大于 0 即普通用户可自建机器账号，混淆攻击有土壤。
description.en: Read ms-DS-MachineAccountQuota and the domain mode with Get-ADObject; a positive quota lets normal users create machine accounts, enabling the spoof.

title.zh: 扫描 noPac 可利用性

description.zh: 运行 noPac.py -debug 对域控检测；输出存在漏洞的判定即 sAMAccountName 混淆与 PAC 校验缺陷组合可利用。
description.en: Probe the DC with noPac.py -debug; a vulnerable verdict means the sAMAccountName spoof plus PAC-validation flaw is exploitable.

title.zh: 混淆机器账号直取域管 shell
title.en: Spoof to a domain admin shell

description.zh: 加 -dc-host 与 -shell 参数重跑；返回以域管上下文执行的交互 shell 即一步拿下域控，完成机器账号名冒充提权。
description.en: Re-run with -dc-host and -shell; the domain-admin interactive shell takes the DC in one step via machine-account name spoofing.

description.zh: 以只读 LDAP 查询替代利用脚本探测 noPac 前提；配额非 0 即可自助建机账户。
description.en: Probe the noPac prerequisite via read-only LDAP instead of exploit scripts; a non-zero quota confirms self-service machine accounts are possible.

description.zh: 零利用流量判定修复状态；未列出 KB 即 sAMAccountName 伪装面存在。
description.en: Determine fix state with zero exploit traffic; missing KBs confirm the spoofing surface exists.

description.zh: 以 AD 模块筛查缺失 $ 后缀的异常机账户；返回结果即伪装痕迹。
description.en: Screen for machine accounts missing the $ suffix via the AD module; any result marks spoofing residue.

name.zh: RBCD 委派属性与 ACL 审计
name.en: RBCD Delegation Attribute and ACL Audit

description.zh: RBCD 委派属性与 ACL 审计保留原始可复现技术命令，并将执行范围限定在书面授权、可回滚的隔离实验环境；仅修复明显占位符、纯叙述行和不可执行片段，同时要求关联身份、主机、目录、网络和安全产品证据。
description.en: RBCD Delegation Attribute and ACL Audit preserves the original reproducible technique commands while restricting execution to a written, reversible, isolated lab authorization. Only obvious placeholders, narrative-only lines, and non-executable fragments are repaired, with identity, host, directory, network, and security-product evidence required.

prerequisites.zh: 确认 RBCD 委派属性与 ACL 审计 的实验域、主机、账号、组件版本和停止条件已书面授权且可回滚。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the lab domain, host, account, component version, and stop conditions for RBCD Delegation Attribute and ACL Audit are authorized in writing and reversible.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常基线、合成对象、唯一标记、回滚快照以及身份、系统和网络日志；任何写入、远程执行或凭据操作都必须属于当前隔离实验授权。
prerequisites.en: Prepare a normal baseline, synthetic object, unique marker, rollback snapshot, and identity, system, and network logs; every write, remote execution, or credential action must be within the current isolated-lab authorization.

overview.zh: RBCD 委派属性与 ACL 审计覆盖基于资源的约束委派滥用场景：针对对目标计算机对象具有写权限的测试主体，验证能否设置 msDS-AllowedToActOnBehalfOfOtherIdentity 并模拟任意用户访问其服务。验证维度涵盖机器账号创建、委派属性写入与 S4U 票据请求三步链路。
overview.en: RBCD Delegation Attribute and ACL Audit covers resource-based constrained delegation abuse: for a test principal with write rights over the target computer object, verify whether msDS-AllowedToActOnBehalfOfOtherIdentity can be set to impersonate arbitrary users against its services. Verification dimensions cover machine-account creation, delegation attribute write, and S4U ticket requests.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是 RBCD 属性允许服务管理者指定可代表其受委派的身份，而对计算机对象持有 GenericAll/GenericWrite 的普通主体即可自行创建机器账号并写入该属性；S4U2Self/S4U2Proxy 随后产出以任意用户身份访问目标服务的可转发票据。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is that the RBCD attribute lets the service's manager designate identities allowed to delegate to it, and an ordinary principal holding GenericAll/GenericWrite on the computer object can create its own machine account and write that attribute; S4U2Self/S4U2Proxy then yields forwardable service tickets as any user against the target service.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步用 New-MachineAccount 创建受控机器账号；第 2 步用 Set-ADComputer -PrincipalsAllowedToDelegateToAccount 把该账号写入目标计算机的委派属性，读取 msDS-AllowedToActOnBehalfOfOtherIdentity 出现对应 SID 即确认成功；第 3 步用 Rubeus s4u 以机器账号哈希请求针对 CIFS 服务的模拟票据，取得 Administrator 身份的票据即确认完整链路。LAB_* 占位符在全局变量菜单中替换。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: step 1 creates the controlled machine account with New-MachineAccount; step 2 writes it into the target computer's delegation attribute with Set-ADComputer -PrincipalsAllowedToDelegateToAccount — the SID appearing in msDS-AllowedToActOnBehalfOfOtherIdentity confirms success; step 3 requests an impersonation ticket for the CIFS service with Rubeus s4u using the machine-account hash — an Administrator-identity ticket confirms the full chain. Replace LAB_* placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh: 移除普通账号对计算机对象的写权限，将 ms-DS-MachineAccountQuota 置 0 或收紧创建权限，定期审计委派属性的非预期值并监控带 S4U 标记的 4769 请求。修复后用第 2 步样例回归，属性写入应被目录拒绝。
mitigation.en: Remove ordinary accounts' write rights over computer objects, set ms-DS-MachineAccountQuota to 0 or tighten creation rights, audit unexpected delegation attribute values periodically, and monitor 4769 requests with S4U flags. After the fix, regress with the step 2 sample: the attribute write must be denied by the directory.

description.zh: 用 New-MachineAccount 以普通域用户创建受控机器账号；返回账号名与密码即获得 RBCD 委派载体。
description.en: Create a controlled machine account with New-MachineAccount as a normal user; the returned name and password are the RBCD delegation vehicle.

description.zh: 用 Set-ADComputer 把目标 PrincipalsAllowedToDelegateToAccount 指向傀儡账号；属性回查生效即劫持基于资源的约束委派。
description.en: Point the target's PrincipalsAllowedToDelegateToAccount at the puppet with Set-ADComputer; the attribute sticking on re-read hijacks resource-based constrained delegation.

description.zh: 用 Rubeus s4u 以傀儡账号申请冒充 Administrator 的 CIFS 票据；注入后以管理员身份访问目标文件服务即完成接管。
description.en: Request an Administrator-impersonating CIFS ticket with Rubeus s4u from the puppet; injecting it and reaching the target's file service completes takeover.

analysis.zh: RBCD 委派属性与 ACL 审计只有在精确版本与对象、当前主体、已审查命令输出、权威配置和服务端日志相互一致时才能确认。端口开放、工具成功、权限名称存在、状态码或单一事件只能作为线索；能力证明与漏洞结论必须分别记录。
analysis.en: RBCD Delegation Attribute and ACL Audit is confirmed only when the exact version and object, current principal, reviewed command output, authoritative configuration, and server-side logs agree. An open port, successful tool run, privilege name, status code, or single event is only a lead; capability proof and vulnerability conclusion must be recorded separately.

opsecTips.zh: 一次只查询一个实验对象并限制结果数量，不保存凭据、哈希、票据、邮箱正文或无关个人数据。
opsecTips.en: Query one lab object at a time with bounded results and do not retain credentials, hashes, tickets, mailbox content, or unrelated personal data.

opsecTips.zh: 发现超出授权的写操作、远程进程、账号变更、防护中断或非实验目标时立即停止，执行回滚并保存审计时间点。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately, roll back, and preserve the audit timestamp on any write, remote process, account change, protection gap, or non-lab target outside the authorization.

review.rationale: 只读取 msDS-AllowedToActOnBehalfOfOtherIdentity、机器账号配额和对象 ACL，不创建账号或设置委派。 该条目保留为具体技术验证卡，保留可复现攻击能力，仅修复不可执行叙述和明显占位符，并补充隔离授权、回滚和蓝队证据要求。

description.zh: 规避 PowerView 的 New-MachineAccount 模块特征：Linux 侧 LDAP 建机账户；返回成功即 RBCD 攻击体就绪。
description.en: Create the machine account via Linux-side LDAP, avoiding PowerView module signatures; success readies the RBCD attack principal.

description.zh: 替代 PowerShell 分步写属性：工具直接完成 msDS-AllowedToActOnBehalfOfOtherIdentity 写入；返回 SUCCESS 即成功。
description.en: Write the RBCD attribute in one tool-driven step replacing PowerShell; a SUCCESS return confirms it.

title.zh: AD 模块原生命令写属性

description.zh: 以官方模块替代攻击框架：管理命令写委派属性日志特征更弱；属性查询回显新值即成功。
description.en: Write the delegation attribute with the official module for a weaker log footprint; the attribute echoing the new value confirms success.

overview.zh: DCShadow 复制元数据检测审计覆盖恶意域控注册场景：针对持有域复制权限的测试主体，验证能否注册伪造域控并以复制流量推送任意目录属性修改。验证维度涵盖 primaryGroupID 修改注册暂存、/push 推送执行与 sidHistory 扩展注册三类。
overview.en: DCShadow Replication-Metadata Detection Audit covers rogue DC registration: for a test principal holding domain replication rights, verify whether a forged DC can be registered to push arbitrary directory attribute changes as replication traffic. Verification dimensions cover primaryGroupID change staging, /push execution, and sidHistory extended registration.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是目录复制协议允许持有相应权限的主体注册为复制伙伴后直接推送属性变更，绕过常规修改路径的审计；primaryGroupID、sidHistory 等特权属性可被无声改写，痕迹集中在 4929/4930/4931 等复制事件。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is that the replication protocol lets principals with the relevant rights register as replication partners and push attribute changes directly, bypassing the audit of the normal modification path; privileged attributes such as primaryGroupID and sidHistory can be rewritten silently, leaving traces concentrated in 4929/4930/4931 replication events.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步用 lsadump::dcshadow /object /attribute:primaryGroupID /value:519 注册暂存对目标对象的修改，注册成功即确认链路可用；第 2 步用 /push 以复制流量推送暂存修改，DC 返回推送完成即确认属性改写落地；第 3 步追加 sidHistory 注册项演示任意属性扩展。执行前提是复制权限与 RPC 端口可达同时满足。LAB_* 占位符在全局变量菜单中替换。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: step 1 stages the change with lsadump::dcshadow /object /attribute:primaryGroupID /value:519 — successful registration confirms the path; step 2 pushes the staged change as replication traffic with /push — the DC reporting completion confirms the attribute rewrite landed; step 3 appends a sidHistory staging entry to demonstrate arbitrary attribute extension. Prerequisites are replication rights plus RPC reachability. Replace LAB_* placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh: 收紧复制目录变更与管理复制拓扑权限，实施分层管理；对 4929/4930/4931 恶意 DC 注册与推送事件及非域控来源的复制流量实时告警。修复后用第 1 步样例回归，伪造 DC 注册应被拒绝。
mitigation.en: Tighten replicate directory changes and manage replication topology rights with tiered administration; alert in real time on 4929/4930/4931 rogue-DC registration and push events plus replication traffic from non-DC sources. After the fix, regress with the step 1 sample: rogue DC registration must be denied.

title.zh: 注册伪 DC 暂存篡改属性
title.en: Register a rogue DC with tampered data

description.zh: 以域管运行 lsadump::dcshadow 指定对象 primaryGroupID=519；属性暂存于第二个 mimikatz 实例即伪造目录服务就绪。
description.en: As domain admin run lsadump::dcshadow setting primaryGroupID=519; staged in the second mimikatz instance, the rogue directory service is ready.

title.zh: 推送变更写入域数据库

description.zh: 执行 lsadump::dcshadow /push；回查对象显示 519（企业管理员组）即域数据被直接篡改并生效。
description.en: Run lsadump::dcshadow /push; the object reading 519 (Enterprise Admins) on re-inspection means the domain data was altered for real.

title.zh: 注入 SID History 影子特权
title.en: Inject shadow privileges via SID History

description.zh: 改用 sidHistory=管理员 SID 参数重新推送；账号回查携带影子 SID 即获得绕过常规组管理的隐性特权。
description.en: Re-push with sidHistory set to an admin SID; the shadow SID visible on the account grants hidden privilege that sidesteps normal group management.

opsecTips.en: Stop immediately, roll back, and preserve the audit timestamp on any write, remote process, account change, protection gap, or non-lab target outside the authorization.

review.rationale: 核对授权域控制器清单、复制拓扑和异常目录变更事件，不注册伪造 DC 或推送属性。 该条目保留为具体技术验证卡，保留可复现攻击能力，仅修复不可执行叙述和明显占位符，并补充隔离授权、回滚和蓝队证据要求。

description.zh: 规避独立 mimikatz.exe 进程特征：以 rundll32 加载 DLL 形式执行；属性推送后 LDAP 查询值变化即成功。
description.en: Avoid a standalone mimikatz.exe process by loading via rundll32; the LDAP attribute changing after push confirms success.

description.zh: 绕过对 primaryGroupID/adminCount 等高敏属性改动的告警规则：改写 description 等低敏属性验证推送通道；值同步即成功。
description.en: Write a low-sensitivity attribute to validate the push channel past alerts on high-sensitivity changes; a synced value confirms success.

description.zh: 控制端与推送端分离执行，模拟正常复制节奏降低单进程聚合特征；第二进程推送后属性生效即成功。
description.en: Separate control and push processes to mimic normal replication pacing; the attribute taking effect after the push confirms success.

name.zh: 组策略编辑权限与变更审计

overview.zh: 组策略编辑权限与变更审计覆盖 GPO 滥用场景：针对持有 GPO 编辑权限的测试主体，验证能否通过即时任务与注册表首选项在应用范围内部署命令执行。验证维度涵盖 GpoEdit 授权枚举、GPO 即时任务创建与注册表首选项写入三类。
overview.en: Group-Policy Edit-Permission and Change Audit covers GPO abuse: for a test principal holding GPO edit rights, verify whether immediate tasks and registry preferences can deploy command execution across the GPO's scope. Verification dimensions cover GpoEdit grant enumeration, GPO immediate task creation, and registry preference writes.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是 GpoEdit 权限允许修改 GPO 内容并随客户端刷新自动应用：New-GPOImmediateTask 可注入计划任务，Set-GPPrefRegistryValue 可写 Run 键，两者都沿 SYSVOL 刷新链以高权限执行，使 GPO 编辑权等价于域内批量命令执行。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is that GpoEdit rights permit modifying GPO content that clients apply automatically on refresh: New-GPOImmediateTask injects a scheduled task and Set-GPPrefRegistryValue writes Run keys, both executing with high privilege along the SYSVOL refresh chain, so GPO edit rights equal domain-wide batch command execution.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步用 Get-GPO -All 配合 Get-GPPermission 枚举授予 Domain Users GpoEdit 权限的 GPO 清单，命中即确认可滥用授权；第 2 步用 New-GPOImmediateTask 在目标 GPO 下创建即时任务，客户端应用后命令执行即确认；第 3 步用 Set-GPPrefRegistryValue 写入 HKLM Run 启动项，客户端刷新后键值出现即确认替代路径。LAB_* 占位符在全局变量菜单中替换。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: step 1 enumerates GPOs granting Domain Users GpoEdit with Get-GPO -All plus Get-GPPermission — hits confirm abusable grants; step 2 creates an immediate task under the target GPO with New-GPOImmediateTask — command execution after client application confirms; step 3 writes an HKLM Run startup value with Set-GPPrefRegistryValue — the value appearing after client refresh confirms the alternate path. Replace LAB_* placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh: 按最小权限回收普通账号的 GpoEdit 授权并实施分层 GPO 管理；监控 GPO 版本与内容变更（5136/5141）及即时任务、首选项写入内容。修复后用第 1 步样例回归，普通账号不应再持有任何 GPO 编辑权限。
mitigation.en: Revoke GpoEdit from ordinary accounts per least privilege and adopt tiered GPO management; monitor GPO version and content changes (5136/5141) plus immediate-task and preference write contents. After the fix, regress with the step 1 sample: ordinary accounts must hold no GPO edit permissions.

description.zh: 用 Get-GPO -All 过滤 Domain Users 拥有 GpoEdit 权限的策略；返回的策略名即可被普通用户滥用的全域推送入口。
description.en: Filter Get-GPO -All for policies where Domain Users hold GpoEdit; the returned names are domain-wide push entries abusable by normal users.

title.zh: 植入即时任务下发载荷

description.zh: 用 New-GPOImmediateTask 向该 GPO 写入执行 cmd 的 Backdoor 任务；策略刷新后域内机器批量执行即载荷送达。
description.en: Write a Backdoor immediate task into the GPO with New-GPOImmediateTask; machines across the domain executing it after refresh confirm delivery.

description.zh: 用 Set-GPPrefRegistryValue 写入 HKLM Run 键指向 C:\backdoor.exe；主机重启自动加载即完成全域持久化控制。
description.en: Write the HKLM Run key to C:\backdoor.exe with Set-GPPrefRegistryValue; auto-load on reboot across the domain completes persistent control.
