prerequisites.en: Confirm that the lab domain, host, account, component version, and stop conditions for Exchange ProxyShell Patch Regression are authorized in writing and reversible.

prerequisites.en: Prepare a normal baseline, synthetic object, unique marker, rollback snapshot, and identity, system, and network logs; every write, remote execution, or credential action must be within the current isolated-lab authorization.

overview.zh: Exchange ProxyShell 补丁回归覆盖 Autodiscover 代理滥用场景：针对未安装相关安全补丁的 Exchange 服务器，验证后端代理链与邮箱数据访问链路。验证维度涵盖 autodiscover.json 代理探测、proxyshell 一键利用与手工代理请求复现三类步骤。
overview.en: Exchange ProxyShell Patch Regression covers Autodiscover proxy abuse: for Exchange servers missing the relevant security patches, verify the back-end proxy chain and mailbox data access. Verification dimensions cover the autodiscover.json proxy probe, one-shot proxyshell exploitation, and manual proxy request replay.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是 Autodiscover 端点把邮箱地址写入代理路径而未校验目标（CVE-2021-34473），后端 PowerShell 端点未强制认证（CVE-2021-34523）；两者组合使未认证用户可调用 Exchange PowerShell cmdlet 访问任意邮箱，进一步可写入 WebShell。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is the Autodiscover endpoint writing the mailbox address into the proxy path without validating the target (CVE-2021-34473) while the back-end PowerShell endpoint does not enforce authentication (CVE-2021-34523); combined, an unauthenticated user can invoke Exchange PowerShell cmdlets against any mailbox and even write a webshell.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步请求 autodiscover.json 代理路径，返回 200 即确认后端代理链路可用；第 2 步在授权实验环境运行 proxyshell.py，输出可访问的 WebShell 路径即确认完整利用；第 3 步用手工 GET 把请求转发至后端 /owa/，返回目标邮箱信息即确认代理与身份绕过同时成立。EXCHANGE_HOST 等占位符在全局变量菜单中替换为目标值。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: step 1 requests the autodiscover.json proxy path — a 200 confirms the back-end proxy chain; step 2 runs proxyshell.py in an authorized lab — a printed accessible webshell path confirms full exploitation; step 3 forwards the request to the back-end /owa/ with a manual GET — returned mailbox information confirms both proxying and identity bypass. Replace EXCHANGE_HOST and other placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh: 升级至受支持 CU 并安装覆盖三个 CVE 的安全更新，运行 Health Checker 核验；限制 Autodiscover/PowerShell 虚拟目录暴露并审计 PowerShell 管道调用与邮箱访问记录。修复后用第 1 步样例回归，代理路径应返回 401/404。
mitigation.en: Upgrade to a supported CU and install security updates covering the three CVEs, verifying with the Health Checker; restrict Autodiscover/PowerShell virtual directory exposure and audit PowerShell pipeline invocations and mailbox access records. After the fix, regress with the step 1 sample: the proxy path must return 401/404.

title.zh: 探测 autodiscover 认证旁路

description.zh: 用 curl 请求 autodiscover.json?@域/mapi/npsi 变形路径；返回接口数据而非登录跳转即认证绕过成立。
description.en: Request the autodiscover.json?@domain/mapi/nspi variant with curl; API data instead of a login redirect confirms the auth bypass.

title.zh: 链式利用导出邮箱与写权限
title.en: Chain the exploit to mail and write access

description.zh: 运行 proxyshell.py 指定管理员邮箱；依次输出 SID、邮件内容与可写路径即完成 SSRF 到 Exchange 管控面的贯穿。
description.en: Run proxyshell.py with the admin mailbox; SID, mailbox contents and writable paths printed in sequence complete the SSRF-to-Exchange-control chain.

description.zh: 以 Email 参数构造 GET /owa/ 请求；返回邮箱界面即能以目标身份收发邮件，可借重置链接接管关联账号。
description.en: Build the GET /owa/ request with the Email parameter; the mailbox UI lets you send and receive as the victim and hijack linked accounts via reset links.

analysis.zh: Exchange ProxyShell 补丁回归只有在精确版本与对象、当前主体、已审查命令输出、权威配置和服务端日志相互一致时才能确认。端口开放、工具成功、权限名称存在、状态码或单一事件只能作为线索；能力证明与漏洞结论必须分别记录。
analysis.en: Exchange ProxyShell Patch Regression is confirmed only when the exact version and object, current principal, reviewed command output, authoritative configuration, and server-side logs agree. An open port, successful tool run, privilege name, status code, or single event is only a lead; capability proof and vulnerability conclusion must be recorded separately.

opsecTips.zh: 一次只查询一个实验对象并限制结果数量，不保存凭据、哈希、票据、邮箱正文或无关个人数据。
opsecTips.en: Query one lab object at a time with bounded results and do not retain credentials, hashes, tickets, mailbox content, or unrelated personal data.

opsecTips.zh: 发现超出授权的写操作、远程进程、账号变更、防护中断或非实验目标时立即停止，执行回滚并保存审计时间点。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately, roll back, and preserve the audit timestamp on any write, remote process, account change, protection gap, or non-lab target outside the authorization.

review.rationale: 核对 Exchange 版本、补丁和 Autodiscover/PowerShell 路由边界，不访问邮箱或执行命令。 该条目保留为具体技术验证卡，保留可复现攻击能力，仅修复不可执行叙述和明显占位符，并补充隔离授权、回滚和蓝队证据要求。

description.zh: 绕过对 autodiscover.json?@ 拼接特征（ProxyShell 标志）的规则：分别对 ? 和 @ 做 %3F %40 编码乃至双重编码 %253F，客户端证书豁免逻辑按 Email 前缀解析仍生效；成功判据：响应为 200/301 而非 401，且证书认证被跳过（无 WWW-Authenticate 提示）。
description.en: Bypasses rules on the signature autodiscover.json?@ splice: encoding ? and @ as %3F %40 with double-encoding %253F keeps the client-cert exempt parsing by Email prefix intact; success criterion: a 200/301 instead of 401 with client-cert authentication skipped (no WWW-Authenticate challenge).

description.zh: 绕过大小写敏感或按规范化前字面匹配的路径规则：目录大小写、点段插入、双斜杠与 %2e 变形在 Exchange 前端规范化后仍路由到 MAPI 后端；成功判据：状态码与原始请求一致（非 401），证明仍走了 ProxyShell 豁免链。
description.en: Bypasses case-sensitive or pre-normalization literal path rules: directory case, dot segments, doubled slashes and %2e still route to the MAPI backend after front-end normalization; success criterion: status codes match the original request (not 401), proving the ProxyShell exempt chain still applied.

description.zh: 绕过对 &Email= 参数特征匹配的规则：HPP 双 Email 取值、参数名小写 email、尾随无害参数 X-Pad 改变查询串形状而解析结果不变；成功判据：仍返回 200 且 Autodiscover/MAPI 响应内容与原请求一致。
description.en: Bypasses rules matching the &Email= parameter signature: HPP double-Email values, lowercase email name and a trailing X-Pad parameter reshape the query without changing parsed results; success criterion: still 200 with Autodiscover/MAPI bodies identical to the original request.

description.zh: 绕过只盯 /mapi/nspi 特征的拦截：同一 autodiscover.json 豁免链可换接 /mapi/emsmdb（代理登录端点）或 /EWS，再以 POST + MAPI 头完成认证；成功判据：emsmdb Authenticate 返回 200 且带 X-ResponseId/MAPI 会话 Cookie（与 ProxyShell 链一致）。
description.en: Bypasses blocks fixated on /mapi/nspi: the same autodiscover.json exemption chain attaches to /mapi/emsmdb (proxy logon endpoint) or /EWS, then completes auth via POST with MAPI headers; success criterion: emsmdb Authenticate returns 200 with X-ResponseId/MAPI session cookies as in the ProxyShell chain.

name.zh: Exchange ProxyToken 授权回归

description.zh: Exchange ProxyToken 授权回归保留原始可复现技术命令，并将执行范围限定在书面授权、可回滚的隔离实验环境；仅修复明显占位符、纯叙述行和不可执行片段，同时要求关联身份、主机、目录、网络和安全产品证据。
description.en: Exchange ProxyToken Authorization Regression preserves the original reproducible technique commands while restricting execution to a written, reversible, isolated lab authorization. Only obvious placeholders, narrative-only lines, and non-executable fragments are repaired, with identity, host, directory, network, and security-product evidence required.

prerequisites.zh: 确认 Exchange ProxyToken 授权回归 的实验域、主机、账号、组件版本和停止条件已书面授权且可回滚。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the lab domain, host, account, component version, and stop conditions for Exchange ProxyToken Authorization Regression are authorized in writing and reversible.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常基线、合成对象、唯一标记、回滚快照以及身份、系统和网络日志；任何写入、远程执行或凭据操作都必须属于当前隔离实验授权。
prerequisites.en: Prepare a normal baseline, synthetic object, unique marker, rollback snapshot, and identity, system, and network logs; every write, remote execution, or credential action must be within the current isolated-lab authorization.

overview.zh: Exchange ProxyToken 授权回归覆盖令牌反序列化与代理组合场景：针对未安装相关安全补丁的 Exchange 服务器，验证无认证用户能否借 X-ClientApplication 代理获得邮箱访问能力。验证维度涵盖 proxytoken 一键利用、附加模式操作与端点暴露核对三类。
overview.en: Exchange ProxyToken Authorization Regression covers token deserialization combined with proxying: for Exchange servers missing the relevant security patches, verify whether an unauthenticated user can gain mailbox access via the X-ClientApplication proxy. Verification dimensions cover one-shot proxytoken exploitation, append-mode operations, and endpoint exposure checks.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是 Exchange 前端允许未认证请求携带 X-ClientApplication 头进入代理路径，后端 SecurityToken 反序列化缺陷与代理身份混淆组合，使攻击者无需口令即可冒充已有会话读取目标邮箱。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is that the Exchange front end lets unauthenticated requests carrying the X-ClientApplication header enter proxy paths; the back-end SecurityToken deserialization flaw combined with proxy identity confusion lets an attacker impersonate an existing session and read the target mailbox without a password.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步在授权实验环境运行 proxytoken.py，获得目标邮箱访问能力即确认利用成功；第 2 步用 -a 附加模式完成后续邮箱操作并输出结果；第 3 步用 curl 向 /ews/Exchange.asmx 携带 X-ClientApplication 头探测，返回可访问响应即确认端点暴露面。EXCHANGE_HOST 等占位符在全局变量菜单中替换为目标值。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: step 1 runs proxytoken.py in an authorized lab — mailbox access confirms exploitation; step 2 performs follow-up mailbox operations in append mode (-a) and reviews the output; step 3 probes /ews/Exchange.asmx with curl carrying the X-ClientApplication header — an accessible response confirms endpoint exposure. Replace EXCHANGE_HOST and other placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh: 安装覆盖该缺陷的安全更新并升级至受支持 CU，限制 EWS/Autodiscover 暴露并审计异常邮箱权限与会话使用；监控携带异常 X-ClientApplication 的请求。修复后用第 1、3 步样例回归，利用应失败且端点响应受限。
mitigation.en: Install the security update covering the flaw and upgrade to a supported CU, restrict EWS/Autodiscover exposure, audit anomalous mailbox permissions and session usage, and monitor requests with unusual X-ClientApplication values. After the fix, regress with the step 1 and step 3 samples: exploitation must fail and endpoint responses must be restricted.

description.zh: 运行 proxytoken.py 指定目标与邮箱探测；返回可达的 OWA 端点即目标 Exchange 未修复该授权缺陷。
description.en: Probe with proxytoken.py against target and mailbox; a reachable OWA endpoint returned means the Exchange lacks the ProxyToken fix.

description.zh: 加 -a 参数重放中转请求访问收件箱路径；响应携带目标收件箱邮件内容即无需任何凭据即可读取他人邮箱。
description.en: Replay the relayed request with -a; the victim's inbox contents returned mean reading mail without any credentials.

title.zh: 直调 EWS 批量收割

description.zh: 用 curl 携带 X-ClientApplication 头访问 /ews/Exchange.asmx；SOAP 查询成功即可脚本化批量导出邮件与附件。
description.en: Call /ews/Exchange.asmx with the X-ClientApplication header via curl; working SOAP queries enable scripted bulk export of mail and attachments.

analysis.zh: Exchange ProxyToken 授权回归只有在精确版本与对象、当前主体、已审查命令输出、权威配置和服务端日志相互一致时才能确认。端口开放、工具成功、权限名称存在、状态码或单一事件只能作为线索；能力证明与漏洞结论必须分别记录。
analysis.en: Exchange ProxyToken Authorization Regression is confirmed only when the exact version and object, current principal, reviewed command output, authoritative configuration, and server-side logs agree. An open port, successful tool run, privilege name, status code, or single event is only a lead; capability proof and vulnerability conclusion must be recorded separately.

opsecTips.zh: 一次只查询一个实验对象并限制结果数量，不保存凭据、哈希、票据、邮箱正文或无关个人数据。
opsecTips.en: Query one lab object at a time with bounded results and do not retain credentials, hashes, tickets, mailbox content, or unrelated personal data.

opsecTips.zh: 发现超出授权的写操作、远程进程、账号变更、防护中断或非实验目标时立即停止，执行回滚并保存审计时间点。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately, roll back, and preserve the audit timestamp on any write, remote process, account change, protection gap, or non-lab target outside the authorization.

review.rationale: 核对精确版本、补丁和前后端授权响应，不伪造 X-ClientApplication 或授予邮箱权限。 该条目保留为具体技术验证卡，保留可复现攻击能力，仅修复不可执行叙述和明显占位符，并补充隔离授权、回滚和蓝队证据要求。

description.zh: 绕过拦截 X-ClientApplication: Test 精确值的规则：ProxyToken 依赖 DelegatedAuth 对该头"非空即信任"，因此换成合法 Outlook UA 值、头名小写或复合值均触发同一信任分支；成功判据：请求未弹 Basic 认证（无 WWW-Authenticate: Basic）而直接进入 EWS 处理。
description.en: Bypasses rules blocking the exact X-ClientApplication: Test value: DelegatedAuth trusts any non-empty value, so a legitimate Outlook UA string, lowercase header name or composite value hits the same trust branch; success criterion: no Basic challenge (no WWW-Authenticate: Basic) and the request proceeds into EWS handling.

description.zh: 绕过对 /ews/Exchange.asmx 精确路径的检测与速率限制：大小写、尾斜杠、点段、%23 截断与查询串追加在 EWS 前端规范化后命中同一终结点；成功判据：所有变形返回同原始路径一致的响应码与服务器头（含 X-DiagInfo 指纹）。
description.en: Bypasses detection and rate limits on the exact /ews/Exchange.asmx path: case, trailing slash, dot segments, %23 truncation and appended query strings normalize to the same endpoint; success criterion: all variants return response codes and server headers (X-DiagInfo fingerprint) identical to the original path.

description.zh: 绕过对 "Authorization: Negotiate <token>" 固定模板的规则：scheme 与 token 间用制表符、头名小写、scheme 全大写及双 Authorization 头（取其一）等形态在 IIS/HttpListener 解析中等价；成功判据：变形请求仍以受害者身份通过 Negotiate 验证（响应含其邮箱上下文而非 401）。
description.en: Bypasses rules on the fixed "Authorization: Negotiate <token>" template: a tab between scheme and token, lowercase header name, uppercase scheme and duplicate Authorization headers (one honored) parse equivalently in IIS/HttpListener; success criterion: the variant still authenticates as the victim (mailbox context in response, not 401).

title.zh: 方法版本差异与 SOAP 内联

wafBypass.command:
curl -sk --http1.0 -X POST https://{EXCHANGE_HOST}/ews/Exchange.asmx -H "X-ClientApplication: Test" -H "Authorization: Negotiate {LAB_VALUE}" -H "Content-Type: text/xml; charset=utf-8" --data-binary "<soap:Envelope xmlns:soap=\"http://schemas.xmlsoap.org/soap/envelope/\"><soap:Body><ResolveNames xmlns=\"http://schemas.microsoft.com/exchange/services/2006/messages\" ReturnFullContactData=\"0\"><UnresolvedEntry>{LAB_USER}</UnresolvedEntry></ResolveNames></soap:Body></soap:Envelope>" -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n"
curl -sk -X POST https://{EXCHANGE_HOST}/EWS/Exchange.asmx/ -H "X-ClientApplication: Test" -H "Authorization: Negotiate {LAB_VALUE}" -H "Content-Type: application/soap+xml" -d "<soap:Envelope xmlns:soap=\"http://schemas.xmlsoap.org/soap/envelope/\"><soap:Body><GetFolder xmlns=\"http://schemas.microsoft.com/exchange/services/2006/messages\"/></soap:Body></soap:Envelope>" -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n"

description.zh: 绕过仅对 GET/HTTP1.1 或无体请求建模的防护：HTTP/1.0 + POST + 内联 SOAP（ResolveNames/GetFolder）携带 DelegatedAuth 头组合直达 EWS 数据面；成功判据：返回 200 且 SOAP 响应包含目标邮箱解析/文件夹结果，证明代理认证链未拦截。
description.en: Bypasses defenses modeling only GET/HTTP1.1 or bodyless requests: HTTP/1.0 + POST + inline SOAP (ResolveNames/GetFolder) carries the DelegatedAuth header set straight to the EWS data plane; success criterion: 200 with SOAP results for the target mailbox, proving the proxy auth chain did not block it.
